title: Erfaren markarbetare sökes till projekt inom el & fiber  Piteå
description:
Är du en erfaren markarbetare som söker nya utmaningar inom bygg och anläggning? Vi söker nu engagerade och självgående markarbetare till projekt inom el- och fiberutbyggnad i Piteå.

Hos oss får du arbeta i varierande projekt med fokus på kvalitet, säkerhet och samarbete. Vi erbjuder en stabil arbetsplats där du blir en viktig del av ett professionellt team som arbetar med framtidens infrastruktur.

Om tjänsten

Som markarbetare kommer du att arbeta med förläggning av el- och fiberkablar i olika typer av mark- och anläggningsprojekt. Arbetsuppgifterna innefattar bland annat kabeldragning, rörläggning, schaktarbete, spadarbete samt arbete med mindre maskiner och verktyg.

Arbetet är varierande och ställer krav på noggrannhet, ansvarstagande och god samarbetsförmåga. Du arbetar både självständigt och tillsammans med kollegor ute på projekt.

Vi söker dig som

Har erfarenhet av markarbete inom el, fiber eller anläggning

Har erfarenhet av kabeldragning, rörläggning och schaktarbete

Är van att arbeta efter ritningar och följa säkerhetsföreskrifter

Har god arbetsmoral och trivs med fysiskt arbete utomhus

Har grundläggande kunskaper i svenska eller engelska

Är ansvarstagande, lösningsorienterad och samarbetar väl med andra

Meriterande certifikat och utbildningar

Arbete på väg 1 & 2

ESA-19

Heta Arbeten

Erfarenhet av arbete med småmaskiner

Vi erbjuder

Ett varierande arbete inom en växande och framtidssäker bransch

Spännande projekt inom el- och fiberutbyggnad

Möjlighet till vidareutbildning och kompetensutveckling

Ett professionellt och engagerat team

Bra arbetsmiljö och god sammanhållning

Därför ska du välja oss

Hos oss blir du en del av ett företag som värdesätter erfarenhet, kvalitet och yrkesstolthet. Vi arbetar långsiktigt och erbjuder en arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att utvecklas samtidigt som du bidrar till viktiga samhällsprojekt.

Anställningsform

Tjänsten är en tidsbegränsad anställning på 6 månader med god möjlighet till förlängning beroende på projektens utveckling.

Ansökan

Låter detta som rätt möjlighet för dig? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag – urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

title: Konsulentti / myynninedistäjä
description:
Red Barons Azeite on neljän ystävän perustama yritys, joka tuo käsin poimituista oliiveista valmistettua portugalilaista huippuöljyä Suomeen. Teemme asiat laadukkaasti, mutta rennolla otteella.

Tavoitteenamme on kasvaa Suomen ja pohjoismaiden tunnetuimmaksi oliiviöljy-brändiksi. Samalla haluamme kasvattaa tuoteperhettämme laadukkailla portugalilaisilla elintarvikkeilla.

Haemme kasvavaan tiimiimme iloista ja oma-aloitteista tuote-esittelijää (konsulenttia) edustamaan ja maistattamaan tuotteita päivittäistavarakaupoissa.

Työssäsi järjestät maistatuksia, esittelet tuotteitamme ja kerrot asiakkaille niiden käytöstä sekä ominaisuuksista. Tavoitteena on lisätä tuotteidemme tunnettuutta ja kasvattaa myyntiä myymälöissä.

Työtehtävät

- Tuotteiden maistatukset ruokakaupoissa

- Tuotteiden esittely ja asiakkaiden neuvonta

- Myynnin edistäminen

- Tuotteiden esillepanon ylläpitäminen

- Asiakaspalautteen kerääminen

Toivomme sinulta

- Reipasta asiakaspalveluasennetta

- Rohkeutta kohdata ihmisiä

- Kiinnostusta oliiviöljyyn ruokaan ja ruoanlaittoon

- Hyvää suomen kielen taitoa

Katsomme eduksi

- Aikaisemman myynti- tai asiakaspalvelukokemuksen

- Hygieniapassin

Tarjoamme

- Joustavan osa-aikatyön, jossa pääset itse vaikuttamaan työtahtiisi

- Kattavan perehdytyksen oliiviöljyn ja myynnin saloihin

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa työvuoroihin

- Mahdollisuuden kasvaa yrityksen mukana myös laajempiin myynnin ja markkinoinnin tehtäviin

Työpäivät sijoittuvat pääosin torstaille, perjantaille ja lauantaille. Työvuoron pituus on noin 4-5 tuntia.

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

Työskentely tapahtuu Helsingin, Tampereen tai Turun alueella.

Palkka

Palkkaus sopimuksen mukaan, Muu | Other

title: Drainage Lead (Rail & Metro) - KSA
description:
Saudi Arabia | Drainage Lead (Rail & Metro)

Join Sener and Shape the Future of Rail Infrastructure

At Sener, we are delivering some of the region's most complex and innovative Rail & Metro infrastructure projects. We are looking for a Drainage Lead to join our team in Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will support a major 8-year PMC rail project in Riyadh, where you'll lead the production, coordination, and technical delivery of Drainage and Wet Utilities design for landmark railway projects.

If you're passionate about engineering excellence, thrive in multidisciplinary design environments, and enjoy leading complex infrastructure projects, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the production, coordination, and technical review of Drainage and Wet Utilities design for Rail & Metro infrastructure projects.

  • Manage the Drainage design team to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality engineering solutions.

  • Develop and review stormwater drainage, sewerage, and wet utilities designs in accordance with project requirements and applicable standards.

  • Coordinate closely with Civil, Structures, Geotechnical, Roads, Track, Utilities, Architecture, Systems, and BIM teams to ensure fully integrated design solutions.

  • Ensure compliance with client requirements, Saudi regulations, AASHTO standards, EN Standards, and other applicable engineering codes.

  • Lead multidisciplinary design reviews, technical workshops, constructability reviews, and value engineering initiatives.

  • Review contractor design submissions, RFIs, engineering proposals, and design changes.

  • Provide technical leadership and resolve complex engineering and coordination challenges throughout the design lifecycle.

  • Mentor and develop Drainage engineers while promoting technical excellence and best practices.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in civil engineering or a related engineering discipline.

  • Minimum 15 years of overall engineering experience.

  • Minimum 10 years of mandatory Rail & Metro experience.

  • Proven experience leading the production, coordination, and review of detailed design for drainage, sewerage, and wet utilities infrastructure.

  • Extensive experience in stormwater drainage, sewerage, and wet utilities design for Rail & Metro infrastructure projects.

  • Experience in potable water design is not required; the primary focus is on drainage, sewerage, and wet utilities.

  • Strong knowledge of AASHTO standards, EN Standards, Saudi Codes, and applicable engineering standards.

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering coordination on complex infrastructure projects.

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and MicroStation.

  • Experience delivering designs across concept, preliminary, detailed, and IFC design stages.

  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Fluent in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with international engineering consultancies.

  • Familiarity with GCC railway standards and Saudi regulations.

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary design teams across multiple project phases.

  • Experience with BIM-enabled design coordination and digital engineering workflows.

Why Join Sener?

  • Multinational working environment

  • High-impact, large-scale Rail & Metro projects

  • End-to-end project ownership

  • Career development and growth opportunities

  • Mentorship and continuous learning

  • Hybrid working environment

  • Competitive salary and benefits

  • Stable, long-term career with an innovative company

  • Collaborative and supportive team culture

  • Opportunity to make a real impact

BE PART OF A MISSION THAT MATTERS — JOIN SENER

If you are passionate about engineering excellence, value meaningful work, and want to be part of a company that designs infrastructure that makes a lasting impact, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Product Director, Higher Education & School Boards
description:
The Role

Unit4 is a market leader for ERP and finance solutions across universities, colleges, and the Canadian K-12 school board market. Higher education faces structural funding pressure, growing research complexity, and the demands of an increasingly digital student experience. School boards navigate provincial funding compliance, trustee governance, and the operational weight of collective agreements across large, geographically distributed organizations. As Product Director for Higher Education and K-12, you own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap that makes Unit4 the platform of choice across these institutions.

This is not an account management or advisory role. You will have dedicated engineering capacity to build vertical depth that distinguishes Unit4 in this market - capabilities that matter to a university CFO managing a research portfolio, a registrar navigating financial aid complexity, or a Superintendent of Business in a school board managing provincial budget allocations. You will work closely with horizontal product teams to ensure the platform delivers end-to-end, but the vertical product strategy is yours.

The right person has built enterprise software for higher education institutions or K-12 school boards. You understand the funding models, the compliance obligations, and where current systems fall short. You have shipped features that research finance officers, HR directors, and school board finance teams actually use.

AI is reshaping higher education from multiple directions simultaneously. Research institutions are navigating AI-assisted grant workflows, evolving indirect cost models, and new data governance obligations from research funders. Administratively, AI offers real efficiency gains across finance, procurement, and HR. Capturing those gains while maintaining the rigorous data governance, academic integrity, and accreditation standards these institutions operate within is the defining challenge. This role requires someone who understands both sides and can build a product roadmap that helps institutions move forward with confidence.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Higher Education and K-12 product vision, strategy, and multi-horizon roadmap; align it with Unit4's platform strategy and commercial growth targets.

  • Lead a prioritized product backlog with dedicated engineering capacity - defining outcomes, success metrics, release plans, and quality criteria.

  • Translate deep sector knowledge into specific, investment-backed product requirements: problem statements, opportunity sizing, and build-vs-partner decisions.

  • Define industry-specific solution blueprints, reference configurations, and pre-built templates for HE and K-12 institutions.

  • Work closely with horizontal product teams to ensure HE and K-12 requirements are reflected in platform investment across finance, HR, procurement, and research management.

  • Partner with the Industry Growth Director on launch readiness, pricing, packaging, and field enablement for new capabilities.

  • Engage directly with strategic customers and the HE Industry Board to validate roadmap direction, co-innovate, and capture outcome evidence.

  • Ensure regulatory, accessibility, research-compliance, and provincial requirements across our supported geographies are systematically reflected in the roadmap.

  • Monitor the competitive landscape - know what Ellucian, Workday, Microsoft, Tribal Group, and others are shipping and what it means for Unit4's positioning.

  • Work with partners to extend the value proposition for HE and K-12 customers.

  • Own feature outcomes, not just delivery - define clear adoption, usage, and customer impact goals for every capability you champion, and track performance against them after launch.

  • Serve as the internal authority on the Higher Education and K-12 verticals, providing product, marketing, analyst relations, and pre-sales teams with the industry grounding they need to position, demonstrate, and sell effectively.

What You'll Bring

  • Proven product management experience building enterprise software - ERP, finance systems, or enterprise SaaS - for higher education institutions or K-12 school boards. You have shipped products used by HE finance teams, research administrators, or school board operations staff, not just studied the sector.

  • Deep working knowledge of higher education finance: research grant accounting, fund and restricted-fund accounting, full economic costing, endowments, and tuition revenue models.

  • For the K-12 dimension: working knowledge of provincial ministry funding formulas, trustee governance and board reporting, school-level budget delegation, and collective agreement administration.

  • Understanding of the student lifecycle interfaces - financial aid, tuition management, integration with student information systems - and what they demand from the ERP layer.

  • A clear point of view on how AI is reshaping the research enterprise and administrative operations of HE institutions, and what responsible, governance-compliant product decisions look like in this context.

  • Commercial orientation: you understand how product decisions drive ARR, win rate, and customer retention.

  • Strong communication skills at CFO, VP Finance, Superintendent of Business, and senior academic and school board leadership level.

  • Experience in product management for enterprise SaaS platforms.

  • Deep understanding of professional services business models, including project-based delivery, utilization, billing, scheduling and compliance.

  • Strong ability to influence without authority and work cross-functionally in a matrixed environment.

  • Proven ability to translate complex industry needs into scalable product solutions.

  • Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with ERP or PSA platforms

  • Familiarity with mid-market services firms and their operational challenges.

  • Familiarity with in AI-driven or data-rich product environments.

Who we are?

We are a people-first community that nurtures all the areas that surround your working experience. With us, you’ll be surrounded by a high-performance team that supports your authentic self and celebrates your uniqueness.

We believe that ‘How work should feel’ is an evolving statement. Work goes beyond tasks and everyday responsibilities it’s about feeling valued, empowered, promoted, impactful, seen, and appreciated. We are reimagining how work makes people feel.

What we offer

  • a culture built on trust and accountability - giving you the freedom and autonomy to be successful and make an impact
  • balance - with our Flexible Leave Paid Time Off policy, remote working opportunities, Global Wellbeing Days, and other great benefits
  • growth opportunities - we provide the tools and guidance required so that you can focus on what really matters to you and so, ultimately, you can achieve your best work
  • talented colleagues, role models and mentors - work, learn and be inspired by some of the best talent in the software industry
  • a commitment to sustainability - with initiatives such as our Environmental, Social, and Governance strategy and Act4Good programme
  • a safe and inclusive working environment – supported by our Employee Resource Groups, which are open to all.

Our commitment to equity

Unit4 is committed to ensuring equal opportunity for everyone. We make our hiring decisions solely based on skills, qualifications, and our current business needs. We know that diversity brings fresh perspectives, ideas, and solutions to our company. This is the essence of our culture. We also welcome and encourage people who are pregnant and/or parents-to-be to apply. If you would like to know more about our commitment to diversity, visit our blogs:

  • Our focus to DEI remains central to who we are
  • Inclusive hiring at Unit4: Building equal opportunities for all

This role may require security clearance required for customer projects and access to sensitive (customer) data. That means that after you have accepted our offer, we could ask for background checks. Subject to applicable local laws, such security checks may require disclosure of personal information including criminal record declaration, right to work, personal identification and work history. No worries though – we'll handle it according to local privacy laws and keep your info safe. Questions? Feel free to reach out!

Salary range: 110,788 - 121,863 EUR

title: Markarbetare sökes till vår kund i Skellefteå
description:
Är du redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär inom bygg och anläggning – eller vill du prova något nytt i en praktisk och utvecklande roll? Vi söker nu engagerade markarbetare till vårt team i Skellefteå. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta i en dynamisk och växande arbetsmiljö där kvalitet och lagarbete står i fokus.

Om rollen

Som markarbetare kommer du att arbeta med varierande uppgifter inom mark- och anläggningsarbete. Arbetet innefattar bland annat plattsättning, rörläggning, vägarbeten, justering och dränering.

Du kommer även att arbeta med småmaskiner och nivålaser samt delta i projekt såsom staketbyggnation, asfaltering och kantstensinstallation. Rollen innebär ett praktiskt arbete utomhus där du bidrar till att skapa hållbara och funktionella lösningar i våra projekt.

Ingen dag är den andra lik, och du blir en viktig del av ett team som levererar kvalitet i varje steg.

Vi söker dig som

  • Har en positiv inställning och vilja att utvecklas
  • Har goda kunskaper i svenska eller engelska i tal och skrift
  • Har giltigt Arbete på väg 1 och 2 (krav)
  • Har erfarenhet av eller intresse för kantstensarbete och markarbeten
  • Har grundläggande erfarenhet av spadarbete, dränering och arbete med småmaskiner

Meriterande:

  • ESA-19
  • Heta Arbeten

Vi erbjuder

  • En aktiv och varierad arbetsmiljö med arbete utomhus
  • Goda möjligheter till utveckling inom bygg- och anläggningsbranschen
  • Utbildning och möjlighet att stärka dina certifieringar
  • Ett stöttande och engagerat team med stark gemenskap
  • Ett tidsbegränsat projekt på cirka fem månader, med möjlighet till förlängning

Om oss

Vi arbetar med projekt som utvecklar och förbättrar samhällsinfrastruktur. Hos oss blir du en del av ett team där engagemang, kvalitet och yrkesstolthet är centralt. Vi värdesätter både erfarenhet och rätt inställning, och tror på att utveckling sker genom samarbete och ansvar.

Vill du vara med och bygga framtidens projekt i Skellefteå? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig. Rekrytering sker löpande.

title: [회계팀] 경영지원실 회계담당자 (3년 이상)
description:
About

"우리는 치과를 넘어, 메디컬의 새로운 표준을 만듭니다."

똑똑플란트치과의원은 강남의 중심에서 매년 폭발적인 성장을 거듭하며, 설립 4년 만에 130여 명의 유능한 동료들이 함께하는 대형 의료기관으로 자리 잡았습니다.

우리의 성장은 단순히 병원 안에만 머무르지 않습니다. 전문적인 병원 경영지원(MSO) 법인을 독립적으로 운영하며 효율적인 시스템을 구축했고, 현재는 병의원 비즈니스의 경계를 넘어 다양한 영역으로 사업을 다각화하며 거침없이 확장하고 있습니다.

안정적인 기반 위에서 스타트업처럼 과감하게 도전하고 빠르게 실행하는 조직, 똑똑플란트에서 폭풍 성장이라는 짜릿한 여정에 합류할 회계 담당자를 기다립니다.

[포지션 소개]

똑똑플란트의 경영지원실 회계 담당자는 단순히 숫자를 기록하는 행정 지원자가 아닙니다. 빠르게 성장하는 병원과 MSO 법인의 재무 건전성을 확보하고, 투명하고 정교한 회계 시스템을 운영하는 '재무 인프라의 핵심 구축자' 입니다.

130여 명의 동료들과 여러 사업 부문이 거침없이 확장할 수 있는 바탕에는 정확한 전표 처리와 빈틈없는 자금 집행으로 단단한 재무적 버팀목이 되어주는 회계 담당자가 있습니다.

수많은 지출 내역을 세밀하게 검토하고, 법인 및 병원의 자금 흐름을 명확히 정산하며, 부가세 신고와 결산 보조를 통해 내실을 다지는 일은 똑똑플란트의 지속 가능한 성장을 이끄는 원동력입니다. 숫자에 대한 꼼꼼함과 책임감을 바탕으로 메디컬의 새로운 표준을 함께 만들어갈 능력 있는 동료의 지원을 기다립니다.

Responsibilities

• 전표 처리 및 비용 관리 총괄 | 더존 위하고(WEHAGO)를 활용해 병원과 MSO 법인의 전표 처리, 기업카드 사용 내역 검토, 월별 정산 보고를 정확하고 투명하게 관리합니다.
• 안정적인 자금 집행 및 보고 | 사업 확장에 따른 자금 흐름을 면밀히 파악하고, 신속·정확한 자금 집행과 정기적인 재무 보고를 통해 경영진의 의사결정을 지원합니다.
• 세무 신고 및 결산 보조 | 부가가치세 신고 실무를 주도적으로 수행하며, 월/연 결산 보조 업무를 통해 법인과 병원의 재무 건전성을 단단하게 다집니다.
• 경영지원 재무·회계 기틀 마련 | 다각화되는 비즈니스 구조 속에서 발생하는 회계 이슈를 선제적으로 체크하고, 전반적인 재무·회계 인프라를 정교하게 세팅합니다.

Requirements

• 3년 이상의 회계/재무 실무 경력 | 전표 처리부터 자금 집행, 결산 보조까지 회계 전반의 흐름을 다뤄본 3년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분을 찾습니다.
• 핵심 회계 툴(더존 WEHAGO) 활용 가능자 | 더존 위하고(WEHAGO) 시스템을 활용한 회계 데이터 처리 및 관리에 익숙하신 분이어야 합니다.
• 엑셀(Excel) 데이터 관리 역량 | 기본 함수 활용은 물론, 대량의 지출 데이터 및 자금 내역을 엑셀로 깔끔하게 정리하고 가공할 수 있는 분을 찾습니다.
• 꼼꼼함과 높은 책임감 | 숫자 하나 놓치지 않는 디테일한 업무 태도와 강한 책임감을 바탕으로 자금 관리 업무를 신뢰 있게 완수하시는 분이 필요합니다.

Preferred

• 병의원 및 MSO 관련 실무 경험 | 메디컬 도메인이나 병원 경영지원(MSO) 법인에서 회계/재무 업무를 경험해 보신 분을 우대합니다.
• 관련 학과 전공자 및 자격증 소지자 | 회계, 재무, 세무, 경영 관련 학과를 전공하셨거나 관련 자격증(전산세무, 전산회계 등)을 보유하신 분을 우대합니다.
• 원활한 커뮤니케이션 및 신속한 출근 | 다양한 부서와의 명확하고 원활한 소통 능력을 갖추신 분 그리고 합류 확정 시 즉시 출근이 가능하신 분을 우대합니다.

Benefits

똑똑플란트치과 복지 혜택

Work & Life
• 풍족한 삼시세끼 제공 | 직원 식당에서 아침, 점심, 야간진료 시 저녁 식사까지 모두 제공합니다.
• 부서 운영비 지원 | 돈독한 팀워크를 위해 부서별 간식비와 회식비를 아낌없이 지원합니다.
• 업무 추진비 지급 | 직급에 따른 특별 복지카드를 지급합니다. (대상자에 한함)
• 안정적인 미래 지원 | 든든한 내일을 위해 DC형 퇴직연금에 가입합니다.


Wellness & Family

title: Product Control Analyst
description:
The Product Control Analyst (PC) role supports all day-to-day running of the trading desk, ensuring a detailed position summary is kept for the traders and for the matrix as a whole (if applicable) and that the traders' exposures are monitored. This may involve the consolidation of data for the trading matrix.

The PC is also accountable for a broader range of activities on the desk, e.g. risk/ exposure of trades and ensuring exposure is properly documented and calculated in a consistent manner, the monitoring of futures that are near expiry (where applicable), and determining what to hedge (upon checking with traders).

The PC is expected to provide commentary on the daily profitability reports to explain P&L movements - this requires the PA to have a strong understanding of the P&L and other relevant market information related to the matrix.

The PC provides all management information and decision support to the traders, e.g. creating reports and/or undertaking general trading, market, or other modeling and analysis on behalf of the traders. In some cases, this may involve other activities such as rolling storage or internal projects such as supporting the setup of a new business and working with the MIS/ IT team.

  • Minimum 3-5 years of Middle Office work experience in a trading house
  • Minimum Bachelor’s degree or higher
  • Strong proficiency working with numbers and large data sets
  • Good proficiency in Microsoft Excel is required. Knowledge of Python is desirable.
  • Good understanding of the oil industry and/or financial markets is desirable
  • Understanding of the trade life cycle is desirable
  • Experience working with a trade capture system is desirable
  • Ability to work in a high-pressure trading environment.
  • Have a strong sense of accountability and ownership of key deliverables
  • Be comfortable undertaking new concepts and ideas associated with a fast-paced, dynamic business
  • Demonstrate the ability to both understand the ‘big picture' and have a willingness to ‘dig into the details'
  • Demonstrate the ability to clearly communicate accounting concepts to senior management and translate them in terms of the commercial business
  • Continually assess, challenge, and improve processes
  • Earn the trust of others by continuously demonstrating the ability to follow-through
  • Be curious, creative, and up for a challenge
  • Effectively communicate with other departments/ external counterparties (written and verbal)

Vitol Asia is committed to providing equal opportunities to all staff. Globally, Vitol seeks to conduct its business in accordance with the UN Global Compact’s ten principles, including those on human rights, one of which is to “Ensure a diverse and inclusive work place, where possible, free from discrimination regardless of age, gender, race, cultural heritage, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion or disability.”

Only successful candidates will be contacted.

title: Office Administrator
description:
BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

The Office Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day administrative, facilities, and basic IT support functions of the Dubai office, ensuring a well-organized, compliant, and fully operational workplace. The role acts as the central point of contact for office operations, building management, government compliance visits (including MOHRE), and employee support matters.

What You’ll Do

Office administration & facilities

  • Oversee daily office operations, ensuring the workplace is organized, well-maintained, and fully operational.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for facilities-related matters, liaising with the building management team and landlords on maintenance, repairs, access, and other facilities issues.
  • Manage relationships with office vendors, including cleaning, maintenance, catering, courier, and security services.
  • Coordinate office supplies, equipment, and stationery procurement, tracking budgets and expenditure.
  • Manage Ejari registration and renewals for company office premises.
  • Support the organization of internal meetings, events, and visits, including room bookings, catering, and logistics.
  • Assist with onboarding logistics for new employees, including workstation setup and office orientation.
  • Maintain office health and safety standards and ensure compliance with local workplace regulations.
  • Manage incoming and outgoing correspondence, deliveries, and visitor reception as required.
  • Assist with travel arrangements and logistics coordination for staff and visiting colleagues as needed.
  • Support HR and administrative teams with general office-based tasks, document handling, and record-keeping.

IT Support Assistant (Office IT Support)

  • Act as a point of contact for basic office IT needs, such as helping colleagues with simple issues (e.g. connecting to Wi-Fi, printer access) and liaising with the IT teams for anything more involved.
  • Coordinate the setup of IT equipment and system access (laptops, monitors, peripherals, access, etc.) for new hires as part of onboarding, working closely with the IT team to ensure everything is ready.
  • Log and escalate any IT issues to the IT team, and external vendors when necessary, following up to ensure timely resolution.
  • Help keep shared office equipment running smoothly — printers, scanners, and meeting room AV/video-conferencing systems — by reporting faults promptly and coordinating with IT or vendors for maintenance.

Government relations & MOHRE compliance

  • Support MOHRE-related matters by attending ministry visits and appointments in person.
  • Collaborate with the Legal Team on matter relating to MOHRE where necessary.

What You’ll Bring

  • Educational certificate higher than a secondary/high school diploma (e.g. diploma, bachelor's degree, or equivalent)
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with attention to detail.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills in Arabic and English.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and general comfort with everyday IT systems and equipment.
  • Basic troubleshooting ability for common IT issues (e.g. connectivity, printers, workstation set-up), or willingness to learn.
  • A proactive, reliable, and professional approach to work.
  • Willingness and ability to attend government entities (e.g. MOHRE) in person as part of the role.
  • Comfortable being entrusted with sensitive company items and information, including custody of the company stamp.

Nice To Have

  • Prior experience in an administrative, office support, or customer-facing role.
  • Prior exposure to basic IT support or helpdesk tasks.
  • Familiarity with office management software, IT ticketing systems, or facilities management tools.
  • Interest in developing a career within a corporate or technology environment.

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com.

title: Sygeplejerske til Gastroenterologisk Ambulatorie på Holbæk Sygehus
description:
Vil du være med til at arbejde med sygepleje til ambulante gastroenterologiske patienter, herunder patienter med lever- og IBD-sygdom? Du vil være med til at præge udviklingen af tilbud for de ambulante gastroenterologiske patienter – herunder snarlig opstart af specialiseret tilbud til patienter med leversygdomme ifm. BASS-Gastro på Holbæk Sygehus.

BASS-Gastro og gastroenterologisk ambulatorie, Holbæk

BASS-Gastro er en regional satsning, der skal styrke behandlingen af patienter med gastroenterologiske sygdomme i Region Sjælland. Som led heri udvider Holbæk Sygehus Medicin 2 blandt andet behandlingen af patienter med leversygdomme gennem etablering af en sygeplejerskedrevet leverklinik. Det betyder øget lægefaglig kapacitet fra Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital i gastroenterologisk ambulatorie, så flere patienter kan tilbydes behandling og opfølgning lokalt. Herudover vil vi fortsat have ambulante tilbud til vores IBD- og anæmi-patienter, ligeledes med fokus på fortsat udvikling i samarbejde med lægefaglig kapacitet fra Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital.

Som sygeplejerske i Gastroenterologisk Ambulatorie får du en unik mulighed for at lære det ambulante speciale at kende og være med til at opbygge og udvikle funktionerne i ambulatoriet, herunder den nye sygeplejerskedrevne leverklinik, i tæt samarbejde med dine lokale sygeplejefaglige kolleger og de gastroenterologiske specialister og erfarne kolleger fra Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital. Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor kvalitet, udvikling og sammenhængende patientforløb er i fokus. Stillingen giver stor selvstændighed, tæt patientkontakt og mulighed for at præge både patientforløb og udviklingen af fremtidens behandlingstilbud til patienter med leversygdomme og de øvrige patientgrupper.

Stillingen indebærer blandt andet:

  • Selvstændige ambulante konsultationer for lever- og IBD-patienter
  • Vejledning og undervisning af patienter og pårørende, herunder diagnosesamtaler
  • Koordinering af patientforløb på tværs af sektorer og specialer
  • Håndtering og observationer ifm. ascitesdrænage
  • Håndtering og observationer ifm. bio-infusioner, bio-injektioner og jern-infusion samt transfusioner
  • Venesectio og kapselendoskopier
  • Tæt samarbejde med læger, sekretærer og øvrige samarbejdspartnere på flere matrikler
  • Medvirken til udvikling af den sygeplejerskedrevne leverklinik
  • Deltagelse i implementering af nye arbejdsgange og kvalitetsudvikling i ambulatoriet
  • Arbejdstid på hverdage fra kl. 7.30-15.00 og deltagelse i vagtdeling hver 4. weekend

Vi søger en sygeplejerske, der

  • Har autorisation som sygeplejerske
  • Gerne har erfaring fra medicinsk afdeling eller ambulatorium
  • Har lyst til at arbejde selvstændigt med patientforløb
  • Trives med ansvar og udviklingsopgaver
  • Har gode samarbejdsevner og et positivt drive
  • Har interesse for patienter med gastroenterologiske og hepatologiske problemstillinger

Erfaring med specialet er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er motivationen for at lære området at kende.

Vi tilbyder

  • Grundig oplæring og kompetenceudvikling
  • Et lille, men dedikeret team af erfarne sygeplejersker lokalt i Holbæk
  • Et tæt samarbejde med specialiserede kolleger på tværs af matrikler
  • En unik mulighed for at være med til at etablere en ny funktion
  • Høj grad af indflydelse på udviklingen af arbejdsgange og faglighed i ambulatoriet
  • Et stærkt fagligt miljø med fokus på kvalitet, patientsikkerhed, refleksion og udvikling
  • Muligheder for deltagelse i faglige netværksmøder og arrangementer
  • Stor indflydelse på egen vagtplan


Om os

Medicin 2 på Holbæk Sygehus består blandt andet af Geriatri, Apopleksi, Multisygdom, Hjemmeindlæggelser og ambulante funktioner. Vi arbejder målrettet med faglig udvikling, tværfagligt samarbejde og patientcentrerede forløb.

Er du interesseret?

Send os din motiverede ansøgning og CV, samt relevante bilag

Ansøgningsfrist 23. august 2026

Samtaler vil blive planlagt til 24. og 25. august.

Tiltrædelse 1. oktober 2026 eller efter aftale

Har du spørgsmål, da kontakt:

Annette Due Højer, sygeplejerske og souschef, andj@regionsjælland.dk, tlf. 59 48 46 44

Tobias Brenøe Gredal, chefsygeplejerske, tlf. 23 69 18 94

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Holbæk Sygehus

Holbæk Sygehus er en innovativ arbejdsplads med masser af muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling. Vi vil være førende i diagnostik og behandling af almene og hyppigt forekommende sygdomme, og vi har velfungerende forskningsmiljøer på disse områder.

Vi er et ambitiøst og veldrevet sygehus med en flad ledelsesstruktur – så vejen fra idé til handling er kort. Vi glæder os til at byde dig velkommen på holdet. Du kan se mere om job på Holbæk Sygehus her.

title: Skiftingenjör till Värme Drift Kontrollrum
description:
Vill du vara med och säkerställa värmeproduktionen för tusentals människor samtidigt som du bidrar till framtidens energilösningar? Vi söker nu en Skiftingenjör till vårt team i Östersund. Här får du en central roll med stort ansvar för drift, optimering och utveckling av våra anläggningar i en tekniskt avancerad och samhällsviktig verksamhet.

Om jobbet

Som Skiftingenjör arbetar du på ett rullande skiftschema med ansvar för driftplanering, övervakning och optimering av våra anläggningar. Förutom att bidra till en säker, stabil och effektiv drift av anläggningarna kommer du även att:

  • Operativt ledningsansvar för ditt skiftlag
  • Övervaka och analysera driftdata för att säkerställa hög tillgänglighet och prestanda
  • Felsöka och avhjälpa komplexa driftstörningar
  • Identifiera långsiktiga trender och bidra till verksamhetens utveckling
  • Utbilda och handleda kollegor
  • Delta i strategiska beslut kring investeringar, processförändringar och utvecklingsinsatser
  • Beredskap kan komma att ingå i tjänsten.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som har flerårig erfarenhet från drift av kraftvärmeverk eller annan avancerad processindustri och besitter en djup förståelse för anläggningars system och integrationer. Gymnasieutbildning med inriktning el/energi eller teknik samt en relevant kvalificerad YH-utbildning. Du har god förmåga att analysera driftdata, identifiera långsiktiga trender och omsätta dina insikter i praktiska förbättringsåtgärder. För tjänsten krävs också goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du är certifierad Driftoperatör enligt AFS 2017:3/2023:11 samt har god datorvana och erfarenhet av att arbeta i flera olika system. Samt har erfarenhet av ledande roller.

Som person är du ansvarstagande, lyhörd och samarbetsorienterad. Du har lätt för att dela med dig av din kunskap, kommunicerar tydligt och arbetar strukturerat med fokus på kvalitet och ständiga förbättringar.

Vad vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du vara med och driva utvecklingen mot ett mer hållbart samhälle, i en bransch som är en förutsättning för vår välfärd. Vi jobbar tillsammans i trygga team där vi vågar testa nytt, växa och lyckas. På Jämtkraft är du viktig! Vi tänker långsiktigt, vi satsar på dig och vill att du ska trivas och hjälpa oss framåt. Vi tar hand om våra medarbetare och har fina förmåner, alltifrån förmånscykel till arbetstidsförkortning och föräldrapenningtillägg. Vi är en erkänt bra arbetsgivare, belönade med certifikatet "Excellent Arbetsgivare 2025" och "Karriärföretag 2025".

Körkort B är ett krav.

Placeringsort: Östersund/Kraftvärmeverket

Anställningsform/omfattning: Tills vidare, heltid

Önskat startdatum: Snarast

Vill du veta mer om jobbet?

Kontakta Lisa Svernby, Avdelningschef Värme Drift Kontrollrum, telefonnummer 076-53 13 750 eller lisa.svernby@jamtkraft.se

title: Cyber Security Analyst
description:
Oletko tietoturvan ammattilainen tai haluatko kehittyä sellaiseksi? Kiinnostaako tietoturvakriittisten ympäristöjen turvaaminen ja poikkeamien selvittäminen osana monipuolista CSOC (Cyber Security Operations Center)-valvomotiimiä?

Haemme nyt CSOC-Valvomotiimiimme uutta henkilöä T1 tason Cyber Security Analyst tehtävään

Tehtävä sisältää:

  • Tietoturvapoikkeamien havainnointia, uhkien torjuntaa sekä dokumentointia ja raportointia
  • Tietoturvaongelmien korjausta, analysointia ja mahdollisia muutoksia havaintojen perusteella
  • Työskentelyä CSOC-tiimissä
  • Toimimista asiakasrajapinnassa.

Työ on hybridiluonteista, joka tarkoittaa, että osa työtehtävistä voidaan suorittaa etänä, mutta osa tehtävistä vaatii ajoittaista paikallaoloa joko Helsingin tai Riihimäen toimistollamme. Alkuvaiheessa työ ajoittuu klo 8 - 18 välille. Perehtymisjakson jälkeen töitä tehdään osana ympäri vuorokauden pyörivää tietoturvavalvomon toimintaa 12 tunnin vuoroissa vuorokierron mukaisesti, myös viikonloppuisin.

Saat jatkuvaa koulutusta ja tukea ammatilliseen kehittymiseesi. Tässä tehtävässä pääset osaksi rentoa ja mukavaa työporukkaa, jossa jokaisen työpanosta arvostetaan. Luotamme siihen, että fiksut ja osaavat ihmiset tietävät mitä tehdä, joten meillä ei hengitetä työntekijöiden niskaan. Tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä tehdään henkilöturvallisuusselvitys (Turvallisuusselvityslaki 726/2014).

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää:

  • Kokemusta kyberturvallisuudesta joko työn tai opiskelujen kautta
  • Kiinnostusta tietoturvatuotteisiin ja tietoturvan ajankohtaisiin asioihin
  • Polttavaa janoa oppia hallitsemaan SIEM-, XDR- ja SOAR-teknologiat
  • Ymmärrystä IT-infraan ja tietojärjestelmiin kohdistuvista uhista
  • Halua kehittyä ja olla tärkeänä osana kasvavaa asiantuntijaorganisaatiota
  • Analyyttistä asennetta, tarkkuuta ja tiimityötaitoja
  • Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa
  • Kykyä toimia asiakasrajapinnassa
  • Valmiutta vuorotyöhön

Arvostamme, jos sinulla on harrastuneisuutta esim. CTF-kisojen kautta tai jos mahdollisesti osaat jo jotakin SIEM-teknologiaa. Jos Microsoftin pilvituotteet tai OT-verkot ovat sinulle entuudestaan tuttuja, niin sekin on plussaa.

Tutustu blogitekstien kautta: Christopherin ensimmäiseen vuoteen tietoturva-analyytikkona ja CSOC-ympäristössä työskentelyyn.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä saat Jan Winbergiltä sähköpostilla (Jan.Winberg@cinia.fi) Jos kiinnostuit, haethan tehtävää 16.8.2026 mennessä! Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana.

title: Aamupalatarjoilija Rovaniemelle
description:
Kiinnostaisiko työt Lapin taian keskellä Rovaniemellä? Tarjoamme ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden työskennellä korkealaatuisen modernin hotellin ravintolassa. Tähän työpaikkaan et voi olla ihastumatta! Jatkahan lukemista niin kerromme lisää.

Arctic City hotel

Arctic City Hotel on uniikki perheomisteinen hotelli, joka sijaitsee aivan Rovaniemen keskustassa lähellä ostosalueita, vain muutaman kilometrin päässä napapiiristä ja Joulupukin Pajakylästä. Kaikki tärkeimmät palvelut ja nähtävyydet ovat kätevästi kävelymatkan päässä hotellilta.

Arctic City Hotel avattiin maaliskussa 1978. Perheomisteinen hotelli on palvellut vieraita nyt jo kolmen sukupolven ajan. Tänä päivänä Arctic City Hotelli on mukava, moderni ja persoonallinen neljän tähden hotelli. Jokainen hotellin 90 huoneesta on saanut oman hahmonsa ja sielunsa.

Ravintola Monte Rosa

Lappilaista ruokaa modernilla twistillä. Ravintola Monte Rosan tunnelmallinen ilmapiiri kutsuu sinua. Lämminhenkisesti sisustettu ravintola on ihanteellinen paikka rentoutua ja nauttia hyvästä ruoasta. Ruokalista, joka pitää sisällään kansainvälisiä herkkuja, lappilaisella kosketuksella höystettynä.

Etsimme nyt aamupalatarjoilijaa talvisesonkiin 2026-2027 määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Ravintola Monte Rosaan Rovaniemelle.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu astioiden blokkaamista ja huolehdit että tavaraa riittää.

Edellytämme sinulta kokemusta ravintola-alalta. Edellytämme sinulta reipasta ja iloista asennetta työhön sekä pystyt toimimaan kansainvälisessä ympäristössä. Kuitenkin asiakaspalvelu tulisi löytyä luonnostaan. Olet ripeä ja oma-aloitteinen sekä et pelkää asiakkaita niin pärjäät tehtävässä hienosti.

Palkkaus Tes/Sopimuksen mukaan.

Työt alkavat marraskuussa ja kestävät maaliskuun loppuun saakka.

Työsopimus on määräaikainen 60h/3vko.

Valittu henkilö työllistyy Lisäpalvelu Pohjois-Suomi Oy:n kautta ja saa meiltä kaiken tuen ja turvan koko meillä työllistymisen ajan.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

* Hymy ei hyydy asiakaspalvelutilanteissa.
* Olet tiimipelaaja.
* Sinulla on hyvää asennetta työntekoon ja halua oppia uutta.
* Sinulta löytyy tilannetajuaja joustavuutta sesonkisessa kiireessä.

Mitä me tarjoamme sinulle?

* Kilpailukykyisen palkan osaamisesi mukaan, joka on aina vähintään alan työehtosopimuksen mukainen.
* Tarvittaessa sinulle löytyy myös majoitus huokeaan hintaan.
* Sinä saat Lisäpalvelun tuen ja turvan koko matkasi ajan. Huolehdimme että kaikki menee lapissa kuten on sovittu ja että viihdyt kohteessa.
* Käymme sinua välillä tervehtimässä ihan paikan päällä. Sinä voit siis keskittyä itse työntekoon ja Lapin luonnosta nauttimiseen.

Tässä vielä muutama syy, miksi sinun kannattaa valita Lisäpalvelu:

1. Meillä saat työnhakijana ja -tekijänä aidosti henkilökohtaista palvelua. Tapaat meidät kasvotusten jo työnhakuvaiheessa. Kun työllistyt kauttamme, saat meiltä yhteyshenkilön, joka auttaa sinua kaikissa työsuhteeseen liittyvissä asioissa.
2. Ravintola-alan asiakaskuntamme on monipuolinen. Siksi pystymme tarjoamaan laajan kattauksen eri tuntureissa ja erilaisia työtehtäviä, joista löytyy jokaiselle jotakin.
3. Pidämme kiinni sovituista asioista ja teemme sen, mitä lupaamme. Sinä voit keskittyä työntekoon, koska me hoidamme puolestasi ylimääräisen byrokratian.



Kuulostaako hyvältä? Hienoa, haluamme kuulla sinusta pian!

Jos saimme sinut kiinnostumaan ja haluaisit liittyä Lisäpalvelun porukkaan, laita meille hakemus tulemaan!

Haethan vain hakuilmoituksen kautta ja liitä myös cv:si hakemukseen.

Jäikö sinulle kysyttävää?

Lisätietoja: marika.haataja@lisapalvelu.net tai Marika Haataja 040-6238068



Lisäpalvelu on vuonna 2002 perustettu valtakunnallisesti toimiva joustavia henkilöstöratkaisuja tarjoava kotimainen yritys. Lisäpalvelu-konserni on tunnettu luotettavuudesta ja pitkäaikaisista asiakassuhteista niin työnantajien kuin -tekijöiden keskuudessa. Työllistämme vuosittain yli 3 000 työntekijää, ja olemme vahva toimija monella alalla: tarjoamme töitä mm. ravintola-, rakennus-, teollisuus-, kunnossapito-, logistiikka-, toimisto-, siivous- ja kaupan aloilla. Olemme Suomen kymmenen suurimman henkilöstöpalvelualan yrityksen joukossa, ja kuulumme Henkilöstöpalveluyritysten liittoon (HPL).

Haluamme tehdä töihin menon sinulle helpoksi: kauttamme voit työllistyä parhaimmillaan jo seuraavana päivänä. Tarjoamme jatkuvasti töitä erilaisiin elämäntilanteisiin, ja kauttamme tehty vuokratyö on ollut monelle työntekijällemme reitti vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

title: Generative AI Engineer (Intern)
description:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.


This internship sits alongside our Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs), who embed with customer teams and ship production agentic AI systems on AWS. You won't carry a delivery commitment on day one instead, you'll work under an FDE's mentorship to learn how agentic systems get built, tested, and verified against real customer data, and you'll get structured exposure to the judgment calls that sit behind every shipped feature.

This is a learning-and-building role, not a staff-augmentation seat and not an advisory role. You'll write real code that feeds into real engagements, under close supervision.

What You'll Do?

  • Support delivery of agentic AI and AWS modernization work across our three pillars: Data Platform Modernization, Application & Database Modernization, and AI Agents for Apps.
  • Help build and test components of AI agents, orchestration, retrieval pipelines, evaluation harnesses under FDE guidance, working with real (not demo) data wherever possible.
  • Assist in converting existing product or process functionality into callable agent tools, under supervision.
  • Sit in on architecture sessions and customer discussions to learn how design decisions get made and defended; you'll observe and contribute, not lead.
  • Help document agent decisions and test evidence so outputs are traceable and defensible.
  • Bring back what you learn from shadowing engagements into small improvements you can own.

    • What we're looking for?

  • Currently pursuing, or recently completed, a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • A foundation in Python (and ideally some TypeScript) from coursework, personal projects, or prior internships no professional production experience required.
  • Genuine curiosity about agentic AI: how agents plan, use tools, retrieve context, and get evaluated. You don't need to have shipped an agent, you need to want to learn how they're built properly.
  • Basic familiarity with cloud concepts; AWS exposure through coursework, certifications-in-progress, or personal projects is a plus.
  • Comfort with testing-driven habits, willingness to learn to write test cases before code, not after.

    • You'll be preferred if you have

  • Personal projects or coursework involving LangGraph, CrewAI, Strands Agents, or similar orchestration frameworks.
  • Exposure to RAG concepts chunking, embeddings, retrieval, even at a conceptual or academic level.
  • AWS certifications in progress (Cloud Practitioner, Solutions Architect Associate, or similar).
    • Life at Mactores
    We care about creating a culture that makes a real difference in the lives of every Mactorian. Our 10 Core Leadership Principles that honor Decision-making, Leadership, Collaboration, and Curiosity drive how we work.
    1. Be one step ahead
    2. Deliver the best
    3. Be bold
    4. Pay attention to the detail
    5. Enjoy the challenge
    6. Be curious and take action
    7. Take leadership
    8. Own it
    9. Deliver value
    10. Be collaborative
    We would like you to read more details about the work culture on https://mactores.com/careers
    The Path to Joining the Mactores Team
    At Mactores, our recruitment process is structured around three distinct stages:
    Pre-Employment Assessment:
    A series of evaluations of your technical proficiency and suitability for the role.
    Managerial Interview: The hiring manager engages with you in multiple discussions, 30 minutes to an hour each, covering technical skills, hands-on experience, leadership potential, and communication.
    HR Discussion: During this 30-minute session, you'll have the opportunity to discuss the offer and next steps with a member of the HR team.
    Mactores provides equal opportunities in all employment practices. We don't discriminate based on race, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, marital status, military status, genetic information, or any other category protected by federal, state, and local laws. This applies to every part of the employment relationship, recruitment, compensation, promotions, transfers, disciplinary action, layoff, training, and social and recreational programs.
    Note: Please answer as many questions as possible with this application to accelerate the hiring process.

title: Systemutvecklare
description:
Vad krävs av en IT-specialist för att säkerställa hållbara och säkra behörighetslösningar i en samhällsviktig myndighet? Hos oss får du arbeta i en omfattande IT-miljö med väldigt höga krav på säkerhet, tillgänglighet och prestanda. Du blir en del av en spännande digital omvandling där ditt kunnande bidrar till långsiktiga och hållbara IT-lösningar. Här får du frihet att forma ditt arbete, samtidigt som du har en trygg arbetsgivare som värdesätter balansen mellan jobb och privatliv. Vi söker dig som gillar att arbeta i skärningspunkten mellan system, infrastruktur och utveckling.

Arbetsuppgifter

Trafikverkets teknikområde Identitet står inför en spännande utveckling! Hur man bygger en säker och hållbar identitets- och behörighetsplattform i en samhällsviktig myndighet är en fråga vi arbetar med varje dag. Vi arbetar i en omfattande och tekniskt komplex IT-miljö där säkerhet, tillgänglighet och stabil drift är avgörande. Samtidigt är vi mitt i en teknisk förflyttning där nya plattformar, automatisering och modern utveckling möter höga krav på säkerhet och kontroll. Vi inför en ny plattform för identitets- och behörighetshantering för att möta nya krav och framtida behov - samtidigt som vi förvaltar och vidareutvecklar våra befintliga lösningar.

Du kommer att arbeta med tekniker och verktyg som exempelvis:

  • JavaScript
  • Bash
  • PowerShell
  • LDAP
  • Ansible
  • Terraform

Har du erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code (IaC) och automatisering av infrastruktur är det särskilt intressant för oss.

Du blir en del av ett team på 13 personer bestående av systemspecialister, tekniker och systemutvecklare som arbetar agilt tillsammans med en Scrum Master. Teamet ansvarar för konfiguration, drift och vidareutveckling av Trafikverkets lösningar för identitets- och behörighetshantering.

I rollen kommer du bland annat att arbeta med:

  • konfiguration och automatisering av identitets- och behörighetslösningar
  • införande, vidareutveckling och avveckling av plattformar och applikationer
  • automatisering av infrastruktur och miljöer
  • integrationer och systemkopplingar i en komplex IT-miljö
  • tekniska förbättringar och utveckling av våra arbetssätt

Vi arbetar agilt enligt SAFe och lägger stor vikt vid samarbete, kunskapsdelning och kontinuerlig förbättring.

Jag som kommer att bli din chef heter Dan Weslien. Jag har som mål att mitt ledarskap ska vara tillitsbaserat och utgår i från att varje medarbetare tar aktivt ansvar för sina arbetsuppgifter och att själv hitta lösningar för sig själv och tillsammans med gruppen. För att skapa tilliten har jag ett närvarande ledaskap. Detta sker genom aktiv dialog där vi tillsammans bygger förtroende. Jag hoppas att du vill vara med oss på den resa vi nu startat!

Kvalifikationer

Vi tror att du är en person som gillar att förstå hur system hänger ihop och hur man kan förbättra och automatisera tekniska lösningar. Du är strukturerad i ditt arbetssätt och trivs i en miljö där du både får lösa tekniska problem och bidra till långsiktigt hållbara lösningar. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och samarbetar naturligt med andra. Eftersom många av våra lösningar är affärskritiska behöver du också ha ett starkt säkerhetstänk och en analytisk förmåga när du arbetar med tekniska problem.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • högskole- eller universitetsutbildning om minst 180 hp (120) med inriktning IT. Alternativt har du annan utbildning i kombination med erfarenhet i närtid som vi bedömer likvärdig
  • arbetslivserfarenhet av programmering i något av följande språk: JavaScript, Bash, PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform
  • aktuell arbetslivserfarenhet av Linux
  • aktuell arbetslivserfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • erfarenhet av att arbeta agilt samt efter metoden Scrum
  • goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift

Det är inte ett krav för tjänsten, men ses som meriterande om du har:

  • erfarenhet av IAM-system
  • har arbetserfarenhet inom it-infrastruktur on-prem
  • erfarenhet av Active Directory alt Microsoft EntraID
  • erfarenhet av ECMAScript
  • erfarenhet av DirXML
  • erfarenhet av REST API:er
  • erfarenhet av PostgreSQL
  • erfarenhet av att dokumentera system & lösningar
Övrig information

Anställningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass. För anställning krävs godkänt resultat i säkerhetsprövningen, som genomförs i enlighet med bestämmelser i säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585).

Vill du ha en flexibel vardag med möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån? I den här rollen kan du jobba på distans upp till två dagar i veckan.

#LI-Hybrid

För att undvika att du missar viktig information om din ansökan behöver du se till att hålla dig uppdaterad via Min karriärsida! Vi använder främst mail (från mejladress: noreply@heroma.se) för att göra utskick och kallelser. Kolla din inkorg och även skräppost/SPAM regelbundet under denna tid för att vara säker på att du får all information från oss! Du kan med fördel även lägga till den mejladressen i dina mejlkontakter.

I denna rekrytering används webbaserade tester som en del i urvalet.

Ansökan

De frågor som du får besvara när du skickar in din ansökan kommer att ligga till grund för det första urvalet vi gör. Om det inte står något annat i annonsen vill vi att du bifogar ditt CV. Vi har slutat begära in personligt brev eftersom vi inte har med det som del av urvalsunderlaget. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ska du kontakta ansvarig chef för rekryteringen så att din ansökan blir hanterad enligt särskilda rutiner. Du hittar namn och kontaktuppgifter till chefen i annonsen.

Inom vår IT-organisation är du med och utvecklar Sverige med hjälp av moderna och innovativa lösningar. Vi är mitt i en spännande förändring där vi försöker ta vara på digitaliseringens möjligheter till fullo. Digitaliseringen ställer allt större krav och vi vill därför anpassa oss vad gäller kompetens, arbetssätt och organisation i takt med utvecklingen. Vi har ett helhetsansvar för IT och telekom, en verksamhet som pågår dygnet runt, året om - precis som Sveriges transportsystem.

På Trafikverket jobbar vi med att göra Sverige närmare. Vi tror på att en förening av olika erfarenheter, bakgrunder och perspektiv är den bästa grunden för att bygga en arbetsplats fri från diskriminering och en miljö där alla trivs och gör sitt bästa. Vi tror på mångfald där den gemensamma nämnaren är pålitlighet, engagemang och mod. För det är så vi bäst representerar vårt samhälle.

title: Civils Operative
description:

Here at Stonbury we are recruiting for Civils Operatives working on clean water sites.

• £18 per hour• Travel and overnight stays will be part of the role

title: Sessional Ombudsman, Life Insurance
description:
Flexible, meaningful work. Expert impact when it matters most.

At AFCA, our purpose is simple: to help Australians achieve fair outcomes when things go wrong with financial services. We're looking to appoint experienced Sessional Ombudsmen, Life Insurance to join our highly regarded decision-making team on a flexible, engagement-based arrangement.

As a Sessional Ombudsman, you'll provide specialist, on-demand expertise as part of a talented panel of senior legal professionals. Engagements can range from a few days to several months, offering you the flexibility to contribute your expertise while maintaining the balance and lifestyle that matter to you.

This opportunity is ideal for accomplished legal professionals who are looking to apply their extensive experience in a role that combines intellectual challenge, community impact and flexibility. Whether you're transitioning from private practice, stepping back from a full-time executive role, or seeking to complement an established portfolio career, you'll have the opportunity to make a genuine difference to consumers and industry alike.

Reporting to Emma Curtis, Lead Ombudsman Insurance, you'll bring significant senior-level experience in the insurance sector, particularly within life insurance and/or general insurance. You may be a highly experienced lawyer, tribunal member, regulator, ombudsman, executive leader or other legally qualified professional with a proven history of sound judgment and decision-making in complex environments.

This is a board-appointed role for a 3 year term, subject to re-appointment.

What you'll bring

You are a trusted and credible leader who:

  • Quickly synthesises complex information and identifies the issues that matter most.
  • Exercises sound judgment and delivers balanced, well-reasoned decisions.
  • Communicates with clarity, confidence and empathy across a broad range of stakeholders.
  • Works effectively both independently and collaboratively.
  • Navigates sensitive and contentious matters with professionalism and resilience.
  • Maintains impartiality while dealing with competing perspectives and challenging situations.

Most importantly, you are motivated by the opportunity to contribute to a fair, accessible and independent dispute resolution service that delivers meaningful outcomes for the community.

To be successful, you'll have:

  • Legal qualifications and substantial senior-level legal experience.
  • Significant expertise within insurance, particularly life insurance and/or general insurance.
  • A demonstrated track record of achievement within a law firm, tribunal, external dispute resolution scheme, regulatory agency, insurer or related organisation.
  • Exceptional analytical, decision-making and stakeholder management skills.
  • The ability to maintain independence and impartiality in all matters.

Please note that your business or professional dealings within the past three years must not give rise to any reasonable perception of bias in favour of consumers or financial firms.

To apply

If you’re passionate about fairness and believe your skills align with this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every single criterion.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and gender identities. If you require any accessibility support during the recruitment process, please reach out to our team at Careers@afca.org.au.

We believe fairness starts with people. That’s why we don’t use AI or automated tools to screen candidates. As a result, our processes may take a little longer, and we thank you for your patience.

About AFCA

The Australian Financial Complaints Authority (AFCA) was established in 2018 as a private not-for-profit ombudsman service providing free, fair and independent help with financial disputes. The original team has grown to over 1600 dedicated professionals. Since 2018, AFCA has received more than 634,000 complaints, helping to secure $2.1 billion in compensation for consumers.

AFCA is a 2026 Circle Back Initiative Employer - we are committed to responding to every applicant.

title: Mgr-Front Office II
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Responsible for all front office functions and staff. Areas of responsibility include Bell Staff, Switchboard Operations, Guest Services/Front Desk and Retail/Gift Shop, as applicable. As a department head, directs and works with managers and employees to successfully execute all front office operations, including guest arrival and departure procedures. Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction and maximize the financial performance of the department.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 5 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.

OR

• 4-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration or related major; 5 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Leading Guest Services Team

• Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

• Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.

• Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.

• Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees' absence.

• Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.

• Ensures recognition of employees is taking place across areas of responsibility.

• Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position and monitors progress.

• Celebrates successes and publicly recognizes the contributions of team members.

Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals

• Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.

• Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.

• Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.

• Keeps Front Office team focused on the critical components of operations to drive guest satisfaction and the desired financial results.

• Conducts department meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Office goals to produce desired results.

• Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.

• Understands the impact of Front Office operations on the Rooms area and overall property financial goals.

• Manages department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.

Managing Projects and Policies

• Ensures compliance with all Front Office policies, standards and procedures.

• Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service

• Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.

• Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.

• Supervises and managing employees. Managing all day-to-day operations. Understanding employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees' absence.

• Acts as the “Service Champion” for the Front Office and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.

• Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service, and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.

• Strives to improve service performance.

• Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.

• Ensures that all Front Office areas have an atmosphere that is conducive to the overall guest experience.

• Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.

• Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.

• Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.

Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

• Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.

• Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.

• Establishes challenging, realistic and obtainable goals to guide operation and performance.

• Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an “open door” policy, and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.

• Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.

• Manages employee progressive discipline procedures for Front Office Staff.

• Administers the performance appraisal process for direct report managers.

• Interviews and hires managers and hourly employee team members with the appropriate skills and in a timely manner to meet the business needs of the operation.

Additional Responsibilities

• Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

• Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

• Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.

• Identifies and analyzes Front Office operational challenges and facilitates the development of solutions to prevent reoccurrence.

• Ensures that Guest Experience Platform (GXP) is properly configured and fully utilized across all departments, driving consistent engagement, timely resolution of guest requests, and adherence to Marriott guest experience standards.

• Monitors compliance, provides guidance and training where needed, and works closely with department leaders to maximize the effectiveness of the platform in enhancing guest satisfaction and operational performance.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

title: Grab Operative
description:

title: FPGA design engineer
description:
This role is for one of the Weekday's clients

Salary range: Rs 100000 - Rs 700000 (ie INR 1 - 7 LPA)

Min Experience: 2+ years

Location: Bengaluru
JobType: full-time

We are seeking a talented and detail-oriented FPGA Design Engineer with 2–6 years of experience in FPGA development to join our engineering team. This role is ideal for professionals passionate about designing reliable, high-performance digital systems for mission-critical applications. Candidates with prior experience in the Defence, Aerospace, or Space industry will be highly preferred due to the nature of the products and quality standards involved.

As an FPGA Design Engineer, you will be responsible for the complete FPGA development lifecycle—from architecture definition and RTL design to simulation, testing, verification, and hardware validation. You will work closely with hardware, embedded software, and system engineering teams to deliver robust FPGA solutions that meet stringent performance, reliability, and compliance requirements.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement FPGA-based digital solutions using VHDL.
  • Create high-quality RTL designs based on functional and system-level requirements.
  • Perform simulation, verification, debugging, and validation of FPGA designs using industry-standard simulation tools.
  • Participate in the complete FPGA development lifecycle, including architecture, synthesis, implementation, timing closure, testing, and hardware bring-up.
  • Analyze and optimize FPGA designs for performance, resource utilization, timing, and power efficiency.
  • Develop and execute test plans to ensure functional correctness and reliability.
  • Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and system engineering teams to integrate FPGA modules into larger embedded systems.
  • Troubleshoot design issues during simulation, lab testing, and production stages.
  • Prepare technical documentation, design specifications, verification reports, and implementation guidelines.
  • Ensure compliance with project quality standards, coding guidelines, and engineering best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 2–6 years of professional experience in FPGA design and development.
  • Strong expertise in FPGA Design using VHDL programming.
  • Hands-on experience with RTL design, simulation, synthesis, implementation, testing, and FPGA verification.
  • Strong understanding of digital design concepts, finite state machines, timing analysis, clock domain crossing, and FPGA architecture.
  • Experience working with FPGA development and simulation tools from leading vendors.
  • Ability to debug complex hardware and FPGA-related issues effectively.
  • Familiarity with hardware interfaces, communication protocols, and embedded digital systems.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in the Defence, Aerospace, or Space industry.
  • Knowledge of safety-critical or high-reliability FPGA development practices.
  • Exposure to FPGA validation in embedded or mission-critical systems.
  • Familiarity with hardware testing equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and signal generators.
  • Understanding of FPGA optimization techniques and design for reliability.

Must-Have Skills

  • FPGA Design
  • VHDL Programming
  • RTL Design
  • FPGA Simulation
  • FPGA Testing
  • Full-Cycle FPGA Development
  • Digital Design

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Defence Domain Experience
  • Aerospace Systems
  • Space Electronics
  • Embedded Hardware Development
  • Hardware Verification

title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer · AI / Computer Vision
description:
Surveily is a start-up on a mission to transform the Health and Safety standards of workplaces around the globe. Our technology focuses on monitoring and improving conditions in some of the most challenging and dangerous environments. By leveraging Machine Learning and Real-time Data, we aim to make a significant difference in the lives of countless employees, ensuring their workday is as safe as possible. Join us and be a part of this noble cause.

We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead the development of production-grade computer vision solutions that solve real customer problems. You'll drive projects across the full machine learning lifecycle - from understanding business requirements and designing technical solutions to deploying, operating, and continuously improving models in production.

We're building a team of end-to-end ML engineers rather than specialists. As a Senior Engineer, you'll take ownership of complex technical challenges, influence engineering direction, mentor other engineers, and help establish best practices across the team.

Strong Python engineering skills are essential. A significant part of your work will involve designing reusable ML infrastructure, improving developer workflows, and building production-quality software that enables the entire team to move faster.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of production-ready computer vision solutions.

  • Own complex ML projects from problem definition through production deployment and long-term maintenance.

  • Translate business and product requirements into scalable machine learning architectures.

  • Drive the complete ML lifecycle, including data strategy, annotation processes, dataset management, experimentation, model development, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  • Design and build reusable Python libraries, ML frameworks, and internal tooling that improve engineering efficiency.

  • Deliver reliable, maintainable, well-tested, and scalable production code.

  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to maximize customer value.

  • Improve model quality through rigorous experimentation, performance analysis, and data-driven decision making.

  • Lead engineering initiatives around reproducibility, testing, CI/CD, observability, MLOps, and deployment best practices.

  • Mentor other Machine Learning Engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.

  • Contribute to technical architecture decisions and help shape the long-term direction of the ML platform.

What we need to see

  • 5+ years of commercial experience building and deploying machine learning systems.

  • Strong understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including:

    • supervised, unsupervised, and self-supervised learning,

    • optimization,

    • probability and statistics,

    • linear algebra,

    • model evaluation and validation.

  • Deep understanding of the entire machine learning lifecycle and the practical challenges of operating ML systems in production.

  • Excellent Python software engineering skills, including:

    • writing clean, maintainable, and testable code,

    • algorithms and data structures,

    • debugging and performance optimization,

    • designing reusable libraries and APIs.

  • Extensive experience developing deep learning models using PyTorch.

  • Experience designing production ML systems with scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind.

  • Strong understanding that successful ML products depend equally on data quality, evaluation methodology, software engineering, and deployment.

  • Proven ability to independently lead technical initiatives from concept to production.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and providing technical leadership.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ways to stand out

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, NVIDIA Triton, ONNX, TensorRT, Object Detection.

  • Strong experience with MLOps tools and production ML infrastructure.

  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or technical publications.

  • Extensive experience building production computer vision systems.

  • Experience optimizing model inference, latency, and deployment efficiency.

  • Experience designing large-scale datasets, annotation pipelines, and data quality processes.

  • Experience building internal ML platforms, frameworks, or developer tooling.

  • Experience shipping customer-facing AI products in a fast-paced startup environment.

What we offer

  • Direct collaboration with company founders using bleeding-edge technology.

  • Opportunity to shape the technical direction of our AI platform.

  • Exciting technical challenges with real ownership and impact.

  • Opportunity to accelerate your career.

  • Friendly, start-up office atmosphere.

  • Gaining experience in a dynamically growing company.

  • Fully remote work model.

  • Fitness and Health membership benefits.

  • Gaming laptop for work.

  • Company off-sites and team activities.
