title: Business Analyst - Billing
description:
Business Analyst – Billing Transformation Programme

We are currently delivering a major Billing Transformation Programme at DP World, introducing a new enterprise billing platform to replace our existing system. Alongside this transformation, we must continue to support and maintain our current platform, ensuring continuity and accuracy while carefully managing complex and business-critical data, processes, and structures. This creates a unique opportunity to be part of a high-impact programme, helping to protect and evolve our billing capability while transitioning to a modern, future-ready solution.

We are looking for an experienced and highly driven Business Analyst to join DP World and play a key role in shaping and delivering the Billing Transformation Programme. This role sits at the centre of business and technology alignment, ensuring that billing requirements, processes, and system behaviours are clearly defined, understood, and successfully delivered.

You’ll work closely with the Billing Product Owner, Project Manager, Integration Lead, IT teams, and business stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, and Operations. The role is both analytical and collaborative, requiring you to translate complex billing rules and operational processes into structured requirements and documentation that support system design, testing, and implementation.

This position is ideal for a Business Analyst who thrives in transformation programmes, enjoys working across complex process, data, and system landscapes, and is comfortable bridging the gap between business needs and technical delivery.

Location: Southampton

Contract: Permanent

How you will contribute

• Engage with Finance, Commercial, Operations, and IT stakeholders to gather, analyse, and define business and system requirements.
• Translate business needs into clear, structured functional and non-functional requirements.
• Capture and document current-state billing knowledge, including billing rules, exceptions, and operational processes.
• Analyse existing billing processes to identify inefficiencies, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
• Support the design of future-state processes aligned to the Target Operating Model.
• Translate business requirements into system requirements to support configuration, build, and integration.
• Work closely with IT and Integration teams to ensure requirements are clearly understood and implemented correctly.
• Facilitate workshops, working sessions, and stakeholder discussions to define requirements and resolve issues.
• Ensure alignment across stakeholders on scope, requirements, and expected outcomes.
• Support testing activities by defining test scenarios, validating expected outcomes, and ensuring requirements traceability.
• Assist business users during UAT to confirm that solutions meet business needs.
• Maintain high-quality documentation including requirements, process flows, and functional specifications.
• Ensure end-to-end traceability from requirements through to design, testing, and delivery.
• Support knowledge transfer into the future UK Billing team, reducing reliance on specialist knowledge.
• Contribute to governance by identifying and escalating gaps, risks, or conflicting requirements.

Day-to-day BAU support:
• Validate billing data to ensure accuracy and completeness prior to invoicing.
• Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies.
• Analyse billing trends and support revenue assurance activities.
• Review customer contracts and identify potential revenue leakage.

What you will bring

• Proven experience as a Business Analyst within system implementation or transformation programmes.
• Strong experience working across both business and IT teams.
• Excellent requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation skills.
• Experience in process mapping and business process improvement.
• Ability to document complex business rules, processes, and operational dependencies.
• Experience in finance, billing, revenue assurance, or data-intensive systems is highly advantageous.
• Comfortable working with data, reports, reconciliations, and system outputs.
• Strong analytical and structured approach with high attention to detail.
• Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts clearly.
• Ability to challenge constructively and manage ambiguity or conflicting requirements.
• Proactive mindset and ability to operate effectively in cross-functional environments.

Compensation

DP World offers exciting and challenging roles within a growing international organization. We strive to hire and develop the right people, locally and globally, stimulating personal growth and self-development within an informal atmosphere. We offer a market competitive compensation package.

About DP World

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 120,000 employees spanning 75 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses—Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology—and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.

What’s more, we’re reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimising disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.

WE MAKE TRADE FLOW
TO CHANGE WHAT’S POSSIBLE FOR EVERYONE

title: 4 Introduktionsstillinger ved Afdeling for Psykoser, Aarhus Universitetshospital er ledige til besættelse 1.november og/eller 1.december 2026
description:
Har du interesse for psykiatri og tværfagligt samarbejde med patienten i centrum? Og vil du arbejde i en afdeling, som ambitiøst fokuserer på at højne kvaliteten i patientbehandlingen?

Så har Afdeling for Psykoser, Aarhus Universitetshospital 4 introduktionsstillinger (6620-93-50-i-01, 6620-93-50-i-04, 6620-93-50-i-05 og 6620-93-50-i-06) ledige pr 1.november og 1.december 2026.

Afdeling for Psykoser varetager udredning af voksne patienter inden for hele ICD-10 spektret. Afdelingen behandler særligt patienter inden for det skizofrene og psykotiske område samt patienter med demens, delir, mental retardering, ADHD, autisme og misbrugsudløste tilstande. Afdelingen har regionsfunktion.


Om Afdeling for Psykoser
Afdeling for Psykoser varetager udredning af voksne patienter inden for hele ICD-10 spektret. Afdelingen behandler særligt patienter inden for det skizofrene og psykotiske område samt patienter med demens, delir, mental retardering, ADHD, autisme og misbrugsudløste tilstande. Afdelingen har regionsfunktion.

Afdelingen har mere end 350 ansatte og ledes af chefsygeplejerske Bente Isager og cheflæge Marie Behrndtz Brandsborg.

Afdelingen omfatter tre sengeafsnit, heraf ½ sengeafsnit, hvor der kan tilbydes en rehabiliterende indsats. Afdeling for Psykoser har endvidere tre ambulante klinikker: Psykiatrisk Klinik 2 med Team for Skizofreni - OPUS, Regionsfunktions og Team for ADHD. Psykiatrisk Klinik 1 med Team for Psykoser, Team for demens og Team for Organiske Psykiske lidelser samt Team for Integreret Misbrugsbehandling (TIB), som er tilbud om integreret behandling for dobbeltdiagnosepatienter, og som er organiseret under Afdeling for Psykoser.

I Afdeling for Psykoser er desuden en Forskningsenhed. Afdeling for Psykoser har forsknings- og undervisningsforpligtigelser og deltager i den kliniske undervisning af lægestuderende og læger samt psykologer i uddannelsesforløb til specialpsykologer. Der er uddannelsesforløb for læger inden for specialerne voksenpsykiatri og almen medicin.

Du vil som udgangspunkt indgå i et lægeteam i tilknytning til sengeafsnittene. Du indgår også i vagtlaget på AUH Psykiatrien med ca 14 dagvagter og 14 nattevagter over 19 uger (forvagter).

Afdeling for Psykoser lægger stor vægt på uddannelse, og tilbyder ”introduktionskursus i psykiatri”. Der vil være mulighed for at deltage i psykoterapeutisk grundkursus, konflikthåndteringskurser og vejlederuddannelse for yngre læger, undervisning i Sundheds-og Psykiatrilov samt selvfølgelig supervision.

I-lægerne vil få ansvar for behandlingsforløb under supervision og blive introduceret til brugen af diagnostiske redskaber.

Uddannelsen i stillingen er i overensstemmelse med reglerne for den nye speciallægeuddannelse. Der henvises til uddannelsesprogram for I-læger.

Kun ansøgere med godkendelse til selvstændigt virke som læge i Danmark bliver taget i betragtning til de ledige stillinger.

Løn i henhold til aftale mellem Yngre Læger og Danske Regioner.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte cheflæge Marie Behrndtz Brandsborg på telefon 4012 9253, uddannelsesansvarlig overlæge Eva Schiöth på telefon 7847 1880, hvis du vil høre lidt om arbejdsdagen for yngre læger i afdelingen.

Løn i henhold til aftale mellem YL og Danske Regioner.

Du kan orientere dig om Afdeling for Psykoser via Afdeling for Psykoser som arbejdsplads - Psykiatrien i Region Midtjylland - til fagpersoner


Ansøgningsfrist: 24.september 2026
Ansættelsessamtaler: Løbende til og med 1.oktober 2026 eftermiddag

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

title: Design Engineer (Precast Industry)
description:
Role Summary:
The Design Engineer is responsible for the structural design and detailing of precast concrete elements, ensuring compliance with project specifications, safety standards, and production requirements. This role involves close coordination with internal teams and external stakeholders to deliver accurate and buildable design solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Plan and execute design activities in alignment with project timelines and site progress.

2. Prepare structural design calculations for precast elements such as walls, slabs, beams, columns etc. Work with PE to ensure safe lifting and handling of precast concrete components are properly designed.

3. Check and validate shop drawings for accuracy, constructibility, and compliance with design intent.

4. Liaise with external consultants (architects, C&S, M&E) to:

· Identify and request missing or incomplete design inputs.

· Detect and resolve discrepancies in design documentation.

· Understand construction sequencing to prioritize design deliverables.

· Modify and optimize designs based on project requirements, production capabilities and site constraints.

· Obtain approvals for design outputs from clients and consultants.

5. Collaborate with internal departments (production, planning, QA/QC) to ensure seamless integration of design with manufacturing and site requirements.

6. Provide sketches and technical guidance to BIM modelers and drafters to develop layout and shop drawings, erection drawing and reinforcement detailing for precast concrete components (eg, beams, columns, wall panels, slabs, staircases etc.)

7. Ensure drawings comply with relevant codes, standards and client specifications.

8. Work with Main Contractor to resolve any precast issues to develop Method of Statement (MoS) for any repair work required.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Civil or Structural Engineering.
  • Strong academic background in structural analysis and design.
  • 1–2 years of experience in structural design, preferably with exposure to precast systems.
  • Proficiency in structural design software (e.g., STAAD, ETABS) and AutoCAD/BIM tools.
  • Knowledge of relevant design codes (Eurocode, BS or local equivalents)
  • Good communication and problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Ready to revolutionize the energy sector? Join Reactive Technologies and drive safer, smarter, and more sustainable energy solutions.

Reactive Technologies is a leader in accurate grid measurement tools and the company’s mission is to streamline and accelerate the energy sector’s transition to zero-carbon energy.

The company is continuing to expand its services globally across multiple regions, and is therefore looking for a hands-on mid-level DevOps Engineer to strengthen the Service Support & DevOps team in Oulu, Finland. The team consists of three DevOps Engineers and three Service Support Specialists.

What will you be doing?

As a DevOps Engineer, you will design, build and maintain Reactive Technologies’ cloud infrastructure and deployment processes. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, scalability and security of the services while supporting development teams in delivering high-quality solutions. You will work closely with software developers, test automation engineers and service support specialists to continuously improve the cloud platform, automation capabilities and operational processes. Your specific tasks will include:

  • Developing, monitoring, maintaining and automating Reactive’s cloud infrastructure, processes and monitoring systems
  • Participating in customer-specific service configuration and deployment activities
  • Supporting developers and test automation engineers with cloud-related activities
  • Managing and improving AWS environments across multiple regions
  • Developing and maintaining Infrastructure-as-Code solutions
  • Monitoring system health, performance and availability, as well as investigating and resolving operational issues and incidents
  • Enhancing CI/CD and deployment automation pipelines
  • Continuously improving automation, reliability, security and scalability across cloud services
  • Investigating AI solutions to automate, simplify, and reduce DevOps-related workload

What kind of person thrives in this role?

You might be the candidate we are looking for if you have approximately 4 to 5 years of relevant DevOps experience and you are now motivated to contribute to the energy sector’s transition to zero-carbon energy. You have strong problem-solving and analytical skills and you want to work at an international scale-up company that that offers opportunities to grow and learn beyond your current role.

We are looking for a positive team player who is willing to collaborate closely with different stakeholders, such as engineering and operations teams to support high-quality service delivery. You are a self-driven individual with the ability to work independently and have a mindset for continuous improvement.

We hope you have the following:

  • Approximately 4-5 years of relevant experience in DevOps positions
  • Experience developing and maintaining AWS cloud infrastructure
  • Skills with Terraform, Linux administration, and Docker
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, InfluxDB (or other time-series databases), and monitoring & observability tools such as Grafana and/or Prometheus
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, scripting and automation (e.g. Python), and Git/GitLab-based development workflows
  • Full professional working proficiency in English

We consider as an asset:

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS DevOps Engineer or similar certification
  • Experience with cloud security and infrastructure hardening
  • Experience with Kubernetes, ECS or container orchestration technologies
  • Knowledge of modern monitoring, observability and reliability engineering practices
  • Working proficiency in Finnish

What Reactive Technologies can offer you:

  • A role in a growing company using cutting-edge technology to enable the global renewable energy transition
  • A role, where your skills and insight are truly appreciated
  • Opportunities for professional growth and to develop your skills
  • A motivated and dynamic work community with flat and agile structure
  • Private healthcare with extensive coverage health insurance
  • Lunch, sport, culture, and bicycle benefit plus extra holidays according to your service years
  • Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and share option scheme

Practicalities:

This is a full-time and permanent position and you will be employed directly by Reactive Technologies. The start time in this position is in September-October 2026. The company’s office is located in Oulu, and ideally you could work from there (hybrid). However, we are also open for candidates from the Tampere region, as the company has team members working in Tampere. Please note that we expect you to already have a valid work permit in Finland.

Ready to join Reactive Technologies’ mission?

Please submit your CV and motivation letter (PDF, in English) by 16.8.2026 at the latest via aTalent’s application system.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email.

We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can familiarize yourself with Reactive Technologies here: https://www.reactive-technologies.com and you can read more about the company’s newest funding round (in Finnish) here: GreenTech-yhtiö Reactive Technologies päättää 31,4 miljoonan dollarin rahoituskierroksen.

For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalent’s Recruitment Consultant Veera Kokko (044 783 5666, veera.kokko@atalent.fi).

title: Product Development Engineer - Propulsion/Body Exterior & Fuel Systems
description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.


Product Development uses design thinking & user experience methods to deliver breakthrough products and services that delight our customers. We bring innovative, exciting, and sustainable ideas to life. We have opportunities around the world for you to contribute to advancements in autonomy, electrification, smart mobility technologies, and more!

In this position...

Ford Motor Company is seeking a highly motivated Fuel System Application Design & Release Engineer to join our Propulsion/Body Exterior & Fuel Systems engineering team. This role is responsible for the design, development, validation, and release of fuel system components and subsystems for current and future vehicle programs. The engineer will collaborate cross-functionally with manufacturing, purchasing, quality, and supplier partners to ensure fuel system designs meet performance, safety, regulatory, durability, and cost targets while supporting Ford's commitment to quality and innovation. This position requires a strong foundation in mechanical/automotive engineering, hands-on problem solving, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

What you'll do...

  • Design, develop, and release fuel system components (fuel tanks, filler pipes, fuel pumps, vapor management/EVAP systems, lines, and connectors) for passenger vehicles and trucks.

  • Create and maintain CAD models, drawings, and engineering specifications using tools in Ford's PLM systems (e.g, TeamCenter, 3DX).

  • Complete Fuel TechClub assessments at all program milestones

  • Ensure fuel system designs comply with federal, state, and international regulatory requirements (FMVSS, EPA, CARB, ECE) related to evaporative emissions, crashworthiness, and fuel system integrity.

  • Conduct design analysis including DFMEA, tolerance stacking, packaging studies, and structural/thermal simulations in coordination with CAE teams.

  • Lead and support design verification and validation testing, including vehicle-level crash testing, durability testing, and evaporative emissions testing; analyze results and drive corrective actions.

  • Manage the Engineering Change Level (ECL) process and Bill of Materials (BOM) accuracy throughout the vehicle program lifecycle.

  • Collaborate with suppliers on component design, sourcing, and manufacturing feasibility; participate in supplier technical reviews and issue resolution.

  • Partner with manufacturing and plant teams to resolve build issues, launch-related concerns, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Support cost reduction initiatives and value engineering activities without compromising safety or performance.

  • Participate in cross-functional Program Milestone reviews (e.g., PD milestones, Gateway reviews) and ensure timely completion of deliverables.

  • Investigate and resolve field/warranty issues related to fuel systems using root cause analysis methodologies (8D, 5-Why, Fishbone).

  • Ensure compliance with Ford's engineering standards, corporate design rules, and safety/regulatory documentation requirements.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above?

No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

• Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
• Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
• Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more
• Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
• Tuition assistance

• Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

title: Genopslag: Vi mangler dig som er social- og sundhedsassistent
description:
Vil du arbejde helhedsorienteret med plejeopgaver og sygeplejeopgaver? Og har du lyst til at indgå i en engageret organisation, der vægter faglighed, arbejdsglæde og fleksibilitet?

Så har Gribskov kommunes Helhedspleje jobbet til dig!

Vi søger social- og sundhedsassistenter til dagvagter på 37 timer pr. uge til ansættelse i et af vores 3 distrikter.

Gerne dig som brænder for den direkte borgerrelaterede pleje, den instrumentelle sygepleje og for det tværfaglige samarbejde.

Du bliver en del af et team af engagerede kollegaer der vægter arbejdsmiljø, faglig sparring og professionel tilgang til borgere og samarbejdspartnere. Vi arbejder med rehabiliterende tilgang.

Vi tilbyder:
  • Grundig introduktion
  • Mentorordning
  • Godt arbejdsmiljø
  • Nærværende ledelse
  • Medindflydelse på vagtplan
  • Masser af mulighed for udvikling
  • Tværfaglig sparring.

Vi søger dig, der
  • er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent
  • brænder for at give borgere i eget hjem en god og værdig pleje
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og tager initiativ til at udvikle fagligheden i praksis
  • kan håndtere digitale omsorgssystemer – vi arbejder med FSlll i Nexus
  • Er god til at holde overblik og trives i en til tider travl hverdag
  • Har en professionel og positiv tilgang til opgaver
  • Tager medansvar for det gode arbejdsmiljø.

Opgaverne er mangeartede og kan bestå af
  • Pleje og omsorg af borgere i eget hjem
  • Sygeplejeopgaver
  • Admin. Opgaver ex. MedCom post, borgertelefon ect.
  • Støtte borgere i at forebygge eller afhjælpe usund livsstil og ensomhed
  • Rehabilitering, hvor borgerne vejledes og motiveres til at klare dagligdagen selv
  • Test og screening af borgerne med henblik på tidlig opsporing
  • Fælles triagering af borgerne
  • Kontakt med borgernes familier og venner.

Derfor skal du vælge os
Helhedsplejen består af ca. 270 fagligt stærke medarbejdere, der med stort gåpåmod og engagement leverer hjemme- og sygepleje af høj kvalitet til ca. 1500 borgere.

Vi er fordelt på 3 distrikter, Midt (Græsted) Nord (Gilleleje) Syd og Vest (Helsinge), samt et tværgående team af specialister og en akutfunktion.
I forbindelse med implementeringen af ældreloven, er hvert distrikt nu inddelt i teams, hvor du som assistent får en central rolle i et team.
Derudover har vi indtil videre to sygeplejeklinikker i Helhedsplejen, beliggende i henholdsvis Helsinge og Gilleleje.

Vi har fokus på miljø, bæredygtighed og helhedsorienteret pleje. Det betyder, at vi uanset vores stilling giver borgere den pleje de har behov for og skaber kontinuitet.

Det praktiske
Er du interesseret i at høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte distriktsleder Majbritt Tillgreen Jensen på telefon 72 49 62 21.

Jeg byder gerne på en kop kaffe, hvis du har behov for at “mærke os”, inden du sender din ansøgning.

Stillingen er på 37 timer pr. uge eller efter aftale.
Løn- og ansættelsesforhold efter gældende overenskomst og efter kvalifikationer.

Vi gør opmærksomme på, at vi i forbindelse med ansættelse vil indhente straffeattest.

Stillingen er i fast dagvagt med arbejde hver 3. weekend.

Det er en forudsætning, at du har gyldigt kørekort og kan formulere dig mundtligt og skriftligt på et niveau svarende til min. 9 klasse dansk.

Der følger mange rettigheder og fordele ved at være ansat i det offentlige, som fx overenskomstforhandlet løn, gode pensionsordninger, 6. ferieuge, særlige feriegodtgørelse, barsel med løn, 2 årlige omsorgsdage pr. barn under 7 år og overenskomstbestemte seniordage.
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være efter gældende overenskomst med mulighed for forhandling ud fra kvalifikationer.

Ansøgningsfrist og samtaler
Ansøgningsfrist er den 23. august 2026.
Vi har flere ledige stillinger og ansætter løbende.

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse i Gribskov Kommune, at du kan oplyse minimum én reference.

Ansøgninger modtages kun elektronisk via knappen 'Søg stillingen'.

Gribskov Kommunes værdier
Åbenhed · Tillid · Respekt · Deltagelse · Mod · Fleksibilitet

Alle oplysninger vil blive behandlet fortroligt og i overensstemmelse med regler for beskyttelse af personfølsomme oplysninger.

title: Lead Backend Engineer, Marketplace Payments (Limited-time Relocation Bonus)
description:
Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

We're searching for a Lead Backend Engineer to join one of our engineering teams in the Marketplace Payments domain. Our goal is to build secure & reliable payments solutions for all Vinted buyers and sellers. You’ll collaborate with experienced colleagues to own the critical lifecycle of a user’s financial journey. This means architecting the systems that power a user’s first sale and balance activation, ensuring seamless payment account creation across multiple PSPs. You will lead the charge in navigating the complexities of KYC/KYB and identity verification within an environment of ever-changing regulatory requirements. You and the team will drive the high-stakes execution of user migrations between different PSPs and payment licenses, all while maintaining the scalable, resilient core platform that ensures smooth payment account lifecycle for the entire Vinted Marketplace.

This is a fast-paced environment at the beginning of our journey, so we embrace uncertainty. We're constantly building new services and evolving existing ones, with experimentation being a key. We balance the "fail fast" principle to avoid analysis-paralysis, but we also take the time to understand the benefits of different alternatives before diving in. We're not afraid to make mistakes. We learn from them.

In this position, you’ll

  • Work in a team of 5-8 engineers, engineering manager, product manager and decision scientist.
  • Apply Agile and Lean principles in your work. We don't rigidly adhere to a single framework. We view Scrum, Kanban, and other methodologies as tools, selecting the most beneficial one for the team to achieve its goals.
  • Collaborate with other developers through GitHub pull requests and code reviews. Our pull requests move fast: time to first review is up to 5 min, average pull request cycle time (from open to merge) is up to 2 hours.
  • Use AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and others to improve your code.
  • See your code to affect millions of users almost instantly. Our main branch gets rolled out straight to production on each merge. With deployments many times per day.
  • Work with diverse tech stack, including: languages: Ruby; infrastructure: AWS and on-premise; databases/storage: MySQL, Elasticsearch, Redis; workflow orchestration: Temporal; monitoring/observability: Prometheus, Grafana. We don't expect you to be familiar with all of them beforehand, but we expect you will be excited to learn them fast.
  • Write unit tests for all of the code you write and contribute to integration and e2e test writing and its usage.
  • Take ownership of critical alerts and business metrics for your team to ensure our services achieve 99.99% availability.
  • You will participate in on-call rotations to ensure our product performs well.

About you

  • Continuous and Passionate Learner: You're eager to master new technologies and concepts, driven by a strong passion for technology and a "can-do" attitude, always ready to embrace new challenges and grow as a specialist.
  • Pragmatic Problem Solver: You think practically, choosing the best solutions while avoiding over-engineering. Your love for fixing things is driven by a deep desire to understand how they work.
  • Backend Expert with Strategic Decision-Making: You have solid backend engineering skills, familiarity with Ruby is beneficial but not required, and you balance immediate needs with long-term stability in your strategic decisions.
  • Collaborative and Communicative Team Player: You prioritize collective success, actively deepening your expertise, sharing knowledge, and upholding best engineering practices. Strong communication skills enable you to collaborate effectively with cross-domain teams and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Holistic and Systematic Thinker: You have a deep understanding and experience of building the complex systems and can strategically navigate how different components interact, guiding architectural decisions.
  • Mentor and Knowledge Sharer: Your mentorship leaves a lasting impact, empowering others to excel and grow by sharing deep technical insights and fostering a culture of knowledge exchange.
  • Cross-Functional Bridge Builder: You excel at aligning teams from different functional areas, ensuring cohesive collaboration to drive impactful outcomes.
  • Proactive Innovator: You identify opportunities for innovation and efficiency, leveraging new technologies to enhance capabilities.
  • Technical Leader: You effectively lead significant technical transformations within the organization, advocating for necessary changes while ensuring alignment with broader business strategies.

Work perks

  • This position is based in Vilnius/Kaunas. If you're currently living outside of Lithuania, we offer extensive Relocation Support. Do you require relocation to Lithuania if successful?
  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 working days of holiday
  • Access to all the tools & tech needed for work
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Private health insurance
  • Mental and emotional health support through the Mindletic app
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation
  • A dog-friendly office
  • In Vilnius office: Gym & in-house meals at friendly prices
  • In Kaunas office: a monthly lunch allowance, and a once-a-week provided in-house lunch and breakfast

Working at Vinted

Limited-time Relocation Package

This position is based in Lithuania, and if you're not (yet), don't worry! We're here to help you settle in with premium relocation assistance and a generous €30,000 gross bonus. If you feel that Vinted is your perfect cultural fit—apply! For more info, refer to our Relocation page.

Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

Hybrid Work

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.

Equal Opportunity

The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

The gross monthly salary range for this position is:
€6.542—€8.842 EUR

title: Markarbetare till vår kund på resande fot

title: Strategy & Operations Associate
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

What You'll Own

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions

Location

  • This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Sweden. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Sweden.

Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Hotel Cleanliness Expert
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

title: Senior Internal Auditor
location: Rabdan Street, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
description:
Senior Internal Auditor is responsible for assessing the effectiveness of internal controls, risk management, and governance processes through audits, reviews, and evaluations, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies, and recommending improvements for operational efficiency.

Risk Based Strategic/Annual Audit Planning:

  • Actively participate in risk assessment process and developing the annual/Strategic Risk-Based Audit Plan.

  • Assist the line manager in achieving the department objectives/KPIs in an efficient and effective manner.

Engagement Planning and Execution:

  • Perform assurance and advisory/consulting assignments relating to various entities/departments/process i.e.,Finance, HR, Procurement, IT,etc.

  • Actively participate in the audit/assignment planning process (i.e., scope, audit programs/procedures, timelines, kick-off, etc.)

  • Execute the operational, financial, and compliance audits in a professional & timely manner in accordance with the department standards, audit program, IIA Standards, code of ethics, etc.

  • Evaluate the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of internal controls to prepare the Risk & Control Matrix (RCM).

  • Ensure that sufficient & appropriate audit evidence are obtained, reviewed, and documented in working papers in in organized manners to support the audit conclusion/opinion.

  • Ensure that review comments of the line manager/IA leadership are appropriately addressed.

Engagement Reporting:

  • Recommend practical and effective solutions to mitigate risks and improve controls.

  • Prepare clear, concise, and well documented audit reports with relevant details (i.e. findings, implications/potential impact, risk rating, and recommendations, etc.) as per IA Manual/Standards.

  • Ensure that review comments of the line manager/IA leadership are appropriately addressed.

  • Discuss findings with the management/process owners, obtain the management response/action plan.

  • Prepare the final report and submit for line manager’s review.

Issue Tracking/Recommendation Follow-up:

  • Monitor implementation of corrective actions on a regular basis.

  • Verify the implementation of IA recommendation and management action plan, as per IA Department plan/guidelines.

Others:

  • Provide support and advisory services to business units on process improvements, internal controls, and risk management.

  • Stay updated on changes in regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

  • Support the IA Leadership in the preparing the periodic updates to the Audit Committee, Board, etc.

  • Perform other tasks as may be assigned by the line manager/IA leadership.

QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE (MANDATORY & PREFFERED):

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration - Mandatory

  • Minimum 4–6 years of internal audit experience, preferably in a relevant industry. External audit experience would be a plus.

  • Holds/working towards Professional certification such as CIA, CFE, CISA, CA, CPA, or ACCA, etc. - Preferred

  • Strong knowledge of Global Internal Auditing Standards (GIAS), IFRS/IASs, risk assessment, and regulatory frameworks, etc.

SKILLS & COMPETENCIES (Technical, Behavioral and Soft):

Technical Skills:

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook)

  • Proficient in Audit Management System (e.g. Teammate, Pentana MK, RSA Archer, etc.)

  • Knowledge of ERP, Data Analytical tools, etc.

  • Organization, Multitasking & Time Management

  • Excellent Communication & Interpersonal Skills

Behavioural Competencies:

  • Customer Focus - Understands customer challenges and takes initiative to resolve them effectively. Leaves positive image of the IA department as a business partner.

  • Accountability and Ownership - Quick learner, proactive, self-starter, and vibrant to complete/manages projects within deadlines with minimal supervision and ensures quality results.

  • Agility and Adaptability - Manages change smoothly and supports others during transitions.

  • Collaboration & Influence - Builds networks across functions and resolves conflicts constructively.

  • Result Orientation - Sets clear goals and works proactively to achieve high performance.

  • Integrity - Display highest standard of integrity in line with the IIA code of conduct/ethics.

Industry preferred: Facility Management and Property Management (Leasing/Rental)

Location: Abu Dhabi

title: Product Manager, Command
description:
The Product Management team drives Asana’s product strategy and execution, translating customer needs and opportunities into a compelling roadmap and working cross-functionally to deliver impactful solutions for team productivity and collaboration. We’re helping to define the Work Management category and inventing new ways for teams to work more efficiently together and see the larger purpose behind their work. Our team works directly with Engineering, Design, Experience Research, and Data Science, as well as with Sales, Support, and Marketing to ship great products. You’ll take part in every type of product work here — from strategy to product to process improvements — conceptualizing, launching, and iterating on Asana itself for millions of teams around the world.

Joining our recently formed team in Warsaw, you’ll contribute to the product direction for Asana’s new product for the agentic software development lifecycle—our bet on what the next $100M+ line of business looks like. As a Staff Product Manager, you’ll work from first principles to define how modern teams plan, sequence, and ship work in an AI-native world.

You’ll partner closely with design, research and engineering to turn ambiguous problem spaces into sharp, opinionated workflows that feel fast, minimal, and “obviously right” to high-performing teams. You’ll validate your bets directly with demanding customers—from hypergrowth startups to global enterprises—and be accountable for turning those insights into a focused roadmap and real business impact.

This role is based in Warsaw with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.

Our employees in Poland are employed under a contract of employment.

What you’ll achieve

  • Deliver a high-craft product to a new kind of customer for Asana

  • Build product with strong passion and operational maturity

  • Create a product strategy to balance multiple priorities and use cases across customers, product teams, and enterprise-level compliance

  • Negotiate with partner teams and deliver a compelling roadmap

  • Maximize clarity by bringing a data-driven mindset to setting concrete goals and milestones

This role is for someone who wants to build a category-defining product from the ground up - not optimize an inherited roadmap. You should be comfortable saying “no” often, shipping with strong opinions, holding the quality bar at the level of the best modern SaaS tools and innovating beyond it.

About you

  • 6+ years of experience in Product Management. Background in building in environments with complex data models, human-centric UX, and B2B SaaS experience preferred.

  • Systems thinker: You feel just as comfortable modeling data relationships in a technical diagram, just as well as you can partner with Design to walk stakeholders through a holistic UX flow.

  • Strategic: You inspire the company by creating bold, intuitive work connections within the platform and scoping them to solve the most critical customer problems.

  • Get Stuff Done: You create, flex, and evangelize a roadmap; thoughtfully break down projects to MVPs + subsequent iterations and ship with high velocity for business impact.

  • Customer-centric: You analyze our top customer personas; dig into the roots of customer needs; synthesize research to gain a deep understanding and narrow definition of a problem.

  • Communication and collaboration: You partner with cross-functional teammates to deliver high-quality results. You speak with clarity and write sharp product specs. You are highly comfortable getting into deep technical discussions with engineers about the pros and cons of different approaches, and you pair with design on complex user flows.

  • Grow Team Asana: You are a mentor for others; create great team morale among other functions and PMs; and share PM best practices you’ve cultivated to date.

  • Growth Mindset: You lead with curiosity and are open to feedback in order to learn.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer

  • Generous, transparent and fair compensation system

  • Contract of Employment (and the option of 50% tax deductible costs for author’s rights usage in respect of applicable roles)

  • Health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med)

  • Meals reimbursement on the days that you work from the office

  • Career growth budget

  • Home office setup budget

  • Gym/Fitness reimbursement

  • Fertility healthcare and family-forming support with Carrot

  • Mental Health Support in Modern Health

  • Group life insurance

  • MacBooks with all necessary accessories

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between 37,000 - 46,000 PLN gross per month (subject to all taxes and necessary deductions). The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity and sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

About us

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.

Join Asana’s Talent Network to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.

title: Inventory Planner
description:
Trove Brands is a privately-held house of brands including BlenderBottle®, Owala®, Whiskware®, and Eco-Brite®. Our patented and best-selling products are designed to simplify and improve everyday life with leading-edge innovation, incomparable quality, and aspirational style.

A career at Trove Brands is not about punching the clock. It’s about embracing exciting and fast-paced opportunities that sharpen your skills, drive innovation, and play an integral role in growing our global reach. Your work will not only impact the company, it will impact the lives of millions of people around the world. When you step up to a career at Trove, you step up to cutting-edge excellence. You sign up for bold action and invigorating synergy. You agree to face—and break through—new challenges every single day.

As an Inventory Planner, you'll work cross-functionally with Sales, Purchasing, Transportation, Product Development, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Customer Service to manage inventory for assigned customers and distribution locations. You'll use data, forecasting tools, and business insight to make recommendations that directly impact customer service, inventory health, and company performance.

Position Summary

The Inventory Planner is responsible for managing inventory and replenishment planning for assigned customers, brands, and distribution centers. This role ensures product availability while minimizing excess inventory through accurate forecasting, replenishment planning, inventory analysis, and collaboration with internal business partners.

Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, sound business judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively across multiple departments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage inventory planning and replenishment for assigned customers, warehouses, and distribution centers.
  • Utilize Blue Ridge Demand Planning and Acumatica ERP to analyze inventory positions and generate purchase recommendations.
  • Review forecasts, sales trends, seasonality, promotions, new product launches, and historical demand to ensure inventory plans align with business needs.
  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to understand customer initiatives, promotional events, and future demand changes.
  • Work closely with Purchasing to place and manage purchase orders while balancing lead times, vendor constraints, and inventory investment.
  • Coordinate with Transportation and Logistics teams to optimize inventory flow across distribution centers.
  • Evaluate inventory health by identifying stockout risks, excess inventory, slow-moving inventory, and obsolete products.
  • Develop recommendations to reduce excess inventory through inventory transfers, demand alignment, and inventory optimization strategies.
  • Monitor customer service levels and inventory performance to support company service objectives.
  • Participate in Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) meetings and provide inventory insights and recommendations.
  • Analyze large data sets to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and performance metrics that support business decision-making.
  • Support new product introductions, product transitions, and end-of-life inventory planning.
  • Ensure data integrity across planning systems and collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve discrepancies.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve planning processes, reporting, and inventory performance.

What Success Looks Like

Successful Inventory Planners consistently:

  • Maintain high product availability while minimizing excess inventory.
  • Improve forecast accuracy through proactive planning and collaboration.
  • Make timely, data-driven replenishment decisions.
  • Communicate inventory risks and recommendations clearly to stakeholders.
  • Build strong partnerships across Sales, Purchasing, Operations, Transportation, and Finance.
  • Identify process improvements that increase planning efficiency and inventory accuracy.
  • Take ownership of assigned customers and distribution centers with minimal oversight.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, Finance, Analytics, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in inventory planning, demand planning, supply chain, purchasing, operations, or a related analytical role.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Experience working with ERP systems.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with demand planning or inventory optimization software (Blue Ridge, SAP IBP, Kinaxis, o9, Logility, Anaplan, or similar).
  • Experience supporting major retail customers or omnichannel fulfillment operations.
  • Experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Snowflake.
  • Understanding of forecasting methodologies, inventory management principles, and replenishment planning.
  • APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM or CSCP) is a plus.

Our culture is passionate, entrepreneurial, and energetic. We value innovation through collaboration. And while we work smart and hard, we also connect and celebrate with equal gusto. We host team-building activities, athletic events, and seasonal celebrations to foster community and reward accomplishments. Bottom line? You’ll love it here.

Among the many benefits our team members enjoy are:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision care
  • 401k package with employer matching
  • Paid Time Off
  • Maternity/Paternity leave
  • Full indoor basketball/volleyball court
  • Fully equipped fitness center (cardio, weights, functional fitness area, lockers and showers, etc.)
  • Yoga studio
  • Meditation/Nap room
  • And much more!

Trove Brands is an equal opportunity employer.

Phone calls regarding this position are not accepted.

This is a fully in-office position at our HQ in Lehi, Utah.

title: CEO Office - AI Neobank App
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region.

Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for strong operators to join the CEO Office for BJAK's AI Neobank app expansion. This role is for someone who can help turn CEO priorities into execution across product, hiring, licensing, partnerships, market launch and daily operating rhythm.

What You'll Own

  • Drive CEO-level priorities from problem definition to execution. 

  • Track OKRs, decisions, blockers, owners and deadlines across teams. 

  • Support licensing applications, country expansion, hiring, partnerships and strategic projects. 

  • Prepare clear briefs, updates, research notes, meeting follow-ups and action trackers.

  • Work across product, engineering, finance, legal, compliance, operations and country teams. 

  • Identify execution gaps and push teams to close them. 

  • Own urgent business problems that do not fit neatly into one department.

What We're Looking For 

  • High-ownership business generalist with strong execution discipline. 

  • Clear writer, structured thinker and strong follow-through operator. 

  • Able to work directly with senior leadership and cross-functional teams. 

  • Comfortable handling ambiguity, urgent problems and shifting priorities. 

  • Strong judgement on what matters, what is blocked and what needs escalation. 

  • Able to keep teams moving without creating unnecessary process. 

  • Experience in startups, consulting, operations, strategy, fintech or founder-led environments is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want 

  • Turns unclear priorities into clear actions. 

  • Can chase, unblock and execute without being chased. 

  • Writes updates that make decisions easier. 

  • Stays calm when many things are moving at once. 

  • Cares about outcomes more than visibility.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings. 

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. 

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines. 

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems. 

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions

Location

  • This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Singapore. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Singapore.

Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process:

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: ML Infrastructure Engineer - Level 4
description:
Why Join HYCU?

HYCU is the fastest-growing leader in the multi-cloud and SaaS data protection as a service industry. By bringing true SaaS-based data backup and recovery to on-premises, cloud-native, and SaaS IT environments, the company provides unrivaled data protection, migration, disaster recovery, and ransomware protection to thousands of companies worldwide. The company's award-winning R-Cloud platform eliminates complexity, risk, and the high cost of legacy-based solutions, providing data protection simplicity to make it the #1 SaaS Data Protection platform. With an industry leading NPS score of 91, HYCU has raised $140M in VC funding to date and is based in Boston, Mass. Learn more at www.hycu.com.

Overview

We are seeking a ML Infrastructure Engineer that will be responsible for designing, building, and operating the infrastructure that supports Generative AI and machine learning workloads in production. This role ensures performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency of AI systems.

We are building next-generation Generative AI products that deliver actionable data insights at enterprise scale. Our platform runs large-scale AI workloads, including Large Language Models (LLMs), data pipelines, and AI agents, on modern cloud-native infrastructure. We focus on building reliable, scalable, cost-efficient, and production-grade AI infrastructure.

Location:

  • Bangalore, India (Hybrid; 3 days onsite/2 days remote)

What You’ll Do:

  • Design and operate infrastructure for training, serving, and scaling machine learning and Generative AI models
  • Build and optimize model serving and inference pipelines for Large Language Models
  • Enable scalable experimentation, evaluation, and deployment of AI models
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for AI infrastructure and model performance
  • Collaborate with AI, data, and DevOps teams to ensure end-to-end system reliability
  • Design and maintain scalable infrastructure for AI and ML workloads
  • Optimize inference performance, resource utilization, and operational costs
  • Implement observability solutions for model and infrastructure health
  • Partner with AI engineers to productionize models and workflows
  • Identify infrastructure risks and drive improvements proactively

What We’re Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 6–9 years of experience in infrastructure, platform, or ML engineering roles
  • Experience supporting production AI or data-intensive systems at scale
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms and modern infrastructure tooling
  • Strong experience with cloud platforms and cloud-native infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration technologies
  • Experience deploying and scaling ML or AI model serving systems
  • Strong understanding of performance optimization, cost management, and reliability engineering
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation

Attributes of a Successful HYCUer in this role:

  • Self-starter and strategic thinker who thinks outside the box
  • Takes responsibility and ownership for driving successful outcomes. You’re results-driven with a winning attitude
  • Team player! You have excellent people and management skills to interact with staff, colleagues, cross-functional teams and third parties
  • Hands-on and builders' mentality with an entrepreneurial mindset and intrinsic motivation
  • Obsessed with being customer-focused – We know our customers and are advocates for their voice and point of view across HYCU
  • Intellectual curiosity, always open for continuous learning/growth mindset

Who We Are:

Our Core Values: Authenticity, Grit and Empathy are at the heart of everything we do at HYCU. All of us at HYCU take ownership in shaping and contributing to our culture. We pride ourselves in developing an inclusive and diverse company that supports our employees and customers to do extraordinary things.

The following is how we approach each Core Value:

  • Authenticity – To be authentic means to be who we are and do it well. Focus your energy on being who YOU are. Be true to yourself. Authenticity also extends to our products. Understanding where we are truly the best fit for our customers and when we are not. And finally, authenticity in relationships: ensuring that we are honest and do what we say we’re going to do.
  • Grit – To win we need to want it. Every team member needs to be able to jump in and help at every turn. Whether it’s staying late to help a colleague or customer or finding a better process and making sure it’s communicated cross-functionally. You just have to do it and love it…and never stop trying.
  • Empathy – We need to care about each other, about our clients, about our business, and about the world around us. That might seem like a tall order, but if we don’t live in a constant state of empathy, if we don’t strive to truly put ourselves in another person’s shoes, we cannot truly serve the market.

"We are at our best when we stay true to our Core Values."~ Simon Taylor, CEO

What We Offer:

Come work for one of CRN’s “Cloud 100 Companies for 2026”. At HYCU you’ll have the opportunity to build your career with a “Visionary” B2B SaaS company from Gartner’s Magic Quadrant for Enterprise BackUp. HYCU provides an excellent benefits package including Medical Insurance, generous time off, and more. We offer career development programs and an inclusive global culture. All our employees participate in our equity program.

title: EV Vehicle Integration Specialist
description:
The Electric Vehicle Integration Specialist supports the development, testing, diagnosis, maintenance, and repair of electric vehicles and their high-voltage systems throughout the product development lifecycle. This hands-on role works closely with engineering and cross-functional teams to integrate prototype hardware and software, identify and resolve technical issues, and ensure vehicles meet performance, safety, reliability, and quality requirements before launch.

Schedule: Work hours may vary based on program and business needs. Early mornings, evenings, and weekends may be required.
Travel: Up to 50%, depending on program needs.

What you'll do...

  • Vehicle Testing and Evaluation: Conduct durability, performance, thermal-management, charging, and safety testing on prototype and production-intent electric vehicles in laboratory, dynamometer, test-track, and public-road environments.
  • Diagnostics and Troubleshooting: Use specialized diagnostic tools, software, and test equipment to identify and resolve electrical, electronic, software, and mechanical issues involving batteries, electric motors, inverters, charging systems, thermal systems, and vehicle controls.
  • Maintenance and Repair: Perform vehicle inspections, preventive maintenance, repairs, and component replacements, including work on high-voltage systems in accordance with established safety procedures.
  • High-Voltage Safety: Follow all applicable high-voltage safety requirements, including personal protective equipment, electrical safe-work practices, and Lockout/Tagout procedures.
  • Prototype Integration: Install and integrate prototype components, instrumentation, test hardware, wiring, and software builds. Perform software updates and approved calibration changes as required.
  • Test Setup and Equipment Support: Assemble and configure test rigs and instrumentation. Operate and maintain equipment such as digital multimeters, oscilloscopes, battery analyzers, data-acquisition systems, and vehicle diagnostic interfaces.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Accurately document test configurations, results, repairs, software versions, vehicle conditions, and technical issues. Provide clear findings and recommendations to support root-cause analysis and design improvements.
  • Issue Resolution: Reproduce concerns, collect relevant data, support root-cause investigations, and verify corrective actions.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, design, manufacturing, service, and testing teams to resolve technical problems and improve vehicle design, validation methods, and service-repair processes.
  • Workplace Organization: Maintain a safe, clean, and organized work environment while ensuring tools, equipment, vehicles, and test assets are properly maintained.

You'll have...

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Hands-on experience in automotive testing, diagnostics, maintenance, repair, vehicle integration, or a related technical environment.
  • Working knowledge of electrical, electronic, and mechanical vehicle systems.
  • Ability to use diagnostic software, electrical test equipment, and standard automotive repair tools.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical manuals, engineering drawings, electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and service procedures.
  • Understanding of electrical safety principles and safe work practices for high-voltage systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to safety and quality.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced product-development environment.
  • Ability to work a variable schedule and travel up to 50%, as business needs require.

Even better, you may have...

  • Associate degree, technical degree, or professional certification in automotive technology, electrical technology, engineering technology, or a related field.
  • Two or more years of relevant experience working with electric vehicles, high-voltage systems, vehicle integration, or automotive test operations.
  • Experience with dynamometers, test cells, prototype vehicles, data-acquisition systems, or on-road vehicle testing.
  • Knowledge of EV batteries, electric motors, inverters, onboard chargers, DC fast-charging systems, thermal-management systems, and vehicle communication networks.
  • Familiarity with OSHA requirements, NFPA 70E, Lockout/Tagout, and high-voltage personal protective equipment.
  • Experience installing prototype hardware, updating vehicle software, performing approved calibration changes, and documenting technical concerns.
  • Relevant EV or high-voltage safety certification.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:
• Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
• Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
• Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more

• Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value.
