title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (F/M/D)
description:
OUR VISION

When people use our technology to "bridge the gap" between the physical and digital worlds, they don’t just capture reality - they create a new one. In this new reality, they are smarter, more productive, more streamlined, and more creative - because they have the digital foundation to build the world they want to live in.

That’s what NavVis offers in all our products and services: the tools to not just map the world as it is, but to pave the way to a better future. To forge something new. Physical or digital, there is only one reality. And it’s the reality NavVis empowers people to build better.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Are you excited by the idea of building the technology behind immersive, browser-based 3D experiences at global scale?
We are looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer to help advance our flagship product, NavVis IVION, a cutting-edge web platform for exploring and managing photorealistic digital twins directly in the browser.

In this role, you will design and implement key parts of our client–server architecture, working with technologies such as Java, Spring, TypeScript, Angular, and PostgreSQL/PostGIS. You’ll collaborate closely with product, design, and fellow engineers to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-quality features that bring real-world spaces to life.

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend and frontend components of NavVis IVION, ensuring performance, reliability, and ease of use.
  • Develop and extend our Java/Spring-based application server and Angular/TypeScript web client, powering 3D visualization, mapping, and data management features.
  • Contribute to the evolution of our PostgreSQL/PostGIS data layer that stores and processes geospatial data at scale.
  • Build and enhance APIs that enable digital enrichment of environments and integration with third-party systems.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate user and business needs into robust technical solutions.
  • Maintain high engineering standards through code reviews, testing, and performance optimizations.
  • Support and mentor engineers with varying levels of experience within your squad, foster knowledge sharing, and encourage continuous improvement.

WHAT WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED IN THE ROLE

  • You bring 3+ years of experience in software engineering, with a track record of delivering complex systems.
  • Expertise in Java, Spring, Hibernate, and modern web application architectures, as well as advanced frontend experience with Angular and TypeScript.
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL/PostGIS) and building scalable, data-intensive services.
  • Demonstrated ability to define technical roadmaps and drive consensus in cross-functional environments.
  • Experience delivering APIs and SDKs, as well as gathering developer feedback to guide future improvements.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to contribute and help shaping technical direction across teams and organizations

Bonus if you bring

  • Working knowledge of C++ is very welcome; while not our primary daily language, it is occasionally required for specific projects.
  • Exposure to AWS Services, geospatial data, or 3D graphics/WebGL development.

HOW WE WILL KNOW WE ARE A PERFECT MATCH

Your recruiting partner for this role is Johnny (He/Him). You can expect to go through a screening call, and up to 4 rounds of interviews, where we would love to discover your passion and interests, introduce you to who we are and what drives us, and finally understand how we can potentially add value to each other's growth.

HOW WE WILL KEEP YOU SMILING

  • It's important to take a break from work! We offer 30 days of paid time off per year
  • Affordable access to a vast network of fitness and wellness facilities through EGYM Wellpass subsidy
  • Deutschlandticket subsidy to support sustainable travel using public transport
  • We offer flexible working hours and a hybrid work setup, enabling you to plan your work around your life, and not your life around work!
  • We offer full visa and relocation support for international candidates
  • An attractive bike leasing model through JobRad, in line with our commitment towards sustainable mobility
  • A competitive compensation package that values the skills and experience you bring
  • Up to 4000 EUR employee referral bonus
  • Financial support for local language classes to help you in your journey of integrating into the culture!

ABOUT US

NavVis is a technologically-focused, global leader in reality capture and digital factory solutions. Prominent manufacturers and laser scanning professionals around the world trust our ground-breaking technology, designed to capture and share the built environment as photorealistic digital twins. By bridging the physical and digital worlds, we’re helping organizations make smarter decisions and build more efficient, connected operations.
With over 300 people from around 60 nationalities and offices around the globe, we’re proud to be a truly international and diverse place to work. As a scaling company, we bring together the agility, innovation, and entrepreneurial mindset of a startup with the professionalism and reliability of an established enterprise — offering our team the best of both worlds.
You’ll be part of an open culture that values trust, collaboration, and transparency. We are proud of our environment where diverse talent can thrive and where feedback fosters individual growth and development. Do you share our passion for disruptive technology and want to be part of our dynamic journey? At NavVis, you’ll own your projects, bring innovative ideas to life, and have real opportunities to grow your career and be recognized for your impact.
We derive our strength from our diversity.

NavVis’ unwavering commitment to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace has laid the foundation for our incredible growth. We thrive on the collective strength of our people who come from diverse backgrounds. We respect and value every experience associated with race, gender identity, sexual orientation, nationality, religion and disability. We do not discriminate on the basis of any of these, or other identities, and strongly encourage everyone to apply.

Together with you, we build NavVis!

If you need assistance at any stage of the recruiting process due to a disability, please reach out to your recruiting partner(s) for this position.

title: Product Lead - AI Neobank App
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Philippines. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Philippines.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Loss Prevention Executive
description:

Patrol all areas of the property; secure rooms; assist guests with room access. Conduct emergency response drills, daily physical hazard/safety inspections, investigations, interviews, and key control audit. Monitor Closed Circuit Televisions and alarm systems. Authorize, monitor, and document access to secured areas. Assist guests/employees during emergency situations. Respond to accidents, contact EMS or administer first aid/CPR as required. Gather information and complete reports. Maintain confidentiality of reports/documents, release information to authorized individuals. Defuse disturbances in accordance with company policies and procedures. Resolve safety hazard situations. Handle all interruptions and complaints. Escort unwelcome persons from the property. Ensure compliance with alcoholic beverage control laws. Call for assistance using proper code responses. Provide proper paperwork to employees.

Assist management in training, motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Follow all company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests’ service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. In addition, some states may have additional licensing/registration requirements to be considered for this position. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Move at a speed required to respond to work situations (e.g., run, walk, jog). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 75 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

title: Segment SOX Officer
description:
The Segment SOX Officer plays a critical role within the SOX & Compliance team at Luxembourg, as he/she is

  • Lead and manage independently the local SOX ITGC program for the defined scope aligning it with the requirements of the Global SOX program.
  • Coordinate with ArcelorMittal Global IT Compliance Team / Global Assurance and the local IT Team for the SOX compliance program and be a focal point & take ownership for all SOX ITGC related issues and recommendations.
  • Provide timely status reporting as required by Global IT Compliance/FPE SOX team, and periodic status reports to the local IT management.
  • Identify/setup quick mitigation plans allowing to minimize/reduce Gaps
  • Participate/supervise urgent SOX action/mitigation plans involving several teams (business and IT)
  • Provide periodic management reporting allowing to give a synthetic view of the portfolio, issues and mitigations actions/plans
  • Optimize the SOX IT General Controls and related processes; and provide consultation & advisory for various best practices on SOX ITGC related matters.
  • Coordinate with the business for periodic risk assessments & scoping activities.
  • Create and Maintain (with periodic review) of ITGC RCM, control descriptions and preparation of testing procedures aligning it with the global framework.
  • Organize & Monitor the Internal SOX ITGC Testing – ToD, ToE & RF phases with the identified resources.
  • Manage any Gaps raised internally including follow-ups for remediation & mitigation activities; and provide consultancy for remediation & mitigation efforts.
  • Ensure the external SOX ITGC audits are planned, organized & coordinated with the relevant stakeholders, adhering to the group compliance calendar / requirements.
  • Organize and manage necessary periodic meetings, status updates with the external audit team for SOX ITGC requirements to discuss and agree upon the audit results and findings.
  • Manage any Gaps raised externally including follow-ups for remediation & mitigation activities; and provide consultancy for remediation & mitigation.
  • Evaluate open deficiencies for ITGCs at year end for financial statement risk, perform risk assessments for any terminal gaps and manage them for a quick close-out.
  • Maintenance of SOX ITGC GAP Summary report - Preparation, updating and follow-up, and ensure that remediation activities are done on a timely basis as per group guidelines.
  • Provide all necessary advisories, participate in key project initiatives for identifying & managing related SOX requirements.
  • Support control implementation for new controls coming from ITGC framework update / change of existing ITGCs for existing scope.

The Segment SOX Officer will be connected to all IT teams (based in India at the GCC or in Europe) and is reporting to Head of D&IT Finance & Compliance.

Minimum applicant attribute:

  • 8-10 years of relevant experience as IT auditor (including as internal auditor).
  • Strong Knowledge of SAP Security & Authorizations (Knowledge of application / tool is a plus: SAP GRC or SAP IG or Pathlock or CSI AA, SailPoint ARM)
  • Background in IT Engineering is a plus.
  • Strong knowledge in ITGC/ITAC, GDPR.
  • IT Project/change management in relation to SOX (e.g. deploy SOX to an existing app)
  • Excellent understanding of IT applications, architecture and systems.
  • Excellent communication skills and capability to synthetize, coordinate and report to C-level business people
  • Assertive and ability to coordinate multi-cultural and multi-sites teams of different levels
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, networking and listening skills.
  • Strategic mindset and problem-solving skills.
  • Analytical mindset and creativity to seek, encourage innovation.
  • Strong customer-oriented mindset and real sense of emergency.

Prisijungusi (-ęs) prie mūsų komandos tapsi organizacijos, kuriančios Lietuvos energetikos ateitį, dalimi. Mums svarbu, kad kolegės (-os) ne tik prisidėtų prie itin svarbių ir visai Lietuvai reikšmingų projektų, bet augtų ir jaustųsi įgalinti.

Mes siūlome:

  • kurti ir įgyvendinti projektus, keičiančius Lietuvos energetikos sistemą;
  • galimybę auginti savo kompetencijas, įsitraukiant į unikalius projektus, dirbant kartu su savo srities profesionalais;
  • mokymus profesiniam ir asmeniniam tobulėjimui;
  • dirbti lanksčiai – derinant darbą biure ir nuotoliniu būdu;
  • karjeros galimybes „EPSO-G“ įmonių grupėje;
  • papildomą sveikatos draudimą;
  • socialinių naudų paketą, kuris suteikia paramą darbuotojams ir jų šeimos svarbiomis gyvenimo akimirkomis;
  • pozityvią darbo aplinką, kur kiekvienas gali jausti svarbus, girdimas ir vertinamas;
  • papildomas apmokamas atostogas.

Siūlomas atlygis: 3100–3600 EUR (su mokesčiais), priklausomai nuo kompetencijų ir patirties. Vertiname darbuotojų pastangas ir už individualius bei komandos pasiektus rezultatus gali būti taikomas papildomas finansinis skatinimas pagal „ESPO-G“ grupės vidinę tvarką.

About the role
The Process Lead is responsible for the Daily Management System (DMS) processes and utilising structured problem-solving techniques, which supports and helps build employee skills and capability. The Process Lead will forward options and recommend actions to prevent or reduce losses. Your decision making will be made in close collaboration with the Line Lead and Maintenance Lead.

What’s in it for you?
We believe in rewarding our colleagues and helping them thrive. Here’s a flavour of what we offer:

  • Comprehensive healthcare support – including Medicash Health Cash Plan, Digital GP, Best Doctors second opinion service and specialist cancer care

title: Tilkaldetolke (ukrainsk og farsi) til DIGNITY
description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde i en organisation, som gør en konkret og positiv forskel for udsatte mennesker i Danmark og verden over? Og har du stærke kompetencer inden for tolkning (ukrainsk og farsi) i komplekse behandlingssituationer inden for sundhedssektoren?

Så kan DIGNITY tilbyde dig en spændende mulighed, da vi har ledige stillinger som timelønnet tilkaldetolk tilknyttet vores Rehabiliteringsklinik. Vi har brug for tolkning indenfor sprogene ukrainsk og farsi.

DIGNITY har siden 1982 arbejdet for en verden fri for tortur og vold. Vi er en menneskerettigheds- og udviklingsorganisation, som også driver en rehabiliteringsklinik. Vi forebygger tortur og vold, behandler traumatiserede ofre og dokumenterer alvorlige menneskeretskrænkelser, så de ansvarlige kan blive retsforfulgt.

DIGNITY’s Rehabiliteringsklinik er en del af vores afdeling for National Rehabilitering, som også rummer en forskningsenhed. Vi er samlet set 25 medarbejdere i afdelingen og arbejder med tværfaglig behandling, rehabilitering og forskning. Vores klinik er godkendt af Sundhedsstyrelsen til at behandle traumatiserede flygtninge og deres familier på hoved- og regionsfunktionsniveau. Vi samarbejder med Socialstyrelsen som VISO-leverandør med specialrådgivning og udredning omkring socialt udsatte børn og unge.

Vores rehabilitering er som udgangspunkt tilrettelagt i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde mellem psykologer, læger, fysioterapeuter og socialrådgivere, og vores forskningsenhed samarbejder tæt med de øvrige rehabiliterings- og indvandrermedicinske klinikker i Danmark. Derudover har vi et sekretariat, der varetager en række af vores administrative opgaver. Afdelingen ledes af en afdelingsleder, som også er klinikchef, og derudover en souschef samt en leder af forskningsenheden.

Om stillingen

Din primære opgave vil være tolkning for patienter i tværfaglige behandlingsforløb. Der kan i mindre omfang være tale om skriftlige tolkeopgaver.

Alle vores tilkaldetolke koordinerer deres arbejde i samarbejde med klinikkens sekretariat.

Kompetencer

Vi forventer, at du:

  • kan formulere dig mundtligt tydeligt og klart på både dansk såvel som det sprog, som du ansættes til at tolke på (ukrainsk eller farsi).
  • har erfaring med tolkning i komplekse behandlingssituationer.
  • er fortrolig med brug af TEAMS, Outlook og Word. Det er et krav i forhold til planlægning, at du i samarbejdet anvender en fælles DIGNITY Outlook kalender.

Derudover leder vi efter tolke, der er positive, imødekommende og punktlige, og udviser en god situationsfornemmelse i kontakten med de udsatte patienter, der kommer i vores klinik.

Det er en fordel, hvis du er fortrolig med medicinsk, fysiologisk, patologisk, psykologisk og psykiatrisk terminologi samt har kendskab til social- og sundhedsvæsenet.

Det er ligeledes en fordel - men ikke et krav – at du har en tolkeuddannelse, kan tolke fra engelsk samt har kendskab til tolkning indenfor specialiseret traumebehandling.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Der er tale om en timelønnet stilling. Det er ikke muligt at garantere et konkret timeantal, da vores tilkaldetolkes opgaver afhænger af, hvilke sprogkompetencer vi har behov for bistand til, hvilket igen er afhængig af, hvilke patienter vi modtager i vores klinik.

Tolkeopgaver finder som udgangspunkt sted på vores hovedadresse på Bryggervangen 55, 2100 København Ø, men der kan i mindre omfang være tale om hjemmebesøg, digitale sessioner over telefon eller TEAMS.

Arbejdsopgaver koordineres mellem dig og klinikkens sekretariat.

Stillingen aflønnes på timebasis. Timelønnen udgør kr. 348,00 i timen plus ferietillæg 12,5 %. For aftaler med fremmøde på Bryggervangen aflønnes med et ekstra tillæg svarende til kr. 87,00 i timen.

Vi indhenter børneattester for alle, som er eller kan blive beskæftiget med børn under 15 år, og ansættelsen er betinget af en ren børneattest (DIGNITY indhenter attesten efter dit samtykke).

Mere information

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte klinikkens souschef, Christina Arrebo Andersen på tlf. 31 40 67 13/mail: CAA@dignity.dk fra den 10. august 2026.

Ansøgning og samtaler

Send din ansøgning med CV, eksamensbevis og eventuelle andre relevante dokumenter via linket senest onsdag den 19. august 2026.

Vi forventer at afholde samtaler onsdag den 26. august 2026 .

Du kan læse om DIGNITYs behandling af dine personoplysninger i vores privatlivspolitik, som du finder her: https://www.dignity.dk/privatlivspolitik/


DIGNITY er en international menneskerettigheds- og udviklingsorganisation. Vi har siden 1982 arbejdet for en verden fri for tortur og vold. Vi forebygger tortur og vold, behandler traumatiserede ofre og støtter lokale partnerorganisationer i at dokumentere alvorlige menneskeretskrænkelser, så de ansvarlige kan blive retsforfulgt.

DIGNITY har hovedsæde i Danmark, men samarbejder med partnerorganisationer i omkring tyve lande.

DIGNITY betragter mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede til at søge stillingen uanset etnisk baggrund, køn, seksuel orientering, handicap, religion eller alder.

title: Lähihoitaja, Etelä-Hervannan ja Hervannan kotihoito
description:
Etelä-Hervannan ja Hervannan kotihoidot sijaitsevat Hermian alueella hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella. Etelä-Hervannassa on kolme hoitajatiimiä ja Hervannassa neljä hoitajatiimiä. Tiimeissä tehdään tiivistä moniammatillista yhteistyötä.

Kotihoidon lähihoitajana työskentelet asiakkaiden kodeissa. Työsi on itsenäistä, liikkuvaa ja päivät ovat erilaisia. Kotihoidossa työsi on monipuolista sekä ihmisläheistä hoito- ja hoivatyötä. Jokapäiväisessä käytössämme on myös työtä tukevaa teknologiaa, kuten lääkeautomaatteja ja kuvapuhelimia.

Miksi hakea meille?
Hyvän perehdytyksen sekä vahvan tuen työkavereilta ja esihenkilöltä.
Vaikutusmahdollisuuden omiin työvuoroihisi, jotta vapaa-ajan ja työn yhdistäminen olisi mutkatonta.
Välimatkat taittuvat pääasiassa parhaiten pyörällä ja autolla, mutta meillä on käytössä myös leasingautoja, bussikortteja ja sähköpolkupyöriä.
Tarjoamme hyvät työsuhde-edut kuten vuosittaisen liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hyvinvointiedun Epassilla, työnantajan lounasedun ja tyhy- sekä Virkisty Vapaalla ry:n toimintaa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?
Olet nimikesuojattu lähihoitaja (sosiaalihuolto) tai perushoitaja.
Sinulla on jo hyväksytysti suoritetut LOVe-lääkehoidon verkkotestit.
Puhut ja kirjoitat sujuvasti suomea.
Oma-aloitteisuutta ja myönteistä suhtautumista teknologiaan.
Asiakaslähtöistä ajattelutapaa, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kehittämismyönteisyyttä
Eduksesi katsomme kokemuksen ikäihmisten kotihoidosta ja voimassa olevan B-luokan ajokortin.

Aloitus vakituisessa tehtävässä sopimuksen mukaan. Työaika on kokoaikatyö, keskimäärin 38 h 15 min/vk. Työhön sisältyy aamu- ja iltavuoroja. Koeaika on kuusi kuukautta. Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 4 momentin mukainen rikosrekisteriote ennen työsuhteen alkamista. Suosittelemme vahvasti tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 §:n mukaista rokotesuojaa.

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi Kuntarekryssä! Haastattelemme jo hakuajalla.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu kiinteistöjen perushuolto, kuten wc-istuinten ja hanojen pienkorjaukset sekä viemäritukosten avaukset. Työ on pääasiassa teknistä kiinteistönhoitoa, mutta satunnaisesti tehtäviin voi sisältyä myös muita kiinteistöhuollon tehtäviä.

Työaika on arkisin klo 7.30–15.30, ja liikkumista varten käytössäsi on työnantajan tarjoama auto.

Toivomme sinulta kiinteistöhuollon koulutusta tai aiempaa kokemusta alalta.
Sujuva suomen kielen taito ja B-ajokortti ovat välttämättömiä tehtävässä menestymiseen. Arvostamme myös hyviä perustaitoja yleisissä huoltotöissä.

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä itsenäisesti ja monipuolisesti, sekä mahdollisuuden pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian ja kestää vähintään kuukauden, mutta jatko on mahdollinen. Pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista tiimiä, jossa työpanostasi arvostetaan.

Jos olet vastuuntuntoinen ja pidät vaihtelevista työtehtävistä, tämä on tilaisuutesi! Tule mukaan tekemään tärkeää työtä kiinteistöjen toimivuuden ja asukkaiden viihtyvyyden eteen.

title: Brugwachter
description:
Als brugwachter verbind jij het scheepverkeer met het treinverkeer.

Werk om trots op te zijn

Als brugwachter in Alkmaar ben jij verantwoordelijk voor een veilige en vlotte afhandeling van scheepvaartverkeer in Noord-Holland. Er zijn vaste openingstijden en in overleg met de treindienstleider kan de brug geopend worden. Je werkt zorgvuldig en beheerst en voorkomt dat zowel de brug onnodig lang gesloten blijft voor de scheepvaart als onnodig lang open blijft en het treinverkeer hindert. Je bent werkzaam op de verkeersleidingspost in Alkmaar en zorgt samen met je collega’s dat het treinverkeer geen vertraging oploopt. Dit doe je door:

  • Bruggen te bedienen met behulp van realtime camera beelden.
  • Het trein- en scheepvaartverkeer te monitoren via meerdere beeldschermen.
  • Zorgvuldig en professioneel te communiceren met de treinverkeersleiders, het scheepvaartverkeer en buurt brugwachters.
  • Samen te werken met de treindienstleider om brugopeningen efficiënt in te plannen.
  • Te voorkomen dat bruggen onnodig lang gesloten blijven voor treinverkeer.

We zoeken iemand voor maximaal 28 uur per week.

Jouw plek

We bieden graag ruimte aan iedereen. Daarbij zien we talent als basis en diversiteit als kracht om samen betere resultaten te behalen. Voor jou als brugwachter is er plek op onze verkeersleidingspost Alkmaar, een van de 12 verkeersleidingsposten die het treinverkeer in Nederland soepel en veilig laten verlopen. Het team bestaat uit zo’n 58 collega’s. Een mooie werkplek waar je samen met je collega’s 24/7 het trein- en scheepvaartverkeer in goede banen leidt. Je werkt in diensten vroeg, laat en dag.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €3.175,- en €3.808,- o.b.v. 36 uur per week, in aanloopschaal 2. Na het behalen van afgesproken werkdoelen in samenspraak met je manager, zal je bevorderd worden naar schaal 3.
  • Direct een vast contract. Wij hebben vertrouwen in jou.
  • Een NS-Business Card met TreinVrij of kilometervergoeding (€ 0,25 per kilometer onbelast bij maximaal 120 kilometer retour per dag).
  • 13,61% van jouw brutosalaris in de vorm van een Individueel KeuzeBudget (IKB). Aan jou de keuze waar je dit voor inzet. Dit budget is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag en 3,25% decemberuitkering.
  • 170 vrije uren én de optie om tot 4 weken verlof bij te kopen vanuit jouw IKB.
  • Een onregelmatigheidstoeslag.

Wij kozen voor een kleine selectie uit onze arbeidsvoorwaarden. Maar we bieden je meer. Voor alle arbeidsvoorwaarden en onze CAO klik op deze link.

Jouw inbreng

Bij ProRail vinden wij het belangrijk dat jij gewoon jezelf kan zijn. Daarom zijn wij benieuwd naar wie jij bent. Voor deze functie breng je sowieso mee:

  • Je bent in het bezit van ten minste een MBO niveau 3 diploma.
  • Je hebt minimaal twee jaar werkervaring (bij voorkeur met het bedienen van bruggen of verkeersleiding).
  • Je bent in bezit van het marifoon certificaat of bereid die te behalen.
  • Je hebt ervaring met het werken met beeldschermen.
  • Je hebt ervaring met werken in onregelmatige diensten.

Jouw sollicitatie

Wil je als brugwachter werken aan de toekomst van Nederland én aan die van jezelf? Solliciteer voor 13 augustus. Bij voldoende geschikte sollicitaties sluit de vacature mogelijk eerder. Solliciteer daarom snel als je interesse hebt. Toch eerst nog een vraag? Stel deze gerust aan Puck Pieterse via puck.pieterse@prorail.nl. Voor inhoudelijke vragen kun je contact opnemen met de Ina Visser via ina.visser@prorail.nl. De sollicitatiegesprekken zullen plaatsvinden op 18 augustus, dus houd hier rekening mee.

Je krijgt zo spoedig mogelijk na de sluitingsdatum onze reactie. Het opvragen van een referentie kan onderdeel zijn van jouw sollicitatieproces. Bij voldoende sollicitanten zullen we de vacature vroegtijdig sluiten. Hierna reageren heeft geen zin, ook niet via de mail!

Word jij onze nieuwe collega? Dan hoort het aanvragen van een VOG tot de indiensttredingsprocedure. De kosten voor de VOG krijg je terug nadat je bent gestart.

title: Resident Technical Officer (M&E) - Central

title: Data Analytics Engineer
description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Data Analytics Engineer

Location: São Paulo (4 days on-site, 1 day remote)

Ebury is a FinTech success story, positioned among the fastest-growing international companies in its sector. Headquartered in London, we have more than 1,000 staff covering over 50 nationalities (and counting!) working across more than 27 offices worldwide and serving more than 45,000 clients every day.

About our team:

Ebury’s strategic growth plan would not be possible without our Data team and we are seeking a Analytics Engineer to join our Analytics Engineering team!

Our data mission is to develop and maintain Ebury’s Data Platform and serve it to the whole company, where Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers and Data Analysts work collaboratively to:

  • Build ETLs and data pipelines to serve data in our platform
  • Provide clean, transformed data ready for analysis and used by our BI tool
  • Develop department and project-specific data models and serve these to teams across the company to drive decision-making
  • Automate end solutions so we can all spend time on high-value analysis rather than running data extracts
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand the requirements, advising on and influencing the solutions, and taking ownership of data implementation and delivery

About our technology and Data stack:

  • Google Cloud Platform as our main Cloud provider
  • Apache Airflow as orchestration tool
  • Cloud Build as CICD
  • dbt as data modelling and warehousing
  • Looker and Looker Studio as Business Intelligence/dashboarding
  • Github as code management tool
  • Jira as project management tool
  • Among others third party tools such as: Hevodata, Synq…

About the role:

As an Analytics Engineer, you will be an integral part of our data team. You will work closely with the rest of the team to help model and maintain the Data Platform.

This role also encompasses important responsibilities in quality assurance, data governance, and promoting best practices to ensure that data-related processes are efficient, secure, and adhere to industry standards.

As part of the team you will

  • Gather requirements from the business and define an action plan to execute them.
  • Work on projects end to end, from definition to delivery.
  • Serve hands-on delivery of data models using solid software engineering practices (eg. version control, testing, CI/CD)
  • Collaborate with team members to reinforce best practices across the platform, encouraging a shared commitment to quality.
  • Manage overall pipeline orchestration using Airflow (hosted in Cloud Composer)
  • Design, develop, deploy and maintain ELT/ETL data pipelines from a variety of data sources (transactional databases, REST APIs, file-based endpoints).
  • Contribute to and promote best practices for query development, version control, code review, documentation, and testing.

What we’re looking for

  • 2+ years of data/analytics engineering experience building, maintaining & optimising data pipelines & ETL processes on big data environments
  • Proficiency in SQL
  • Mid - Level experience with Python
  • Experience with our modern data stack tools (a plus!) We use dbt, Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, DataStudio), Looker
  • Familiarity with dimensional modelling/data warehousing concepts
  • Experience with software engineering practices in data
  • Attention to detail and commitment to data quality
  • Advanced in English (Spanish, a plus)

#LI-JC1

#LI-HYBRID

About us

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.

Submit your CV and professional portfolio.

title: Railway Validation and Verification engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Test and Validation Engineer to join our team, focusing on testing for embedded systems within the railway sector:

  • Define, update, and execute test strategies based on system and functional requirements.
  • Design, execute, and maintain test cases and validation procedures for signalling subsystems.
  • Perform non-regression, delta, and gap testing to ensure system compliance and stability.
  • Set up, maintain, and support test environments, including test benches, HIL/SIL platforms, and laboratory rigs.
  • Investigate, track, and coordinate resolution of anomalies through Change Request and defect management processes.
  • Collaborate with Design, Software, and RAMS teams to implement corrective actions and ensure issue closure.
  • Produce test reports, analyze results, and provide validation recommendations.
  • Capitalize on and document V&V knowledge, ensuring effective knowledge transfer and team upskilling.
  • Support integration and validation activities in laboratory environments and contribute to defect analysis.
  • Participate in occasional business trips for product knowledge transfer and collaboration with international teams.
  • Master’s degree (BAC+5) from an engineering school or university specializing in embedded systems.
  • At least 5 years of successful experience in system/product validation, functional testing, or integration in a safety-critical industry (rail, aerospace, automotive)
  • Perform system and product validation activities, including functional, non-regression, and delta/gap testing in a safety-critical environment.
  • Design, set up, and maintain test environments and validation benches (HIL/SIL) for system integration and verification.
  • Manage requirements traceability and validation evidence using tools such as DOORS, Reqtify, and EWM throughout the V-Cycle.

title: iOS Developer
description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain or the UK.
  • Contract:
    • Spain: Full-time, permanent contrato indefinido via Deel (our employer of record in Spain)
    • UK: Full-time, permanent
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

Curious what it's actually like to work at Airalo? We've put together a guide for each of the hubs we hire from most, covering our benefits, remote culture, employment setup, and what our team values most:

  • Life at Airalo · España: https://airalo-public.notion.site/life-at-airalo-espana
  • Life at Airalo · United Kingdom: https://airalo-public.notion.site/life-at-airalo-united-kingdom

We are looking for a skilled iOS engineer who is ready to learn and keen to join our expert team developing new features and extending the existing ones in our main product!
We welcome talented, passionate, innovative, result-oriented professionals who strive to absorb new knowledge and technologies and are willing to use them.

In this role, you will work within a modern development environment that leverages a modular architecture with Swift Package Manager (SPM), hybrid UI workflows combining SwiftUI for views and UIKit for navigation, and Swift Concurrency. You will be part of a team committed to high code quality through high unit test coverage (80%+) and cutting-edge agentic End-to-End (E2E) workflows.

Your main responsibilities are:

  • Build Core Software: Design and develop enterprise-quality software components based on product specifications, delivering brand-new features as well as enhancements to existing ones.
  • Ensure Code Quality & Reliability: Write clean code adhering to team guidelines, implement robust tests, and troubleshoot technical or application issues as they arise.
  • Collaborate Across the Lifecycle: Work daily alongside fellow developers throughout the full software development lifecycle, and prepare clear technical documentation to enrich our iOS knowledge base.
  • Drive Continuous Innovation: Stay current with industry best practices and proactively bring fresh, creative ideas to the engineering team.

    • Does this sound like you:

  • Proven iOS Engineering Background: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering (or a similar field) and bring at least 3 years of hands-on experience developing Swift-based iOS applications within agile teams—including a track record of publishing and continuously supporting one or more live apps.
  • Core Technical & Architectural Mastery: You are confident in software architecture and design, with deep proficiency in MVVM (or similar modern patterns), OOP principles, iOS Frameworks, and Git/Gitflow workflows.
  • Modern UI & Domain Experience: You bring strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, processes, and memory management, combined with practical experience building pixel-perfect UIs with SwiftUI and Auto-Layout, alongside domain exposure to payment systems and marketplaces.
  • Quality & Modern Workflow Expertise: You prioritize software reliability through Unit Testing, Feature Testing, and Mocking, and you bring solid, up-to-date knowledge of AI workflows and agentic engineering.
  • Strong Collaboration & English Skills: You possess strong communication skills and full fluency in English, thriving in a team-first development environment.

    • Bonus:

  • UI/UX & Testing: Knowledge of UI/UX best practices and experience in A/B testing.
  • Agile & Telecom: Prior experience with SCRUM and other agile methods.
  • Domain Knowledge: Prior work experience in telecommunications, including knowledge of eSIM and GSMA related technologies and services.

    • Why People Join Us

    🇪🇸 Why people join us in Spain

    We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

    Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact.

    For many of our teammates in Spain, it's the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home.

    🇬🇧 Why people join us in the UK

    We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product first discovered us as customers.

    Our team spans 60+ countries, but what people often notice quickly is how work actually feels here. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

    As Airalo continues to grow, people tend to stay for a mix of things: the chance to work on a product used globally, the autonomy to shape how they work, and the opportunity to keep taking on new challenges without getting stuck in one lane.

    Before You Hit Apply

    By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here: www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy?srsltid=AfmBOooBT0rXAj1FaNelZ3VfN0wvhwzvAoxdtHnOKSVETpiSjiXVuycy
    We sincerely thank all applicants in advance for submitting their interest in this opportunity. Airalo is an equal-opportunity employer and values diversity, equity & inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations upon request for individuals with disabilities throughout our job interview process.

title: Vanhempi konstaapeli (04.04), Mikkeli
description:
Vanhemman konstaapelin virka on sijoitettu Itä-Suomen poliisilaitoksen eteläisen kenttäjohtoalueen valvonta- ja hälytystoiminnan yksikön kenttävalvontaryhmään. Virkapaikka on Mikkeli.
Vanhemman konstaapelin tehtäviin kuuluu:
- yleisen järjestyksen ja turvallisuuden monipuoliset valvontatehtävät
- hälytystehtävien hoitaminen
- ensipartion toimenpiteet rikospaikoilla ja suppea esitutkinta
- monipuoliset tutkintatehtävät
- muut esimiesten erikseen määrättävät tehtävät

Virkaan valittava toimii tehtävissään poliisin arvojen mukaisesti.

Valvonta- ja hälytystoimintayksikön tehtävänä on tuottaa 24/7 hälytyspartiotoimintaa, YJT-valvontaa ja liikenteen valvontaa toiminta-alueellaan. Poliisilaitoksen eteläinen kenttäjohtoalue kattaa Etelä-Savon maakunnan ja Varkauden, Leppävirran, Joroisten ja Heinäveden kunnat. Alueella on neljä poliisiasemaa: Mikkeli, Savonlinna, Varkaus ja Pieksämäki. Alueelle tunnusomaista ovat pitkät välimatkat sekä laajat vesistöalueet. Alueella on runsaasti vapaa-ajan asutusta, kesäisin huomattavan paljon erilaisia tapahtumia sekä monipuoliset harrastusmahdollisuudet etenkin luontoon liittyen. Kenttäjohtoalueella on siirrytty osin myös monialaisen poliisityön malliin.

title: Security Technician specialized in Fire Protection Systems
description:
The Physical Security Technician will be responsible for managing Fire Protection Systems, overseeing maintenance services, and supporting the implementation of new security projects. This role is essential to ensuring the safety of facilities, maintaining regulatory compliance, and assisting in the continuous improvement of physical security measures. The responsibilities of the profile will be divided into the following topics:

Fire Protection Systems (PCI) Management:

  • Monitor the installation and maintenance of PCI equipment such as fire extinguishers, smoke detectors, alarms, and sprinklers.
  • Ensure that all fire safety equipment is fully operational and compliant with applicable regulations.
  • Conduct regular inspections and internal audits of PCI elements to ensure the maximum effectiveness of safety systems.
  • Coordinate with external vendors to ensure timely maintenance of all physical security systems.
  • Supervise the quality of service provided by contractors and ensure corrective actions are implemented promptly.

External Firefighting Team Management:

  • Lead and manage the internal/external firefighting team, ensuring proper coordination, availability, and operational readiness.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for firefighting team members, addressing concerns and facilitating communication with management.

External PCI Maintenance Service Management:

  • Manage and supervise external contractors responsible for regulatory PCI maintenance, ensuring compliance with all legal and safety requirements.
  • Coordinate scheduled maintenance activities with external service providers, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
  • Review and approve maintenance reports, certifications, and regulatory documentation provided by contractors.
  • Ensure corrective actions from maintenance inspections are implemented promptly and effectively.
  • Track maintenance schedules and ensure all regulatory deadlines are met to maintain full compliance.

Support for New Physical Security Projects:

  • Assist in the planning and implementation of new physical security projects, from the design phase to final execution, ensuring adherence to safety and quality standards.
  • Collaborate in risk assessments to identify necessary improvements or new implementations related to physical security.
  • Work with other departments to ensure new security measures are effectively integrated into daily operations.

Regulatory Compliance and Training:

  • Ensure compliance with current regulations related to physical security and PCI, staying up to date with regulatory changes.
  • Support training activities for staff on emergency procedures and the use of PCI equipment.
  • Maintain documentation and evidence for regulatory audits and certifications.
  • Develop and update emergency response procedures and fire safety protocols.

Coordination with the primary responsible of Physical Security:

  • Coordinate with the primary responsible for physical security to provide support and ensure seamless service when necessary, such as during absences or vacations, maintaining full cooperation between both areas to ensure comprehensive security coverage.
  • Provide backup support for physical security operations, demonstrating flexibility and cross-functional capability.
  • Support in leading emergency response coordination during fire incidents.

Administrative and Documentation Management:

  • Maintain comprehensive records of inspections, maintenance activities, incidents, KPIs and training sessions.
  • Ensure proper documentation flow between internal departments and external service providers.
  • Manage administrative tasks related to service contracts, warranties, costs and compliance certificates.

Education:

  • Training or equivalent experience in physical security and fire protection systems is required.

Profile:

The following qualifications are required for this profile:

  • Experience in emergency response or equivalent practical experience in fire protection.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and coordinate maintenance services.
  • Knowledge of physical security standards and fire safety regulations.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills.
  • Flexibility and teamwork skills to support cross-functional responsibilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, Outlook) for documentation and reporting.
  • Leadership and team management skills, with the ability to coordinate and motivate firefighting personnel.
  • Experience managing external service providers and supervising contractor performance.

Other considered assets:

  • Experience in maintenance coordination or facility management.
  • Project management skills or demonstrated ability to contribute to multi-phase projects.
  • Valid driver's license (for site inspections and vendor meetings).
  • English language skills (written and spoken) for technical documentation and international supplier communication.
  • Previous experience managing emergency response teams or volunteer firefighting brigades.
  • Knowledge of regulatory PCI maintenance requirements and certification processes.

Personal Competencies of the profile:

  • Proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining strong team collaboration.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to safety standards.
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn new systems and procedures.
  • Leadership potential in emergency situations and the ability to make critical decisions.
  • Strong interpersonal skills for team management and cross-departmental coordination.
  • Assertiveness and negotiation skills for managing external service providers effectively.

Languages:

  • A high level of English is required.

Applus IDIADA is committed to equality, diversity and inclusion. We don’t put limits on you, so don’t put limits on yourself either. There is a place for everyone.

title: Myyntiedustaja, Sadex Oy, Rovaniemi
description:
Sadex on kotimainen yritys, joka suojaa ja turvaa suomalaisia katolta tippuvalta vedeltä ja lumelta sekä tekee katolla liikkumisen turvallisemmaksi.Toteutamme yksityis- ja yritysasiakkaiden vesikouru-, tikas- ja kattoturvatuoteurakat suunnittelusta asennukseen. Sadexilla on kaksitoista toimipistettä ympäri Suomea. Teemme työtämme rehdisti ja intohimoisesti ympäri vuoden, asiakkaan turvallisuus ja tyytyväisyys edelläsekähenkilöstön hyvinvointiin panostaen.

Haluatko turvata ja suojata suomalaista asumista sekä olla mukana nostamassa rakentamisen laatua? Onko sinulle tärkeää osallistua työyhteisön rakentamiseen omalla persoonallasi ja kannustaa myös muita menestymään omassa työssään? Etsimme nyt asiantuntijamyyjää Lapin alueelle vastaamaan Lapin ränni- ja kattoturvatuotemyynnistä omakotiasiakkaille ja taloyhtiöille.

Sadex on suomalaisen rakentamisen luotettava tekijä. Olemme toimineet Lapissa noin vuoden ja nyt etsimme Rovaniemen myyntitiimiimme huipputyyppiä pitämään huolta siitä, että palvelumme tavoittavat asiakkaat parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla. Asiakkainamme on kaikkea valtakunnallisista rakennusliikkeistä paikallisiin rakentajiin, taloyhtiöihin ja yksityisasiakkaisiin.

Sadexilla työnkuvaasi kuuluu

· sadevesijärjestelmien, tikkaiden ja kattoturvatuotteiden myynti yksityisasiakkaille ja taloyhtiöille koko Lapin alueella

· aktiivinen asiakashankinta ja kohteiden kartoituskäynnit

· uusien omakotialueiden ja rakennustyömaiden kierrokset

· tarjouslaskenta

· asennussuunnitelmien laatiminen

Odotamme sinulta erityisesti oma-aloitteisuutta, määrätietoisuutta ja motivaatiota rehdin asiakaslähtöiseen myyntityöhön. Sovit joukkoomme, mikäli olet luonteeltasi tiimipelaaja, nautit ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja pidät liikkuvasta työstä. Lisäksi katsomme eduksesi mahdollisen aiemman kokemuksesi alalta ja myyntityöstä. Rakennusalan kokemus ei kuitenkaan ole välttämätön, sillä koulutamme loistavalla asenteella varustetun henkilön kattavasti tehtävään. Meillä ovat pärjänneet myyntityössä aiemmin myyntityötä tehneiden lisäksi niin sairaanhoitajat kuin kokitkin! Oma auto ja ajokortti ovat työssäsi välttämättömät.

Tarjoamme sinulle onnistumiseen alan nykyaikaisimmat myynnin työkalut, vahvan joukkueemme tuen sekä erittäin kannustavan palkkausmallin, jossa onnistumisesi huomioidaan reilusti. Vaikka työssäsi menestyminen pohjautuukin vahvasti omaan aktiiviseen myyntiotteeseesi, tulet saamaan valmiita liidejä myös tehokkaalta markkinointitiimiltämme. Mukaan salkkuusi saat Sadexin erinomaisen maineen, ensiluokkaiset tuotteet ja korkean asiakastyytyväisyyden, jotka kaikki tukevat menestymistä roolissasi.

Työpäivän tiimellyksessä käytössäsi on aina tuore, ilmainen kahvi. Käyttöösi saat laadukkaat työvälineet (puhelin, tietokone, työvaatteet).

Myyntityöstä Sadexilla tekee erityisen mieluista se, että jaan samanlaiset arvot edustamani yrityksen kanssa: Meillä on oikeasti loistava tuote sekä palvelu, ja kaikki toimintamme pohjautuu rehellisyyteen. Lisäksi meillä pidetään työntekijöistä hyvää huolta, ja meihin panostetaan. Näillä eväillä on kiva tehdä töitä!

– Annika Niemelä, myyntiedustaja Liedossa ja tuleva kollegasi, Sadex Oy

Sadexilla on tutkitusti loistava työilmapiiri, sillä meillä noudatetaan vahvasti seuraavia periaatteita:

  • Meillä ei ole kahden kerroksen väkeä, vaan jokaisen työpanos nähdään yhtä arvokkaaksi.

  • Jokainen työntekijä kantaa vastuun omasta tontistaan.

  • Kaikkea tekemistämme ohjaavat rehellisyys, palveluhalu ja korkea tekemisen taso.

  • Toimimme aina tiimissä – kaverilta saa aina jeesiä.

  • Asioista puhutaan reilusti ja suoraan, selän takana ei kyräillä.

  • Olemme ylpeitä siitä, mitä teemme, ja teemme aina parhaamme.

  • Meille on tärkeää, että töihin on aina kiva tulla.

  • Meillä jokainen saa olla oma itsensä ja ymmärtää vastuunsa yhteisestä ilmapiiristä.

  • Meillä on lupa myös mokata.

Hae heti!

title: QA Analyst - Billing
description:
We are currently delivering a major Billing Transformation Programme, introducing a new enterprise billing platform to replace our existing system. Alongside this transformation, we must continue to support and maintain our current platform, ensuring continuity and accuracy while carefully managing complex and business-critical data, processes, and structures. This creates a unique opportunity to be part of a high-impact programme, helping to protect and evolve our billing capability while transitioning to a modern, future-ready solution.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive QA Analyst to join DP World in Southampton and support the successful delivery of the Billing Transformation Programme. This role plays a key part in ensuring quality across system and business testing, helping to validate that integrations, data, and billing outputs meet defined requirements.

You’ll work closely with the QA Lead, IT teams, and business stakeholders to execute testing activities across system integration, user acceptance testing, and regression phases. This is a hands-on role requiring strong attention to detail and the ability to work across both technical and business validation.

This position is ideal for someone with QA or testing experience who enjoys working in fast-paced transformation environments and wants to contribute directly to the delivery of high-quality systems and processes.

Location: Southampton

Contract: 2 year FTC

How you will contribute

• Execute test cases across System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and regression testing.
• Validate end-to-end business processes and system functionality.
• Record and maintain accurate test results and supporting documentation.
• Perform data validation and reconciliation between legacy and new systems.
• Support verification of billing outputs to ensure accuracy and completeness.
• Identify discrepancies and escalate issues for resolution.
• Log, track, and manage defects, ensuring clear documentation and timely resolution.
• Support retesting and validation of defect fixes.
• Assist with preparation of test data, scenarios, and scripts.
• Support QA Lead in test environment readiness and planning activities.
• Assist and guide business SMEs during UAT execution.
• Provide updates on testing progress, issues, and outcomes to the QA Lead.
• Maintain accurate QA documentation, reports, and test artefacts.
• Contribute to continuous improvement of testing practices and quality processes.

What you will bring

• Experience in QA, testing, or system validation roles.
• Experience executing test cases and supporting SIT and UAT activities.
• Understanding of data validation, reconciliation, and testing processes.
• Experience working with IT teams and business stakeholders.
• Experience within finance, billing, or data-driven environments is advantageous.
• Exposure to performance testing or automation is a plus.
• High attention to detail and accuracy.
• Hands-on, proactive approach to testing and problem-solving.
• Strong organisational skills with a structured approach.
• Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
• Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced delivery environment.

Compensation

DP World offers exciting and challenging roles within a growing international organization. We strive to hire and develop the right people, locally and globally, stimulating personal growth and self-development within an informal atmosphere. We offer a market competitive compensation package.

About DP World

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 120,000 employees spanning 75 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses—Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology—and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.

What’s more, we’re reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimising disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.

WE MAKE TRADE FLOW
TO CHANGE WHAT’S POSSIBLE FOR EVERYONE

title: Software Engineer (D/F/M)
description:
QphoX is looking for a new member to join us in developing and building our technology for scalable and networked quantum computing. We are looking to expand our R&D team with a Software Engineer. As a member of our team, you will develop software interfaces for controlling and operating the modem and supporting the next generation of research. You will learn about the operation of complex equipment in the laboratory, database development and quantum technology.

What you will be involved in:

• Development, implementation and support of software for QphoX’s product roadmap.
• Developing and maintaining software for the testing, measurement, and operation of novel devices, including embedded software, firmware, equipment drivers, communication interfaces, and graphical user interfaces.
• Managing software projects and communicating requirements, priorities, progress, risks, and technical decisions to stakeholders.
• Working closely with physicists, engineers, and scientists to understand their needs, translating functional requirements into structured software deliverables.
• Establishing and promoting software engineering best practices, including Git branching, code reviews, testing, documentation, and controlled integration into the main codebase.
• Learning about laboratory operations and translating experimental workflows into reliable, maintainable software solutions.

Skills and knowledge you will bring to QphoX:

• At least five years of software engineering experience in a high-tech industry, with strong programming skills in C, C++, and Python.
• Experience developing embedded software or firmware, working with microcontrollers, and integrating software with sensors, actuators, measurement equipment, or other physical systems.
• Experience writing equipment drivers and working with hardware communication protocols.
• Ability to gather requirements from technical stakeholders and translate them into clear tasks, deliverables, and release priorities.
• Experience managing shared codebases and applying good development practices, including Git workflows, code reviews, testing, and documentation.
• Strong communication, organizational, and planning skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across a wide range of technical disciplines.
• A proactive approach to improving software quality, processes, and maintainability.
• No previous experience in or knowledge of quantum physics is required.

Supplementary skills:

• Experience with embedded Linux, real-time operating systems, bare-metal development, or communication protocols such as UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, Ethernet, or USB.
• Experience debugging embedded hardware and software using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, or hardware debuggers.
• Experience leading software projects, improving development processes, or implementing automated testing and continuous integration.
• A background in mechatronics, telecommunications, robotics, industrial automation, instrumentation, or a related field.

Our Ideal Candidate:

You are comfortable with writing stable, well-organized codes for solving complex problems. To add, you are self-motivated and independent in your projects and have a strong sense of responsibility and excited to work with those using their code for a variety of applications in science and engineering.

Teamwork is an essential value of our company, hence fitting into the team is crucial. Finally, you feel positive working in a fast-paced learning environment.

We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where all people, regardless of gender, race, religion, ethnicity, age, disability, sexual orientation, or background, can thrive.

Benefits and other perks of working with us:

  • Competitive salary
  • Employment stock ownership plan
  • End-year performance-based bonus
  • 25 days of holidays on a full-time basis
  • Career growth opportunities
  • Opportunities to network and connect

About us:

QphoX develops next-generation quantum computing technology based on advanced electro-optical and photonic systems. Our mission is to enable scalable quantum computing through innovative hardware solutions that bridge research and real-world applications.

We strive to be an inclusive workplace where talented people can learn, grow, and do their best work. We believe diversity of perspectives strengthens our team, drives innovation, and helps us build better technology for the future.

title: Voorzitter en lid met financieel profiel voor de raad van commissarissen bij Poort6
description:
Poort6 zoekt twee nieuwe leden voor de raad van commissarissen (RvC): een ervaren voorzitter en een lid met een stevig financieel profiel, tevens voorzitter van de auditcommissie. Ervaren toezichthouders die vanuit maatschappelijke betrokkenheid willen bijdragen aan goed en betaalbaar wonen in Gorinchem. Die onafhankelijk oordelen, verbinding zoeken en samenwerken vanuit vertrouwen en wederzijds respect. Wil jij je ervaring als voorzitter of je financiële expertise hiervoor inzetten? Lees dan verder!

Over Poort6

Poort6 is de enige woningcorporatie in Gorinchem, de grootste vestingstad van Nederland. Met circa 7.000 verhuureenheden bieden ze zo’n 15.000 inwoners een thuis. Goed wonen is een mensenrecht en een belangrijke basis. Als dé sociale huisvester van Gorinchem zetten zij zich elke dag in voor een betaalbaar en fijn thuis voor hun huurders en woningzoekenden. Ze zijn er voor iedereen die hen nodig heeft: vandaag, morgen en in de toekomst.

“#WIJ: onze identiteit en koers”

#WIJ is al jaren de rode draad in alles wat Poort6 doet. In 2021 kozen ze voor deze koers, met als kernwaarde 'de wil om te verbinden'. Vanuit de overtuiging dat ze samen verder komen dan alleen. Inmiddels is #WIJ veel meer dan een koersdocument. Het is hun identiteit geworden. Een houding die medewerkers, bewoners en partners herkennen.

Begin 2026 stelde Poort6 hun vernieuwde strategische koers vast: #WIJ: het volgende hoofdstuk. Daarmee zetten zij de ingezette beweging voort en maken ze ruimte voor wat nú nodig is. Zes thema’s vormen daarin het kompas: “We bouwen mee aan een stad die klaar is voor morgen. We brengen samen gemeenschappen tot bloei. We bieden een fijn en passend thuis. We kijken door de bewonersbril. We werken vanuit hart en hoofd, met nieuwe technologie. En we versterken onze verbindingen.”

De volkshuisvestelijke opgave van Poort6 is groot, in de context van beperkte financiële middelen en een veranderende samenleving. Dat vraagt om scherpe keuzes en om toezicht met inhoud én gevoel voor verhoudingen. Meer informatie, waaronder de strategische koers en het jaarverslag, vind je op de website van Poort6.

De vacatures

De RvC van Poort6 bestaat uit vijf leden. Zij zijn complementair aan elkaar en fungeren samen als toezichthouder, klankbord en werkgever. Toezicht houden is bij Poort6 nadrukkelijk teamwerk. Ieder lid brengt zijn of haar eigen expertise in. Gezamenlijk dragen de RvC-leden de verantwoordelijkheid voor goed toezicht in de volle breedte. De sfeer binnen de raad is betrokken, informeel en constructief. Er is ruimte voor scherpte, humor en relativering.

Conform het rooster van aftreden nemen begin 2027 twee ervaren leden afscheid. Daarom zoeken we een voorzitter van de RvC en een lid met een financieel profiel en tevens voorzitter van de auditcommissie.

Voor de voorzitter van de RvC gelden de volgende uitgangspunten:

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring als voorzitter van een toezichthoudend orgaan. Bij voorkeur in de corporatiesector, of met aantoonbare affiniteit met de volkshuisvesting.

  • Je hebt kennis van governancevraagstukken en gevoel voor juridische verhoudingen en organisatieontwikkeling.

  • Je bent een verbindende persoonlijkheid die gezag combineert met toegankelijkheid. Je brengt verschillende perspectieven samen en bevordert een goede samenwerking binnen de raad.

  • Je investeert in een goede relatie tussen RvC en bestuurder en bent diens eerste aanspreekpunt en een stevige en inspirerende sparringpartner.

  • Je bewaakt de rolzuiverheid van de raad en de balans tussen afstand en nabijheid.

  • Je brengt ervaring, rust en overzicht mee, en draagt met humor en relativeringsvermogen bij aan een open en constructieve toezichtcultuur.

Voor het lid met financieel profiel en tevens voorzitter van de auditcommissie gelden de volgende uitgangspunten:

  • Je hebt een stevig financieel profiel en ruime ervaring met audit- en controlvraagstukken.

  • Je kunt begrotingen, jaarstukken en meerjarenprognoses beoordelen. Je kent bij voorkeur het waarderings- en borgingsstelsel van de corporatiesector en de rol van de Autoriteit Wonen en het Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw daarin.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met compliance, risicomanagement en IT- en digitaliseringsontwikkelingen.

  • Je combineert financiële diepgang met strategisch inzicht. Je toetst investeringsbeslissingen op risico’s én maatschappelijk rendement en denkt vanuit een ondernemende houding mee over hoe ambities financieel verantwoord kunnen worden gerealiseerd.

  • Je bent vanuit de RvC de eerste gesprekspartner van de externe accountant.

  • Je hebt de scherpte om de juiste vragen te stellen en het vermogen en de bereidheid om ingewikkelde financiële vraagstukken toegankelijk te maken voor collega-commissarissen.

  • Je bent kritisch en onafhankelijk, maar zoekt altijd naar mogelijkheden.

  • Luchtigheid, collegialiteit en een constructieve stijl van toezicht houden horen bij het profiel.

Het is een pré als één van de twee nieuwe leden binding heeft met Gorinchem of de directe regio. Ook ervaring in of met een (politiek-)bestuurlijke omgeving zien we graag in de combinatie terug.

Voor alle leden van de RvC geldt het volgende uitgangspunt:

  • Je hebt een visie op de volkshuisvesting, de rol van corporaties en strategische samenwerkingsverbanden.

  • Je hebt een brede maatschappelijke belangstelling en een volkshuisvestelijk hart.

  • Je hebt gevoel voor toekomstige ontwikkelingen en maatschappelijke innovatie.

  • Je hebt een academisch werk- en denkniveau en ervaring met bestuurlijke besluitvorming.

  • Je bent kritisch en onafhankelijk, ziet grote verbanden en bent rolbewust in afstand en nabijheid.

  • Je beschikt over reflectief vermogen en handelt met een hoge mate van integriteit en ethisch besef.

  • Je bent benaderbaar en open, kunt goed luisteren en hebt het lef om de dialoog op te zoeken, ook als het schuurt.

  • Je beweegt gemakkelijk in een organisatie, bent een teamspeler en kunt gevraagd en ongevraagd adviseren zonder de bestuurlijke verantwoordelijkheid over te nemen.

  • Je voelt je oprecht verbonden met de maatschappelijke opdracht van Poort6 en vervult de rol vanuit een intrinsieke motivatie om bij te dragen aan goed en betaalbaar wonen.

  • Je hebt voldoende tijd beschikbaar voor een goede invulling van de functie.

Benoeming en vergoeding

De benoeming is in principe voor een periode van vier jaar, met de mogelijkheid van één herbenoeming van vier jaar. De vergoeding past binnen de wettelijke kaders (WNT). Poort6 volgt de beroepsregel van de VTW. De benoeming vindt plaats onder voorbehoud van een positieve zienswijze van de Autoriteit woningcorporaties (fit- en propertoets).

Diversiteit en inclusie

De RvC gelooft in de kracht van diversiteit. Dat bevordert een betere besluitvorming. We nodigen dan ook nadrukkelijk kandidaten van alle achtergronden uit om te solliciteren.

Geïnteresseerd?

De werving en selectie wordt begeleid door Berenschot Search. Ben je geïnteresseerd? Stuur dan vóór 15 september 2026 een motivatiebrief en curriculum vitae via de solliciteerbutton naar Marion Kortenraij en Dorinda Honkoop van Berenschot Search. Heb je vragen? Neem gerust contact op met Dorinda via 06 48 06 77 62 of Marion via 06 11 37 84 88 (op vakantie tot 20 augustus). Zij vertellen je graag meer over de vacatures.

Selectieprocedure

Na een eerste selectie voert Berenschot in week 39 en 40 oriënterende gesprekken met kandidaten. Op basis daarvan volgt begin oktober een shortlist. Geselecteerde kandidaten worden op 12 oktober uitgenodigd voor gesprekken met de selectie- en adviescommissie van Poort6. Daarna volgen matchgesprekken met de ondernemingsraad en met Huurdersvereniging Poort6 (HP6). Een assessment en een referentiecheck kunnen deel uitmaken van de procedure. Het streven is dat de nieuwe RvC-leden onder voorbehoud van de zienswijze van de Aw, per 1 januari 2027 worden benoemd. De invulling van de voorzittersrollen vindt plaats na een korte periode van overdracht en inwerken.
