title: Lead Decision Scientist, Revenue, Purchase & Order
description:
Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

The Revenue, Purchase & Order area spans three domains, which define the user experience through the entire escrow service funnel we offer at Vinted. From the value-driven pricing propositions, to smooth checkout and messaging experience, to the successful order fulfillment and addressing challenges when things go wrong. How do we optimise discounts for acceptable ROI and platform growth? How do we use pricing strategies for generating revenue without a cost on growth speed? How can we decrease cancellations through levers within and beyond your scope? And finally, how do we reduce friction for users’ order management? All these questions need guidance for measurement for us to be confident in steering the decision-making in the right direction.

We’re looking for a Lead Decision Scientist to join our Area DSA team to create impact by identifying and prioritising the most impactful problems to solve within this scope and ensuring they get resolved through influencing stakeholders, enabling your DSA peers to tackle them, or solving them on your own. We expect the Lead Decision Scientist to determine the right approach for each challenge.

You will report directly to the Area DSA lead, and will be part of the Area's DSA leads team. This setup will enable you to deliver impact across all three domains and will require close collaboration with all data roles and product directors for each domain.

In this position, you’ll

  • Identify, prioritise, and systematically resolve the most impactful Decision Science problems and opportunities across Pricing, Purchase & Order, ensuring solutions are effective, efficient, and viable long-term
  • Build alignment by engaging domain leadership, peers, fellow decision scientists, and cross-functional stakeholders to validate priorities, clarify, and measure trade-offs
  • Set and raise the standard for experimentation and decision-making across the scope by improving metrics, methods, interpretation, and how insights are translated into decisions
  • Be responsible for the measurability of success for key Marketplace Product programs within your scope
  • Partner with the domains' leadership to ensure measurability of OKRs and prioritise accordingly, where the input is needed the most
  • Be ready to own and deliver selected initiatives hands-on yourself

About you

  • Experience: You have proven experience in a Decision Science, Data Analytics, or Data Science role.
  • Analytical Mindset: You possess excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance the depth of your analysis with tangible business impact. You are highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes.
  • Statistical Foundation: You have strong knowledge of statistical methods, including experience running A/B tests, regression analysis, causal inference, and other inferential techniques. You can suggest alternative methods when standard approaches aren't the best fit.
  • Technical Expertise: You have strong skills in SQL and Python. You treat data code like software, valuing reproducibility, clarity, and performance. You are comfortable with giving and receiving code and methodology reviews, and Git is part of your daily workflow. You are also experienced with BI tools like Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Master Communicator: You are fluent in written and spoken English and can convincingly present complex results and statistical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. You are effective in influencing decision-making without authority through data, communication, and collaboration.

Work perks

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per your workday
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Access to a discounted gym membership plan
  • Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
  • Supplemental Private Health Insurance

title: Keittiön Vuoropäällikkö, Pori
description:
Haluatko olla mukana ravintola-alan seuraavassa vallankumouksessa?

Huuva on uudenlainen ravintola-alan toimija, joka valmistaa parhaiden brändien eri annoksia saman katon alla. Miltä kuulostaa esim. Seksico Tacos, Naughty Brgr, Green Hippo tai Boneless? Jokaiselta ravintolalta parhaat annokset yhdellä tilauksella lounaalle tai illanviettoon?

Huuvan ravintolat pyörivät meidän omalla Huuva OS -järjestelmällä, mikä mullistaa tavan jolla ravintolamme toimivat lisäten tehokkuutta ja tarkkuutta koko prosessin läpi tilauksesta toimitukseen. Avasimme ensimmäisen ravintolamme syksyllä 2021 ja siitä lähtien olemme avanneet 12 toimipistettä valtakunnallisesti.

Haemme nyt vuoropäällikköä esihenkilöksi tulevaan Porin ravintolaamme. Lue alta lisää tehtävästä ja lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, haluamme kuulla sinusta pian lisää!


Mitä tulet tekemään Huuvalla?

Huuvalla toimit ravintolan esihenkilönä ja vastaat korkean laatutason ylläpitämisestä niin ruoan kuin johtamisen osalta. Olet ravintolapäällikön oikea käsi ja vastaat keittiön johtamisesta hänen poissa olon aikana. Tätä varten toivomme, että sinulla on aikaisempaa kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä.

Saat selkeän perehdytyksen Huuvan sisäisiin data- sekä toiminnanohjaus-työkaluihin, joiden avulla voit johtaa jokaista osa-aluetta tarkasti. Toivomme, että viihdyt teknologia painotteisessa työskentely ympäristössä.

Huuvan vuoropäällikkö johtaa keittiön tiimiä päivittäisessä tekemisessä, mukaan lukien varaston ja tilausten hallinta, ruokien valmistus ja lähettäminen. Toivomme, että olet myös tiimipelaaja, ja viihdyt keittiön esihenkilön roolissa. Tulet myös kommunikoimaan työssäsi englanniksi.

Ravintolapäällikkö tietysti tukee ja ohjaa sinua varmistaakseen, että sinulla on työkalut menestyäksesi.

Sinä olisit vastuussa

  • Päivittäisen palvelun suorittaminen tiimin kanssa keittiön kapteenina

  • Raaka-ainehävikin hallinta

  • Palvelun laadun pitäminen odotetulla tasolla

  • Varmistetaan, että tapahtumapaikka ja ruokalista pysyvät auki/verkossa

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • Hyvää asennetta ja halua oppia

  • Kokemus esihenkilötyöstä, mieluiten 2+ vuotta

  • Olet loistava tiimipelaaja, jolla on vahvat johtamisominaisuudet

  • Pärjäät hyvin paineen ja stressaavien tilanteiden alla

  • Hyvät viestintätaidot englanniksi (työkielemme)

  • Olet tyytyväinen teknologiapainotteiseen ja nopeatempoiseen työympäristöön

  • Voimassa oleva EU:n hygieniapassi tai vastaava

  • Negatiiviset salmonellatestitulokset

Mitä me tarjoamme sinulle?

  • Ystävällisen työympäristön

  • Vakaan sekä kasvavan yrityksen missä työskennellä

  • Uuden oppiminen yhdessä Michelin-koulutetun ravintolatoimen johtajan sekä data-analyytikkojemme kanssa

  • Ainutlaatuisen ympäristön missä käytetään viimeisintä teknologiaa ruoanlaiton tukena

Jos haluat tulla osaksi Huuvan tarinaa, ole hyvä ja aloita lähettämällä hakemuksesi linkin kautta. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jatkuvasti ja täytämme paikan sopivan tekijän löydyttyä. Otamme kaikkiin hakijoihimme yhteyttä henkilökohtaisesti.

Emme malta odottaa saavamme kuulla sinusta lisää!

title: Food Services Supervisor
description:

title: Design Engineer
description:
About the company

Trust Wallet is the leading non-custodial cryptocurrency wallet, trusted by over 200 million people worldwide to securely manage and grow their digital assets. Our vision is to give individuals the freedom to own their assets, confidently participate in the future economy, and access opportunities that enhance their lives. Our mission is to be a trusted personal companion — helping users safely navigate Web3, the on-chain economy, and the emerging AI-powered future. With support for over 10 million assets across 100+ blockchains, Trust Wallet offers a seamless, multi-chain experience backed by industry-leading self-custody technology, a vibrant community, and a growing ecosystem of partners.

About the Role

Trust Wallet is looking for a Design Engineer to sit at the intersection of design and engineering — someone who can move fluidly between Figma and code to build and ship polished, high-quality UI directly in our React Native app. You'll close the gap between design intent and shipped product, working hands-on with both the design and engineering teams.

Responsibilities

  • Build production-quality UI components and interactions directly in React Native, translating designs into pixel-accurate, performant code

  • Partner with product designers to prototype ideas quickly, test interactions, and iterate before full engineering handoff

  • Own and maintain the design system/component library, ensuring consistency and reusability across the app

  • Bridge design and engineering — flag feasibility issues early, propose technical solutions to design problems, and vice versa

  • Improve UI performance, animations, and micro-interactions across web, mobile, and browser extension

  • Collaborate with engineering on architecture decisions that affect UI flexibility, theming, and component scalability

  • Help define and evolve design-to-dev workflows/tooling (Figma → code handoff, design tokens, etc.)

Requirements

  • 3-5+ years of experience in frontend/UI engineering, with strong hands-on React Native experience

  • Strong eye for design craft — typography, spacing, motion, and interaction detail

  • Comfortable working directly in Figma (or similar) to prototype and iterate on UI

  • Experience building and maintaining component/design systems

  • Track record of shipping polished, consumer-facing mobile products

  • Strong communication skills — able to work fluidly across design and engineering teams and translate between the two

  • Genuine interest in Web3/crypto products a plus

Nice to Have

  • Experience with design tokens, theming systems, or cross-platform component libraries

  • Background as either a designer who learned to code or an engineer with strong design sensibility

  • Familiarity with animation libraries (Reanimated, Lottie, etc.) in React Native

  • Prior experience in fintech, crypto, or high-growth consumer apps

Additional Information

This is a global and fully remote role. You must have the right to work for the country you are based.

Why work at Trust Wallet?

  • Be a part of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem that continues to grow.

  • Excellent learning and career development opportunities.

  • Work alongside diverse, world-class talent, in an environment where learning and growth opportunities are endless.

  • Tackle fast-paced, challenging and unique projects.

  • Work in a truly global organization, with international teams and a flat organizational structure.

  • Work fully remotely with flexible working hours.

  • Enjoy competitive salary and benefits.

Apply today to join our team in building the world’s most trusted and secure crypto wallet and enable a decentralized future for everyone.

Trust Wallet is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

*Due to the large amount of the applications, please consider your application as unsuccessful should you not be contacted within 4 weeks from your application date.

title: Security Operations Engineer
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

YTL PowerSeraya Pte. Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of YTL Power International Berhad, is in the business of producing, wholesaling, trading and retailing of energy; with a primary focus on electricity. As an established player in Singapore's energy sector, it supplies the country's energy needs through its multi-utilities platform. With a licensed generation capacity of 3,100 MW*, it is one of Singapore's largest electricity generators.

The YTL PowerSeraya Group has three subsidiaries: the retail arm under the Geneco brand provides electricity price plans and energy solutions to homes and businesses, PetroSeraya is the fuel management arm of the Group, and Taser Power which operates Taser Power Plant.

Besides being a Plaque of Commendation (GOLD) awardee at the National Trade Union Congress's May Day Awards 2023, YTL PowerSeraya has adopted four Tripartite Standards under the Tripartite Alliance for Fair and Progressive Employment Practices, and has committed to be a fair and progressive employer. To find out more about the organisation, please visit ytlpowerseraya.com.

*As at 4 February 2026, our registered generating capacity with EMA is 2,487 MW.

RESPONSIBILITIES

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Security Operations Engineer to join our Infrastructure Operations & Cyber Security team. This role is responsible for supporting day-to-day security operations across Azure and on-premises environments, with a focus on security event investigation, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, security monitoring, and cyber awareness initiatives.

The successful candidate will work closely with internal technology teams, managed security service providers, vendors, and business stakeholders to investigate security events, improve cyber resilience, maintain operational security controls, and contribute to the continuous enhancement of the organisation's security posture.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Security Engineering & Hardening

  • Support the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of security controls across infrastructure and cloud environments.
  • Assist with onboarding and validating security log sources into approved SIEM platforms.
  • Support detection tuning, security configuration reviews, and monitoring improvements.
  • Evaluate and implement security technologies that strengthen the organisation's cyber defence capabilities.
  • Support the deployment and maintenance of security hardening standards across Windows, Linux, Microsoft 365, and Azure environments.
  • Ensure controls align with CIS Benchmarks and industry-recognised security best practices.

Vulnerability Management & Threat Advisory

  • Coordinate vulnerability assessment activities for critical infrastructure and servers.
  • Validate assessment findings and engage system owners to ensure timely remediation.
  • Monitor cybersecurity advisories, threat intelligence notifications, and indicators of compromise (IOCs).
  • Perform IOC validation activities and coordinate blacklisting, containment, investigation, and remediation actions where necessary.
  • Track, monitor, and report remediation progress until closure.

Security Operations & Incident Response

  • Investigate and follow up on security alerts, incidents, and suspicious activities escalated by the external SOC team across endpoints, servers, email, and cloud environments.
  • Assess security events, determine potential impact, gather relevant technical and business context, and coordinate containment, recovery, remediation, and closure activities.
  • Act as the internal coordination point between infrastructure teams, vendors, system owners, and external security providers during incident investigations.
  • Support security monitoring activities through SIEM dashboards, workbooks, queries, scheduled reporting, evidence collection, and case tracking.
  • Utilize approved AI-assisted tools to improve alert triage, investigation efficiency, log analysis, and case documentation in accordance with security and data-handling requirements.
  • Identify and promote practical AI-assisted use cases that improve operational consistency and security investigation effectiveness.

Endpoint Security & Platform Protection

  • Administer and support endpoint protection and Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) platforms.
  • Monitor agent health, policy compliance, signature updates, asset coverage, and endpoint security status.
  • Perform endpoint troubleshooting, agent deployment, reinstallation, and remediation activities.
  • Support housekeeping activities to maintain security tool effectiveness and infrastructure visibility.

Security Awareness & User Engagement

  • Coordinate organisation-wide security awareness initiatives and phishing simulation campaigns.
  • Deliver targeted follow-up activities, awareness communications, and user education programs.
  • Monitor phishing resilience results and prepare reporting on participation rates, trends, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support broader cyber awareness initiatives including newsletters, learning modules, roadshows, and periodic security communications.

Governance, Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain and update security policies, procedures, standards, technical documents, operational playbooks, and tracking records.
  • Support review and maintenance of incident response procedures, investigation workflows, hardening standards, endpoint security procedures, and operational documentation.
  • Prepare monthly and ad-hoc cyber security reports, dashboards, inventories, metrics, and compliance-related documentation.
  • Maintain accurate operational records to support management reporting, regulatory compliance, audits, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Support multiple operational and project-based initiatives while meeting established timelines and service expectations.
QUALIFICATIONS
  • Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • 4-6 years of experience in cybersecurity operations, infrastructure security, or a related technical security role.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint protection, EDR technologies, SIEM platforms, and security incident investigation processes.
  • Proficient in vulnerability management, remediation tracking, IOC validation, and security monitoring concepts.
  • Proficient knowledge for Windows, Linux, Microsoft 365, Azure, and general cloud security principles.
  • Understanding of security awareness programs, phishing simulations, malware investigation, and security documentation practices.
  • Exposure to open-source security monitoring or cyber defence tools will be advantageous.
  • Professional certifications such as ISC2 CC, CompTIA Security+, Microsoft SC-200, CEH, CHFI, or similar certifications will be advantageous.

AI & DIGITAL SKILLS WE VALUE

We do not expect candidates to be AI specialists. We are looking for security professionals who are curious about responsible AI usage and able to leverage modern technologies to improve cyber defence operations.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted security operations, threat detection, log analysis, and incident investigation use cases.
  • Ability to evaluate and validate AI-assisted outputs while maintaining human oversight and professional judgement.
  • Understanding of responsible AI principles including privacy, security, transparency, and appropriate handling of sensitive information.
  • Interest in emerging cybersecurity technologies, attack techniques, threat intelligence, and cyber defence innovation.
  • Continuous learning mindset with a willingness to explore new tools, methodologies, and automation opportunities.
OTHER INFORMATION

title: Director of Weddings- JW Marriott Bengaluru Prestige Golfshire Resort & Spa
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Assists in leading the property’s segmented sales effort (e.g., group, transient, association, corporate, etc.) and assists in the implementation of the segment sales strategy and achieving segment revenue goals, property revenue goals and guest and employee satisfaction. Conducts all day-to-day activities related to the sales function with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of property sales objectives. CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 3 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR

• 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

Developing & Executing Sales Strategies

• Works with sales leader to ensure understanding of sales strategy and effective implementation of this strategy for the segment.

Maximizing Revenue

• Provides positive and aggressive leadership to ensure maximum revenue potential (e.g., sets example with personal booking goals).

• Recommends booking goals for sales team members.

Managing Sales Activities

• Approves space release for catering to maximize revenue (DOS, Group) in the absence of a Business Evaluation Manager.

• Participates in sales calls with members of sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.

• Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).

Analyzing & Reporting on Sales and Financial Data

• Analyzes market information by using sales systems and implements strategy to achieve property’s financial room and catering goals.

• Assists Revenue Management with completing accurate six period projections.

• Reviews sales and catering guest satisfaction results to identify areas of improvement.

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service

• Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies customer service and creates a positive example for guest relations.

• Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.

• Meets with guests during pre- and post-convention meetings to obtain feedback on quality of product (e.g., rooms, meeting facilities and equipment, food and beverage), service levels, execution against contract and overall satisfaction.

• Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.

• Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.

• Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of department meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.

• Gains understanding of the property’s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.

Building Successful Relationships

• Develops and manages relationships with key stakeholders, both internal and external.

• Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels (e.g., Event Booking Center, Market Sales, GSO) to ensure the property needs are being achieved and the sales efforts are complementary, not duplicative.

Eftersom vi alltid vill göra saker så enkelt som möjligt är det inte säkert att vi väntar till sista ansökningsdag innan vi går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen. Så vänta inte, sök redan nu.

title: Android Software Engineer - AI Neobank App
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region.

Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

The Role

We are looking for Android software engineers to build the native Android experience for KIRA's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Poland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Poland.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
We’re seeking a highly skilled, execution-focused Senior Data Scientist with a minimum of 5 years of experience. This role demands hands-on expertise in building, deploying, and optimizing machine learning models at scale, while working with big data technologies and modern cloud platforms. You will be responsible for driving data-driven solutions from experimentation to production, leveraging advanced tools and frameworks across Python, SQL, Spark, and AWS. The role requires strong technical depth, problem-solving ability, and ownership in delivering business impact through data science.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and deploy scalable machine learning models into production systems.
  • Develop advanced analytics and predictive models using Python, SQL, and popular ML/DL frameworks (Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Leverage Databricks, Apache Spark, and Hadoop for large-scale data processing and model training.
  • Implement workflows and pipelines using Airflow and AWS EMR for automation and orchestration.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate models into cloud-based applications on AWS.
  • Optimize query performance, storage usage, and data pipelines for efficiency.
  • Conduct end-to-end experiments, including data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, validation, and deployment.
  • Drive initiatives independently with high ownership and accountability.
  • Stay up to date with industry best practices in machine learning, big data, and cloud-native deployments.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Data Science or Applied Machine Learning.

title: Digital Design Director
description:
Digital Product Design (DPD) at Ford is committed to envisioning and creating simple, thoughtful, enjoyable, and compelling product experiences that our customers need and love. We work in close partnership with product and engineering to deliver best-in-class interactions experiences that meet the needs of people today, and in the future. Our team is comprised of a dynamic group of product designers, researchers, visual designers, industrial designers, modelers, and project managers.

In this position...

EXPERIENCE STRATEGY & DESIGN TEAM

The Experience Strategy & Design team is defining the next generation of in-vehicle experiences and the operational approach needed to get there. Rather than focusing on one-off feature-driven solutions, this team moves up stream to get ahead of delivery cycles, building bridges through curiosity and a clear mission to deliver on our brand equities and core customer needs. We find the big picture by connecting concepts and feature ideas and unifying them into cohesive and purposeful experiences across the entire vehicle ecosystem. This team drives the definition, early design, and delivery plan for differentiated experiences that are critical to the brand loyalty for each of the unique customer groups across Ford. We do this through bringing the right cross-functional teams and right skillsets together early, identifying key hardware and software technology and connections needed to unblock and deliver incredible experiences to each of our unique customer groups.

This role is Hybrid work model (in office 4 days/week) in Palo Alto, CA

THE ROLE

We are searching for an innovative and visionary Product Design Leader to shape Ford’s experience strategy and deliver breakthrough UI/UX solutions for vehicles now and in the future. This high-impact role calls for a proven design professional with a passion for tackling complex challenges, thriving in ambiguity, and charting new directions that seamlessly integrate hardware, software, and customer needs. If you excel at inspiring teams, navigating complexity, and setting the standard for design excellence, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact on Ford’s future.

WHAT YOU’LL DO...

  • Establish and lead the overall design vision, driving multiple large-scale strategic projects and advancing future interaction models that integrate physical and digital experiences.
  • Unite and empower cross-functional teams—including design, engineering, product management, customer insights, and technology—by promoting collaboration, delegation, and mentoring to foster creativity and continuous improvement.
  • Communicate and present complex concepts and strategies to partners, executives, and stakeholders, using strong storytelling skills and seeking feedback to contribute to Ford’s broader design culture.
  • Transform innovative ideas into compelling prototypes and high-quality design deliverables, validating technical feasibility and ensuring creative concepts become reality.
  • Set and uphold the standard for design quality by staying engaged with design iterations, maintaining a cohesive design language, and driving visual excellence across all touchpoints for transformative yet scalable vehicle experiences.
  • Collaborate closely with a triad, including Product Management, Engineering, and other partners to define customer-centric strategies and ensure seamless execution from concept through delivery.

FUNCTIONAL & TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE

What you'll have...

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience in Digital Product Design or related fields.
  • 12+ years of experience in relevant product design commercial organizations.
  • 4+ years managing and/or leading cross-functional teams from concept to shipping complex customer-facing design experiences.
  • Proven experience in product, interaction, and experience design within complex ecosystems.
  • Strong communication and storytelling abilities, with a knack for making complex ideas clear and compelling.
  • High performing proficiency in Figma with the ability to communicate design concepts and create compelling presentations.
  • Proven ability to lead and deliver impactful product design strategies by integrating UX, visual design, content, research, and technical constraints into cohesive, user-focused experiences that support business goals.
  • Ability to work within current frameworks, evolve core processes, and invent new ways of working to drive impactful change and efficiency.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while also building strong collaborative relationships across disciplines, seamlessly connecting design, engineering, strategy, and technology.
  • Passionate for Ford's products and its customers.

Even better you'll have...

  • Strength in systems thinking and mapping end-to-end customer journeys.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous spaces where outcomes are completely undefined.
  • Comfortable working on changing demands with the ability to pivot efforts while motivating others through change.
  • Able to take a flexible approach to working with others across an enterprise, with a demonstrated ability through ambiguity.
  • Self-starter that is organized and can prioritize and manage multiple tasks with minimal direction.
  • Passionate customer focus, including use of collaborative design processes to yield best-in-class customer outcomes.

title: Dog Welfare Assistant (18.75 hours per week)
description:
Have you always had an itch to scratch when it comes to helping dogs? We’re looking for someone with a commitment to animal welfare to join the team in our busy rehoming centre.

Dog Welfare Assistants are the backbone of our centres, as they care for our four-legged friends every day. We’re looking for someone who can provide our dogs with the highest level of care and enrichment, as they prepare for their forever home.
As Dog Welfare Assistant, you’ll:
  • provide daily care to the dogs in the rehoming centre, working to Dogs Trust's code of practice and Health and Safety guidelines,
  • educate potential new owners and the general public on the care and welfare of their dogs,
  • deliver excellent customer service to all visitors to the centre.
The successful candidate will be an excellent communicator with the ability to show empathy to both people and animals. A strong team player, you'll have lots of energy and a positive upbeat attitude. Experienced in working with or handling dogs, you'll be knowledgeable in basic behaviour and health issues and, above all, be committed to the aims and objectives of Dogs Trust. A full, manual driving licence is also essential, as driving will be a part of the role.

Interviews are provisionally scheduled for 24th August at Snetterton Rehoming Centre.
Our rehoming centres house thousands of dogs each year until they can find a loving new home and the success of our centres wouldn’t be possible without our dedicated team of staff and volunteers; there is a real family-community within each of our centres. Come rain or shine, our team are out in all weathers to make sure the dogs have the best possible life. Dealing with thousands of visitors each month, our rehoming centres are the face of Dogs Trust, and we pride ourselves on our staff providing the very best in customer service.

This role involves working every Saturday and across a rota throughout the week.

title: Director, Product Management
description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

Enterprise Technology plays a critical part in shaping the future of mobility. If you’re looking for the chance to leverage advanced technology to redefine the transportation landscape, enhance customer experience and improve people’s lives, this is the opportunity for you. Join us and challenge your IT expertise and analytical skills to help create vehicles that are as smart as you are.

In this position...

As a Director, Product Management, you will play a critical role in the delivery of high-impact transformation initiatives across Global Product Creation, driving roadmap development, prioritization, dependency management, and execution discipline. Sitting at the intersection of business strategy, technology, and engineering, you will lead capabilities to maximize enterprise value and deliver a seamless, high-performance Tech Stack. In this capacity, you will define and drive the product group vision, roadmap, and investment business cases in direct alignment with Ford’s broader digital and industrial ecosystem goals. You will convert high-level strategy into clear initiatives, partnering closely with engineering, design, and platform teams to own the end-to-end agile development, launch, and flawless execution of high-quality, scalable features while carefully managing requirements, trade-offs, and timelines. Furthermore, you will maintain operational excellence by establishing KPIs, monitoring system and product health, driving operational improvements, leading incident response, managing budgets and resource allocation, mitigating digital and enterprise risks, and integrating emerging technologies like AI to drive efficiency and modern capabilities.


Based in Dearborn, MI, this is a hybrid position with a required four-day onsite presence each week. Relocation assistance may be available for qualified candidates.

What you'll do...

  • Define and drive product group vision, roadmap, and investment business cases, in alignment with Ford’s broader digital and industrial ecosystem goals.
  • Convert high-level strategy into clear initiatives, partnering closely with engineering and platform teams to build high-quality, scalable features while managing trade-offs, requirements, and timelines.
  • Own end-to-end agile development and launch of features, collaborating across engineering, design, and product to ensure flawless execution and quality.
  • Identify and navigate dependencies and integrations across a matrixed organization, driving end-to-end value stream optimization to maximize enterprise-wide value.
  • Uncover internal customer needs through robust discovery, customer feedback, and telemetry to make high-impact, data-driven decisions.
  • Establish KPIs, monitor system/product health, drive operational improvements, and lead incident response.
  • Cultivate strong relationships with senior executives and external partners, serving as the bridge to align technical delivery with commercial needs.
  • Mentor, build, and grow a collaborative, customer-centric team, setting clear objectives and fostering continuous innovation.
  • Oversee budgets and resource allocation, mitigate digital and enterprise risks, and integrate emerging technologies like AI to drive efficiency and modern capabilities

You'll have...

  • Bachelor of Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

  • 5+ years of experience leading Agile teams, fostering a "fail-fast, learn-fast" culture, and guiding successful digital change management initiatives.

  • 5+ years of Senior Product Management experience with skills that include the following:
    • Exceptional leadership and mentoring skills, with experience designing talent pipelines and succession plans for critical roles.
    • Decisive, articulate, and comfortable commanding a room; experienced in guiding executive discussions, building consensus, and distilling complex technical topics into actionable business decisions.
    • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders, proactively resolving conflicts and driving alignment in politically charged or highly matrixed environments.
    • Strong financial management skills, including business case development, budget oversight, and value-driven portfolio prioritization.
    • Solid grasp of Human-Centered Design (HCD), user-experience metrics (e.g., SUS), and building systemic feedback loops to anticipate customer needs.
    • Proactive self-starter who defines agendas, anticipates problems 1–2 quarters out, makes sound decisions under high ambiguity, and course-corrects rapidly.
    • Strong results orientation, driving structured accountability and performance metrics across teams in a fast-paced environment.


Even better, you may have...

  • MBA or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or similar
  • Dassault 3DX Expertise – Understanding of Dassault 3DX capabilities and ecosystem

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

  • Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
  • Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up childcare and more
  • Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more
  • Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
  • Tuition assistance
  • Established and active employee resource groups
  • Paid time off for individual and team community service
  • A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day
  • Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

This position is leadership level 5 and ranges from $141,700- 268,300.

title: 웹 디자이너(계약직/1년)
description:
About

압도적인 제품 만족감과 브랜드 경험을 통해 즐겁고 사랑받는 브랜드를 만듭니다.

와이어트는 비교할 수 없는 제품 만족도와 즐거운 브랜드 경험을 통해 모두에게 즐거움과 감동을 선보이며 브랜드의 가치와 본질에 집중합니다. 우리가 첫 번째로 집중한 산업은 헤어케어 시장으로 차별화된 브랜드 전략과 실행력을 통해 우리의 역량을 증명하였습니다.

한국소비자만족지수 샴푸 부문 12년 연속 1위에 빛나는 '닥터포헤어(Dr.FORHAIR)' 브랜드와 5년 연속 올리브영 헤어케어 부문 1위를 수상한 '어노브(UNOVE)'를 포함해 '탱글엔젤(TANGEL ANGEL)' 브랜드를 운영 중이며, 타협하지 않는 품질력을 기반으로 국내 1위 브랜드를 넘어 아시아, 유럽, 북미를 석권하는 글로벌 NO.1 헤드케어 브랜드로 성장하였습니다.

와이어트는 2025년 기준 약 1,300억의 매출액을 달성하며 올해 미국, 일본, 중국, 동남아, 웨스턴 등 글로벌로 진출하여 폭발적인 성과를 내고 있으며, 향후 카테고리 확장을 통한 새로운 브랜드 포트폴리오 강화를 공격적으로 전개할 예정입니다.


[팀을 소개 합니다]

웹 디자인팀은 와이어트의 브랜드인 [닥터포헤어], [어노브], [탱글엔젤] 의 웹 디자인을 전담하며, 각 브랜드의 고유한 아이덴티티와 전략을 반영한 고품질의 웹 콘텐츠를 제작합니다. 시장 트렌드와 브랜드의 개성을 조화롭게 담아내며, 디자인 퀄리티 향상에 중점을 두고 있습니다.
또한, 웹 디자인팀은 문제 해결에 있어 저마다의 역량만큼이나 '태도'의 중요성을 믿고 있습니다. 우리는 스스로 최선을 다해 고민하며 도전하고, 필요할 때는 팀원들과 적극적으로 소통하고 협력합니다. 웹 디자인팀은 프로다운 자세로 서로의 아이디어를 모아 하이퀄리티 작업물을 완성하기 위해 항상 노력하고 있습니다.


[이런 점이 커리어에 도움이 됩니다]

웹 디자인팀은 와이어트의 브랜드인 [닥터포헤어], [어노브], [탱글엔젤] 의 아이덴티티와 커뮤니케이션 전략을 반영해 소비자와 브랜드를 연결하는 하이퀄리티 웹 콘텐츠를 만들어가고 있습니다. 각 브랜드가 가진 개성과 본질을 잘 이해하고, 최신 시장 트렌드를 적절히 결합하여 감각적인 브랜드 웹 디자인 결과물을 창출해내고 있습니다.
단순히 디자인을 만드는 것을 넘어서, 다양한 디지털 프로젝트의 기획부터 실행까지 전 과정을 경험할 수 있는 기회가 주어지는 것도 웹 디자인팀의 큰 장점입니다. 팀원들은 실무에서 각 브랜드의 특성과 소비자 니즈를 반영한 콘텐츠를 제작하면서 브랜딩과 디자인 사이의 균형을 맞추는 역량을 키우고, 다양한 부서와 협력하며 긍정적인 영향을 주는 협업 문화를 함께 만들어가고 있습니다. 서로에게 건설적이고 존중 어린 피드백을 주고받으며 배우고 성장할 수 있는 환경에서 일한다는 점이 웹 디자인팀의 큰 매력 포인트입니다.
자유롭게 의견을 나누고 창의적이고 주도적으로 업무를 진행할 수 있는 분위기 속에서, 디지털 캠페인도 주도적으로 디자인하고 실행하면서 문제 해결 능력과 디자인 퀄리티를 꾸준히 높여가고 있습니다. 독창적이고 완성도 높은 브랜드 웹 디자인을 목표로 삼고, 팀원 모두가 힘을 모아 각 브랜드가 소비자에게 일관된 이미지를 전달할 수 있도록 노력하고 있습니다. 이러한 환경 속에서 웹 디자인 실무 역량 뿐만 아니라, 팀워크와 커뮤니케이션 스킬까지 자연스럽게 성장시키며 특별한 커리어를 쌓아가실 수 있습니다.

Responsibilities

※ 어노브 담당
• 국내 및 글로벌 디지털 광고소재 제작
• 템플릿 기반 기획전 디자인(네이버/쿠팡/옥션/11번가/지마켓 등)

Requirements

title: Credit Analyst (Banking/Insurance)
description:
We are seeking a Credit Analyst to join the Credit Research team at L&G Asset Management.

As Senior Credit Analyst you’ll specialise in the Financial Institutions sector, with coverage focused on banks and/or insurance companies. You’ll be responsible for delivering high-quality fundamental credit research, assessing ESG and regulatory risks, and generating investment recommendations across the capital structure of primarily European issuers. The role will directly support investment decision-making across our fixed income portfolios.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Assuming primary responsibility for the credit coverage of a specified list of banks and/or insurance companies
  • Conducting in-depth fundamental credit analysis across business models, financial performance, capital adequacy, liquidity, asset quality and management strategy
  • Monitoring regulatory, political, macroeconomic and industry developments, evaluating their impact on issuer creditworthiness and relative value opportunities
  • Maintaining financial models, forecasts and stress-testing frameworks to support forward-looking credit analysis
  • Identifying and monitoring investment opportunities across issuers, sectors and the capital structure
  • Producing research notes, credit opinions and investment recommendations for portfolio managers and other stakeholders
  • Presenting credit views, investment ideas and sector insights to portfolio managers, investment committees and broader investment teams
  • Contributing proactively to meet the output requirements of the Global Research and Engagement Group (GREG) while supporting ad hoc credit requests, client queries and continuous improvements to research processes and analytical framework

Who we’re looking for:

  • Demonstrate strong credit research experience covering banks and/or insurance companies
  • Experience gained on the buy side, sell side or within a credit rating agency, Direct buy-side portfolio-facing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of Financial Institutions, including business models, regulation, capital structures and key credit metrics
  • Advanced financial modelling and analytical skills
  • Ability to develop independent credit views and explain them clearly
  • Strong awareness of financial markets and macroeconomic trends
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A proactive, curious and collaborative approach, with strong attention to detail

Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

  • The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance -related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
  • Generous pension contribution
  • Life assurance
  • Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
  • At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
  • Competitive family leave
  • Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
  • There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
  • We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience

At L&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.

If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.

We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.

It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

title: Senior/ Medical Writer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Medical Writer to lead the development of high-quality clinical and regulatory documents supporting global regulatory submissions. This role plays a critical part in ensuring that documents such as Investigator’s Brochures (IBs), Clinical Study Reports (CSRs), and marketing authorization applications (MAAs/NDAs/BLAs) are scientifically accurate, consistent, and aligned with program objectives and global regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate will act as a lead writer for key summary documents, providing strategic guidance to cross-functional teams while overseeing medical writing activities across multiple compounds. This position reports to the Director of Medical Writing (or above)

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development of high-quality clinical and regulatory documents (e.g., Investigator’s Brochures, Clinical Study Reports, clinical summaries, and marketing authorization submissions) in compliance with global regulatory guidelines (ICH, FDA, EMA) and internal standards

  • Serve as the lead writer for key summary documents, overseeing medical writing activities across multiple compounds or programs

  • Provide strategic guidance to cross-functional teams on document content, messaging, and regulatory positioning to ensure alignment with program goals

  • Manage medical writing projects, including planning, timelines, resource coordination, and delivery to ensure milestones and submission deadlines are met

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders (Clinical, Regulatory Affairs, Biostatistics, Safety, etc.) to gather, interpret, and accurately present clinical data

  • Mentor and support other medical writers, ensuring high-quality, scientifically sound, and consistent deliverables across projects

  • Review and edit project-related documents to ensure accuracy, clarity, consistency, and compliance with templates and style guides

  • Attend project and team meetings to provide expert input on document development, study data interpretation, and process improvements

  • Contribute to and lead process improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, quality, and consistency in document preparation

  • Develop, maintain, and refine standard operating procedures (SOPs), templates, and best practices for medical writing

  • Stay current with evolving global regulatory requirements, industry trends, and therapeutic area knowledge to ensure compliance and innovation

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, clinical, regulatory, or related field required; advanced degree (e.g., MSc, PhD, PharmD, MD) preferred

  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in medical writing within the biopharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO industry; equivalent experience in clinical or preclinical development will also be considered

  • Strong knowledge of global regulatory requirements and guidelines (e.g., ICH, FDA, EMA) across all phases of clinical development

  • Broad understanding of clinical research processes, including study design, data analysis, and regulatory submission requirements

  • Demonstrated ability to lead writing activities for complex documents and provide strategic input to cross-functional teams

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly and accurately present complex scientific and clinical information

  • Strong organizational, time management, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines

  • Proven ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional, team-oriented environment while also operating independently when needed

  • High attention to detail with a commitment to quality, consistency, and scientific accuracy

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and document formatting best practices

  • Experience with electronic document management systems (eDMS) and familiarity with document templates, style guides, and structured authoring tools

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

title: iOS Developer
description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

    • UK: Full-time, permanent

  • Life at Airalo · United Kingdom: https://airalo-public.notion.site/life-at-airalo-united-kingdom

We are looking for a skilled iOS engineer who is ready to learn and keen to join our expert team developing new features and extending the existing ones in our main product!
We welcome talented, passionate, innovative, result-oriented professionals who strive to absorb new knowledge and technologies and are willing to use them.

In this role, you will work within a modern development environment that leverages a modular architecture with Swift Package Manager (SPM), hybrid UI workflows combining SwiftUI for views and UIKit for navigation, and Swift Concurrency. You will be part of a team committed to high code quality through high unit test coverage (80%+) and cutting-edge agentic End-to-End (E2E) workflows.

Your main responsibilities are:

  • Build Core Software: Design and develop enterprise-quality software components based on product specifications, delivering brand-new features as well as enhancements to existing ones.
  • Ensure Code Quality & Reliability: Write clean code adhering to team guidelines, implement robust tests, and troubleshoot technical or application issues as they arise.
  • Collaborate Across the Lifecycle: Work daily alongside fellow developers throughout the full software development lifecycle, and prepare clear technical documentation to enrich our iOS knowledge base.
  • Drive Continuous Innovation: Stay current with industry best practices and proactively bring fresh, creative ideas to the engineering team.

    • Does this sound like you:

  • Proven iOS Engineering Background: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering (or a similar field) and bring at least 3 years of hands-on experience developing Swift-based iOS applications within agile teams—including a track record of publishing and continuously supporting one or more live apps.
  • Core Technical & Architectural Mastery: You are confident in software architecture and design, with deep proficiency in MVVM (or similar modern patterns), OOP principles, iOS Frameworks, and Git/Gitflow workflows.
  • Modern UI & Domain Experience: You bring strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, processes, and memory management, combined with practical experience building pixel-perfect UIs with SwiftUI and Auto-Layout, alongside domain exposure to payment systems and marketplaces.
  • Quality & Modern Workflow Expertise: You prioritize software reliability through Unit Testing, Feature Testing, and Mocking, and you bring solid, up-to-date knowledge of AI workflows and agentic engineering.
  • Strong Collaboration & English Skills: You possess strong communication skills and full fluency in English, thriving in a team-first development environment.

    • Bonus:

  • UI/UX & Testing: Knowledge of UI/UX best practices and experience in A/B testing.
  • Agile & Telecom: Prior experience with SCRUM and other agile methods.
  • Domain Knowledge: Prior work experience in telecommunications, including knowledge of eSIM and GSMA related technologies and services.

    • Why People Join Us

    🇪🇸 Why people join us in Spain

    We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

    Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact.

    For many of our teammates in Spain, it's the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home.

    🇬🇧 Why people join us in the UK

    We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product first discovered us as customers.

    Our team spans 60+ countries, but what people often notice quickly is how work actually feels here. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

    As Airalo continues to grow, people tend to stay for a mix of things: the chance to work on a product used globally, the autonomy to shape how they work, and the opportunity to keep taking on new challenges without getting stuck in one lane.

    Before You Hit Apply

    By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here: www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy?srsltid=AfmBOooBT0rXAj1FaNelZ3VfN0wvhwzvAoxdtHnOKSVETpiSjiXVuycy

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations upon request for individuals with disabilities throughout our job interview process.

description:
About

[피플팀 소개]
라프텔 피플팀은 구성원을 단순한 자원이 아닌 조직의 핵심으로 바라보는 팀이에요.
구성원의 합류와 성장, 그리고 그들이 매일 마주하는 공간과 업무 환경까지 구성원 경험 전반을 설계하고 운영해요.
빠르게 성장하는 조직일수록 사람과 환경이 함께 따라가야 해요.
요청이 오기 전에 먼저 움직이고, 작은 불편도 그냥 지나치지 않으면서, 라프텔이 더 좋은 곳이 될 수 있도록 한 발 앞서 준비해요.

[피플팀의 일하는 방식]
• 구성원의 요청이 오기 전에 먼저 생각하고 선제적으로 준비해요.
• 작은 것도 꼼꼼하게 관리해요. 계약 만료일 하나, 자산 대장 하나가 나중에 큰 문제로 이어질 수 있다는 걸 알고 있어요.
• 비효율이 보이면 개선해요. "원래 이렇게 해왔어요"는 저희 팀 사전에 없어요.
• 각 팀의 언어를 이해하려고 노력해요. 전사를 지원하는 팀인 만큼, 맥락을 이해하고 소통하는 것을 중요하게 생각해요.

[팀원을 채용하는 이유]
라프텔은 빠른 성장과 함께 구성원 수가 크게 늘어나고 있어요.
그동안 여러 구성원이 나눠서 처리하던 총무 업무를 이제는 한 분이 전담해서 체계적으로 만들어야 할 시점이에요.
IT 자산 관리부터 사무 환경 운영, 계약서 관리, 툴 라이선스까지 흩어져 있던 총무 업무를 하나의 기준으로 정리하고, 구성원들이 본업에 더 집중할 수 있는 환경을 함께 만들어 주실 분을 찾고 있어요.

[피플팀은 이런 동료를 기다리고 있어요]
• 빈틈이 생기는 것을 본능적으로 싫어하는 분. 계약 만료일, 재고 수량, 갱신 시점 같은 것들을 놓치지 않는 꼼꼼함이 있는 분을 기다리고 있어요.
• "그건 제 업무가 아닌데요"보다 "제가 해볼게요"가 자연스럽게 나오는 분. 총무 업무는 경계가 모호한 일이 많아서, 유연하게 움직이는 분이 잘 맞아요.
• 티 나지 않는 곳에서 환경을 만들어가는 것에서 보람을 느끼는 분. 구성원의 작은 불편도 먼저 발견하고 개선하려는 분을 기다려요.
• 정해진 매뉴얼이 없는 상황에서도 스스로 기준을 세우고 체계를 만들 수 있는 분.

title: Product Director, Public Sector
description:
The Role

Unit4 supports hundreds of public sector organizations across the UK, Netherlands, the Nordics, and similarly managed geographies - municipalities, local authorities, agencies, non-department public bodies, and emergency services. These organizations operate under a persistent double constraint: budgets that do not grow and teams that are stretched thin, often without the dedicated technology capacity that private-sector counterparts take for granted. The gap between what they are expected to deliver for communities and what their current systems enable them to do keeps widening. As Product Director for Public Sector, you own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap that helps close that gap.

This is not a policy advisory role. You will have dedicated engineering capacity to build vertical depth that makes Unit4 genuinely competitive for local government and specialist agencies. You will work closely with horizontal product teams to ensure the platform delivers end-to-end across finance, HR, procurement, and operations, but the vertical product strategy and roadmap are yours.

The right person has built enterprise software for public sector organizations - municipalities, local authorities, agencies, or emergency services. You understand what public finance management looks like from the inside, what compliance and audit obligations demand in practice, and you have shipped features that public sector finance and operations teams actually use.

AI presents a genuine opportunity for public sector organizations: automating administrative burden, accelerating compliance processes, and providing better insight for decision-making. But these are not commercial organizations free to move fast and iterate. They are stewards of public funds, citizen data, and community trust, operating under transparency and security obligations that set a higher bar. This role exists to ensure Unit4's public sector roadmap is complete, balanced, and innovative without being reckless: a portfolio that earns the confidence of government buyers and gives public servants more time to focus on what they are there to do - building stronger communities.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Public Sector product vision, strategy, and multi-horizon roadmap; align it with Unit4's platform strategy and commercial growth targets.

  • Lead a prioritized product backlog with dedicated engineering capacity - defining outcomes, success metrics, release plans, and quality criteria.

  • Own feature outcomes, not just delivery — define clear adoption, usage, and customer impact goals for every capability you champion, and track performance against them after launch.

  • Serve as the internal authority on the Public Sector vertical, providing product, marketing, analyst relations, and pre-sales teams with the industry grounding they need to position, demonstrate, and sell effectively.

  • Translate deep sector knowledge into specific, investment-backed product requirements: problem statements, opportunity sizing, and build-vs-partner decisions.

  • Define industry-specific solution blueprints, reference configurations, and pre-built templates that reduce implementation time for public sector customers.

  • Work closely with horizontal product teams to ensure public sector requirements are reflected in platform investment across finance, HR, procurement, and operations.

  • Partner with the Industry Growth Director on launch readiness, pricing, packaging, and field enablement.

  • Engage directly with strategic customers and the Public Sector Industry Board to validate roadmap direction, co-innovate, and capture outcome evidence.

  • Ensure regulatory, security, accessibility, and localisation requirements across our supported geographies are systematically reflected in the roadmap.

  • Monitor the competitive landscape - know what Civica, Visma, Centric, CGI, and others are shipping and what it means for Unit4's positioning.

  • Work with partners to extend the value proposition for public sector customers.

What You'll Bring

  • Proven product management experience building enterprise software - ERP or enterprise SaaS - for public sector organizations, particularly municipalities, local authorities, or specialist agencies. You have shipped products used by public sector finance and operations teams, not just consulted for them.

  • Deep knowledge of public finance management, public sector accounting, and government budgeting practices.

  • Solid understanding of public procurement frameworks and how they translate into practical ERP requirements - from approval workflows and audit trails to supplier management and contract compliance.

  • Understanding of the security, data residency, and audit expectations of government buyers and what that means for cloud ERP product decisions.

  • A clear point of view on how AI can responsibly empower public sector organizations - balancing real opportunity for efficiency and insight with the accountability, transparency, and security obligations these organizations carry.

  • Commercial orientation: you understand how product decisions drive ARR, win rate, and customer retention.

  • Strong communication skills at Head of Finance, Head of ICT, and senior public service leadership level.

  • Experience in product management for enterprise SaaS platforms.

  • Deep understanding of professional services business models, including project-based delivery, utilization, billing, scheduling and compliance.

  • Strong ability to influence without authority and work cross-functionally in a matrixed environment.

  • Proven ability to translate complex industry needs into scalable product solutions.

  • Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with ERP or PSA platforms

  • Familiarity with mid-market services firms and their operational challenges.

  • Familiarity with in AI-driven or data-rich product environments.

Who we are?

We are a people-first community that nurtures all the areas that surround your working experience. With us, you’ll be surrounded by a high-performance team that supports your authentic self and celebrates your uniqueness.

We believe that ‘How work should feel’ is an evolving statement. Work goes beyond tasks and everyday responsibilities it’s about feeling valued, empowered, promoted, impactful, seen, and appreciated. We are reimagining how work makes people feel.

What we offer

  • a culture built on trust and accountability - giving you the freedom and autonomy to be successful and make an impact
  • balance - with our Flexible Leave Paid Time Off policy, remote working opportunities, Global Wellbeing Days, and other great benefits
  • growth opportunities - we provide the tools and guidance required so that you can focus on what really matters to you and so, ultimately, you can achieve your best work
  • talented colleagues, role models and mentors - work, learn and be inspired by some of the best talent in the software industry
  • a commitment to sustainability - with initiatives such as our Environmental, Social, and Governance strategy and Act4Good programme
  • a safe and inclusive working environment – supported by our Employee Resource Groups, which are open to all.

Our commitment to equity

Unit4 is committed to ensuring equal opportunity for everyone. We make our hiring decisions solely based on skills, qualifications, and our current business needs. We know that diversity brings fresh perspectives, ideas, and solutions to our company. This is the essence of our culture. We also welcome and encourage people who are pregnant and/or parents-to-be to apply. If you would like to know more about our commitment to diversity, visit our blogs:

  • Our focus to DEI remains central to who we are
  • Inclusive hiring at Unit4: Building equal opportunities for all

This role may require security clearance required for customer projects and access to sensitive (customer) data. That means that after you have accepted our offer, we could ask for background checks. Subject to applicable local laws, such security checks may require disclosure of personal information including criminal record declaration, right to work, personal identification and work history. No worries though – we'll handle it according to local privacy laws and keep your info safe. Questions? Feel free to reach out!

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem

ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.

As a Sr. Software Engineer in Norcross, GA, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem!

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join the MTS Development team responsible for one of the industry's most critical high-value payments platforms. This role will focus on maintaining, enhancing, and modernizing core payment processing capabilities while supporting regulatory mandates, customer commitments, platform resiliency, and long-term product sustainability.

The ideal candidate will be a strong software engineer with experience in complex enterprise applications, payment systems, mission-critical production support, and large-scale modernization initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain core MTS platform capabilities.
  • Deliver customer and regulatory commitments including payment network mandates.
  • Participate in production issue resolution and root cause analysis.
  • Support modernization initiatives including 64-bit migration, ISO 20022, structured address, security, and platform enhancement programs.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Professional Services, Quality Engineering, and Customer Support teams.
  • Act as a technical mentor and support knowledge transfer initiatives.
  • Drive engineering excellence through automation, testing, observability, and quality improvements.
  • Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity and code quality.

Required Qualifications

  • 6-8 years of software development experience.
  • Strong Cobol and enterprise application development experience.
  • Experience working with large-scale transaction processing platforms.
  • Experience debugging complex production issues.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, integration patterns, APIs, and database technologies.
  • Experience with secure software development practices.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Payments industry experience (Fedwire, CHIPS, SWIFT, ISO 20022).
  • Experience supporting Tier-1 financial institutions.
  • Experience with cloud migration and modernization initiatives.
  • Knowledge of high-availability and mission-critical systems.
  • Experience using AI engineering tools such as Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or equivalent.

Success Measures

  • Successful delivery of roadmap and mandate commitments.
  • Reduction in production incidents and resolution time.
  • Increased automated test coverage.
  • Effective knowledge transfer and documentation.
  • Contribution to long-term platform sustainability.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visa status or work permit now or in the future.

In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment.

Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www.aciworldwide.com Job ID (Requisition #19604)

ACI Worldwide is an AA/EEO employer in the United States, which includes providing equal opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities, and an EEO employer globally.

Important Notice About Recruitment Scams
Job seekers should be aware of ongoing recruitment scams where individuals or organizations impersonate legitimate companies to offer fake job opportunities. These scams often involve requests for personal information, payments, or interviews through unofficial channels. Please be cautious and verify any communications claiming to be from our company (www.aciworldwide.com / @aciworldwide.com). The ACI Worldwide recruitment team will always follow official channels and will never request payment.
