title: Werkstudent Technisch Inspecteur Energiebesparing (EML)
description:
Wil jij naast je studie praktijkervaring opdoen in de techniek? Als werkstudent inspecteer je gebouwen en installaties op unieke locaties door heel Nederland en draag je bij aan energiebesparing in de praktijk.

Wat doe je als werkstudent technisch inspecteur?

Als werkstudent technisch inspecteur ondersteun je bij EML-inspecties (Erkende Maatregelenlijst Energiebesparing) op locaties verspreid over heel Nederland. Samen met ervaren collega's beoordeel je gebouwen, technische installaties en voorzieningen op aanwezige energiebesparende maatregelen en onderzoek je waar kansen liggen om energie efficiënter te gebruiken.

Je verzamelt inspectiegegevens, controleert technische installaties en legt bevindingen zorgvuldig vast volgens vaste werkwijzen. Daarbij kom je op verschillende locaties. Zo is geen dag en geen inspectie gelijk. Vooraf volg je een praktijkgerichte opleiding, zodat je goed voorbereid aan de slag gaat.

Dit vind jij mooi om te doen:

  • Technische inspecties uitvoeren op uiteenlopende locaties;

  • Meer leren over gebouwen, installaties en energiebesparing;

  • Nauwkeurig gegevens verzamelen en vastleggen;

  • Samenwerken in teams van twee of drie collega’s;

  • Reizen naar bijzondere niet-openbare locaties verspreid door het land.

Met wie werk jij samen?

Je komt terecht in onze adviesgroep Energietransitie en Duurzaamheid, waar je samen met enthousiaste collega's werkt aan technische en duurzame vraagstukken. Je voert inspecties uit met ervaren inspecteurs die je begeleiden in je ontwikkeling. Daarnaast heb je regelmatig contact met opdrachtgevers en andere betrokkenen op locatie.

Dit zien we graag terug:

  • Je beschikt over een mbo-diploma: Bouwkunde (MBO3 of 4), Werktuigbouwkunde (MBO4) of Elektrotechniek (MBO4);

  • Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding;

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en hebt interesse in techniek, gebouwen, installaties en energiebesparing;

  • Je vindt het leuk om op verschillende locaties in Nederland te werken;

  • Je bent beschikbaar voor de verplichte opleiding op 17 en 18 augustus;

  • Je kunt regelmatig één aaneengesloten dag per week werken;

  • Je werkt graag samen en communiceert gemakkelijk met collega's.

De sollicitatiegesprekken vinden plaats op 11 augustus 2026, zodat je tijdig kunt starten met de verplichte opleiding op 17 en 18 augustus.

title: Product Director, Public Sector
description:
The Role

Unit4 supports hundreds of public sector organizations across the UK, Netherlands, the Nordics, and similarly managed geographies - municipalities, local authorities, agencies, non-department public bodies, and emergency services. These organizations operate under a persistent double constraint: budgets that do not grow and teams that are stretched thin, often without the dedicated technology capacity that private-sector counterparts take for granted. The gap between what they are expected to deliver for communities and what their current systems enable them to do keeps widening. As Product Director for Public Sector, you own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap that helps close that gap.

This is not a policy advisory role. You will have dedicated engineering capacity to build vertical depth that makes Unit4 genuinely competitive for local government and specialist agencies. You will work closely with horizontal product teams to ensure the platform delivers end-to-end across finance, HR, procurement, and operations, but the vertical product strategy and roadmap are yours.

The right person has built enterprise software for public sector organizations - municipalities, local authorities, agencies, or emergency services. You understand what public finance management looks like from the inside, what compliance and audit obligations demand in practice, and you have shipped features that public sector finance and operations teams actually use.

AI presents a genuine opportunity for public sector organizations: automating administrative burden, accelerating compliance processes, and providing better insight for decision-making. But these are not commercial organizations free to move fast and iterate. They are stewards of public funds, citizen data, and community trust, operating under transparency and security obligations that set a higher bar. This role exists to ensure Unit4's public sector roadmap is complete, balanced, and innovative without being reckless: a portfolio that earns the confidence of government buyers and gives public servants more time to focus on what they are there to do - building stronger communities.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Public Sector product vision, strategy, and multi-horizon roadmap; align it with Unit4's platform strategy and commercial growth targets.

  • Lead a prioritized product backlog with dedicated engineering capacity - defining outcomes, success metrics, release plans, and quality criteria.

  • Own feature outcomes, not just delivery — define clear adoption, usage, and customer impact goals for every capability you champion, and track performance against them after launch.

  • Serve as the internal authority on the Public Sector vertical, providing product, marketing, analyst relations, and pre-sales teams with the industry grounding they need to position, demonstrate, and sell effectively.

  • Translate deep sector knowledge into specific, investment-backed product requirements: problem statements, opportunity sizing, and build-vs-partner decisions.

  • Define industry-specific solution blueprints, reference configurations, and pre-built templates that reduce implementation time for public sector customers.

  • Work closely with horizontal product teams to ensure public sector requirements are reflected in platform investment across finance, HR, procurement, and operations.

  • Partner with the Industry Growth Director on launch readiness, pricing, packaging, and field enablement.

  • Engage directly with strategic customers and the Public Sector Industry Board to validate roadmap direction, co-innovate, and capture outcome evidence.

  • Ensure regulatory, security, accessibility, and localisation requirements across our supported geographies are systematically reflected in the roadmap.

  • Monitor the competitive landscape - know what Civica, Visma, Centric, CGI, and others are shipping and what it means for Unit4's positioning.

  • Work with partners to extend the value proposition for public sector customers.

What You'll Bring

  • Proven product management experience building enterprise software - ERP or enterprise SaaS - for public sector organizations, particularly municipalities, local authorities, or specialist agencies. You have shipped products used by public sector finance and operations teams, not just consulted for them.

  • Deep knowledge of public finance management, public sector accounting, and government budgeting practices.

  • Solid understanding of public procurement frameworks and how they translate into practical ERP requirements - from approval workflows and audit trails to supplier management and contract compliance.

  • Understanding of the security, data residency, and audit expectations of government buyers and what that means for cloud ERP product decisions.

  • A clear point of view on how AI can responsibly empower public sector organizations - balancing real opportunity for efficiency and insight with the accountability, transparency, and security obligations these organizations carry.

  • Commercial orientation: you understand how product decisions drive ARR, win rate, and customer retention.

  • Strong communication skills at Head of Finance, Head of ICT, and senior public service leadership level.

  • Experience in product management for enterprise SaaS platforms.

  • Deep understanding of professional services business models, including project-based delivery, utilization, billing, scheduling and compliance.

  • Strong ability to influence without authority and work cross-functionally in a matrixed environment.

  • Proven ability to translate complex industry needs into scalable product solutions.

  • Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with ERP or PSA platforms

  • Familiarity with mid-market services firms and their operational challenges.

  • Familiarity with in AI-driven or data-rich product environments.

Who we are?

We are a people-first community that nurtures all the areas that surround your working experience. With us, you’ll be surrounded by a high-performance team that supports your authentic self and celebrates your uniqueness.

We believe that ‘How work should feel’ is an evolving statement. Work goes beyond tasks and everyday responsibilities it’s about feeling valued, empowered, promoted, impactful, seen, and appreciated. We are reimagining how work makes people feel.

What we offer

  • a culture built on trust and accountability - giving you the freedom and autonomy to be successful and make an impact
  • balance - with our Flexible Leave Paid Time Off policy, remote working opportunities, Global Wellbeing Days, and other great benefits
  • growth opportunities - we provide the tools and guidance required so that you can focus on what really matters to you and so, ultimately, you can achieve your best work
  • talented colleagues, role models and mentors - work, learn and be inspired by some of the best talent in the software industry
  • a commitment to sustainability - with initiatives such as our Environmental, Social, and Governance strategy and Act4Good programme
  • a safe and inclusive working environment – supported by our Employee Resource Groups, which are open to all.

Our commitment to equity

Unit4 is committed to ensuring equal opportunity for everyone. We make our hiring decisions solely based on skills, qualifications, and our current business needs. We know that diversity brings fresh perspectives, ideas, and solutions to our company. This is the essence of our culture. We also welcome and encourage people who are pregnant and/or parents-to-be to apply. If you would like to know more about our commitment to diversity, visit our blogs:

  • Our focus to DEI remains central to who we are
  • Inclusive hiring at Unit4: Building equal opportunities for all

This role may require security clearance required for customer projects and access to sensitive (customer) data. That means that after you have accepted our offer, we could ask for background checks. Subject to applicable local laws, such security checks may require disclosure of personal information including criminal record declaration, right to work, personal identification and work history. No worries though – we'll handle it according to local privacy laws and keep your info safe. Questions? Feel free to reach out!

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer - Partnership & Enterprise
description:
The Partnership and Enterprise squad is building the infrastructure that powers SumUp's partner channel, a business that supports around 800 active partners and is growing fast. As the squad's Senior Full-Stack Engineer, you'll take end-to-end ownership of the Partner Portal, the product that sits at the heart of how SumUp's partners manage their merchants, fees, and operations. This is an opportunity with real scope: you'll shape technical direction, collaborate closely with CRM engineers and product stakeholders, and ship features that directly reduce operational friction for the teams driving SumUp's sales growth.

What you'll do:

  • Build and own the Partner Portal's frontend using React, TypeScript, and Next.js, creating fast, reliable, and well-structured user-facing experiences

  • Write and maintain back-end APIs, services, and data pipelines in TypeScript and Go that are scalable and built to support a fast-growing global platform

  • Actively contribute to code reviews, team ceremonies, and chapter rituals, sharing context and knowledge across engineering disciplines to avoid silos

You'll be great for this role if:

  • You have proven experience with TypeScript and React, building scalable, production-grade full stack applications using frameworks such as Next.js, Remix, Nuxt, or similar
  • Solid experience designing and working with RESTful APIs and complex microservice systems, with comfort navigating and refactoring large codebases
  • Solid knowledge of Go, or strong experience with another backend language such as Node.js, used to build reliable, performant backend services
  • Experience as a Kubernetes user, with familiarity in CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure tooling such as Terraform
  • Comfort working closely with CRM systems or adjacent tooling (e.g. Salesforce), and an openness to bridging the gap between CRM engineering and full stack development
  • A product mindset, connecting technical decisions to real business outcomes, and a genuine sense of ownership over the features you build from planning through to maintenance

Why you should join SumUp:

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

title: Goldman Sachs Asset & Wealth Management - OCIO Insurance Associate - The Hague
description:
MULTI-ASSET SOLUTIONS OVERVIEW

Multi Asset Solutions (MAS) is a multi-asset class investing group that sits within the Asset Management Division at Goldman Sachs. It designs and develops comprehensive investment management solutions customized to meet the investment objectives and relevant constraints of clients. These solutions bring together state-of-the-art techniques for multi-asset and liability-hedging portfolio design and implementation and reflect proprietary research and analytics conducted by the MAS team. With investment professionals across the globe, MAS invests or advises on assets for some of the world’s leading corporations, sovereign wealth funds, pension plans, governments, financial institutions, endowments, foundations, and family offices.

The OCIO Insurance team is a global team that provides investment solutions and OCIO services for insurance companies. The team works collaboratively with portfolio managers, research, engineering and reporting teams, sales and client relationship professionals across multi-asset and the broader GS organisation.

Role Overview

We are seeking an associate to join the LPM team in The Hague. This role is ideal for someone looking to continue developing his/her analytical and client-facing skills in delivering investment solutions to insurance companies. Sitting at the intersection of investment strategy, regulatory capital management and business development, you will work directly with senior LPM’s and clients to drive investment results. You will ensure investment portfolios are optimized for both risk-adjusted returns and capital efficiency while identifying new investment opportunities.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Asset-Liability Analysis: Perform "whole-of-balance-sheet" analytics to match investment assets with insurance liability streams (Life, P&C, and Health).
  • SAA & Portfolio Construction: Develop and implement bespoke Strategic Asset Allocation frameworks that account for insurance-specific constraints, including Solvency II considerations, return-on-capital requirement needs and risk parameters.
  • Client Engagement: Contribute to providing best-in-class client service by delivering amongst others presentation materials, analytics, market insights and investment reports as well as participating in client meetings.
  • Thought Leadership & Content: Collaborate with internal research and other teams to produce high-impact investment content, including quarterly commentaries and market-driven thought leadership research.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work together closely with colleagues to contribute to the delivery of responses to commercial opportunities including RFIs, RFPs and site-visits.

COMPETENCIES

  • Presence: Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to engage confidently with insurers and senior stakeholders.
  • Investment Judgment: Ability to demonstrate sound investment logic and adapt to rapidly changing market conditions.
  • Entrepreneurial Drive: A proactive approach to identifying platform enhancements and business growth initiatives.
  • Teamwork: A collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across global teams in The Hague, London, and New York.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience: 3–5 years of experience in multi-asset investing, investment strategy or actuarial consulting. Proven experience in a client-facing or commercially-oriented role within the insurance market is highly preferred.
  • Analytical Skills: Thorough understanding of regulatory frameworks like Solvency II and fixed income, alternative, private, illiquid and equity markets including liability-hedging strategies.
  • Commercial Mindset: Ability to identify business opportunities and to transform these into new business.
  • Education: Master’s degree in a quantitative, economic or actuarial field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Dutch is a significant advantage given the local client base.
  • Technical Skills: Expert-level proficiency in MS Office Suit. Familiarity with industry data sources and adaptability to new software is essential.

About Goldman Sachs

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world. We believe who you are makes you better.

title: Verpleegkundige Wijkzorg Zeewolde
description:
Wil jij als verpleegkundige het verschil maken voor cliënten thuis én meedenken over de Wijkzorg in de toekomst? Dan zoeken wij jou voor ons team Wijkzorg Zeewolde.

Verpleegkundige Wijkzorg Zeewolde

Uren in overleg

Coloriet Wijkzorg in Zeewolde

Wie zijn wij?

Coloriet ondersteunt ouderen in elke levensfase, met persoonlijke aandacht en deskundigheid. Daarom sluiten we aan bij wat iemand zelf kan, wil en belangrijk vindt. Wij zorgen mét mensen. Met meer dan 1400 cliënten en hun familieleden, ruim 1400 medewerkers en 600 vrijwilligers geven wij samen kleur aan een waardevol leven. Thuis, in de wijk of op één van onze locaties in Biddinghuizen, Dronten, Lelystad, Swifterbant of Zeewolde.

De Wijkzorg in Zeewolde is volop in ontwikkeling. We werken met zorgtechnologie, versterken de samenwerking in de wijk en bouwen verder aan de palliatieve zorg.

Wie ben jij?

Als verpleegkundige Wijkzorg in Zeewolde ben jij één van de vertrouwde gezichten voor onze cliënten die thuiszorg ontvangen, maar ook voor hun familie en mantelzorgers. Jij hebt een positieve blik en wilt graag samen processen optimaliseren om de zorg beter maken. Jij bent een echte verbinder. Jouw probleemoplossend vermogen deel je graag met anderen en jouw enthousiasme werkt aanstekelijk. Voor de zorg die wij bieden zijn onze kernwaarden Verbindend, Eigen-wijs en Vooruitstrevend belangrijk. Je staat open voor slimme zorgtechnologie en vindt het leuk om mee te denken hoe dit het dagelijks leven van cliënten makkelijker en aangenamer kan maken.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt met mensen met uiteenlopende zorgvragen, verhalen en achtergronden. Je biedt zorg en begeleiding aan cliënten die nog zelfstandig thuis wonen in Zeewolde.

Je signaleert veranderingen in gezondheid en welzijn, stemt deze af met collega’s en schakelt waar nodig andere disciplines in. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat cliënten zo lang mogelijk veilig, prettig en zelfstandig thuis kunnen blijven wonen met ondersteuning die past bij hun situatie.

Wat maakt jouw werk bijzonder?

Jouw werk is geen “rondje routes draaien”. Je komt bij mensen thuis en ziet van dichtbij wat zij nodig hebben om hun zelfstandigheid te behouden. De ene dag verzorg je een wond of dien je medicatie toe, de andere dag signaleer je veranderingen en denk je mee over een passende oplossing.

Je werkt midden in de wijk, waar zorg, wonen en welzijn samenkomen en waar jij elke dag het verschil kan maken. De Wijkzorg is volop in ontwikkeling, onder andere op het gebied van palliatieve zorg.

Wat vinden wij belangrijk:

  • Je bent een enthousiaste verpleegkundige met passie voor je vak;

  • Je beschikt over een afgeronde opleiding verpleegkunde niveau 4 en bent BIG geregistreerd;

  • Je hebt affiniteit met thuiszorg (en palliatieve zorg);

  • Je hebt een rijbewijs;

  • Geen nachtdiensten: die verzorgen wij samen met de regionale nachtdienst. Zo kun je rekenen op meer regelmaat in je rooster;

  • Je bent op de hoogte van de ontwikkelingen binnen je vak;

  • Wij vinden werkplezier belangrijk en jij ook!

Wij bieden:

  • Bij wederzijds enthousiasme bieden wij een arbeidsovereenkomst aan voor onbepaalde tijd;

  • Superleuk en zinvol werk in een enthousiast en betrokken team;

title: Architect BI & Data Science
description:
Bouw mee aan het dataplatform van een AI-gedreven Arriva

Data en AI krijgen een steeds grotere rol binnen Arriva. Van realtime operationele inzichten en voorspelmodellen voor vervoerplanning tot AI-oplossingen die interne processen ondersteunen. Om deze ontwikkeling mogelijk te maken, zoeken wij een ervaren Data Architect die de technische koers van ons data- en AI-landschap helpt bepalen.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de architectuur van ons dataplatform en de bijbehorende ontwikkelprocessen. Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen technologie. Je helpt Arriva om werkprocessen, governance, tooling en ontwikkelstandaarden klaar te maken voor een toekomst waarin AI steeds vaker wordt ingezet voor analyses, besluitvorming en productontwikkeling.

Je werkt nauw samen met de Manager BI & Data Science, developers, data scientists, business analisten en IT. Samen zorg je ervoor dat data betrouwbaar, veilig en schaalbaar beschikbaar is en dat nieuwe AI-oplossingen gecontroleerd en beheersbaar naar productie kunnen worden gebracht.

Jouw rol

Als Data Architect ben je de technische aanjager van professionalisering binnen BI, Data Science en AI. Je vertaalt strategische ambities naar een concrete technische roadmap en zorgt dat innovaties daadwerkelijk landen binnen de organisatie.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Ontwerpen en doorontwikkelen van de data- en AI-architectuur van Arriva.

  • Inrichten van een toekomstbestendig dataplatform in Azure en Snowflake.

  • Ontwikkelen van standaarden voor Data Science, AI en softwareontwikkeling.

  • Implementeren van data governance, data lineage, security en toegangsbeheer.

  • Adviseren over de inzet van generatieve AI, machine learning en AI-assisted development.

  • Coachen en begeleiden van ontwikkelaars en data scientists op architectuur, engineering en best practices.

  • Structureren en standaardiseren van documentatie, ontwikkelrichtlijnen en werkprocessen.

Wat maakt deze functie uniek?

Bij veel organisaties ligt de focus van een architect op het beheer van bestaande systemen. Bij Arriva krijg je de kans om actief mee te bouwen aan de volgende generatie van ons data- en AI-landschap.

Je helpt bepalen:

  • Hoe AI verantwoord kan worden geïntegreerd in bedrijfsprocessen.

  • Hoe ontwikkelteams sneller en kwalitatiever software en AI-oplossingen kunnen ontwikkelen.

  • Hoe governance en security meebewegen met een groeiend AI-landschap.

  • Hoe data, BI, Data Science en AI samenkomen in één geïntegreerd platform.

Wat breng jij mee?

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Data Architect, Solution Architect of vergelijkbare rol.

  • Ervaring met het ontwerpen van data- en analyticsplatformen in Azure.

  • Kennis van moderne data architecturen, data governance en security.

  • Affiniteit met / nieuwsgierigheid naar AI, machine learning en generatieve AI.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van technische teams en het verhogen van ontwikkelvolwassenheid.

  • Afgeronde MSc in bijvoorbeeld Informatica, Data Science, Wiskunde of een vergelijkbare studie.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om technische keuzes begrijpelijk uit te leggen aan zowel management als ontwikkelaars.

Wat bieden we jou?

Je krijgt afhankelijk van je relevante werkervaring een salaris in schaal 11 (max. € 7.583), passend bij jouw ervaring en verantwoordelijkheden.

Verder:

  • 30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. 40 uur);

  • een Persoonlijk Keuze Budget (je hebt recht op een 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld);

  • een Persoonlijk Ontwikkel Budget voor opleidingen die niet werk-gerelateerd zijn;

  • volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen via onze Arriva Academy (leerportaal) en ook fysiek, met een bedrijfsfitness-regeling;

  • reiskostenvergoeding en gratis reizen met al onze bussen en treinen via Arriva’s reisapp glimble;

  • je kunt uiteraard (deels) vanuit huis werken. Daarvoor is een thuiswerkplekbudget beschikbaar van €900.

Solliciteren?

Graag! Je solliciteert naar deze baan via de sollicitatieknop. Richt je sollicitatie, bij voorkeur inclusief motivatie aan Ricardo Abbas, Senior Recruiter bij Arriva. Heb je eerst nog vragen over de procedure? Je kunt Ricardo bereiken door een mail te sturen naar ricardo.abbas@arriva.nl.

Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over deze functie? Stel die dan aan Krista Jaarsma, manager BI & Data Science, te bereiken op 06 22 57 00 88.

title: Kaivinkoneenkuljettaja Dahlbacka Oy:lle, suorarekrytointi
description:
Yhdelle on vielä tilaa!

Good Fellas Oy etsii suorarekrytointitoimeksiantona ammattitaitoista kaivinkoneenkuljettajaa Dahlbacka Oy:lle vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Työsuhde solmitaan suoraan Maanrakennus B. Dahlbacka Oy:n kanssa.

Maanrakennus B. Dahlbacka Oy

Maanrakennus B. Dahlbacka Oy on vakavarainen, yli 60 vuotta toiminut perheyritys, joka toteuttaa monipuolisia maanrakennus- ja infrarakentamisen hankkeita laadukkaasti ja ammattitaidolla. Yrityksen toiminnan kulmakiviä ovat osaava henkilöstö, nykyaikainen kalusto sekä pitkäjänteinen sitoutuminen työntekijöiden hyvinvointiin ja turvalliseen työskentelyyn. Yritys tunnetaan laadukkaasta työnjäljestään, osaavasta henkilöstöstään sekä pitkäjänteisestä toimintatavastaan.

Varsinainen työpaikka sijaitsee Kokkolassa ja työmaat sijaitsevat pääasiassa Pohjanmaan alueella, mutta projekteja toteutetaan myös muualla Suomessa. Nyt Maanrakennus B. Dahlbacka Oy hakee vahvistusta osaavaan tiimiinsä kaivinkoneenkuljettajan tehtävään.



Kaivinkoneenkuljettaja

Etsimme kokenutta ja vastuullista kaivinkoneenkuljettajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Työssä pääset osallistumaan monipuolisiin vesihuolto- ja infrarakennuskohteisiin sekä työskentelemään osana ammattitaitoista työryhmää.

Työssäsi toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä asentajien ja muun työmaahenkilöstön kanssa. Ymmärrät tarkkuuden merkityksen kaapelireittien kaivamisessa, putkitusten asennuksissa ja työn viimeistelyssä. Hallitset turvallisen työskentelyn myös liikennöidyillä alueilla ja osaat ottaa vastuun työn laadusta sekä turvallisuudesta.

Työkoneet ovat pääasiassa kokoluokaltaan 15–30 tonnin kaivinkoneita.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu

* Vesijohto- ja viemäriverkoston rakennustöiden ja saneerauskohteiden kaivinkonetyöt

* Kaapeli- ja putkiasennuskaivantojen kaivuu ja täyttötyöt

* Putkitusten asennustöiden mahdollistaminen yhteistyössä asentajien kanssa

* Työskentely liikennöidyillä työalueilla

* Työmaan turvallisuuden ja työn laadun varmistaminen

* Päivittäinen yhteistyö asentajien ja muun projektihenkilöstön kanssa

Odotamme sinulta

* Kokemusta kaivinkoneenkuljettajan tehtävistä infra- tai vesihuoltohankkeissa

* Kokemusta vesijohtotöistä ja saneerauksista

* Kykyä työskennellä turvallisesti ja huolellisesti

* Itsenäistä ja vastuullista työotetta

* Hyviä yhteistyö- ja kommunikointitaitoja

* Joustavaa asennetta ja luotettavuutta

* Valmiutta reissutyöhön

* B-ajokorttia

* Suomen kielen taitoa työtehtävien hoitamiseen

Lisäksi toivomme voimassa olevia:

* Työturvallisuuskorttia

* Tieturva 1 -korttia

* Vesihygieniapassia

Eduksi katsomme

* Kokemuksen pyöräalustaisista kaivinkoneista

* Sähkö- ja puskuhitsausosaamisen

* Kokemuksen kaivinkoneiden 3D-koneohjauksesta

* Piirustusten luku- ja tulkintataidon

* Tulityökortin

* CE-ajokortin



Mitä tarjoamme?

· Vakituisen työpaikan vakavaraisessa yli 60-vuotiaassa perheyrityksessä

· Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen työnkuvan mielenkiintoisissa infrakohteissa

· Mahdollisuuden oppia uutta ja kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi

· Nykyaikaisen ja hyvin huolletun kaluston

· Työnantajan, joka aidosti huolehtii työntekijöistään

· Mukavan, ammattitaitoisen ja tekemisen meininkiä arvostavan työyhteisön

· Epassi-edun liikunnan, kulttuurin ja hyvinvoinnin palveluihin

· Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan



Työsuhde

· Työsuhde: vakituinen

· Aloitus: mielellään elokuun 2026 aikana sopimuksen mukaan

· Sijainti: Kokkola

· Työmaat: pääasiassa Pohjanmaalla, tarvittaessa myös muualla Suomessa

Miten haen?

Rekrytoinnista vastaa Good Fellas Oy, mutta valittu henkilö työllistyy suoraan Maanrakennus B. Dahlbacka Oy:n palvelukseen. Haku tehtävään päättyy 19.8.2026.

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana, ja paikka voidaan täyttää heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

www.dahlbacka.com [http://www.dahlbacka.com]

----------------------------------------

Good Fellas on kokkolalainen yritys, joka työllistää väkeä pääosin rakentamisen, logistiikan ja teollisuuden sekä palveluiden eri tehtävien pariin. Työsuhteet voivat olla toistaiseksi voimassa olevia, määräaikaisia tai sidottuna johonkin projektiin. Olemme työnantajana joustava ja luomme erilaisia mahdollisuuksia työn parissa viihtyville. Haluamme että tunnet työntekijänä olevasi vahvasti yksi meistä, yksi GoodFella ja toivomme että vastaamme ammatilliseen nälkääsi tarjoamalla vaihtuvia työkohteita, uusia työhaasteita ja mahdollisuutta vaikuttaa omaan työhösi. In a world where you can be anything you want, why not be a GoodFella?

title: Re Advertised - General Services Clerk NPSA 4 (Amman, Jordan)
description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

  • Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
  • Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
  • Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
  • Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

As part of the global development system, UNDP Jordan focuses on supporting national efforts toward inclusive growth, resilience, and sustainable development, in line with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and national development priorities.

The UNDP Country Office implements a wide range of programmes and projects addressing governance, social cohesion, economic development, climate action, and institutional capacity building. The Operations Unit plays a critical role in ensuring the efficient delivery of administrative, financial, procurement, and logistical services to support programme implementation.

Within this framework, the General Services function ensures effective management of common premises, administrative services, government liaison functions, and transportation services to support the smooth functioning of the Country Office.

Duties and Responsibilities

Scope of Work

Under the direct supervision of the Administrative Analyst (NOA), the general services Clerk supports the delivery of efficient and compliant administrative services within the UNDP Country Office. The incumbent ensures the smooth implementation of administrative processes and provides support across common premises management, registry services, government liaison functions, and fleet coordination in accordance with UNDP rules and procedures.

The incumbent performs the following functions:

1. Support the Management of Common Premises and Facilities

  • Assist in the day-to-day administration of office premises and common facilities.
  • Coordinate routine maintenance activities, minor repairs, and facility services.
  • Assist in following up on service delivery related to cleaning, maintenance, and facility services.
  • Maintain records related to premises management, maintenance requests, and service provision.
  • Support compliance with corporate standards related to occupational safety, security, and office environment management.

2. Provide Registry and Mail Management Services

  • Manage incoming and outgoing mail and ensure timely distribution of official correspondence.
  • Maintain registry records and ensure proper documentation and filing in line with UNDP records management procedures.
  • Track and archive official documents and correspondence in both physical and electronic systems.
  • Ensure confidentiality and proper handling of official records and documentation.

3. Support Government Liaison and Administrative Transactions

  • Facilitate administrative processes with government entities for international personnel, including residency permits, visas, and related documentation.
  • Coordinate customs clearance procedures for official shipments, equipment, and supplies.
  • Maintain updated records and tracking systems for residency permits and customs documentation.
  • Support communication with relevant government authorities under the guidance of the supervision.

4. Support Fleet and Transportation Coordination

  • Coordinate daily transportation requests and scheduling of drivers.
  • Maintain records related to vehicle usage, maintenance schedules, insurance, and documentation.
  • Assist in administrative monitoring vehicle condition and ensuring compliance with UNDP fleet management procedures.
  • Support the implementation of safe and efficient transportation services for office operations.

5. Support Administrative Coordination, Service Delivery and knowledge sharing

  • Maintain administrative records, logs, and tracking tools related to services provided by the General Services Unit.
  • Maintain records and tracking tools related to services provided by the General Services Unit.
  • Perform other administrative and operational tasks as assigned by the supervisor.
  • Synthesize lessons learned and best practices in procurement. · Make sound contributions to knowledge networks and communities of practice.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Institutional Arrangement

The General Services Clerk will work under the direct supervision of the Administrative Analyst (NOA) within the Operations Unit and will coordinate closely with programme teams, operations personnel, and relevant government counterparts to ensure the efficient delivery of administrative services.

Think Innovatively: LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements

Ability to apply existing concepts to new situations, and to develop new concepts to generate workable solutions and new approaches. title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
For Digital Hub Warsaw, we are looking for:

Senior Data Scientist

Are you excited to turn complex business questions into measurable impact? We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist for the Machine Learning & Artificial Intelligence unit within Bayer’s Enterprise Data & Analytics Platform. You will combine generative AI with classical machine learning, lead rigorous experimentation and evaluation, and communicate clear, actionable insights to stakeholders- delivering high-impact AI solutions across Finance, Supply Chain, HR, Procurement, Legal, and Communications. Our international team spans Poland, Germany, Spain, and India. We work with LLMs and embeddings, classical ML, and optimization on a modern, cloud-native stack (Python, AWS, Azure, Databricks). If solving business problems with analytical rigor and applying cutting-edge machine learning and GenAI techniques excites you, this is the place.

At Bayer, we are committed to transparency, equal pay for equal work or work of equal value, and objective reward practices in line with EU and local regulations. The minimum monthly gross compensation for this role is 20 240 PLN, with final pay determined based on objective factors such as experience, qualifications, scope of responsibility, and internal alignment.

This position is eligible for variable pay components, such as performance based bonuses, awarded in accordance with the applicable employee group, role scope, and compensation structure.

Your Tasks & Responsibilities:

  • Translate business needs into data science problems; define hypotheses, success metrics, and evaluation plans; communicate progress and outcomes to stakeholders.

  • Design, build, and evaluate (Gen)AI solutions for enterprise data, including:

  • LLMs and AgenticAI; including prompt/chain design, tool use, and lightweight agent workflows (LangChain, LangGraph, PydanticAI

  • Classical ML models (classification, regression, forecasting, clustering), feature pipelines, and explainability (e.g., SHAP

  • RAG pipelines and vector search for knowledge use cases

  • Establish rigorous evaluation: offline metrics, human-in-the-loop reviews, rubric-based GenAI assessments, groundedness/hallucination checks, and online tests (A/B or interleaving).

  • Implement production-ready Python code with high-quality engineering standards: Git-based workflows, code reviews, automated tests, documentation, and reproducibility.

  • Ensure monitoring and traceability: data/feature drift checks, model and prompt versioning, cost/latency tracking, and structured logging.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Data Engineers, AI Engineers, and Business stakeholders to drive adoption for high outcome, production-grade AI solutions

  • Champion problem-solving and analytical rigor; lead workshops, stakeholder demos, and clear storytelling around insights, risks, and trade-offs.

Qualifications & Competencies (education, skills, experience):

  • Master’s or PhD with 5+ years in Data Science or Applied ML, delivering production-impact solutions.

  • Strong Python and SQL skills; expertise with standard data science libraries: pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn; experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow is a plus.

  • Hands-on with Generative AI: embeddings, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, PydanticAI); experience with vector databases (pgvector and others).

  • Solid grounding in classical ML: model selection, validation, and metrics (e.g., AUC/F1/RMSE); time series or forecasting experience is a plus.

  • Evaluation focus: design and run offline/online tests, rubric-based GenAI evaluation, safety checks, and error analysis; familiarity with LangSmith/Langfuse or similar is beneficial.

  • Clear stakeholder communication: requirements gathering, expectation setting, storytelling, and influencing decisions with data.

  • Proven problem-solving skills: structuring ambiguous problems, hypothesis-driven analysis, and iterative experimentation.

  • Basic cloud proficiency (AWS and/or Azure): storage and compute (e.g., S3/Blob, Lambda/Functions or containers), secrets, and Databricks or Spark; awareness of CI/CD (e.g., GitHub Actions).

  • Good engineering hygiene: modular code, testing, documentation, and reproducibility.

  • Data governance and privacy awareness.

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages from our team regions are a plus.

In addition, Bayer offers a competitive and holistic benefits package, including:

  • Medical care above statutory requirements

  • Flexible benefits supporting leisure, and well being/sports programs

  • Life, accident, and disability insurance through group coverage

  • Employer supported pension plans with regular company contributions

  • Home office allowance to support hybrid or remote work

  • Extra Paid Holidays

Benefits may vary depending on country, role, and employment conditions.

You feel you do not meet all criteria we are looking for? That doesn't mean you aren't the right fit for the role. Apply with confidence, we value potential over perfection.

Denna position rapporterar till:

Engineering Manager

__

We are currently seeking a service-minded and supportive Electrical Engineer to join our team in Västerås. If you are eager to apply your expertise in electrical machines and expand your knowledge in areas such as driven equipment and grid stability, this position could be a perfect fit for you! You will join a good team and be working with our products with a technical tailor-made products and solutions. With these products we meet the increased demands of future technology of our Synchronous Condensers in for example data center.

In this role, you will be instrumental in helping us achieve our goal of providing world-class support to our customers by delivering timely and comprehensive solutions. Your main responsibilities will include supporting our sales teams (new sales and aftersales) in the Global Technical Support function with electrical, magnetically and thermal designs that meet customer requirements, environmental conditions, as well as internal design and manufacturing guidelines. Additionally as a member of the project team, you will also oversee the electrical design of synchronous machines (Motors, Generators, Synchronous Condensers) during manufacturing and assess their performance in final testing, often in the presence of our customers. Finally, you will play a key role in training both our sales teams and customers on electrical machine theory.

This position offers you the chance to work in an international environment with a diversity of projects and applications, collaborating with colleagues from diverse cultural and geographical backgrounds.

Qualifications

  • You hold a Master of Science degree in Electrical Engineering with focus on electrical power and/or rotating electrical machines, or equivalent. Alternatively, you hold a Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, combined with several years of work experience from rotating electrical machinery or testing electrical machines.
  • You have five (5) or more years of experience with electrical machine design preferably with Synchronous Machines.
  • You are familiar with International Standards, (IEC, IEEE, NEMA and industry standards like API 546).
  • Experience from working in Sales and sales support functions (writing comments and deviations, discussing with custoners) is considered a merit. You have experience with the dynamic electrical and mechanical behavior of machines in power systems.
  • As part of a global organization, fluency in written and spoken English is a must. Swedish is considered a plus.
  • On a personal level you are open-minded and always strive to understand customer requirements and try to find the best possible solution, based on our unique concepts. Since you also will work closely with our sales team and customers you need to have a helpful and service-minded attitude.

More about us

ABB Large Motors and Generators (Machines) develops, sells, designs, and manufactures large 4 or 6 pole salient motors, generators and synchronous condensers for various applications. We have global responsibility within ABB and deliver to all continents.

title: Afvalcoach
description:
Een baan waarbij je buiten bent, veel contact hebt met mensen én zelf je gesprekken voert? Als afvalcoach ga je de wijk in, bel je aan bij bewoners en help je hen met tips en uitleg over afval scheiden.

Naast je werk in de wijk ben je ook aanwezig bij activiteiten die helpen om inwoners nog beter te bereiken. Je staat op markten en lokale evenementen waar je in gesprek gaat met mensen en praktische tips geeft. Ook kom je op scholen om kinderen op een begrijpelijke en leuke manier uit te leggen hoe zij kunnen bijdragen aan minder afval. Zo vergroot je stap voor stap het bewustzijn.

Afvalcoach Chantal van de Velde:
“Als afvalcoach weet je nooit wat de dag brengt en juist dat maakt het zo leuk! De ene dag sta ik voor de klas en help ik kinderen begrijpen waarom afval scheiden zo belangrijk is, de andere dag loop ik door de wijk om vragen van bewoners te beantwoorden om ze nét dat juiste zetje te geven. Soms is het wat duidelijkheid geven, soms vertellen we juist het duurzame verhaal, maar elke dag lukt het om samen het verschil maken.“

  • Je bent communicatief sterk en zoekt op een natuurlijke, klantgerichte manier contact met inwoners.

title: Biotechnician USP
description:
As part of the Pilot Plant team, the Biotechnician (USP) supports the development of processes for the manufacturing of recombinant proteins with CHO cultures by executing pilot batch runs, preparing materials, collecting data and sharing knowledge with manufacturing teams.
  • Conducts manufacturing activities at pilot scale and applies standard laboratory practices under guidance and supervision within scope and timelines
  • Supports technology transfer activities and shares knowledge with manufacturing team
  • Documents executed work in accordance to internal guidelines
  • Supports troubleshooting activities in collaboration with Subject Matter Expert
  • Documents batch results with a critical mind
  • Writes protocols, SOPs, using available templates
  • Drives simple initiatives (in relation to job duties) with limited guidance and supervision within his/her team/group
  • Ensures consistent application of EHS standards in daily laboratory operations, supports colleagues in following safety procedures, and contributes to improving the overall safety and housekeeping practices in the laboratory
  • Preparation of media and buffers, including pH adjustment, sterile filtration, and accurate weighing
  • Aseptic techniques and working in biosafety cabinets
  • Operation, basic troubleshooting and maintenance of laboratory equipment
  • Sample handling and preparation (e.g., clarification, sterile filtration, buffer exchange)
  • Use of general analysis instruments (e.g., automated cell counters, osmolality and metabolite analysers, spectrophotomer, pH meter etc.)
  • Data collection and report writing, confident in the use of IT tools
  • Good understanding of GMP practices and constraints at manufacturing scale
  • Basic troubleshooting and maintenance of bioreactors, ATFs and support systems
  • Excellent communication skills (English required, German is a plus)
  • Solution-oriented mindset
  • Ability to work in a fast paced environment
  • Collaborative team player
  • Ability to deal with changes and quickly adjust to new situations
  • Make a difference by directly impacting patients lives
  • Biologics is an attractive, high growth sector with professional development
  • Offers a multinational and diverse workplace
  • Proud to be a pioneer in “Next Generation” manufacturing technologies
  • Family owned: Entrepreneurial, and short communication lines
  • Basel is a great place to live, play and work in the center of Europe

title: BIM Moduller
description:
Job Summary:

The BIM Modeller is responsible for developing, managing, and coordinating detailed 3D models using Building Information Modelling (BIM) software. The role supports design, engineering, and construction teams by ensuring accurate model creation, clash detection, and documentation in accordance with project standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain 3D BIM models for architectural, structural, and MEP disciplines.

  • Prepare detailed drawings, shop drawings, and construction documentation from BIM models.

  • Coordinate with design engineers and consultants to ensure model accuracy and completeness.

  • Perform clash detection and model coordination using Navisworks or similar tools.

  • Ensure compliance with project BIM Execution Plan (BEP) and company BIM standards.

  • Update models based on design revisions and site feedback.

  • Extract quantities and generate reports from BIM models.

  • Maintain proper file management and version control as per project protocols.

  • Participate in coordination meetings and provide model-based inputs.

Software Proficiency Required:

  • Autodesk Revit (Architecture / Structure / MEP)

  • AutoCAD

  • Navisworks

  • BIM 360 / ACC (preferred)

  • Microsoft Office

Key Skills:

  • Strong technical and detailing skills

  • Knowledge of BIM standards and LOD requirements

  • Good coordination and communication skills

  • Ability to work under deadlines

Qualification & Experience:

  • Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in Civil / Architecture / Mechanical / Electrical Engineering.

  • 3–8 years of experience in BIM modelling.

  • Experience in Metro, Railway, Infrastructure, or High-rise Building projects preferred.

  • Strong understanding of construction drawings and detailing standards.

title: Recurring Revenue Management IT Product Owner
description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Recurring Revenue Management IT Product Owner

Hybrid role based on site in Cork, Ireland 2/3 days a week

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Recurring Revenue Management IT Product Owner with 8-15 years of proven expertise to lead the design, architecture, and continuous optimization of our enterprise revenue management ecosystem. This strategic role focuses on subscription/Services billing, revenue recognition, and complex bundling scenarios across services, software, and hardware subscriptions. You will serve as the critical bridge between Finance, IT, and business stakeholders to ensure Subscription/Services Invoice flexible billing, accurate revenue capture, ASC 606/IFRS 15 compliance, and seamless revenue operations and accounting of Revenue.

Key Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Requirements

  • Strategic Alignment: Partner with Finance, RevOps, and IT to gather requirements for complex subscription models, multi-element arrangements (MEAs), and hybrid pricing.

  • Process Documentation: Author detailed BRDs, FRDs, use cases, and process flows. Map out revenue allocation rules, deferred revenue logic, and prevent revenue leakage.

  • Compliance & Gap Analysis: Lead cross-functional workshops and perform gap analyses to ensure current and future processes meet ASC 606/IFRS 15 requirements.

Revenue & Billing Architecture

  • Revenue Framework: Design end-to-end ASC 606/IFRS 15-compliant revenue recognition frameworks based on the five-step model, defining standalone selling prices (SSP) and performance obligations.

  • Billing Solutions: Architect comprehensive subscription billing solutions supporting diverse pricing models (seat-based, usage, tiered). Design workflows for the full lifecycle (activation to cancellation), proration, taxation, self-service portals, and dunning.

Platform Configuration & Integration

  • System Setup: Hands-on configuration of top-tier platforms (Zuora, Stripe, Salesforce RCB, or RightRev). Set up product catalogs, pricing tiers, discount structures, and tax logic.

  • Revenue Automation: Configure revenue schedules, waterfall templates, GL mappings, event triggers, and SOX-compliant approval workflows.

  • Data & Integration: Define integration points between billing platforms, CRMs, ERPs, and tax engines. Manage version control and data governance across environments.

Agile IT Collaboration

  • Partner with IT Value Squads to bridge the gap between technical teams and Finance.

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, retrospectives) and validate product backlog scopes.

Required Qualifications

Experience & Background

  • Overall IT: 8–15 years of IT experience.

  • Specialization: 3–4+ years focused heavily on revenue management, subscription billing, or financial systems.

  • Track Record: Proven success in full-cycle enterprise implementations, specifically driving ASC 606/IFRS 15 compliance and recurring revenue operations in Agile environments.

Technical Expertise

  • Core Platforms (Must have one): Zuora (Billing/Revenue), Stripe Billing, Salesforce Revenue Cloud Billing (RCB), or RightRev.

  • Ecosystem Knowledge: Strong understanding of ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, MS Dynamics), Salesforce CRM/CPQ, and tax platforms (e.g., Avalara).

Communication & Leadership

  • Executive Presence: Outstanding ability to present complex financial concepts to diverse audiences, including C-suite and Finance leadership.

  • Facilitation: Excellent at leading cross-functional JAD sessions, managing stakeholder expectations, and resolving conflicts.

  • Documentation: Rigorous approach to capturing technical requirements for both IT execution and SOX/audit compliance.

Education

  • Degree: Bachelor's or Master's in Finance, Accounting, Business, IT, or Computer Science.

  • Preference: Accounting or Finance degrees, MBAs, and relevant professional certifications are highly valued.

Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. title: el-teknisk formand
description:
Trives du i en nøglerolle med stor frihed under ansvar, hvor du fungerer som en central figur på byggepladserne? Søger du en hverdag, hvor du veksler frit mellem ledelse, planlægning og det praktiske håndværk?

Som El-teknisk formand hos JYTAS får du ansvaret for el-entrepriserne på Sjælland. Du bliver den centrale figur i den daglige eksekvering, hvor du sikrer, at opgaverne løses effektivt, mens du fungerer som det faste anker for dine kolleger på pladsen

om jobbet

Jobbet tager udgangspunkt på byggepladserne, hvor du får en dynamisk hverdag, der veksler mellem teknisk arbejde, planlægning og ledelse. Du vil ikke være fastlåst bag et skrivebord, men derimod deltage aktivt i det praktiske arbejde samtidig med, at du leder teamet på ca. 10 elektrikere.

Firmaets bygningsmoduler leveres fra produktionen med grundinstallationen. Derfor vil dit ansvar lægge i at færdiggøre byggeriet on-site med fokus på bl.a. at etablere føringsveje, kabling og sammenkobling.

Samtidig har du ansvaret for at sikre, at materialer bestilles hjem rettidigt, og at projekterne glider som aftalt gennem tæt koordinering af tidsplaner og bemanding. Det er en stilling præget af stor selvstændighed, hvor det forventes at du driver opgaverne og tager ejerskab over den daglige drift.

Dine primære ansvarsområder vil indebære:
●Daglig ledelse af opgaverne og ressourcerne på Sjælland.
●Planlægning, koordinering og drift af byggeprojekter.
●Deltagelse i det praktiske arbejde med en bred teknisk snitflade.
●Kvalitetssikring af arbejdet, både for egne folk og underleverandører.
●Løbende sparring med fabrikken omkring udvikling og optimering af byggeprocesser.

om dig

Vi søger en profil med en solid håndværksmæssig baggrund som elektriker. En uddannelse som el-installatør er et ønske, men ikke et krav. Erfaring som enten overmontør eller formand vægtes højt. Det vigtigste er dog, at du har erfaring med byggeri og almen installation. Dybdegående kendskab til områder som netværk og sikkerhedsbelysning vil være en fordel.

Personligt er du direkte og ærlig og udviser ansvar og ordentlighed i dit arbejde. Opstår der udfordringer, bringes de proaktivt på banen med henblik på hurtig løsning.

Vi er åbne over for både yngre, ambitiøse kandidater med et ønske om at udvikle sig, samt mere erfarne profiler, som søger en praktisk orienteret nøglerolle og ikke ønsker at være fastlåst bag et skrivebord.

Vi leder efter dig, der:
●Har erfaring med byggepladser og installation.
●Har erfaring med den daglige, praktiske ledelse af et team.
●Evner at planlægge din egen og andres tid samt stå for materialehåndtering.
●Har erfaring med kvalitetssikring og styring af underleverandører.
●Lægger vægt på ordentlighed, passer dit arbejde og holder dine aftaler.
●Har lyst til at bidrage til udvikling og optimering af byggeprocesserne.

hvorfor JYTAS?

JYTAS tilbyder en spændende og ansvarsfuld stilling med rig mulighed for både personlig og faglig udvikling. Kandidaten vil blive en del af en fleksibel arbejdsplads med et uhøjtideligt arbejdsmiljø, gode kolleger og sociale arrangementer.

Virksomheden har en stærk samarbejdskultur baseret på tæt tværfagligt samarbejde på tværs af afdelingerne hvor al produktion, el, VVS og lignende foregår internt. JYTAS har en flad ledelsesstruktur, hvor ansvar uddelegeres til den enkelte medarbejder.

Arbejdsmiljøet hos JYTAS er åbent og indbydende, med gode muligheder for sparring. Jobbet rummer frihed under ansvar og stor fleksibilitet i opgaveløsningen. JYTAS vægter en stærk teamånd, gensidig respekt og en venlig omgangstone. Virksomhedens kultur er præget af socialt sammenhold, hvor man laver ting sammen i teamet.

om JYTAS?

JYTAS er en af Danmarks ældste byggevirksomheder med rødder tilbage til 1910. Virksomheden specialiserer sig i præfabrikeret modulbyggeri og leverer fleksible kvalitetsbyggerier til både private og offentlige kunder i hele landet.

Modulerne produceres i egne haller i Galten og færdiggøres op til 80 %, hvilket sikrer hurtig levering og minimalt byggerod på leveringsadressen. JYTAS varetager hele processen fra de indledende tegninger til den endelige montage og råder over egne afdelinger inden for både el og VVS.

ansøg nu

Kan du se dig selv i rollen som el-teknisk formand hos JYTAS, så send os din ansøgning. Randstad varetager denne rekrutteringsproces på vegne af JYTAS.

Vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte konsulent Thomas Krogfelt på +45 24 94 11 06. Alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt, og vi kalder løbende til samtale.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

om randstad

Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle uanset baggrund og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.

Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.

Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group. Vi formidler dagligt arbejde til over 600.000 mennesker verden over og er førende inden for rekruttering, karriererådgivning og fleksibel arbejdskraft i Danmark, med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.

title: AI & Management Consulting Intern (Value Engineering - DACH Market)
description:
Celonis is the global leader in Process Intelligence and the pioneer of Process Mining technology. As one of the world’s fastest-growing enterprise SaaS companies, we are changemakers pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. We invest heavily in advanced AI capabilities—specifically our Process Intelligence Graph—to turn data insights into immediate business action. We believe there is a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by placing intelligence at the core of every business process. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

As an Intern in AI & Management Consulting you join our Value Engineering team to focus on driving and closing opportunities by identifying and selling the value Celonis can bring to customers. Our Value Engineers (VE) are the trusted advisor for customers and work on the intersection of technology and business. Value Engineers partner with sales and customers to create compelling solutions to critical business problems. A great VE understands the customer, the technology, and the sales cycle making it what may be the most interesting, challenging, and fulfilling role in enterprise technology sales.

The Role:

Value Engineers are the trusted advisors for our prospects and customers and leverage product expertise and business acumen to solve our prospects’ and customers’ most pressing challenges. You will gain experience in executing proof of value projects and take part in technical discussions with stakeholders. By creating customer-based business cases, you support the strategic business development activities for the DACH market.

The work you’ll do:

  • Analyze data from our customers to increase transparency in business processes
  • Understand the pain points of our customers and translate them into actionable use cases in the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform
  • Collaborate with customers and partners to uncover their core business challenges and determine how Celonis Process Intelligence can help them achieve their business objectives
  • Quantify financial impact of use cases implemented in the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform and prepare management ready presentations
  • Present findings together with your team in front of customers’ C-level and decision makers
  • Leverage Celonis data modeling and AI capabilities to uncover process inefficiencies, generate insights, and deliver high impact, data driven value propositions to clients.
  • Pitch the Celonis AI value proposition and vision to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy
  • Build strong relationships with our customers by winning their trust through technical, product expertise, and business acumen

The qualifications you need:

  • Student of Business Informatics / Management & Technology / Industrial Engineering/ Computer Science/ Economics / Mathematics or of a comparable program
  • Strong communicational skills and interest in interacting with potential customers
  • Confidence to present to C-level executives and larger audiences
  • Have a passion for technology, data, OpenAI and LLMs and the impact it can have on the world
  • Experience in consulting and highly interested in Data Analytics & Applied AI
  • Knowledge in SQL and Python or related database query languages (completion of Celonis "Rising Star" modules would be a plus)
  • Analytical mindset and the ability to multi-task, prioritize and execute
  • Effective communicator and business fluent in German and English
  • Full-time availability for at least five months starting from October/ November 2026

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.
