title: National Consultancy:  Professional Graphic Designer - ASRO
description:
TERMS OF REFERENCE (to be completed by Hiring Office)
Hiring Office:

UNFPA Arab States Regional Office (ASRO) — Communications Unit

Purpose of consultancy:

The UNFPA Arab States Regional Office (ASRO) frequently produces digital and print publications requiring fast, high-quality, and brand-compliant visual design. The purpose of this consultancy is to establish non-binding Framework Agreements (Individual Retainer Contracts) with pre-vetted freelance graphic designers to provide high-quality graphic design, visual layout, and Desktop Publishing (DTP) services on an on-demand, as-needed basis across the Arab region. Engagement under this retainer framework enables the office to execute work orders via standardized design briefs without initiating new procurement cycles for individual assignments.

Scope of work:

(Description of services, activities, or outputs)

When activated via an individual design brief, the retainer holder shall provide high-quality graphic design and layout services. The scope of work encompasses:

  • Visual identity and brand alignment: Ensuring all creative assets flawlessly follow the UNFPA branding toolkit guidelines.
  • Layout and creative concept development: Submitting three distinct initial cover and layout concept options for review based on the provided design brief.
  • Iterative proof corrections: Executing progressive sub-rounds of text and design corrections in coordination with the communications and technical units until full layout integrity is achieved.
  • Structuring and adjusting layouts to account for multilingual requirements: Ensuring correct right-to-left (RTL) formatting logic for Arabic text, and left-to-right (LTR) formatting logic for English and French text, including proper text-flow adjustments across bilingual or trilingual layouts.
  • Digital accessibility compliance: Designing all digital products to meet international accessibility standards for persons with disabilities (WCAG 2.1 mapping). This includes embedding proper alternative text (alt-text) tags for images, charts, and maps provided by the technical unit, defining a logical document reading order for screen readers, ensuring high color contrast thresholds, and formatting tagged structural headings within the final PDF asset.
  • Sustainable design practices: In line with UN green mandates, prioritizing digital-first, screen-optimized products. If physical printing is requested, files must be structurally optimized for local, recycled-paper printing contexts.

Strict prohibition on raw AI asset generation and automated layouts

The utilization of unedited artificial intelligence image generators, automated layout software, or raw machine-generated design elements (e.g., Midjourney, DALL-E, automated Canva layouts, or generic AI vector wrappers) to execute the required graphic design interventions is strictly prohibited. While professional layout software utilities, digital drawing applications, and standard design tools are necessary for technical and mechanical precision, the final output must completely reflect human analytical judgment, custom visual harmonization, and creative design polish. Submissions that display a reliance on generic templates, robotic visual generation loops, or superficial machine adjustments will be rejected as non-responsive, and final vendor payment will be frozen.
Duration and working schedule:

Duration:

Initial duration of 11 months from the date of contract signature. Subject to satisfactory performance assessments and ongoing operational needs, contracts may be considered for renewal following a mandatory one-month break in service in full compliance with UNFPA consultancy policy.

Schedule:

On-demand retainer basis (as-needed). Turnaround parameters, deadlines, and page counts will be negotiated case-by-case upon issuance of each design brief.
Place where services are to be delivered:

Remotely
Delivery dates and how work will be delivered (e.g. electronic, hard copy etc.):

Work deliverables will be delivered electronically according to the negotiated project schedules in the individual design briefs. Turnaround parameters, deadlines, and total page counts will be negotiated case-by-case at the time of the specific design brief issuance.

Upon completion of each work order, the consultant must submit a complete asset package including:

  1. Pre-press printable files: High-resolution, print-ready PDFs with crop marks and bleeds.
  2. Digital-optimized files: Low-resolution, interactive web-ready PDFs (with hyperlinked tables of contents and URLs) and standalone social media graphics if requested.
  3. Open source working files: Complete packaged source files (e.g., Adobe InDesign .indd, Illustrator .ai, Photoshop .psd) including all linked high-resolution imagery and vector assets.

All layout and design work executed under this retainer framework must strictly comply with:

  • The UNFPA Global Branding Toolkit (corporate typography, color palettes, logo placement rules, and grid structures). The full toolkit is accessible via this Link: http://unf.pa/brand using this Password: Guidelines2025_Live!
  • The UNFPA Global Brand examples.
Monitoring and progress control, including reporting requirements, periodicity format and deadline:

Day-to-day art direction:

The consultant will work under the direct day-to-day creative supervision of the Communications Unit to ensure design quality control.

Substantive review, and final approval ownership:

The respective Technical Requesting Unit remains responsible for content accuracy, proofreading text inside the proofs, and granting the final written sign-off and approval on both the final text and design layout before public distribution or printing.

Performance evaluation and quality assessment:

Upon completion of each work order, the Communications Unit, and the Requesting Technical Unit, will conduct a formal performance assessment of the deliverables (evaluating criteria such as design quality, visual creativity, brand compliance, speed/adherence to deadlines, and communication responsiveness). Satisfactory evaluation scores are required to process payment clearances and maintain roster eligibility. In cases of repeated poor performance, failure to adhere to branding guidelines, or unsatisfactory layout quality, UNFPA reserves the right to issue a formal warning or immediately terminate the retainer contract without obligation for future work order activations.
Supervisory arrangements:

The Communications Unit, led by Samir Aldarabi, Regional Communications Adviser, will serve as the technical gatekeeper and managing authority for this retainer contract.
Expected travel:

None. (100% remote assignment).

Required expertise, qualifications and competencies, including language requirements:

Educational requirements:

  • A First-level university degree (Bachelor’s degree) in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communications, Digital Media, or a related field.
  • A relevant technical diploma or secondary education combined with two (2) additional years of qualifying professional experience may be accepted in lieu of a university degree.

Years of experience:

  • A minimum of two years of progressively responsible professional experience in graphic design, publication layout, Desktop Publishing (DTP), and corporate brand management.
  • Demonstrated track record producing high-level publications (e.g., annual reports, complex policy briefs, data-dense infographics, and social media visibility asset packs).

Technical competencies & software proficiency:

  • Expert mastery of industry-standard professional software (Adobe Creative Cloud: InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat Pro).
  • Demonstrated experience in native InDesign file packaging, master page configuration, layer management, and layout grid setup.
  • Proven technical proficiency in formatting right-to-left (RTL) Arabic typography and left-to-right (LTR) English/French typography.
  • Strong technical familiarity with WCAG 2.1 digital accessibility tagging and screen-reader optimization within PDF publications.

Language requirements:

  • Fluency (written and spoken) in English and Arabic is required. Working knowledge of French is an asset.
Inputs / services to be provided by UNFPA or implementing partner (e.g support services, office space, equipment), if applicable:

The Communications Unit and Technical Requesting Unit will make available:

  • The final copyedited, proofread narrative text file in an editable format (MS Word).
  • All mandatory institutional reference links (UNFPA global branding toolkit, corporate templates, and photo libraries).
  • The design brief, including specific dimensions, layout constraints, or presentation goals required for the final product.
  • The exact, approved text for all mandatory legal disclaimers, funding acknowledgments, or institutional notices.
Other relevant information or special conditions, if any:

We require the retainer holder to provide:

  • An assigned, responsive point of contact or rapid communication workflow to coordinate assignments.
  • A clear, structured execution timeline ensuring full adherence to the negotiated design milestones.
  • The complete, multi-asset deliverable package as defined under the specific activities section below.

Payment safeguard:

  • Final consultant payment against an activated Purchase Order (PO) will remain frozen until both the Communications Unit and the technical requesting unit issue a joint technical clearance confirming all assets have been satisfactorily received.

Selection and awarding of retainer contracts:

Because this process aims to select qualified freelance designers for individual retainer contracts, candidates will be evaluated on a Pass/Fail baseline of portfolio quality and technical compliance, with contract awards and task matching dictated by the most competitive financial rates provided. Candidates will be evaluated covering:

  • Technical portfolio check
  • Submission of a professional-level portfolio demonstrating advanced creative design capability.
  • Submission of a professional portfolio showcasing corporate layout design (reports, policy briefs, infographics).
  • Demonstrated experience in typography hierarchy, grid layouts, and accessible digital documents.
  • Result: Pass/fail

  • Multilingual and tool proficiency
  • Mastery of industry-standard software (Adobe Creative Suite: InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop). Candidates must provide one sample packaged native file (InDesign package) or an IDML file accompanied by a PDF showing the hidden layout grid and structural characters to verify professional grid alignment, master page configuration, and clean layer management.
  • Proven capability in formatting right-to-left (RTL) Arabic layouts and left-to-right (LTR) English/French layouts.
  • Result: Pass/fail

  • Financial rate sheet (per-page/product retainer basis)
  • Bidders must submit fixed, standard rates using the financial matrix below. Oncoming work orders will be matched primarily to the lowest-priced available roster member for that product type.

Required financial rate matrix

Bidders must outline their flat rates based on the following standard office products. Hourly rates or raw Word-document page counts will not be accepted. All page billing is calculated based on final designed publication pages:

Product type Unit

Proposed retainer rate

EGP
Standard report layout (Text, images and basic tables) Per final designed page
Highly complex document (Dense data layout with multiple tables, charts, and custom infographics) Per final designed page
Complex policy brief (High infographic density) Per final designed page
Brochure / leaflet / visibility asset Flat rate per product
Social media asset pack (Set of 4 static cards/covers) Flat rate per pack
Animated GIF / short motion graphic (Up to 15 seconds) Flat rate per product
Social media reel / video edit (Up to 60 seconds with subtitles) Flat rate per product

Submission instructions

Interested freelance designers must submit:

  • A written application containing their CV.
  • A link to their creative portfolio.
  • Their completed Financial Rate Sheet.

title: Inspection & Maintenance Engineer
description:
Please note that this is not an active vacancy at this time. However, we are always interested in hearing from talented individuals who share our values and may be a good fit for future opportunities. By submitting your details, you are expressing an interest in being considered for roles that may arise in the future. When a suitable opportunity becomes available, we will review your application and contact you if your skills and experience match our requirements.


At KOMPAN, our Aftersales department delivers high-quality on-site inspections, repairs, full refurbishments, and maintenance across playground equipment from all manufacturers — including those no longer in operation.

This is a great opportunity to be part of a well-established business, supporting an expanding client base with ongoing inspection and maintenance services.

The Role

As an Inspection & Maintenance Engineer, you will:

  • Carry out operational inspections and repairs

  • Regularly visit our central storage facilities to collect and replenish parts

  • Ensure all inspections comply with BS EN 1176 standards

  • Use the Play Inspection Company app (or similar software) to document findings

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Completing operational inspections and risk assessments

  • Capturing accurate information for repair quotations (measurements, quantities, photographs, manufacturer details)

  • Planning inspections efficiently, taking into account weather, traffic, and local conditions

  • Contacting customers to confirm inspection dates and times

  • Maintaining effective communication with the office team

  • Identifying opportunities for larger repair and refurbishment works

  • Carrying out minor corrective repairs where required

  • Ensuring all work is completed to a high standard

In addition, you will:

  • Manage vehicle stock and request replenishment as needed

  • Conduct stock checks when required

  • Maintain tools, equipment, and PPE in good condition

  • Contribute ideas to improve efficiency

  • Support and train colleagues where needed

  • Comply with company policies, including vehicle care and code of conduct

  • Work safely at all times and use appropriate PPE

Your Profile

We are looking for a practical, customer-focused individual who can work independently and take ownership of their workload.

Experience & Qualifications:

  • Experience in construction, maintenance, or service engineering

  • Practical skills such as woodworking, surface repair, painting, and mechanical repairs

  • Strong customer service and communication skills

  • Basic IT skills, including Microsoft Office

  • Full, clean UK driving licence

  • RPII Operational Inspection qualification (or willingness to obtain)

  • Ability to travel daily

  • Willingness to undergo an Enhanced DBS check

Personal Skills:

  • Self-motivated with the ability to work on your own initiative

  • Strong organisational and planning skills

  • High attention to detail and accuracy

  • Able to manage multiple tasks effectively

  • Proactive problem-solver with a positive, ‘can-do’ attitude

  • Team player with good collaboration skills

  • Quick to learn and adaptable

  • Committed to delivering excellent customer service

KOMPAN - Who are we?

KOMPAN is a global leader in outdoor play and fitness solutions. We design, produce, and install over 1,000 playgrounds and fitness areas every month across 94 countries. Our HQ is based in Odense, Denmark, with manufacturing site in Czech Republic and sales offices worldwide. Read more

What’s our culture like?

We combine professionalism with playfulness. Our teams work across functions and cultures, valuing diversity, creativity, and results.

Why should you work with us?

At KOMPAN we make a real impact - creating healthier, happier communities through play and movement and have done this since 1970. You'll grow your career while changing lives worldwide. This is a very strong purpose to be part of.

How to apply?

Please apply via our website. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and you can expect to hear from us once we have selected candidates to proceed to a first interview. You will, of course, hear from us regardless of whether you proceed in the process or not.

Here's a good tip!

If you don’t see an open position that matches your competencies and interests, we encourage you to connect with us. Once registered, your profile will automatically be matched with future openings and you’ll receive an invitation to apply when a good match is found.

We regularly post new job openings on our website. If you're interested in other opportunities with us, be sure to check back often. Let’s Play!

KOMPAN is an equal opportunity employer and encourages all to apply.

title: Butikssäljare 10%, Stadium Outlet Barkarby
description:
Vill du jobba i ett team med engagerade kollegor, fyllt med energi? Ser du dig själv som driven, serviceinriktad och flexibel? Toppen, då kanske du är vår nästa stjärnspelare! Vi söker en butikssäljare till vårt lag.

Stadium Outlet vill göra sport och sportmode tillgängligt för alla. För att lyckas med vårt uppdrag måste alla våra medarbetare har roligt på jobbet och drivas av samma sak som oss: att aktivera världen – vad är din drivkraft? Läs mer om våra drivkrafter på vår karriärsida.

Vad innebär det att vara butikssäljare?
Våra kunder ska känna sig välkomna hos oss, de ska bli inbjudna till en kundupplevelse i hela butiken. En upplevelse som kännetecknas av service i världsklass. Vem är du?
Vi tror att du delar vår inställning och övertygelse när det gäller att se varje utmaning som en möjlighet. Du trivs med att ha mycket ansvar och vill växa och utvecklas i rollen som butikssäljare. För att jobba på Stadium måste du ha fyllt 18 år. Butikserfarenhet är ett plus.

Vad erbjuder vi dig?
Läs mer om vårt lag på vår Karriärsida, på Instagram WorkatStadium eller på Linkedin.

Klicka på länken här för att komma till våra poddavsnitt och på 15 min få en inblick i hur det är att jobba på Stadium.

Eftersom vi alltid vill göra saker så enkelt som möjligt är det inte säkert att vi väntar till sista ansökningsdag innan vi går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen. Så vänta inte, sök redan nu.

Välkommen med din ansökan. Come join the movement!

title: Fullstack Engineer (AI, Distributed Systems, Automation)
description:
At Web Impact, we’re more than just an email marketing agency and digital solutions provider. We build cutting-edge, socially impactful products that redefine how businesses operate in the digital world.

We’re looking for a Fullstack Engineer who enjoys building complex systems, integrating external services, and leveraging AI tools to speed up development and automate workflows.

If you’re excited about combining modern frontend development with AI-driven workflows and automation tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and LLM frameworks, this one is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and contribute to end-to-end features across SaaS products and internal tools, collaborating with senior engineers on architecture and implementation decisions.

  • Build modern, high-performance frontends using Next.js and React.js

  • Develop scalable backend services using Node.js / NestJS

  • Design and integrate APIs (REST, WebSockets, external services)

  • Build and maintain automation workflows and background jobs

  • Work with async systems, queues, and event-driven architectures

  • Integrate third-party services with real-world constraints (rate limits, retries, auth flows)

  • Use AI tools to improve development speed, testing, and automation

  • Collaborate directly with product, data, and leadership teams

  • Build MVPs, proof-of-concepts, and new product ideas from scratch

  • Rapidly validate business ideas through experimentation and iteration

  • Help evolve successful prototypes into production-ready systems

AI & Automation

This role includes working with modern AI tooling and automation systems, with a strong focus on speed, ownership, and execution:

  • Using tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenAI SDK in daily development

  • Building AI-driven workflows and integrations quickly and iteratively

  • Automating repetitive processes (data handling, content, integrations)

  • Applying LLMs in production with a pragmatic, results-first approach

  • Taking ownership of problems - from idea to production

  • Shipping fast, testing in real conditions, and iterating based on outcomes

  • Being accountable for delivery - not just writing code, but making things work end-to-end

  • Prioritizing execution over perfection - speed is key

What We’re Looking For

  • 2,5+ years of professional full-stack experience

  • Strong frontend skills in React.js / Next.js

  • Backend experience with Node.js (NestJS preferred)

  • Experience integrating external APIs (auth, pagination, retries, rate limits)

  • Hands-on experience with modern AI tools (OpenAI, Claude, Cursor, etc.)

  • Good SQL skills (PostgreSQL preferred)

  • Experience working with async processing, queues, and background jobs

  • Understanding of building reliable systems (error handling, retries, observability)

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally

  • Fluent in English and Polish

title: Administration Officer
description:
WHAT IS ON OFFER

Alfred H Knight has an exciting opportunity through its Indonesia entity, PT AHK Testing Indonesia, who is looking for an Administration Officer to join our team based in Jakarta. PT AHK Testing Indonesia provides independent analysis and inspection services to the metals, minerals and solid fuels industries. We have a well-earned reputation for our knowledge and professionalism in all aspects of weighing, sampling and analysis.


As an Administration Officer you are responsible for providing excellent customer service to our clients and overseas offices, verbally and electronically. Within the administration team, you will handle all client inquiries and communicate with clients in a professional, accurate and efficient manner. It is essential that you have excellent time management skills, administration experience and client relationship-building capability in order to be successful. The ability to identify and solve problems is vital, as well as being able to work independently and prioritize tasks



ABOUT US

Alfred H Knight is a totally independent, family owned business spanning five generations. A global network of strategically placed offices and laboratories enable global trade by providing independent inspection, analysis and consultancy services to the metals and minerals, solid fuels and agriculture industries.


We have honed & carefully crafted our reputation. Delivering knowledge and professionalism in all aspects of weighing, sampling and analysis. We thrive by continuing to re-invest in our facilities, technology and people. Click here to find out more about AHK.


DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES?


To be successful at Alfred H Knight you will need to display the following:



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Serve as the point of contact for client inquiries and correspondence, requests, and concerns.

  • Proactive contribution to the continued achievement of departmental KPI’s and SLA’s

  • Use Dashboard to manage workload, maintain transparency in order to ensure accuracy and timely delivery of data and achievement of KPI’s.
  • Assist the Supervisor and Head of Administration and Client Coordinator as needed.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE AND WORK EXPERIENCE



Required Knowledge, Skills and Behaviours


  • Fluent in Bahasa Indonesia and English, with proficiency in other languages being a plus.
  • Excellent client liaison skills, with the ability to develop and maintain strong client relationships.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to communicate professionally at all levels.

  • Understanding of service quality principles and commitment to delivering high-quality results.
  • Excellent organization skills with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office programs, with the ability to prepare management information and reports.
  • Strong communication and coordination skills to collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to work well under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Sincere, honest, loyal, passionate about learning new knowledge, disciplined, and accurate in work.


Required Work Experience


  • Having a minimum 1 (one) year experience in administration for the energy and metals minerals sector is a plus.
  • Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.


Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree in any major. This requirement may be substituted for experience on a year for year basis.


Required Languages


  • Bahasa Indonesia

BENEFITS


We are offering an excellent opportunity with a salary and benefits package to match including pension, life assurance and an employee assistance programme.

title: Butikschef till Puuilo - bli med och driv vår etablering i Sundsvall
company: Retail Recruitment - Rekrytering chefer/specialister inom Retail/E-commerce/FMCG
description:
Vill du vara med och bygga upp någonting helt nytt från grunden? Har du ett starkt kommersiellt driv, fötterna stadigt på butiksgolvet och ett ledarskap som får medarbetare och försäljning att växa? Då kan du vara Puuilos nästa Butikschef! Puuilo är en av Finlands mest framgångsrika lågpriskedjor och nu tar vi klivet in på den svenska marknaden. Vårt koncept är enkelt: ett brett sortiment, låga priser och allt samlat under ett tak. Vi gör det enkelt för kunden att hitta det som behövs, när det behövs. Nu söker vi en trygg och operativ Butikschef som vill leda vår etablering och bygga upp ett engagerat team i Sundsvall. Rollen som Butikschef Som Butikschef hos oss har du det övergripande drift-, personal- och resultatansvaret för ett varuhus på cirka 3 000 kvadratmeter och ett sortiment på över 30 000 artiklar. Du leder ett team på cirka 15–20 medarbetare och rapporterar direkt till vår svenska driftchef. Rollen är både operativ och administrativ. Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats är ute på butiksgolvet tillsammans med ditt team – det är där vi möter kunderna, driver försäljningen och bygger vår kultur. Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden:
  • Uppföljning av försäljning och nyckeltal (KPI:er) samt utveckling av butikens lönsamhet.
  • Rekrytering, introduktion, schemaplanering och coachning av teamet.
  • Planering och ledning av den dagliga driften så att varje teammedlem känner sig motiverad och engagerad i att göra sitt bästa.
  • Att skapa en öppen och interaktiv feedbackkultur där vi uppmärksammar framgångar, ger kontinuerlig feedback och utvecklas tillsammans.
  • Att aktivt delta i det praktiska butiksarbetet – hos oss leder du från golvet och är redo att använda radiokommunikation, köra truck och hjälpa till med montering av släpvagnar.
Vad erbjuder Puuilo dig?
  • Ett mångsidigt och ansvarsfullt uppdrag: I denna roll har du möjlighet att använda och utveckla din kompetens brett.
  • Möjligheter i ett företag i tillväxt: Hos oss blir du en del av ett framgångsrikt och snabbt växande företag, där du genom ditt arbete kan påverka företagets utveckling och tillväxt.
  • En omfattande introduktion: Du får en grundlig introduktion till ditt uppdrag för att kunna starta med en stabil grund. Vi satsar på att du ska känna dig välkommen och få vårt stöd i dina nya utmaningar.
  • Professionell coachning och utbildningsmöjligheter: Vi satsar på våra medarbetares professionella utveckling genom olika utbildningsmöjligheter. Dessutom coachar vi våra chefer regelbundet för att ge dem bästa möjliga verktyg för att leda sina team till framgång.
  • Möjlighet att avancera till mer krävande roller: Du har en betydelsefull roll i vår organisation och vi vill stötta din karriär genom att erbjuda mångsidiga möjligheter att avancera till mer ansvarsfulla uppgifter.
  • En av våra viktigaste värderingar är GLÄDJE: Hos oss blir du en del av en positiv och uppmuntrande arbetsmiljö där alla känner sig uppskattade.
Vad förväntar vi oss av dig?
  • Erfarenhet av chefsarbete inom handelsbranschen. Du förstår handelns verksamhetsmiljö och har förmåga att leda ditt team framgångsrikt mot gemensamma mål.
  • Stark kommersiell förståelse Du har ett gott affärssinne och förmåga att fatta beslut som stöder verksamhetens tillväxt och lönsamhet.
  • Vilja att utvecklas i din roll och som chef Du är motiverad att lära dig nytt och vill kontinuerligt utvecklas som ledare. Du stöttar även ditt team i deras utveckling och hjälper dem att nå sina mål.
  • Ett modernt och coachande ledarskap Du tror på ett coachande ledarskap och kan hjälpa ditt team till bästa möjliga prestationer. Du skapar en öppen och uppmuntrande arbetsmiljö där alla har möjlighet att lyckas.
  • Förmåga att leda i en föränderlig verksamhetsmiljö Du är anpassningsbar och kan leda ditt team effektivt även mitt i förändringar som är typiska för ett tillväxtbolag. Du ser förändringar som möjligheter och leder teamet mot gemensamma mål.
  • Erfarenhet av schemaplanering och kunskap om kollektivavtal Du förstår hur schemaplanering bidrar till en smidig och effektiv verksamhet och hur resurser används rättvist och jämlikt i butiken.
Våra butiker präglas av högt tempo och radiokommunikation – en självklar del av Puuilos unika kultur. Hos oss är du redo att köra truck och hjälpa till med montering av släpvagnar. Arbetet kräver flexibilitet, engagemang och förmåga att leda i ett snabbt tempo och en föränderlig tillväxtmiljö. Ansökan och process I denna rekrytering samarbetar Puuilo med Retail Recruitment. Skicka in din ansökan via länken så snart som möjligt då urval sker löpande. Din ansökan ska innehålla:
  • Ett CV
  • En fritt formulerad ansökan/personligt brev
  • En frivillig videopresentation (om du vill sälja in dig själv lite extra!)
För ytterligare information om rollen eller processen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Malin Niklasson på Retail Recruitment. Välkommen med din ansökan – bli en del av Puuilos framgångssaga i Sverige! Puuilo är en ledande finsk detaljhandelskedja känd för sitt breda sortiment, sina låga priser, bra butikslägen och en bekväm shoppingupplevelse. Med ett särskilt fokus på hantverk, hushållstillbehör och djurfoder samt mer än 50 butiker och e-handel i Finland, är Puuilo en av Finlands största och mest framgångsrika butikskedjor inom konsumtionsvaror. Nu tar Puuilo sitt starka koncept vidare och står inför en mycket spännande etablering på den svenska marknaden med målet att bli en ledande aktör även i Sverige. Läs mer om Puuilo och vår resa på https://www.investors.puuilo.fi/en/about_us/in_brief

Som grävmaskinförare kommer du att ha en viktig roll i våra projekt och arbeta med varierande uppgifter inom mark och anläggning. Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat:

Grävarbeten med band- och hjulgrävare

Schaktning, finplanering och markförberedelser

Arbete med 3D-mätsystem för hög precision

Dränerings- och anläggningsarbeten

Daglig tillsyn och enklare underhåll av maskiner

Arbetet sker både självständigt och i nära samarbete med kollegor och arbetsledning ute på olika projekt.

Vi söker dig som

Har 2–4 års erfarenhet som grävmaskinförare eller inom mark- och anläggningsarbete

Innehar B-körkort

Har certifikat för Arbete på väg 1 och 2

Har goda kunskaper i svenska eller engelska

Är noggrann, ansvarstagande och lösningsorienterad

Trivs med att arbeta utomhus och i ett högt arbetstempo

Har god samarbetsförmåga och en positiv inställning

Meriterande:

Erfarenhet av arbete med 3D-mätsystem

Ytterligare maskinbehörigheter eller certifikat

Erfarenhet av service och underhåll av entreprenadmaskiner

Vi erbjuder

En trygg anställning i ett växande företag

Arbete med moderna maskiner och spännande projekt

Varierande arbetsdagar i en dynamisk arbetsmiljö

Ett professionellt och sammansvetsat team

Goda möjligheter till långsiktig utveckling inom företaget

Varför välja oss?

Vi tror på kvalitet, engagemang och långsiktiga relationer – både med våra kunder och medarbetare. Hos oss får du arbeta i en organisation där din kompetens värdesätts och där du får möjlighet att vara med och bygga framtidens infrastruktur och utemiljöer.

Ansökan

Låter detta som nästa steg i din karriär? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Senior Engineer, OT
description:
Job Summary

The Senior Engineer, OT - Commissioning is responsible for the planning, coordination, and execution of commissioning activities for OT systems. This role ensures that all systems and components are designed, installed, tested, operated, and maintained according to the operational requirements of the client or final user. The role also includes providing technical support within the Section, with a specific focus on network and cybersecurity aspects, including compliance with IEC 62443 standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Commissioning Leadership:

  • Lead the development and implementation of commissioning plans, procedures, and schedules.

  • Coordinate with project managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment with project timelines and objectives.

  • Oversee and guide junior commissioning engineers and technicians.

  • Manage a team of technicians, providing direction, support, and performance feedback.

  • Ensure that all commissioning activities are completed on time as per project and commissioning plan.

    • Develop and implement strategies to improve commissioning processes and outcomes.

  • System Testing and Validation:

  • Conduct and supervise pre-commissioning and commissioning tests on OT systems, including hardware and software components.

  • Validate system performance against design specifications and operational requirements.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues identified during testing phases.

  • Develop and execute test plans, procedures, and protocols for system validation.

  • Ensure that all test equipment and tools are calibrated and maintained.

    • Document and report test results, including any deviations from expected performance.

  • Network and Cybersecurity:

  • Ensure the secure integration of OT systems with IT networks.

  • Conduct network configuration, testing, and validation to ensure robust and secure communication between devices.

  • Implement and verify cybersecurity measures to protect OT systems from potential threats.

  • Ensure compliance with IEC 62443 standards for industrial automation and control systems security.

    • Stay updated with the latest cybersecurity trends and best practices to ensure the protection of OT infrastructure.

  • Documentation and Reporting:

  • Prepare and review detailed commissioning reports, including test results, deviations, and corrective actions.

  • Maintain accurate records of commissioning activities and ensure documentation is up to date.

  • Ensure all documentation meets industry standards and client requirements.

  • Develop and maintain commissioning checklists, logs, and other documentation tools.

  • Provide regular status updates and reports to project stakeholders.

    • Ensure that all documentation is stored and managed in accordance with company policies and procedures.

  • Engineering and Commissioning Integration:

  • Start from the engineering phase to work with the commissioning team.

  • Provide required input and review commissioning procedures for systems and subsystems related to automation, network, and cybersecurity.

  • Ensure that engineering designs are aligned with commissioning requirements and operational goals.

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to identify and address potential design issues.

  • Review and provide comments on engineering drawings, specifications, and other documentation.

    • Ensure that all engineering and commissioning activities are coordinated and integrated.

  • Training and Support:

  • Provide cybersecurity training and necessary support to MODEC, suppliers, end-users, and maintenance personnel on board during the commissioning phase until the handover of OT systems.

  • Offer technical support during the handover phase and post-commissioning period.

  • Provide ongoing technical support and troubleshooting assistance to end-users.

    • Ensure that all training and support activities are documented and tracked.

  • Team Management:

  • Manage a team of technicians, ensuring effective collaboration and communication.

  • Provide functional reporting and work closely with the commissioning team to achieve project goals.

    • Foster a positive and collaborative team environment.

  • Compliance and Safety:

  • Ensure all commissioning activities comply with industry standards, safety regulations, and company policies.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement mitigation strategies to ensure safe commissioning processes.

  • Promote a culture of safety and compliance within the team.

  • Develop and implement safety plans and procedures for commissioning activities.

  • Conduct regular safety audits and inspections to identify and address potential hazards.

    • Provide safety training and guidance to team members and other stakeholders.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Computer Science, or a related field. A Master’s degree is a plus.

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in commissioning, preferably within the Operational Technology or Industrial Automation sectors.

  • Proven experience with OT systems, including SCADA, PLCs, DCS, and network infrastructure.

  • Demonstrated leadership experience in managing commissioning projects and teams.

  • Experience in network configuration and cybersecurity for OT systems.

  • Familiarity with IEC 62443 standards and their application in industrial environments.

title: Familjehemssekreterare
description:
Vårgårda kommun – här lyckas vi tillsammans!

Välkommen till Vårgårda kommun och en arbetsplats där du får utvecklas och göra skillnad varje dag. Med respektfullt bemötande och hög tillgänglighet gör vi allt för att leverera välfärdstjänster som överträffar invånarnas förväntningar. Med utgångspunkt i vår vision, vår gemensamma värdegrund och tydliga politiska mål bygger vi för stark tillväxt och ett attraktivt arbetsgivarvarumärke.

I Vårgårda kommun arbetar vi tillsammans med fokus på verksamhetens syfte och invånarnas behov. Vi vill vara en plats där drömmar kan bli verklighet, där trygghet och aktivitet går hand i hand och där alla kan känna sig hemma. Tillsammans fortsätter vi att utveckla en kommun där det är gott att leva, bo och verka!

Vi är en gemensam IFO-enhet där barn och unga, vuxen, funktionsstöd och LSS ingår. Enheten leds av två enhetschefer som också är 1:e socialsekreterare för sina respektive områden: barn och unga där familjehemssekreterare, barnsekreterare och kontaktsekreterare ingår och vuxen/funktionsstöd/LSS.

Våra lokaler ligger i kommunhuset centralt i Vårgårda.

Vi söker dig som vill fortsätta det goda sociala arbetet som görs i Vårgårda kommun och bidra till framtidens socialtjänst utifrån nya socialtjänstlagen tillsammans med oss med fokus på dem vi är till för.

Vår familjehemssekreterare som arbetat länge hos oss har nu valt att gå vidare till nya arbetsuppgifter i annan kommun. Hon har lagt en god och stabil grund för det fortsatt viktiga familjehemsarbetet.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Inom verksamheten Barn och unga arbetar familjehemssekreterare, barnsekreterare och kontaktsekreterare i nära samverkan med utredande socialsekreterare för att skapa trygga och hållbara lösningar för barn och familjer.

Som familjehemssekreterare ansvarar du för rekrytering, utredning, handledning och uppföljning av familjehem och kontaktfamiljer. Barnsekreterare och kontaktsekreterare samverkar med dig i vissa delar av arbetet.

I Vårgårda kommun arbetar vi utifrån Signs of Safety i tillämpliga delar utifrån ditt arbetsområde. Vi ser grundprinciperna i Signs of Safety som viktiga där delaktighet, respekt och fokus på dem vi är till för är centrala i arbetet.

De flesta av dina blivande kollegor har erfarenhet av yrket. De är öppna och prestigelösa vilket ger en arbetsplats som präglas av såväl hög kompetens som en god och varm stämning. Det är viktigt för oss att hjälpas åt, stötta varandra och uppehålla ett gott arbete för de barn, ungdomar och familjer vi möter.

En viktig del i arbetet är samverkan både internt och externt. Du har i ditt arbete kontinuerligt och nära stöd av både chef/1:e socialsekreterare och kollegor och deltar regelbundet vid metodmöten. Alla som börjar på enheten får en individuell introduktionsplan och internutbildning i Signs of Safety. Utifrån din erfarenhet och dina intressen förväntas du vara aktiv i vårt löpande utvecklingsarbete och fortsatta arbete med Signs of Safety.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har socionomexamen och ett genuint engagemang för barn och unga. Du är trygg, professionell, relationsskapande och har god samarbetsförmåga. Du har god förmåga att uttrycka dig väl på svenska både i tal och skrift. Vi vill att du har erfarenhet av familjehemsarbete, meriterande är även om du har erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning inom barn och unga och erfarenhet av att arbeta utifrån Signs of Safety.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet:, tillträde: 2026-10-05  .

För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen i Vårgårda kommun samt möjliggöra god kommunikation med våra sökande ber vi dig skicka in din ansökan digitalt och inte via e-post eller pappersformat.

Till vissa av kommunens tjänster krävs det ett utdrag från misstanke- och belastningsregister innan anställning kan ske. Vi kommer därför efterfråga detta av dig som erbjuds anställning hos oss i Vårgårda Kommun. Utdraget får inte vara äldre än 6 månader.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Till bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som säljare: 

Vårgårda kommun har gjort sitt medieval för rekrytering och undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

title: Director Data & AI
description:
About S&S

Sullivan & Stanley is not a traditional consulting firm we're intentionally building something different. We're a company of relationship builders, consultants and entrepreneurs who believe how work gets done matters just as much as what gets delivered. We exist to challenge ineffective change and outdated consulting models, replacing them with approaches that are human, pragmatic and built for the realities of modern organisations.

Culture at S&S is something we take seriously not as a certification, but as a daily practice. We're committed to an environment where people are trusted, supported and encouraged to bring their full selves to work, balancing high standards with humanity, care and accountability.

We're deeply mission-driven. We want to change business for good, so that the next generation — including our founder Pat Lynes' sons, Sullivan and Stanley, who the company is named after inherit organisations that are healthier, fairer and better equipped for the future.

As we grow, we're pioneering a Service-as-a-Software approach to consulting, blending community, capability, technology and delivery at scale. This is a chance to join a firm in its next phase of growth and help shape what consulting becomes next not just participate in what it has been.


Our Values: Stand Connected · Stronger Together · Say it Straight · See it Through · Stay Sharp


About the Role

You are a strategic data and AI leader who thrives in an entrepreneurial, client-facing consulting environment building capability from scratch, shaping architecture and propositions, and partnering with senior leadership and clients to unlock value from data and AI.

You move easily between practice-building and hands-on delivery: one day setting the vision for a market-leading Data & AI practice, the next acting as Lead Enterprise & Data Architect on a strategic client transformation.

Reporting to the Head of Consulting and based in London (UK travel required), the Director of Data & AI will establish and lead Sullivan & Stanley's Data & AI capability, shaping both the consulting practice and the architecture behind our Intelligent Enterprise proposition.

Roughly 60% of your time goes to high-value client engagements and executive advisory as Lead Enterprise & Data Architect; the rest to growing the practice, developing propositions, supporting business development, and creating IP.

Responsibilities

Practice Leadership

  • Set the vision, strategy and operating model for the Data & AI practice, including governance, budgeting and commercial framework
  • Build market-leading propositions across Data Strategy, Architecture, Governance, AI Enablement and Intelligent Enterprise transformation
  • Own capability growth: recruitment, mentoring, career pathways and competency frameworks
  • Develop reusable methodologies and accelerators; partner with Sales and Client Partners on pipeline and strategic wins

Data & AI Architecture Leadership

  • Define reference architectures and principles aligning Human, AI, Technology and Execution Intelligence
  • Set best practice for data governance, metadata, information architecture and quality
  • Develop AI operating models and Responsible AI frameworks
  • Shape MissionHub's architectural direction and evaluate emerging technologies for the firm's propositions

Strategic Client Leadership

  • Act as trusted advisor to CEOs, CIOs, CDOs, CTOs and Transformation Directors
  • Lead as Lead Enterprise & Data Architect on complex transformation programmes
  • Design target operating models for Intelligent Enterprise transformation
  • Provide executive assurance and technical governance; build long-term client relationships

Practice Growth & Thought Leadership

  • Publish thought leadership on the Intelligent Enterprise proposition
  • Represent Sullivan & Stanley at industry events and roundtables
  • Build strategic partnerships and reusable consulting/maturity frameworks

Leadership Responsibilities

  • Build a high-performing consulting culture and develop future leaders
  • Champion delivery excellence and cross-discipline collaboration
  • Contribute to company strategy as part of the senior leadership team



Accountabilities Accountable for: a profitable, market-leading Data & AI practice; robust architecture and governance across engagements; delivery excellence on complex programmes; team recruitment and retention; collaboration with Sales and leadership; and the firm's external profile in Data & AI.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience: Extensive experience leading enterprise data strategy, architecture or consulting functions, with a demonstrable track record building consulting capabilities or practices
  • Architecture & Governance: Deep expertise in enterprise data architecture, governance and operating model design, with a strong understanding of AI architecture, data platforms and emerging technologies
  • Transformation Leadership: Experience leading complex transformation programmes, with exceptional executive stakeholder management skills
  • Commercial Acumen: Commercial awareness with experience supporting business development and proposal creation

Desirable: Experience developing AI-enabled consulting propositions and working within high-growth consulting organisations; knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and modern cloud ecosystems; experience across Financial Services, Insurance or other regulated industries; professional certifications in architecture, data management or cloud technologies.

Success Measures

Commercial Success

  • Establish a profitable and sustainable Data & AI practice
  • Deliver agreed revenue, utilisation and profitability targets
  • Build a healthy sales pipeline and contribute to business growth
  • Increase strategic client relationships and repeat business

Practice Development

  • Successfully establish the Data & AI operating model
  • Recruit and develop a high-performing consulting team
  • Launch market-leading consulting propositions
  • Create reusable intellectual property and delivery assets

Client Outcomes

  • Deliver measurable business value across strategic engagements
  • Maintain exceptional executive client satisfaction
  • Increase repeat engagements and client advocacy
  • Provide technical leadership on Sullivan & Stanley's most complex programmes

Market Impact

  • Establish Sullivan & Stanley as a recognised voice in Data & AI consulting
  • Publish thought leadership that supports the Intelligent Enterprise proposition
  • Build strategic technology partnerships
  • Increase external recognition through speaking engagements and industry participation

Benefits

  • Borough Market office space with event space & bar
  • Monthly gym membership contributions
  • Access to learning and development opportunities
  • Membership of The Change Society
  • NEST Pension and Life Assurance
  • Hybrid working

Additional Information

S&S value difference. We are working to be our best diverse selves and are committed to providing an inclusive, safe and amicable environment for all people, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, ability, age, ethnicity, socioeconomic status, and religion (or lack thereof).

We are an equal opportunity employer and our recruitment process is based on capability and experience.

S&S also values giving forward, which is why Business for Good is one of our five strategic pillars. We believe that to be good you need to do good, and all it takes is a company with an idea and passion to make something good happen. Our objectives for Business for Good are:

  • Good for our people: create an exemplary and equitable working environment in which to learn and develop
  • Good for our community: create a positive impact for the charities we support and provide our associate network with purposeful work
  • Good for our clients: deliver meaningful and sustainable change

title: Afdelingslæge søges til Sengeafsnit 2/4 for unge, Børne- og ungdomspsykiatrisk afdeling, AUH
description:
Vi søger en speciallæge i Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatri til ansættelse som afdelingslæge.

Stillingen er ledig til besættelse pr. 1. september 2026 eller snarest herefter.

Om stillingen

Du vil i et samarbejde med teamet og miljøpersonalet i afsnittet varetage udredning og behandling af en række psykiatriske lidelser hos unge under indlæggelse såsom f.eks. psykotiske og affektive tilstande, personlighedsforstyrrelser, autisme, mental retardering og ADHD. Mange patienter indlægges akut med affektreaktioner, selvskade og suicidalitet.

Afsnittet dækker både hoved-, regions- og højt specialiseret funktion.

Som speciallæge i afsnittet, vil du, endvidere få konferenceledelse.

Vores sengeafsnit er delt på to matrikler (S2/S4), hvor du som udgangspunkt er tilknyttet S2 i Skejby.

Til stillingen er ligeledes knyttet udarbejdelse af mentalobservationer. Erfaring inden for mentalobservationer er ikke en forudsætning for stillingen. Der kan ligeledes være opgaver med at følge retslige patienter ambulant og under indlæggelse.

Du vil blive inddraget i udvikling af afsnittets faglige tilbud herunder at understøtte implementering af visioner, målsætninger samt faglige og organisatoriske indsatser i afsnittet. Du vil også blive inddraget i bl.a. kvalitetsarbejde, Safewards, nedbringelse af tvang og andet udviklingsarbejde samt forskningsprojekter i afsnittet.

Som speciallæge vil du indgå i det tværfaglige og tværsektorielle samarbejde med interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere, og du vil have medansvar for sikring af flow og optimal ressourceudnyttelse.

I stillingen vil du også komme til at indgå i et tæt samarbejde med afsnitsledelsen.

Organisering – Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Afdeling (BUA)

BUA er én afdeling under AUH. BUA er en selvstændig afdeling, som ledes af en cheflæge, en chefsygeplejerske og chefpsykolog som tilsammen udgør afdelingsledelsen. BUA er placeret på tre matrikler i henholdsvis Herning, Viborg og Skejby.

I BUA er der syv kliniske enheder med ambulatorier, døgn- og/eller dagafsnit, samt en forskningsenhed og en sekretærgruppe, som ledes selvstændigt.

Det psykiatriske sengeafsnit for unge Gødstrup/Skejby

Afsnitsledelsen består af en afsnitsledende overlæge og af to oversygeplejersker (aktuelt vakant i Gødstrup).

Afsnittet består af to sengeafsnit hhv. i Skejby (11 pladser) og i Herning (5 pladser). Dertil har afsnittet tilknyttet Klinik for Ungdomsretspsykiatri.

Der er ansat følgende faggrupper: Læger, sygeplejersker, psykologer, socialrådgivere, pædagoger, ergoterapeuter, fysioterapeuter, social- og sundhedsassistenter og sekretærer.

Målsætning for afsnittet

Afsnittet har som overordnet mål at sikre gode patientforløb for de unge med stort fokus på at sikre gode overgange mellem sygehus og familie/bosted.

Derudover er målene, at

  • have fortsat udvikling af mentaliseringsbaseret miljøterapeutisk behandling
  • være en attraktiv arbejdsplads med en udviklingsorienteret kultur
  • have medarbejdere og ledere, der bygger samarbejde og ledelse på respekt, loyalitet, tillid og professionalisme
  • arbejde med forebyggelse af tvang.

Dine kvalifikationer er, at du

  • skal være speciallæge i børne- og ungdomspsykiatri
  • har interesse for og kompetencer til at indgå bredt i det kliniske arbejde
  • besidder overblik, gode samarbejdsevner samt lyst og evne til at arbejde internt og eksternt med en stor personalegruppe i en kompleks organisation
  • skal være udviklingsorienteret og samtidig motiveret for fastholdelse af den daglige drift.

Vi tilbyder

  • et godt tværfagligt samarbejde med interne og eksterne samarbejdspartner
  • en spændende og udfordrende stilling blandt dygtige kolleger
  • høj vægtning af faglig og personlig udvikling
  • mulighed for deltagelse i faglige kurser/aktiviteter og videreudvikling af ledelsesmæssige kompetencer
  • tværfagligt samarbejde med ansvar for fagsupervision
  • mulighed for individuel og gruppesupervision
  • medarbejdere og ledelse, der er kendetegnet bl.a. igennem deres dedikerede engagement og motivation for varetagelse af kerneopgaven
  • en organisation, hvor samarbejde og kommunikation er prioriterede veje til et godt arbejdsmiljø.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

I henhold til overenskomsten indgået mellem Danske Regioner i Danmark og Yngre Læger med mulighed for forhandling vedr. evt. kvalifikationstillæg.

Ansættelsen er betinget af en tilfredsstillende børneattest og en tilfredsstillende autorisation.

Du vil indgå i BUA’s selvstændige vagtberedskab i Skejby med vagt udenfor tjenestestedet.

Ansøgningsfrist er onsdag d. 10. august 2026 kl. 12.00.

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes onsdag d. 19. august 2026 fra kl. 12.00 - 15.30

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås hos afsnitsledende overlæge Martin Hansen mathas@rm.dk mobil nr. 4048 3520 eller oversygeplejerske Rikke Nielsen rikenils@rm.dk, mobil nr. 2162 1149 se også

Du kan finde Funktionsbeskrivelse afdelingslæge her

Udover en kort motiveret ansøgning bedes du udfylde skema til de 7 faglig bedømmelse. Besvarelserne skal indtastes som en del af ansøgningsproceduren.

Du kan finde skema her.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

title: Painter
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Apply paint, stain and other finishes to property walls, ceilings, and furniture using brushes, spray guns, or rollers. Apply primers or sealers to prepare new surfaces for finish coats. Remove old finishes by stripping, sanding, wire brushing, burning, or using water and/or abrasive blasting. Cover surfaces with appropriate material for protection during painting and post appropriate paint signs. Clean up and store paint and painting tools and equipment in appropriate areas. Coordinate with vendor in order to modify colors of paint, stain, or varnish.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests’ service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Support team to reach common goals. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move up and down a ladder. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: Technical, Trade, or Vocational School Degree.

Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

title: Tilsynsførende til rengøring på Scandlines færgerne i Rødby - fuldtid
description:
"I Forenede har vi fokus på, at vores medarbejdere går glade på arbejde"

Forenede Service søger en engageret og serviceorienteret tilsynsførende i en fuldtidsstilling, som finder det naturligt at tage ansvar, prioriterer det gode samarbejde og lægger en ære i at sikre trivsel blandt medarbejderne.

Du vil føre tilsyn på vores Scandlines kontrakt. Det er din fornemmeste opgave, at sikre dine medarbejdere er motiveret og rustet til at udføre de aftalte opgaver. Udover tilsyn og ledelse, vil halvdelen af din tid være, at udføre rengøringsopgaver

Som tilsynsførende:

  • assisterer du servicelederen med den daglige ledelse af serviceassistenterne.
  • er det din opgave at føre tilsyn samt kvalitetssikre, at leverancerne lever op de aftalte krav.
  • er du synlig i driften og bidrager til at sikre proaktivitet og engagement i dit team.
  • er den primære arbejdstid morgen, eftermiddag og aften men også weekend arbejde kan forekomme

Som person er du:

  • en holdspiller som er engageret, tager initiativ og trives med at have og tage ansvar
  • omhyggelig og detaljeorienteret, men samtidig ser det store billede
  • serviceorienteret og imødekommende overfor dine kunder, dine kolleger og ikke mindst dit team.

title: UK TEMPLATE - SENIOR LEAD - PROJECT DELIVERY (BH3/2)

title: Automation Engineer (PAM/CPBF)
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

AST SpaceMobile and our global partners are building the first and only space-based cellular broadband network accessible by standard smartphones. Called SpaceMobile, this ultra-powerful network is being designed to provide connectivity at 4G/5G speeds everywhere on the planet—on land, at sea, and in flight.

We are seeking an Automation Engineer to lead, build, and create an automation infrastructure for our software. In this role, you will work closely with the engineering team to maintain high-quality products throughout their lifecycle while gaining hands-on experience with cloud technologies and complex system testing. This position offers the opportunity to play a key role in shaping the future of our products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated tests for backend, UI, and API components to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and ensure timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Work closely with development team members to identify test scenarios, perform manual testing, and automate them effectively.
  • Troubleshoot and debug automation code to ensure reliable test execution and accurate results.
  • Continuously improve test coverage, execution efficiency, and reliability through optimization of automation frameworks and processes.
  • Mentor team members on automation best practices and provide technical support as needed.
  • Drive and support a zero-bug approach.

Qualifications

Education

  • BSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Equivalent experience may be considered, including IDF courses or equivalent bootcamp programs.

Experience

  • A minimum of 7 years of automation testing experience.
  • Proven experience in automating tests for backend, UI, and API layers using programming languages such as Java, C#, or Python, and frameworks such as Cucumber or other BDD frameworks.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in Agile environments, preferably within CI/CD pipelines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience mentoring team members and providing technical guidance on automation best practices.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Experience working with Linux.

Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot issues in automated tests across different layers.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to changing project requirements and technology stacks.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with a proactive approach to enhancing automation frameworks and processes.

Technology Stack

  • Java
  • C#
  • Python
  • Cucumber and other BDD frameworks
  • Selenium
  • Cypress
  • Postman
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Linux

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to work in a standard office environment and use a computer for extended periods.

title: Product Lead - AI Neobank App
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Vietnam. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Vietnam.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Student Financial Services & Enrollment Coordinator
description:
Oxford International Career Colleges (OICC)

Oxford International Education Group, is a leading education provider committed to transforming lives through learning. OICC delivers career-focused training and student-centered support that prepares learners for success in high-demand industries such as healthcare, community care, and childcare. We are passionate about creating opportunities through education and helping students achieve their career and life goals. Join our growing Canadian team and help make a meaningful impact on Canadian students’ lives as a valued team member on our Career Colleges direct-to-student recruitment teams! If you’re passionate about helping students succeed in achieving their career goals, you’re a results-driven and data-driven individual, we want to hear from you!

Job Purpose

The Student Financial Services & Enrollment Coordinator plays an integral role in delivering an exceptional student experience by supporting prospective and enrolled students throughout their educational journey from enrollment through graduation. This position serves as the primary connection between the Admissions, Academics, Finance, and Student Services teams, ensuring students receive timely guidance regarding enrollment, financial aid, tuition, and institutional processes.
Enrollment & Registration

  • Guide prospective and newly admitted students through the enrollment process, ensuring a seamless transition from Admissions to Academics.
  • Prepare, generate, and maintain enrollment documentation including enrollment agreements, enrollment letters, student files, and official student letters.
  • Coordinate student intake activities including creating student files, student ID cards and orientation preparation.
  • Maintain accurate student records within institutional databases and student information systems.
  • Ensure all enrollment documentation is complete prior to program start dates.
  • Monitor student documentation throughout the student lifecycle. Process withdrawals, transfers, deferrals, and program changes in accordance with institutional policies.
  • Respond to student inquiries within one business day.

Financial Aid & Student Funding

  • Provide confidential financial aid advising to prospective and current students.
  • Counsel students regarding tuition fees, payment options, Student Aid BC funding, private funding, and institutional payment plans.
  • Assist students with Student Aid BC applications and supporting documentation.
  • Review financial aid documentation for completeness and accuracy.
  • Prepare financial letters and supporting documentation required by funding agencies.
  • Develop, administer, and monitor student payment plans.
  • Track tuition balances and communicate payment deadlines.
  • Follow up on outstanding tuition accounts professionally and respectfully.
  • Explain institutional policies relating to refunds, withdrawals, dismissals, and tuition obligations.

title: Servicemedarbejder, afløser til Tradium - Randers.
description:
I Forenede har vi fokus på, at vores medarbejdere går glade på arbejde.


Vil du have et job, hvor du er glad for at gå på arbejde, og hvor vi tilbyder tryghed via grundig oplæring og mulighed for kurser og uddannelse?

Forenede Service søger en servicemedarbejder, afløser til vores kunde på Tradium


Hvor mange timer skal du arbejde, og hvornår skal du starte?

Stillingen er som Servicemedarbejder, afløser. Mødetiden ligger mellem kl. 15:00 og 19:00, mandag til fredag, og der kan forekomme arbejde i weekenden. På sigt vil der evt. blive mulighed for at tilbyde faste timer. Opstart hurtigst muligt.


Hvilket område skal du arbejde med?

Det er en skole med flere Servicemedarbejdere ansat i Randers C og Randers NØ


Dine opgaver vil (bl.a.) bestå af:

• Vask af gulve og aftørring af inventar samt rengøring af toiletter, omklædning, baderum, rengøring af fællesarealer og skoleklasse værelser samt kontorer.

Hos os løfter vi i flok og det betyder, at vi bakker op om hinanden og hjælper til, hvis behov opstår fx under kollegers sygdom og ferie. Du bliver en del af et team, der sammen leverer den standard og kvalitet, der er aftalt med kunden.


Hvem er du?

• Du har erfaring med rengøring og service og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

• Du arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret og formår at prioritere din opgaver

• Du er mødestabil, kvalitetsbevidst og har øje for detaljen

• Du kan kommunikere på dansk og engelsk.


Vi tror også at følgende kan gøre dig glad:

• Løn ifølge Serviceoverenskomsten. Start grundløn: 162,75 + diverse tillæg

• Pensionsordning 10,15%/2% og sundhedsforsikring

• Oplæring og mulighed for bl.a. dansk kursus og uddannelse (med løn)

• En arbejdsplads, hvor vi hylder forskelligheden

• Et trygt og sikkert arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi følger faste procedurer for at passe på dig

• Mulighed for at leje attraktive ferieboliger i både ind- og udland (fx Lalandia, Barcelona).


Hvordan søger du jobbet?

Du søger ved at klikke på den blå knap "Ansøg". Du bedes uploade CV og ansøgning.

Vi holder løbende samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Har du spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte Søs Hundborg på mail soshun@forenede.dk


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!


Velkommen til Danmarks største privatejede Facility Service virksomhed

Forenede Service A/S er en mangfoldig virksomhed, der beskæftiger ca. 3.000 medarbejdere, som repræsenterer +80 forskellige nationaliteter. Vores medarbejdere servicerer flere hundredtusinder personer, når de dagligt leverer services inden for rengøring, kantine og ejendomsdrift til offentlige og erhvervsvirksomheder i Danmark.


Forenede Service A/S er en del af Forenede koncernen, som er en familieejet servicekoncern med en omsætning på mere end DKK 3 mia. Forenede Koncernen leverer omsorgsydelser og Facility Service gennem virksomhederne Forenede Care og Forenede Service i Danmark og Sverige.


Du kan læse mere om Forenede Service her: www.forenede-service.dk

title: QA Lead - Billing
description:
We are currently delivering a major Billing Transformation Programme, introducing a new enterprise billing platform to replace our existing system. Alongside this transformation, we must continue to support and maintain our current platform, ensuring continuity and accuracy while carefully managing complex and business-critical data, processes, and structures. This creates a unique opportunity to be part of a high-impact programme, helping to protect and evolve our billing capability while transitioning to a modern, future-ready solution.

We are looking for an experienced and highly driven QA Lead to join DP World in Southampton and play a critical role in delivering the Billing Transformation Programme. This role sits at the heart of programme delivery, leading and owning the full quality assurance lifecycle to ensure billing accuracy, data integrity, and system readiness.

You’ll work closely with the Project Manager, Billing Product Owner, IT teams, and business stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, and Operations to ensure a robust and structured testing approach. This role is both strategic and hands-on, requiring you to define QA frameworks while actively participating in testing activities to support successful delivery.

This position is ideal for a QA professional who thrives in transformation programmes, enjoys working across complex system, data, and business validation scenarios, and can lead quality initiatives while stepping into execution when needed.

Location: Southampton

Contract: 2 year FTC

How you will contribute

• Own and manage the full QA lifecycle across the Billing Transformation Programme, from planning through execution to final sign-off.
• Define testing strategy, scope, and approach across SIT, UAT, regression, and data migration validation.
• Create detailed test plans, scenarios, entry/exit criteria, and success metrics.
• Actively participate in hands-on testing, including system testing, data validation, and defect verification.
• Support and guide QA analysts and business SMEs during testing phases, ensuring alignment with business processes.
• Validate billing outputs through reconciliation between legacy and new systems, ensuring accuracy and integrity.
• Work closely with the Billing Product Owner to confirm correct implementation of billing rules and logic.
• Establish and manage defect tracking, prioritisation, and resolution processes, leading defect triage sessions.
• Coordinate testing activities across IT, Finance, Commercial, and Operations teams.
• Facilitate test workshops, readiness reviews, and UAT support activities.
• Define and enforce QA governance, quality standards, and testing frameworks.
• Assess go-live readiness from a quality and data integrity perspective and support sign-off decisions.
• Escalate risks, defects, and quality issues where required to ensure delivery standards are met.
• Contribute to continuous improvement of QA practices, tools, and methodologies.

What you will bring

• Strong experience in QA and testing within system implementation or transformation programmes.
• Proven experience across system integration testing (SIT), UAT, regression, and data migration validation.
• Hands-on QA experience, with the ability and willingness to actively participate in testing execution.
• Solid understanding of data validation, reconciliation, and reporting processes.
• Experience working with finance, billing, or data-intensive systems is highly advantageous.
• Exposure to test automation and performance testing tools is desirable.
• Strong defect management experience, including tracking, triage, and resolution processes.
• High attention to detail with a structured and methodical approach to testing.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and resolve complex issues.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work across technical and business teams.
• Ability to challenge constructively and enforce quality standards within a fast-paced environment.
• Resilient, proactive, and capable of operating effectively within complex programme delivery environments.
• Strong coordination and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Compensation

DP World offers exciting and challenging roles within a growing international organization. We strive to hire and develop the right people, locally and globally, stimulating personal growth and self-development within an informal atmosphere. We offer a market competitive compensation package.

About DP World

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 120,000 employees spanning 75 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses—Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology—and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.

What’s more, we’re reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimising disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.

WE MAKE TRADE FLOW
TO CHANGE WHAT’S POSSIBLE FOR EVERYONE

description:

At BEAT81, we’re on a mission to revolutionize fitness by merging the best of technology, group training, and expert coaching.
