title: Senior Process Automation Engineer
description:
We’re a global team of over 400 people, working together to push the boundaries of open-source technology and multi-cloud solutions. Our vision is to help developers, builders, and creators bring their ideas to life with speed and simplicity, by providing a cloud data platform that makes open-source databases, search, streaming, and application infrastructure easily accessible to everyone.

The Role

We're building one shared internal automation platform, and hiring the engineer to build it. Aiven runs on a lot of processes nobody wrote down. The worst of it sits between systems: an approval living in three systems where one would be enough, numbers copied by hand from one place to the next. Your role is to work out what's a simple integration, what actually needs AI's judgment, and how the two run together.

Your Mission: Build the Automation Platform, Starting in Finance

You will own the automation platform, starting in Finance, the function with the least room for error and the most to gain from getting this right. Two other people in Enterprise IT are already automating parts of Finance. You'll give that work a shared platform and reusable capabilities, so it scales past one-off workflows. Prove it there, and it can grow into a company automation platform.

Here's the part most automation roles don't offer: we have a big say in picking the problems. The role is in the Data Platform & Enterprise IT team. We make the whole company observable through data and own a lot of the systems it runs on. We are in a perfect place to figure out what needs automating in the business and actually do something about it. And people want us to help them: we have strong relationships across Aiven and more demand than we can serve, so what you ship gets adopted.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who treats automation as infrastructure. AI is central to how you'll work: you'll build with agents, automation platforms, and MCPs every day. You always reach for the simplest solution, not the trendiest. If certain systems require tons of customisation, we'll push for changing the system, not build around it. This isn't legacy RPA, recording desktop clicks or automating individual tasks. The platform might use visual tools, but everything that matters is production software: versioned, tested, observable, owned.

In concrete terms, this means you'll:

  • Own the automation platform: Build, run, and scale our orchestration platform as real infrastructure, production workflows with observability, error handling, and retries, not demos that quietly rot. We run n8n today; you own where it goes.
  • Turn it into a platform, not a services queue: Find the primitives Finance needs and ship them as reusable capabilities, so you're not reinventing reconciliation and the next workflow is a paved road, not a six-month project.
  • Start where getting it wrong isn't an option: Finance. Today, closing the books or reconciling bank transactions still means moving data by hand between systems like NetSuite, Zip, Atlar, and Rydoo. You take workflows like procure-to-pay and the month-end close and rebuild them so they run end to end, with approvals and exception handling where financial controls or human judgment need them. If it survives Finance's deadlines and its auditors, it scales anywhere.
  • Put agents to work where they earn it: Design human-in-the-loop and autonomous agent workflows for the cases where an agent genuinely beats a deterministic flow.
  • Partner across the systems you orchestrate: Work alongside the engineers and specialists who own the underlying platforms (NetSuite, billing, payments); you orchestrate the flows across them, they own what's underneath.

What good looks like:

Within your first six months, at least one manual, deadline-driven Finance workflow (the kind that today runs through a spreadsheet, a Slack ping, and someone's memory of the exception cases) runs on your platform instead: observable and auditable, routine failures recover safely, and the exceptions reach the right person without anyone watching the process by hand.

What We're Looking For

Must-have:

  • A builder with high agency: You've seen a broken process nobody told you to fix, and fixed it. You start, you decide, you ship. You don't wait for permission or a perfect spec.
  • A systems thinker: It's easy for you to break a process down into its parts, put it in a diagram, and think about the system as a whole.
  • You can find out how work really happens: You sit with the people doing the job, tell the real process apart from the official one, map the normal path and the exceptions, and turn something nobody wrote down into something you can build, without losing the detail that makes it work.
  • A fast learner, across domains: You can go from knowing nothing about procurement or the month-end close to automating it, because you get genuinely curious about how things work.
  • Built and run real automation in production: n8n, Temporal, Airflow, Prefect, or you wired systems together with your own code and APIs and owned the result. You think in API contracts, webhooks, idempotency, retries, secrets. Not a POC you ran once, something people depended on.
  • Real software discipline: Version control, tests, not scripts that rot.
  • AI is already how you build: Not something you need convincing about. You use Claude or similar, MCP, and agent orchestration to ship real things. You've built workflows where models read information, make decisions, or take action, and you know how they fail. You reach for an agent when it's right and a plain workflow when it isn't.
  • Fix the process, not the symptom: When someone asks you to automate everything from the ticket onward, your first instinct is to ask why there's a ticket at all, then redesign the flow end to end. And when something breaks, you don't stop at the fix. You dig into why it happened and change that too.

Strong advantages, not requirements:

Finance familiarity: Familiarity with finance systems (NetSuite, billing, payments) at the integration layer helps, and so does knowing the finance domain itself — the month-end close, reconciling bank transactions — not just the systems. We'd still rather hire an exceptional automation engineer who can learn the finance domain than a finance-systems specialist who can't build the platform. Finance is where you start.

Amazing! What’s next:

If you think Aiven is the place for you and that our Values align with yours, send us your resume and we’ll get in touch!

Global Benefits:

Our global benefits are designed to help you thrive and grow, personally and professionally:

  • Participate in Aiven’s equity plan.
  • Balance work and life with our hybrid work policy.
  • Choose the equipment you need to set yourself up for success.
  • Use your Professional Development Plan budget for learning opportunities.
  • Receive holistic wellbeing support through our global Employee Assistance Program.
  • Inquire about our Global Time Off Commitment (Parental and Sick Leave, as well as Personal Time)
  • Enjoy country-specific benefits for our global cast.

How to Recognize and Avoid Employment Scams:

There has been a rise in fake job postings used by scammers to get personal information. At Aiven, all of our emails relating to recruitment come from an @aiven.io, @greenhouse.io or @eu.greenhouse.io domain and all of our interviews are conducted by video call or in person. Our interviews will never occur via text or chat. If you’re unsure of the legitimacy of a job opportunity/offer pertaining to Aiven, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at recruitment@aiven.io.

Equal Opportunities:

Aiven provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants for employment without regard to age, gender identity, national or ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, physical and mental ability, marital and family status or without regard to any other similar personal attributes. Aiven complies with applicable local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company operates. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, training and any other terms and conditions related to employment.

At Aiven we are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities or special needs in our working environment and job application procedures. We make all reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities or who otherwise need support to thrive in the workplace. We are committed to continuously improving workplace accessibility. There is an option to request a discussion in the application process but if you have any questions before applying please write to us at recruitment@aiven.io.

title: Kirke- og kulturmedarbejder søges til Vejlby-Strib-Røjleskov Sogne
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe et større kirkerum – fysisk, socialt og åndeligt?

Vejlby-Strib-Røjleskov Sogne søger en engageret kirke- og kulturmedarbejder, som brænder for at skabe fællesskaber, formidle kristendom og være med til at udvikle kirkens liv og aktiviteter for børn, unge og voksne.

Vores vision er "Et større kirkerum – fysisk, socialt og åndeligt". Med visionen ønsker vi at skabe en kirke, hvor der er plads til flere mennesker, flere fællesskaber og flere måder at være kirke på. Det handler ikke kun om de fysiske rammer, men i lige så høj grad om at skabe et større socialt og åndeligt rum, hvor mennesker i alle aldre kan mødes, finde fællesskab og opleve nærvær, tro, håb og mening.

Vi ønsker, at Vejlby, Strib og Røjleskov Kirker fortsat skal være levende og relevante samlingspunkter i lokalsamfundet – med plads til livets store begivenheder, fordybelse, fællesskab og tro. Et sted, hvor mennesker kan mødes på tværs af generationer, stille de store spørgsmål, finde mening og opleve kirkens budskab som relevant i deres liv.

Som kirke- og kulturmedarbejder bliver du en vigtig del af denne vision. Du får en central rolle i at skabe og understøtte fællesskaber, formidle kirkens budskab og være med til at udvikle aktiviteter, der inviterer mennesker ind i kirkens liv.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

Børn, unge og undervisning

  • Planlægning og gennemførelse af mini-konfirmandundervisning
  • Medvirken ved konfirmationsforberedelse og konfirmationsgudstjenester
  • Udvikling af børne- og ungdomsarbejdet, eksempelvis gennem børne- eller juniorklub, Børnetjenesten fra DKM eller andre nye initiativer
  • Planlægning og medvirken ved familiegudstjenester og juleafslutninger
  • Babysalmesang
  • Udvikling og gennemførelse af sommerhøjskole for børn i samarbejde med organisten

Fællesskaber og diakonalt arbejde

Du bliver en vigtig del af arbejdet med at skabe og understøtte fællesskaber for mennesker i forskellige aldre og livssituationer. Opgaverne omfatter blandt andet:

· Tovholder- og sekretæropgaver for aktivitetsudvalget

  • Planlægning af sogneaftener, sogneudflugt og andre arrangementer
  • Understøttelse af fællesskaber i Sognegården som Dagligstuen, Lille-stuen, Spis-sammen, læsekreds, strikkeklub og andre aktiviteter

Frivillige

  • Samarbejde med sognemedhjælper og daglig leder om koordinering og udvikling af det frivillige arbejde
  • Bidrage til planlægning og afholdelse af frivilligmøder

Kommunikation og administration

  • Sekretæropgaver for præsterne
  • Udarbejdelse af koncertprogrammer og salmeark til gudstjenester, samt flyers til børnearrangemeter
  • Deltage i medarbejdermøder og udarbejde referater

Vi søger dig, som:

  • Er uddannet pædagog, lærer eller har en anden relevant uddannelsesmæssig baggrund
  • Brænder for arbejdet med børn og unge og har lyst til at skabe trygge, inspirerende og meningsfulde fællesskaber
  • Har gode relationelle og formidlingsmæssige kompetencer og kan engagere mennesker gennem undervisning, kommunikation og nærvær
  • Kan se dig selv indgå aktivt i kirkens liv og bidrage til forkyndelse og formidling af kristendommen
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, strukturere din arbejdstid og tage ansvar for dine opgaver
  • Har lyst til at samarbejde med præster, medarbejdere og frivillige

Vi tilbyder:

  • En meningsfuld stilling med mulighed for at præge udviklingen af kirkens børne-, unge- og fællesskabsarbejde
  • En arbejdsplads med engagerede kolleger og mange aktive frivillige
  • Et alsidigt arbejde, hvor du både får mulighed for at formidle tro, skabe fællesskaber og udvikle nye initiativer
  • En stilling på 19 timer ugentligt med fleksibilitet i tilrettelæggelsen af arbejdstiden

Ansættelsen sker ved Vejlby-Strib-Røjleskov Sogne med tiltrædelse d. 1. oktober 2026. Du kan læse mere om vores sogne her: www.stribkirke.dk

Der er pligt til at gøre tjeneste ved andre ansættelsesmyndigheder i Middelfart Provsti i overensstemmelse med de aftaler Menighedsrådet indgår/har indgået med andre ansættelsesmyndigheder.

Ansættelsen vil være omfattet af Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og CO10 – Centralorganisationen af 2010 og Organisationsaftale mellem Kirkeministeriet og CO10 – Centralorganisationen af 2010 for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgaver som henholdsvis kordegn, kirke- og kulturmedarbejder eller kirkemusiker og det tilhørende protokollat for kirke- og kulturmedarbejdere.

Aftalerne kan ses på www.folkekirkenspersonale.dk.

Der er uddannelseskrav til stillingen. Se § 14 og 15 i Cirkulære nr. 10001 af 12/11 2019.

Det er en betingelse, at den obligatoriske grunduddannelse for kirke- og kulturmedarbejdere gennemføres indenfor 2 år efter ansættelsens start, medmindre du i kraft af din hidtidige uddannelse opfylder uddannelseskravet.

Medarbejdere, der ikke opfylder uddannelseskrav og ikke har gennemført den obligatoriske grunduddannelse aflønnes i løngruppe 1. Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 348.201 - kr. 439.396 kr. (nutidskroner). Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Rådighedstillægget udgør 36.434 kr. (nutidskroner).

Medarbejdere, der opfylder uddannelseskrav eller har gennemført den obligatoriske grunduddannelse aflønnes i løngruppe 2. Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 364.781 - kr. 497.429 kr. (nutidskroner). Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Rådighedstillægget udgør 36.434 kr. (nutidskroner).

Til stillingen er knyttet et OK-24 tillæg på 3.630 kr. (nutidskroner) pr. år.

Løn, OK tillæg samt rådighedstillæg kvoteres i overensstemmelse med stillingens ansættelsesbrøk, d.v.s. 19/37.

Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem Menighedsrådet og Kirkekultur.nu

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til daglig leder Lene Frølund Rasmussen på telefon 4022 0130 eller mail lefr@km.dk i perioden d. 17. - 19. august.

Ansøgning sendes til 7825fortrolig@sogn.dk senest d. 19. august 2026. Samtaler afholdes d. 26. og 27. august 2026.

Menighedsrådet kan oplyse, at der vil blive indhentet referencer, samt børneattest på den der tilbydes ansættelse.

title: Full Stack Product Engineer Intern, Agent Native
description:
About Mactores
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most enterprise modernization stalls at pilots and handoffs; ours ships, production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, Aedeon Inc. Aedeon absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, mapping, validation, test generation, while forward-deployed engineers own architecture, judgment, and cutover. Mactores is Aedeon's flagship deployment partner: field delivery informs the platform roadmap, and the platform shapes how we deliver.

About Aedeon

Aedeon is the agent platform for enterprise modernization, built by Aedeon Inc., a separate product company founded by the same team that founded Mactores. Aedeon turns the systems already running a business applications, databases, data platforms, business rules, workflows into governed AI agents, grounded in a persistent Code Intelligence Graph of the customer's own code and verified through behavior-equivalence proof. Aedeon is delivered as a product, not a services engagement, and runs without mandatory forward-deployed engineers.


This internship puts you inside the platform side of Aedeon: you'll help build product features on the Aedeon frontend, working alongside senior full-stack engineers who will mentor you through the full delivery lifecycle, building features, writing test cases, and validating releases. You'll get hands-on exposure to a real product with real enterprise customers, not a sandbox project.

What you'll do?

Product development

  • Assist in designing, building, and maintaining features across the Aedeon frontend (React + Next.js) under the guidance of senior engineers.

  • Work with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to understand requirements and help take features from spec to shipped, tested release.

  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, and start building a product-first perspective.

    • Learning release discipline

  • Learn how features are owned end to end — from development through deployment and post-release validation.

  • Practice breaking down tasks against sprint timelines and flagging blockers early.

  • Shadow how the team coordinates with DevOps and QA to keep releases clean and repeatable.

    • Testing and quality

  • Learn test-driven development: write test cases before code, under mentor review.

  • Help write test cases for features you work on — functional flows, edge cases, and regression scenarios.

  • Get exposure to AI-assisted tools for generating test coverage, and to automated test suites (E2E, integration, unit) wired into CI/CD.

    • Collaboration and documentation

  • Write clear, well-documented code and submit pull requests for review.

  • Document your work features, test plans, decisions in Confluence or equivalent, in a way others can follow without you in the room.

    • What we're looking for?

    Frontend fundamentals

  • Currently pursuing, or recently completed, a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (final-year students welcome).
  • Working knowledge of React.js fundamentals components, state, hooks.
  • Familiarity with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript/TypeScript basics.
  • Some exposure to Next.js, Git, and modern frontend tooling is a plus, but not required, we'll teach you.
  • No prior professional experience required; personal projects, coursework, or hackathon work count.

    • Mindset

  • Curiosity about how production software actually ships — not just how it's coded.
  • Comfortable asking for feedback and iterating quickly on it.
  • Genuine interest in testing discipline and quality, not just feature output.

    • You'll be preferred if you've

  • Any exposure to AWS services (S3, DynamoDB, Cognito) through coursework or personal projects.
  • Familiarity with Playwright, Cypress, or any automated testing framework.
  • A GitHub profile or portfolio showing projects you've built.
    • Life at Mactores
    We care about creating a culture that makes a real difference in the lives of every Mactorian. Our 10 Core Leadership Principles that honor Decision-making, Leadership, Collaboration, and Curiosity drive how we work.
    1. Be one step ahead
    2. Deliver the best
    3. Be bold
    4. Pay attention to the detail
    5. Enjoy the challenge
    6. Be curious and take action
    7. Take leadership
    8. Own it
    9. Deliver value
    10. Be collaborative
    We would like you to read more details about the work culture on https://mactores.com/careers
    The Path to Joining the Mactores Team

    At Mactores, our recruitment process is built around distinct structured stages. Here's an overview of what to expect at each stage:

    Take-home Assessment:
    A technical task relevant to the role, so you can demonstrate your thinking and approach at your own pace.

    Technical Interview:
    A hands-on session with one of our panel members covering your technical skills, hands-on experience, and how you deliver quality under pressure.

    Panel Interview:
    A structured conversation with members of the hiring team covering your experience, product thinking, and how you work.

    HR Discussion:
    During this 30-minute session, you'll have the opportunity to discuss the offer and next steps with a member of the HR team.

    At Mactores, we are committed to providing equal opportunities in all of our employment practices, and we do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, marital status, military status, genetic information, or any other category protected by federal, state, and local laws. This policy extends to all aspects of the employment relationship, including recruitment, compensation, promotions, transfers, disciplinary action, layoff, training, and social and recreational programs. All employment decisions will be made in compliance with these principles.

title: Fleet Engineering Compliance Monitoring Engineer
description:
We are looking for a compliance and airworthiness specialist to oversee engineering activity within a complex regulatory environment.

You will lead compliance monitoring, provide expert regulatory advice, and ensure engineering operations meet all required standards. Your work will protect approvals, reduce risk, and support safe, reliable operations.

Why AirTanker?

AirTanker is a vital part of the UK’s defence capability, delivering air-to-air refuelling and air transport services to the RAF and MOD. We operate at the intersection of military precision and commercial innovation. As a Fleet Engineering Compliance Monitoring Engineer, you provide independent assurance across engineering and maintenance activities, ensuring full regulatory compliance while supporting safe and effective operations.
  • Operational impact: Protect airworthiness and regulatory approvals. Your work directly supports the organisation’s licence to operate
  • Cross-functional exposure: Work with engineering, maintenance, safety, and leadership teams. You influence activity across the business.
  • Regulatory influence: Shape how the organisation meets aviation regulations. Your judgement supports critical decisions.
  • Comprehensive benefits: Access private medical insurance, bonus scheme, EV scheme, contributory pension, and additional company benefits.
  • Adventure and belonging: Take part in battlefield tours, adventure training, and family events. Build strong connections across the organisation.

  • Plan and deliver audits across engineering, maintenance, suppliers, and operational locations
  • Conduct on-site, off-site, overseas, and short-notice audits
  • Produce clear reports with risk-based recommendations and support regulatory inspections
  • Maintain oversight of compliance systems, audit data, and reporting accuracy
  • Identify trends, assess risk, and escalate key issues to senior stakeholders
  • Support safety management and continuous improvement activity
  • Manage engineer authorisation processes, including competency reviews
  • Ensure licences and approvals are issued and maintained in line with requirements
  • Assess and audit maintenance organisations, suppliers, and subcontractors
  • Support approval of line stations and operational locations
  • Provide regulatory guidance on maintenance, defect resolution, and technical activity
  • Act as a subject matter expert on engineering compliance
  • Support onboarding, training, and development of team members
  • Promote a strong compliance culture across the organisation

  • Experience in an aviation maintenance environment
  • Background in compliance monitoring, quality, or safety
  • Strong understanding of aviation regulatory frameworks
  • Proven audit and reporting capability
  • Formal aeronautical or technical training

title: Triple'A Interface Developer
description:
Triple’A Interface Developer

Who is MARVES Consulting

MARVES is the consulting firm specialised on Triple’A implementation, integration and customisation. We have the largest and most senior team of TAP experts in Europe with many Triple’A founders from Odyssey / Temenos having joined our team. We are covering all business functions and technological layers of Triple’A. We also develop in-house applications as accelerators or to enrich Triple’A functionalities. MARVES has offices in Switzerland, Luxembourg and Singapore. MARVES is currently actively expanding in Singapore to service its clients in the region.

Job Summary

Position Overview:
We are seeking an experienced and proficient Triple'A Interface Developer to join our dynamic team in Singapore. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining sophisticated integration interfaces using IBM WTX (WebSphere Transformation Extender), ITX (IBM Transformation Extender), or TTI (Transformation Toolkit for Integration). These interfaces are critical for the seamless transfer of static and dynamic data between Triple'A platforms and various back-office systems, data feeds, risk applications, execution engines, and other core banking applications.

Key Responsibilities:

· Analyze business requirements and technical specifications to design efficient and scalable data transformation interfaces.

· Develop, code, test, and deploy maps and processes using WTX/ITX/TTI for real-time and batch data integration.

· Build and maintain interfaces that handle complex financial data (e.g., trades, positions, market data, risk metrics, static data) ensuring accuracy and integrity.

· Integrate Triple'A with downstream systems such as data warehouses, reporting platforms, risk management applications (e.g., Algorithmics, RiskMetrics), execution systems, and general ledger.

· Collaborate with business analysts, QA teams, and infrastructure engineers to ensure successful end-to-end integration.

· Perform troubleshooting, debugging, and performance tuning of existing interfaces.

· Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including design specs, map specifications, and operational runbooks.

· Adhere to software development lifecycle (SDLC) best practices, including version control, code reviews, and release management.

· Ensure all solutions comply with industry standards and internal security & governance policies.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

· Minimum of 3-5 years of hands-on development experience with IBM WTX, ITX, or TTI in a banking or financial services environment.

· Proven experience in building interfaces for Triple'A is mandatory.

· Strong understanding of financial instruments, trade lifecycle, and relevant data domains (static data, market data, transactional data).

· Experience with integration patterns for data feeds (e.g., Bloomberg, Reuters), risk systems, and back-office applications.

· Proficiency in related technologies: XML, XSD, SWIFT formats, FpML, CSV/Flat file parsing.

· Working knowledge of databases (SQL, Oracle, DB2) and scripting languages (Shell, Python, Perl) for automation.

· Familiarity with middleware/messaging (IBM MQ, JMS) and scheduling tools (Control-M, Autosys).

· Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

· Ability to work independently and as part of a distributed team in a consulting environment.

What We Offer:

· Opportunity to work on high-impact projects with leading financial institutions.

· A collaborative and intellectually stimulating work environment.

· Competitive remuneration and benefits package.

· Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.

title: CQV Engineer
description:
Position Overview

The CQV Engineer is responsible for the commissioning, qualification, validation, and lifecycle management of GMP equipment, utilities, and controlled temperature storage systems. The role involves planning and executing temperature mapping studies, developing User Requirement Specifications (URS), generating qualification protocols and reports, and performing periodic reviews to ensure continued compliance with GMP and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute temperature mapping studies for GMP-regulated equipment and facilities, including cold rooms, refrigerators, freezers, stability chambers, warehouse storage areas, incubators, and environmental chambers.
  • Perform risk assessments to determine sensor placement strategies, analyze mapping data, identify temperature deviations, hot spots, and cold spots, and support remediation activities where required.
  • Develop, review, and approve User Requirement Specifications (URS) for GMP equipment, utilities, and systems, ensuring operational, quality, regulatory, and business requirements are accurately captured.
  • Prepare, review, and execute Validation Plans, Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), Performance Qualification (PQ), Risk Assessments, Traceability Matrices, and Validation Summary Reports.
  • Coordinate qualification activities with cross-functional teams and equipment vendors, investigate deviations, support CAPA implementation, and ensure all validation activities are properly documented.
  • Conduct periodic reviews of qualified equipment and systems by evaluating maintenance records, calibration status, change controls, deviations, and CAPAs to determine continued validated status or requalification requirements.
  • Maintain validation documentation in accordance with data integrity requirements and support change control, continuous improvement initiatives, internal audits, customer audits, and regulatory inspections.
  • Ensure all CQV activities comply with cGMP requirements, FDA regulations, EU GMP Annex 15, ISPE guidelines, and company procedures.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.
  • 2–3 years of experience in Commissioning, Qualification & Validation (CQV), Validation, or Engineering within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or life sciences industry.
  • Hands-on experience performing temperature mapping and qualification of GMP equipment, utilities, and controlled storage systems.
  • Experience developing User Requirement Specifications (URS), validation protocols (IQ/OQ/PQ), validation reports, and other qualification documentation.
  • Familiarity with validation lifecycle management, risk assessment methodologies, change control, deviation investigations, and CAPA processes.
  • Good understanding of GMP-regulated environments and applicable regulatory requirements, including FDA regulations, EU GMP Annex 15, and ISPE guidelines.
  • Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional project teams.

How to apply

Key Responsibilities

Digital Building Design & Engineering

title: Visiting Researcher, FAIR
description:
Meta is seeking a highly specialized, research-driven expert to define the future of our Computer Use Agent (CUA) data creation. Moving fast to train the next generation of AI and product experiences requires foundational data that is precise, statistically sound, and unbiased.

In this role, you won't just analyze data, you will architect the scientific frameworks, task-creation methodologies, and quality standards that govern it. You will sit upstream of production, conducting primary and empirical research to establish the definitive "gold standard" protocols that engineering and product teams rely on. If you are passionate about data governance as a research discipline and want to impact the experience of billions of people, join us.

Responsibilities

  • Establish Foundational Standards: Lead primary and secondary research to design, build, and implement rigorous, scalable CUA data quality standards and validation frameworks with Meta Superintelligence Labs.
  • Develop Task Methodologies: Architect scientifically sound task creation methodologies and annotation guidelines to ensure downstream datasets are highly accurate, reproducible, and representative.
  • Mitigate Data Risk: Conduct deep dive data integrity research to identify systemic biases or quality gaps, proactively mitigating "garbage in, garbage out" risks for AI model training.
  • Cross Functional Leadership: Partner closely with data science, software engineering, and operational teams to translate complex research methodologies into clear, executable data pipelines.
  • Define Metrics & Baselines: Establish statistical baselines and key quality metrics to evaluate, audit, and continuously improve CUA data health across the product lifecycle.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s or PhD degree in a quantitative or research-heavy field (e.g., Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience)
  • Demonstrated experience conducting empirical research, data curation & validation, or designing complex data collection/annotation methodologies
  • Deep expertise in establishing data quality control frameworks, statistical sampling, and data governance

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in a highly quantitative or empirical research field (e.g., Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience)
  • Experience designing and scaling data quality frameworks or human-in-the-loop (HITL) annotation methodologies specifically for training Machine Learning, NLP, LLM foundation models
  • Familiarity with user behavior log data, or defining complex interaction taxonomies
  • Experience solving complex problems and evaluating alternative solutions, tradeoffs, and perspectives to determine a path forward
  • Proven track record of building data governance metrics and quality baselines from scratch in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment
  • Experience translating complex, abstract research methodologies into clear, executable operational pipelines for cross-functional engineering and product partners

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

title: Buschauffeur (opleiding) regio Rivierenland
description:
Zin om een nieuwe loopbaan te starten als buschauffeur in de regio Rivierenland? Dan is dit je kans – stap in!

We zoeken nieuwe collega’s. Wil je een carrière switch maken of droom je altijd al om buschauffeur te worden? Dat kan! In circa 4 maanden leiden we je op tot buschauffeur. Na de opleiding ga je zelfstandig met de bus op pad. Wil je liever opgeleid worden tot buschauffeur naast je huidige baan? Dat kan ook. We kijken graag samen met jou naar de mogelijkheden. Een leertraject dat je geen cent kost, maar waarvoor we (afhankelijk van het traject waar je voor kiest) je zelfs keurig betalen. Mooier kan niet, toch?

  • Meteen zekerheid via een contract bij Arriva; een betrouwbare en sociale werkgever

  • Maandelijkse toeslagen van gemiddeld € 350,- en overige arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de cao Multimodaal

  • Flexibel werken zonder nachtdiensten, zodat je tijd hebt voor je gezin, studie of hobby’s

  • Aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een bedrijfsfitnessregeling en korting op je zorgverzekering

  • Gratis reizen (zowel werk als privé) via de reisapp Glimble, als je reist met vervoer van Arriva (bus, trein, deelfiets)

  • Een tablet die je voor werk en privé mag gebruiken

  • Via de Arriva Academy (digitaal leerportaal), beschikbaar voor iedere medewerker, zijn er volop mogelijkheden om je verder te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen gericht op vaardigheden en kennis die nodig is voor je werk maar ook daarbuiten relevantie hebben.

Gedreven, leergierig, vriendelijk en een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel!

Om achter het stuur van een Arriva-bus plaats te nemen ben je in het bezit van een rijbewijs D*. Ook kun je een geldige VOG (Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag) aanleveren. Je hebt een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en bent zorgzaam voor bus en reizigers. Je bent klantvriendelijk en het spreekt je aan om mensen op tijd, tevreden en veilig op de plek van bestemming te brengen. Je bent een heer – of dame – in het verkeer, die verantwoordelijkheid neemt ten opzichte van overige weggebruikers. Je staat open voor diensten op wisselende tijden. Je werkt zelfstandig, maar collegialiteit vind je ook belangrijk.

We bieden verschillende mogelijkheden om je bus rijbewijs te halen. We kijken samen met jou welk opleidingstraject het beste bij jou past. Maatwerk dus.

Välkommen till Capio Vårdcentral Selma - en arbetsplats där omtanke, engagemang och arbetsglädje präglar vardagen.

Vi finns i ljusa, moderna lokaler på Selma Lagerlöfs Torg i Hisings Backa och ansvarar för vården av cirka 9 600 listade patienter. Hos oss möts människor i olika skeden av livet, och vårt gemensamma mål är att varje patient ska känna sig trygg, lyssnad på och väl omhändertagen.

Vi tror på styrkan i teamarbete. Här arbetar läkare, sjuksköterskor, distriktssköterskor, psykolog, fysioterapeuter, arbetsterapeuter och BVC tillsammans för att skapa en sammanhållen och personcentrerad vård. Vi hjälper varandra, delar kunskap och utvecklas tillsammans.

Vi är stolta över vår arbetsmiljö där det är nära till skratt, stöd och goda idéer. Som en del av Capio får du tryggheten i en stor organisation samtidigt som besluten fattas nära verksamheten och patienterna.

Vi söker dig som vill arbeta i en verksamhet där relationer, kvalitet och utveckling går hand i hand.

Som sjuksköterska hos oss får du ett varierande arbete med medicinsk rådgivning, telefontriagering och mottagningsbesök, både akuta och planerade. Du arbetar självständigt men är aldrig ensam. Tillsammans med läkare och övriga professioner planerar och följer du upp patienternas vård med patientens behov i centrum.

Vi tror att de bästa resultaten skapas när vi samarbetar, delar erfarenheter och stöttar varandra i vardagen.

Vi erbjuder dig

Hos oss blir du en del av ett engagerat team där vi värnar om både våra patienter och varandra. Vi vill att du ska trivas, utvecklas och känna dig delaktig i verksamheten.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad sjuksköterska och som har ett genuint intresse för primärvård och för att möta människor i olika livssituationer.

Erfarenhet från vårdcentral eller primärvård är meriterande, men det viktigaste för oss är vem du är. Vi tror att du är trygg i din yrkesroll, har ett gott bemötande och uppskattar att arbeta tillsammans med andra. Du är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och vill bidra till en arbetsplats där vi hjälper varandra och utvecklas tillsammans.

title: Global SaaS Operations Architect
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Digital Platform Operations Manager


What we believe in

ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.

We offer a broad range of automation, electrification, and digital solutions for process, hybrid, and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control systems, software, measurement, analytics, and lifecycle services. Our digital portfolio enables customers to improve operational excellence, reliability, cybersecurity, and sustainability across industrial operations.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will join ABB's Industrial Automation Digital Organization as a Global SaaS Operations Architect, where you will define and govern the operational architecture for enterprise-scale SaaS platforms deployed across Azure cloud, on-premises, and edge environments. You will establish operational standards, platform reliability practices, observability strategies, and deployment governance to ensure secure, scalable, and highly available services. Working closely with Platform Engineering, DevSecOps, Security, Infrastructure, and Product Engineering teams, you will drive operational excellence and continuous platform modernization.

This role is contributing to the Process Automation Business in Bangalore, India.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Define and govern operational architecture, deployment standards, and operational readiness frameworks for hybrid SaaS platforms across Azure cloud, on-premises, and edge environments.
  • Drive platform reliability and operational excellence by establishing observability strategies, resilience patterns, capacity planning, automation, and standardized operational processes for deployments, upgrades, monitoring, and disaster recovery.
  • Collaborate with Platform Engineering, DevSecOps, Security, Infrastructure, and Product Engineering teams to ensure platform operations align with security, compliance, scalability, performance, and cost optimization objectives.
  • Provide architectural leadership for hybrid deployments, Kubernetes platforms, customer onboarding, and operational governance while driving continuous improvements through reusable standards, architecture guidance, and operational best practices.

Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. Relevant Azure, Kubernetes, or cloud architecture certifications are an advantage.
  • 10–15 years of experience in SaaS operations, cloud platform architecture, or enterprise operations, with strong exposure to large-scale hybrid cloud environments.
  • Proven expertise in Azure cloud, Kubernetes platforms (AKS, OpenShift, K3s, MicroK8s), hybrid deployments, platform operations, and operational architecture governance.
  • Strong experience with observability, monitoring, logging, automation, and CI/CD practices using technologies such as Azure Monitor, Grafana, Log Analytics, Splunk, Azure DevOps, GitHub, and Helm.
  • Good understanding of hybrid edge computing, industrial connectivity technologies (MQTT, OPC UA), identity and security services (Entra ID, Key Vault), and infrastructure reliability practices.
  • Experience with enterprise data platforms including Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Databricks, CrateDB, and operational data integration patterns.
  • Excellent analytical, stakeholder management, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across global engineering, operations, infrastructure, security, and product teams.

More about us

ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, helping industries become more productive, efficient, and sustainable. The Process Automation business automates, electrifies, and digitalizes some of the world's most complex industrial infrastructures, serving customers across energy, process, hybrid, marine, mining, chemicals, water, and manufacturing industries.

By combining deep domain expertise with innovative software, automation platforms, and digital technologies, ABB enables customers to improve operational performance, strengthen cybersecurity, increase reliability, and accelerate their digital transformation. At ABB, we foster an inclusive culture where collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning empower our people to create sustainable solutions for industries worldwide.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Product Engineer Intern, Agent Systems
description:
About Mactores
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most enterprise modernization stalls at pilots and handoffs; ours ships, production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, Aedeon Inc. Aedeon absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, mapping, validation, test generation, while forward-deployed engineers own architecture, judgment, and cutover. Mactores is Aedeon's flagship deployment partner: field delivery informs the platform roadmap, and the platform shapes how we deliver.

About Aedeon

Aedeon is the agent platform for enterprise modernization, built by Aedeon Inc., a separate product company founded by the same team that founded Mactores. Aedeon turns the systems already running a business applications, databases, data platforms, business rules, workflows into governed AI agents, grounded in a persistent Code Intelligence Graph of the customer's own code and verified through behavior-equivalence proof. Aedeon is delivered as a product, not a services engagement, and runs without mandatory forward-deployed engineers.


As an intern on Aedeon's Agent Systems team, you'll work alongside the engineers who build the agents that do the actual modernization work: parsers that read legacy estates, extractors that lift business rules out of code, verifiers that produce behavior-equivalence proof. You won't own an agent end to end on day one, but you'll write real Python against the Code Intelligence Graph, under close mentorship, and see how governed autonomy (shadow, supervised, autonomous stages) actually works in production.

You don't need prior experience with Bedrock or LangChain. You need to be a curious, careful Python learner who wants to understand agent frameworks deeply rather than treat them as a buzzword.

What you'll do?

Agent systems development

  • Assist in building components of the Aedeon agent fleet parsers, extractors, dependency mappers, test synthesizers under senior engineer guidance.
  • Learn how agents operate against the Code Intelligence Graph so every action traces back to a line of code.
  • Get exposure to governed autonomy stages (shadow, supervised, autonomous) and the human-in-the-loop controls at each stage.
  • Shadow how the team orchestrates foundation models (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) through the Aedeon Decision Model.

    • Verification and quality

  • Practice writing tests before code, for the small pieces of functionality you own.
  • Help build behavior-equivalence checks comparing agent output against expected results.
  • Contribute to test cases covering functional flows and edge cases, with mentor review before anything ships.
  • Get hands-on with pytest and the team's CI/CD-integrated test suites.

    • Collaboration and documentation

  • Write clear, readable Python and submit pull requests for review.
  • Document what you build in Confluence or equivalent clearly enough that a teammate can pick it up without asking you first.

    • What we're looking for?

    Core Python and fundamentals

  • Currently pursuing, or recently completed, a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

title: IT Infrastructure Engineer (CyberArk)
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Infrastructure Engineer (cyber security tools related) to join our cyber security operations team. The ideal candidate will play a key role in maintaining our organisation's technology stack. The role involves focusing on security and compliance, operational efficiency, and service excellence – keeping organisation cyber safe.

Key Responsibilities

This role ensures the security posture of critical systems through proactive monitoring, incident response, system maintenance, and implementation of security enhancements across the organisation's technology stack.

Be part of a team that is responsible for managing and maintaining the cyber security operations of organisation:

  • Lead Vulnerability Management (VM) of assigned cyber security tools, including proactive monitoring of vulnerabilities, planning remediation schedules, adhering to vulnerability deadlines and seeking deviations via Risk Assessment (RA).

  • Lead security compliance through regular system hardening, configuration management, and policy enforcement.

  • Lead IT lifecycle management.

  • Ensure timely and successful updates and upgrades whilst ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.

  • Plan downtime and collaborate with cross-functional teams for system updates and upgrades.

  • Support regular audits and perform remediation actions.

  • Work closely with vendors.

  • Provide operations support, in a multi-vendor network including Critical Information Infrastructure (CII).

  • Participate in Disaster Recovery (DR) exercise and contribute to architectural planning for managed security tools in cloud environments.

  • Manage tool setups and migrations.

  • Create, maintain and review technical documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) as part of Knowledge Management (KM).

  • Drive efficiencies through automation.

  • Proactive documentation as part of Knowledge Management (KM).

  • Occasionally provide after-hours support including weekends as required.

What we are looking for

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity operations and security tool management.

  • Excellent knowledge and proven hands-on ability in operating Privileged Access Management (PAM) tools such as CyberArk.

  • Good vendor management skills.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to influence and communicate effectively with non-technical audiences including management.

  • Applicants are expected to manage work in fast-paced environments, across heterogeneous networks including cloud environments, some of which are Critical Information Infrastructure (CII).

  • CyberArk CDE is a mandatory requirement for this role.

Preferred Qualifications, Knowledge and Experience

  • Proven ability to manage and maintain cyber security operations.

  • Good fundamental knowledge and familiarity with Security Incident Event Management (SIEM) and Vulnerability Management (VM) tools including Splunk and Nessus (by Tenable), respectively.

  • Experience with automation tools and scripting (Ansible, Python, PowerShell) to automate repetitive tasks.

  • Experience with Singapore Government security standards and compliance frameworks (IM8, CSA guidelines).

  • Experience in harnessing AI solutions to continuously improve cyber security operations efficiency, including processes and service delivery, is advantageous.

  • Experience in demonstrating AI literacy with the ability to use AI tools responsibly, ethically, and securely, ensuring compliance with organisational policies, data privacy, confidentiality, and governance requirements.

  • Understanding of financial sector security requirements and regulations.

  • Understanding in Identity and Access Management (IAM) concepts.

title: Ohjaaja, Moikoisten lastenkoti, Turku
description:
Haemme innostunutta lasten ja nuorten kanssa työskentelystä kiinnostunutta ohjaajaa tiimiimme Turkuun.

Tehtäväsi

Lastenkodissamme on 12 lasta kahdella osastolla. Ohjaajana tuet, autat ja ohjaat lapsia ja nuoria päivittäisissä arjen toiminnoissa. Työsi perustuu lapsen yksilölliseen kohtaamiseen ja hänen tarpeidensa huomioimiseen.

Toimit lapsen omaohjaajana ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä lapsen läheisten sekä muun lähiverkoston kanssa. Työskentelet asiakassuunnitelman pohjalta, ja jokaiselle lapselle laaditaan yksilöllinen hoito- ja kasvatussuunnitelma, jossa huomioidaan lapsen avun, tuen ja ohjauksen tarpeet. Tehtävässä toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä myös eri viranomaistahojen kanssa.

Työ tarjoaa mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa lasten ja nuorten arkeen sekä osallistua tavoitteelliseen hoito- ja kasvatustyöhön osana moniammatillista työyhteisöä.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden tehdä merkityksellistä työtä lasten ja nuorten hyvinvoinnin edistämiseksi. Pääset hyödyntämään omaa osaamistasi omaohjaajatyössä ja tekemään tiivistä yhteistyötä perheiden, lähiverkostojen ja viranomaisten kanssa.

Saat myös mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa ammatillista osaamistasi sekä osallistua lastenkodin toiminnan kehittämiseen.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Edellytämme kokemusta työskentelystä lastensuojelulaitoksessa tai muuta työkokemusta lastensuojelusta lasten ja nuorten parissa. Sinulla on valmiuksia tehdä yhteistyötä sekä perheiden että viranomaistahojen kanssa.

Arvostamme sinussa:
- Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja
- Kykyä itsenäiseen ja tiimityöskentelyyn
- Hyvää paineensietokykyä
- Kunnioittavaa ja periksiantamatonta asennetta
- Halua kehittää itseäsi ammatillisesti sekä olla mukana kehittämässä lastenkotia

Eduksi luetaan lastensuojelun menetelmäosaaminen, lääkekoulutus ja hygieniapassi.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto tai aikaisempi opistotasoinen tutkinto. Tehtävä edellyttää hyvää suomen kielen taito.

Jos tunnistat itsesi kuvauksesta ja haluat olla mukana tukemassa lasten ja nuorten kasvua sekä hyvinvointia, jätä hakemuksesi ja tule osaksi lastenkotimme arkea.

title: Storeman
description:

Receive and stage merchandise by department, mark appropriately for placement in facility, and deliver merchandise to appropriate department. Stack received merchandise on pallets or carts. Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak to guests and co-workers using clear, appropriate and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print).

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

  • Ability to work accurately and without supervision
  • Proficiency in Microsoft packages essential (Word, Excel, email) essential

CRITICAL WORK ACTIVITIES

  • Assist cost controller in determining par stock levels for stores as per consumption

Communication

Working with Others

  • Partner with and assist others to promote an environment of teamwork and achieve common goals.

Quality Assurance/Quality Improvement

  • Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards.

Physical Tasks

  • Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print).
  • Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift.
  • Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance.
  • Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination.
  • Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces.
  • Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces.
  • Move up and down stairs and/or service ramps.

General Procurement

  • Notify manager/supervisor of low stock levels in a timely manner.
  • Receive and stage merchandise by department, mark appropriately for placement in facility, and deliver merchandise to appropriate department.
  • Complete requisition forms for inventory and supplies.
  • Stack received merchandise on pallets or carts.

General Food - Stocking/Receiving

  • Date, label, and rotate all items according to company standards.
  • Adhere to food safety and handling policies and procedures, such as First In-First Out (FIFO) and Cold Chain compliance, across all food-related departments or areas.
  • Maintain the sanitation standards of the food storeroom and walk-ins.
  • Identify and remove merchandise that is outdated, distressed, or unacceptable in appearance to ensure quality and freshness.
  • Organize and clean all walk-in and reach-in refrigerators and freezers.
  • Reduce workplace hazards in storeroom by following safe handling and storage policies and procedures.
  • Receive deliveries, store perishables properly, and rotate stock.
  • Refuse acceptance of damaged, unacceptable, or incorrect items, track refusal of items, and communicate to appropriate management.
  • Inspect deliveries and date times to verify freshness, cleanliness, consistency, and quality throughout case lots.
  • Check meats to ensure Cryovac packaging is sealed and unopened.
  • Eliminate cross contamination by processing and handling raw and ready-to-eat products separately.
  • Check weights of all items as compared to order and billing.
  • Handle spills, broken glass, and crushed/jagged metal or aluminum cans to ensure safety.
  • Store food following company cooking and storage temperature guidelines.
  • Clean and sanitize floors, food equipment, and drains, and dust/wipe down walls, doors, lights, ceiling tiles, vents, and trash cans in accordance with cleaning checklists and schedules.

Forklift/Pallet Jack

  • Remove empty pallets, cardboard, and trash and place in proper storage areas.

title: Lähihoitaja, Haaparinteen asumispalveluyksikkö, Pälkäneen Luopioinen
description:
Haaparinteen asumispalveluyksikkö tarjoaa ympärivuorokautista sekä yhteisöllistä kuntouttavaa, päihteetöntä asumispalvelua täysi-ikäisille mielenterveysasiakkaille Pälkäneen Luopioisissa. Miljöö on rauhallinen ja kaunis Kukkiajärvi sijaitsee aivan asumispalveluyksikön läheisyydessä.

Tehostettu palveluasuminen on tarkoitettu asukkaille joiden toimintakyky on alentunut psyykkisistä syistä ja he tarvitsevat ympärivuorokautista apua ja tukea. Henkilökunta on paikalla ympäri vuorokauden. Tehostetussa palveluasumisessa asukaspaikkoja on kahdeksan. Yhteisöllisessä palveluasumisessa on sekä raskaan että kevyemmän tuen asukkaita. Se on tarkoitettu asukkaille, jotka tarvitsevat ohjausta elämän eri haasteisiin. Henkilökunta on paikalla virka-aikana. Tuetussa palveluasumisessa asukaspaikkoja on kahdeksan. Talot sijaitsevat vierekkäin, jolloin avun ja tuen saaminen on mahdollista myös yhteisöllisen palveluasumisen asukkaille ympäri vuorokauden.

Lähihoitajana tehtäviisi kuuluu asukkaiden kokonaisvaltainen hoito ja kuntoutus. Osallistut myös asukkaiden lääkehoidon toteuttamiseen ja teet verkostotyötä.

Työyhteisömme on avoin, lämmin ja huumorintajuinen sekä toisia huomioonottava. Saat käyttöösi myös kattavat Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueen henkilöstöedut. Tarjoamme henkilöstölle työterveyshuollon palvelut, vuosittaisen liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hyvinvointiedun Epassilla, työnantajan lounasedun, tyhy-toimintaa sekä Virkisty Vapaalla ry:n toiminnan.

Olet kelpoinen tehtävään, jos olet Suomessa nimikesuojattu lähihoitaja. Arvostamme kokemustasi mielenterveys- ja päihdetyöstä. Toivomme, että sinulla olisi suoritettuna lääkehoidon LOVe-tentin LOP, PKV, KIPU1 ja PSYK1-osiot, mutta tarvittaessa voit suorittaa ne meillä maksutta työsuhteen alussa. Sinulla tulisi olla myös voimassa oleva hygieniapassi. Lisäksi tehtävään valitulla henkilöllä tulee olla olla voimassa oleva tartuntalain 48 §:n mukainen rokotesuoja. Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 4 momentin mukainen rikosrekisteriote ennen työsuhteen alkamista.

Tehtävässä aloitus on 1.10.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Tehtävässä on kuuden kuukauden koeaika. Työaika on kokoaikatyö, ja työaika on keskimäärin 38 h 15 min/vk. Työhön sisältyy aamu-, ilta- ja yövuoroja.

Jos uskot kuntoutumisen voimaan, arvostat aitoa kohtaamista ja haluat tehdä työtä sydämelläsi, saatat olla etsimämme työkaveri. Tule mukaan Haaparinteelle. Odotamme hakemustasi!

title: IT-specialist til Den Fælles Sterilcentral
description:
Er du klar til at blive en del af et stærkt motiveret og innovativt specialistteam? Er du god til samarbejde og koordinering i eget - men også på tværs af teams? Så er det helt sikkert dig, vi leder efter. Vi søger en dygtig systemspecialist, der kan være med til at sikre en robust drift og velkørende IT-afdeling i rivende udvikling.

Om stillingen

I Den Fælles Sterilcentral – verdens mest avanceret Sterilcentral - har vi nogle af de nyeste maskiner indenfor industriel sterilbehandling, samt it-løsninger inden for industrirobotter, AGV’er (Automated Guided Vehicle), transportsystemer og automatiske lagre, som du vil komme til at arbejde med og få specialviden om.

Dit primære ansvar vil være at sikre stabil drift af sterilcentralens systemer i samarbejde med dine dygtige, faglige og engagerede kolleger i Teknik, IT og Processupport.

Du vil også i samarbejde med dit team få opgaver med at udarbejde dokumentation for arbejdsprocesser samt videreudvikling af egenudviklede supportværktøjer.

Vi forestiller os, at du har:

  • Uddannelse som datamatiker, datatekniker, IT-supporter eller tilsvarende
  • Anden relevant erfaring fra enten arbejde eller uddannelse, der giver kvalifikationer på samme niveau som nedenstående
  • Analytisk tilgang og forståelse for komplekse systemer og deres sammenhænge
  • Fundamental IT-viden
  • Teknisk nysgerrighed
  • Gerne erfaringer med komplekst IT-miljø fx
    • Support af kompleks software, automation, softwareudvikling eller lignende
    • Aveva (tidligere Wonderware) MES systemplatform
    • SCADA og HMI-udvikling
    • T-DOC eller andre sporbarhedssystemer
    • PLC-programmering og maskinstyring via PLC
    • Forståelse for databaser, netværk og fx avancerede printerløsninger
    • Databaseudtræk / -databaserapporteringer
    • Kommunikation mellem systemer
Hvis du er nyuddannet, er det absolut ingen hindring – du skal blot have masser af gå-på-mod og lyst til at være kollega i en organisation med masser af spændende udfordringer.

Personligt forventer vi, at du:

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt - tage ansvar samt skabe systematik og struktur i arbejdet
  • Er stærk i kommunikation og en aktiv teamplayer
  • Er fleksibel og kan bidrage positivt i et tværfagligt samarbejde
  • Har erfaring med opdatering og vedligehold af dokumentation
Om os

I Teknik, IT og Processupport er vi en bred faggruppe af bl.a. maskinmestre, teknikere, systemspecialister, processupportere, laboranter m.m., som sikrer en stabil drift af Den Fælles Sterilcentrals vaskemaskiner, autoklaver og automatiske anlæg. Vi håndterer med vores specialviden og kompetencer de nyeste maskiner inden for sterilbehandling samt de nyeste it-løsninger inden for industrirobotter, AGV’er, transportsystemer og automatiske lagre.

Vi er en del af Den Fælles Sterilcentral, der er en nyetableret virksomhed i Region Hovedstaden fra 1. januar 2025 og fortsat er under opbygning. Ifm. med etableringen samledes de to regionale sterilcentraler fra Rigshospitalet og Herlev Hospital organisatorisk med en direktør i spidsen.

De øvrige hospitalers lokale sterilcentraler skal løbende implementeres frem til 2028 i den nye virksomhed, som derefter får det samlede ansvar for hele Region Hovedstadens genbehandling og understøttelse af ca. 1.000 daglige operationer.

I Den Fælles Sterilcentral genbehandler vi kirurgiske instrumenter i et samspil mellem manuelle og fuldautomatiske processer, hvor bl.a. avanceret robotteknologi gør, at vores to sterilcentraler er blandt de mest automatiserede sterilcentraler i verden. Du vil hos os opleve et entusiastisk og udviklende arbejdsmiljø med en kultur båret af kvalitet, produktionsstabilitet, lønsomhed, fællesskab og bæredygtighed.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på i gennemsnit 37 timer om ugen med skiftende vagter. Arbejdstiden ligger mellem kl. 07:00 og 23:00 med rådighedsvagt derudover.

Tjenestested kan være på både Herlev Hospital og Rigshospitalet Blegdamsvej, hvor Den Fælles Sterilcentral har matrikler.

Tiltrædelse 1. oktober 2026 eller efter aftale.

Ansættelse sker i henhold til én af nedenstående overenskomster. Startlønnen kan variere afhængigt af din anciennitet, erfaring, uddannelse samt arbejdsstedets geografiske placering.

Overenskomst og stilling:

  • Administrations- og IT-personale m.fl. - overenskomst 32.01.1
    • Professionsbachelor på administrations-/IT-området
    • Specialist (trin 33 efter lokal aftale)
eller

  • Håndværkere herunder montører, elektronikteknikere, elektronikfagteknikere, datafagteknikere, frisører, bagere, konditorsvende, ørepropteknikere og kokke - overenskomst 32.23.1
    • Håndværker (trin 33 efter lokalaftale) (IT-support, datatekniker, m.m.)
Udover startlønnen kan du have:

  • ret til tillæg efter lokale forhåndsaftaler.
  • ret til særydelser, fx tillæg for aften-, nat- og weekendarbejde.
  • mulighed for at forhandle individuelle tillæg afhængigt af stillingen samt din erfaring og dine kvalifikationer.
Ansøgningsprocedure

Du søger stillingen via linket i annoncen.

Ansøgningsfrist er søndag d. 16. august 2026. Der afholdes løbende samtaler i uge 34 og 35.

Hvis du har brug for yderligere oplysninger eller spørgsmål til stillingen – er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Fagspecialist, Anders Egeberg Klausen, mobil nr. 4033 5713 – mail: anders.egeberg.klausen@regionh.dk (tilbage fra ferie den 3. august).

IT-chef, Rune Keller. mobil 71180639 – mail: rune.reinholt.keller@regionh.dk (tilbage fra ferie den 10. august).

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

title: Senior AI QA Engineer:  Java + Python
description:
Project description

We are looking for a Senior Automation QA Engineer who will design and implement a complete automated testing framework for a complex, data heavy, AI enabled market data analytics platform. This role focuses on API, data and AI workflow validation. You will work closely with backend and frontend engineers, data engineers, and ML teams to build a robust automated quality layer across all components of the platform.

Responsibilities

  • Manual Testing
  • Analyze requirements, acceptance criteria, and specifications for new features.
  • Create and maintain test plans, test cases, and test scenarios across UI, API, and data workflows.
  • Perform functional, regression, exploratory, and integration testing.
  • Validate correctness of data transformation, analytical workflows, and large dataset processing.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Developers, and Data/AI Engineers to clarify expected behavior. Automation
  • Develop and maintain UI automation using Selenium.
  • Implement E2E scenarios covering cross-service workflows.
  • Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / GitLab / Jenkins / AWS CodeBuild).
  • Configure test runs in AWS environments (dev/stage).
  • Participate in root-cause analysis of defects and quality incidents. Quality Engineering
  • Contribute to QA strategy and test automation roadmap.
  • Improve test stability, reduce flakiness, optimize runtime.
  • Define KPIs for coverage, quality, and regression scope.
  • Support test data preparation and environment setup.

SKILLS

Must have

  • Strong experience (8+ years) in Java test automation
  • UI automation: Selenium
  • API automation: RestSharp / HttpClient / Postman
  • SQL proficiency
  • Experience testing data pipelines (ETL/ELT)
  • RAG/LLM QA experience (prompt testing, embeddings validation)
  • CI/CD pipeline automation (Docker, GitHub Actions/GitLab/Azure DevOps)
  • Solid understanding of testing methodologies, QA lifecycle, and Agile processes.
  • Ability to analyze complex workflows and large datasets.
  • Strong communication skills and a proactive mindset.

Nice to have

• Experience with Capital Markets, trading, market data, or financial analytics. • Strong Python skills (5+ years experience) • LangChain familiarity • Performance testing (Locust/k6) • Experience with ontologies / RDF / semantic data modeling • Infrastructure as Code understanding (Terraform/CloudFormation basics) • Experience with Graph Databases (Graph DB, SPARQL or Cypher) • SHACL validation experience

title: Workplace Safety and Health Officer
description:
Job Description:

  • Responsible for the implementation and monitoring of Workplace Safety & Health and Environment Management Systems at work sites.
  • Conduct regular WSH inspections and follow-up actions to ensure safety compliance
  • Ensure all Health & Safety policies, procedures, rules and regulations are adhered to and are regularly reviewed, updated and communicated.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Must be responsible, organized, and self-initiated.
  • Respect for deadlines, sense of urgency.

Klient – dlaczego warto wybrać akurat tego klienta z portfolio JIT?

Nasz Klient to niekwestionowany lider w dziedzinie usług ubezpieczeniowych w Polsce. Specjalizuje się głównie w obszarze ubezpieczeń majątkowych i osobowych.

Firma zatrudnia ponad 1000 pracowników w IT. Oferuje nie tylko szeroką gamę produktów ubezpieczeniowych, zajmuje się także windykacją i wsparciem klientów w spłacie zobowiązań finansowych.

Dzięki wieloletniemu doświadczeniu w branży ubezpieczeniowej, klient regularnie wprowadza zmiany w swoich systemach, dążąc do zwiększenia efektywności usług i stosowania nowoczesnych rozwiązań IT. Wspieramy szkoły, uczelnie i instytucje edukacyjne – prowadząc zajęcia, projekty edukacyjne, sponsorując wydarzenia czy przekazując sprzęt do nauki. Oferujemy staże umożliwiające rozpoczęcie kariery w IT. Wspieramy ratowników wodnych oraz szpitale, dostarczając potrzebne wyposażenie. Wspieramy też liczne organizacje charytatywne wspierające ubogich, dzieci i osoby starsze. Jesteśmy Polską firmą i dzielimy się tym, co osiągnęliśmy przez ponad 15 lat działalności. Wspierając rodzime inicjatywy, dbamy o obieg dobrej energii.

title: Lärare till åk. 4, Höglundaskolan Kvarnbäckskolans rektorsområde
description:
Har du idéer för framtiden och drivs du av utmaningar? I Haninge får du utvecklas tillsammans med trygga kollegor som vill göra skillnad redan idag. Just nu pågår ett av de mest ambitiösa förändringsarbetena i vår kommuns historia. Vi bygger en ny stad, cirka 20 minuter från Söder. Följ med på vår resa.

Välkommen att utvecklas hos oss!

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad lärare i årskurs 4–6 och som har behörighet att undervisa i ämnena SO, EN och TK.

Höglundaskolan är en av två F-6- skolor i samma rektorsområde som har drygt 500 glada och kunskapstörstiga elever och ca 70 kompetenta medarbetare som alla tillsammans arbetar utifrån vår vision "Kunskapsglädje och framtidstro. Vi kan, vi vill, vi vågar". Våra elever och/eller deras vårdnadshavare kommer från världens alla delar. Därför är det viktigt att du är kulturmedveten och intresserad av att aktivt arbeta för elevernas språkutveckling. Vår skola som är vackert utformad och de ljusa moderna lokalerna bjuder in till lärande och möten mellan människor. I ett socioekonomiskt tufft område som vårt är det viktigt att skolan andas kunskap och trygghet som grund för att våga och vilja utvecklas. Detta kräver också ett medvetet, målinriktat och tidvis hårt arbete, men den dagliga belöningen från elevernas framgångar och stolthet när de lyckas, gör att vi väljer att arbeta på Höglundaskolan. Under kommande läsår kommer stor vikt att läggas vid utveckling av språk- och kunskapsutvecklande arbetssätt i alla ämnen på hela skolan.

Arbetsuppgifter

Ditt uppdrag är att axla rollen som lärare till våra blivande åk 4:or. Det innebär att du planerar, genomför och följer upp undervisningen i de ämnen som du undervisar i. Du är också mentor för en av klasserna i årskursen och har ansvaret för elevernas utveckling, uppföljning av elevernas kunskapsutveckling, utvecklingssamtal, dokumentation och kontakt med vårdnadshavare. Du kommer att arbeta i ett arbetslag där förväntan finns på samarbete och kollegialt lärande.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är utbildad och legitimerad lärare för åk. 4-6 Du är en tydlig och trygg ledare som med glädje och kreativitet ser till elevernas lärande. Meriterande är att du har en bred kompetens och erfarenhet. Du ser på relationsskapande som en självklar framgångsfaktor för varje elevs optimala utveckling utifrån dennes förutsättningar. Meriterande är också om du är utbildad i "PAX i skolan".

Du är en lagspelare som tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och ditt engagemang på skolan samt bidrar till en tillåtande miljö, i vilken man vågar misslyckas och be om hjälp. Du är inte främmande för att prova nya vägar i din roll.

Vänta inte med din ansökan! Intervjuer genomförs löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Inför den här rekryteringen har vi redan gjort våra val av annonskanaler och samarbetspartners. Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt all form av hjälp från utomstående aktörer.

Under sommarperioden v.27 till v.32 kan det vara längre svarstid än vanligt. Vi tackar dig för ditt tålamod.

Haninge kommun ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar alla sökande. Vår kompetensbaserade rekryteringsmetodik syftar till att fokusera på individens kompetens och därigenom även motverka diskriminering.

Information om anställningsvillkor och förmåner finns samlad på vår hemsida. Där kan du läsa mer om vad det innebär att vara anställd i Haninge kommun.

Vill du veta mer om oss är du varmt välkommen att titta in på haninge.se/karriar

title: Data Quality Engineer
description:
We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 2 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits

We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer / Data Quality Engineer to join our team and help shape our approach to Data Quality and work on the data foundations for high growth areas at Funding Circle.

This is a unique opportunity to help build a top tier Data Quality and Data Governance function, with the full backing of the business. We’re investing heavily in the people, tools, and technology needed to make it happen - and giving you the chance to play a key role in shaping its future.

Hear from our Senior Data Product Manager, Michael, about what it's like to be part of our Data team!

Your responsibilities will include

  • Building and owning high quality dbt models, ensuring they are performant, well documented and thoroughly tested

  • Rule Engineering: Partner with product engineering and business teams to translate business logic into programmatically enforced Data Quality Rules

  • Collaborate with analysts and data scientists to understand their needs and build models that drive Data Quality and the visibility and measurability of Data accuracy.

  • Champion best practices for Data Quality and data testing, across data engineering teams

  • Review and work on Data Quality issues, both from a technical perspective and performing root cause analysis with stakeholders

What we’re looking for 🌱

  • Strong SQL skills, with experience writing efficient and well structured queries

  • Hands on experience with DBT, building and maintaining modular, scalable data models that follow best practices

  • Previous experience working on Data Quality engagements

  • Strong understanding of dimensional modelling

  • Strong understanding of Data Quality and how it is measured

  • Desireable: Experience writing complex validation logic using tools like Great Expectations, dbt tests, Elementary, Soda, or Deequ.

  • Familiarity with AWS data services ( S3, Athena, Glue )

  • Experience working with data lakes or modern data warehouses ( Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery )

  • A pragmatic problem solver who can balance technical excellence with business needs

  • Able to architect custom AI solutions and smart automated systems that are safe, maintainable, and aligned with our long-term mission

  • Act as a technical bridge and mentor, training “builders" across the company to move from basic AI usage to sophisticated system creation

We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

Why join us? 💜

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

Our Circler Proposition focuses on five areas:

  • Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.

  • Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.

  • Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

  • Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.

  • Lifestyle: We have electric car and cycle-to-work schemes, plus season ticket loans.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.

Ready to join a mission that matters? We’d love to chat!

title: Accounts Executive
description:
