  • Keeping full set of accounts for several crewing entities, including preparation of financial statements, relevant reconciliation reports and audit schedules
  • Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, cashbook, fixed assets and general ledger functions
  • Maintain individual accounts receivable and accounts payable subledgers and make adjustment whenever necessary, including generating and posting sales invoices in the ERP system, posting of supplier invoices in the system for approval and payments
  • Preparing & co-ordinating period end closing activities for corporate reporting
  • Responsible for submitting annual budgets and quarterly forecasts including AARO reporting
  • Perform variance analysis, bank & accounts reconciliations
  • Liaising with customers, suppliers and other parties on financial transactions
  • Preparing annual financial reports within statutory deadlines
  • Submission of GST returns, prepare corporate tax computation and XBRL
  • Manage treasury activities, including cashflow forecasts, working capital requirements and ensure sufficient funding received from clients for seafarers’ payrolls
  • Liaise with corporate secretarial agents, auditors, tax agents, solicitors, bankers and statutory organizations etc, for preparation and submission of necessary regulatory documentation & returns
  • Ensuring compliance with internal controls procedures and processes in line with company’s policies
  • Involved in external ISO & internal controls audits, finance procedures & transfer pricing documentation and writing minutes of meetings
  • Any other duties and responsibilities assigned by superior

Education & Experience

  • Diploma in Accountancy or equivalent preferred
  • Computer literate particularly in Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, and Microsoft PowerPoint
  • Organized, detailed and deadline-oriented
  • Able to work both independently and equally in a team environment
  • Possess a positive attitude

title: Hjullastarförare sökes till spännande projekt i Luleå
description:
Vill du vara med och bidra till viktiga bygg- och anläggningsprojekt i Luleå? Vi söker nu en engagerad och ansvarstagande hjullastarförare som vill bli en del av vårt team. Oavsett om du är ny i yrket eller har tidigare erfarenhet erbjuder vi en utvecklande roll i en bransch med goda framtidsmöjligheter.

Om tjänsten

title: Manufacturing Project Manager

Manufacturing Project Manager - known internally as Start Up Lead
Billingham (Home of McCoy’s, Wheat Crunchies, pombear and more)

Join our snack-loving team
We are seeking a dynamic and innovative Start Up Leader to join our Manufacturing & Production department at KP Snacks. If you’re ready to bring your ideas to the table, grow your skills and be part of a team that values what makes you, you - this could be your next big move.

About the role
In this role, you will be responsible for leading the start-up phase of a new process and wrapping line, ensuring smooth operations and successful implementation. After this phase the candidate will then be the Line Lead of that area.

What’s in it for you?
We believe in rewarding our colleagues and helping them thrive. Here’s a flavour of what we offer:

  • Competitive annual salary

  • KP Pension Plan with up to 7% matched contributions

  • 25 days holiday, with the option to buy up to five additional days for more flexibility

  • Comprehensive healthcare support including Health Cash Plan, Digital GP and Employee Assistance Programme

  • KP4ME benefits platform with discounts, cashback, wellbeing tools and everyday savings

  • Leads and owns the communication with operations on progress against the VSU tasks, deliverables and results

Who are we?
We’re KP Snacks, part of the Intersnack family. Across more than 30 countries, over 15,000 of us work together to make the snacks people love – from Hula Hoops to McCoy’s. In the UK, we’re a team of around 2,400 colleagues, based across seven sites and our Slough HQ. We’re proud of our close-knit culture, where we speak up, celebrate differences and push boundaries together.

We’re committed to inclusion

  • Understanding of Lean Manufacturing techniques / IWS ways of working

  • Understanding of Project management tools

  • Cost Centre Management, Budgeting and Forecasting

  • Knowledge of legislative requirements and responsibilities relating to Health, Safety and Environmental issues

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters.

Enterprise Technology plays a critical part in shaping the future of mobility. If you’re looking for the chance to leverage advanced technology to redefine the transportation landscape, enhance the customer experience and improve people’s lives, this is the opportunity for you. Join us and challenge your IT expertise and analytical skills to help create vehicles that are as smart as you are.

In this position...

As a Technical Program Manager within Global Product Creation, you will play a key role in the execution and delivery of high-impact transformation initiatives, with a specific focus on driving a significant, modernizing transformation in our product definition capabilities.

This role has a truly global scope, supporting diverse vehicle programs around the world that are manufactured across our international plants. Sitting at the intersection of business, technology, and engineering, you will contribute directly to the product group vision and roadmap, helping define tactical plans and execution strategies in alignment with broader digital and industrial goals. You will translate high-level strategy into actionable user stories and technical requirements, partnering closely with engineering, design, and platform teams to coordinate the end-to-end agile delivery, launch, and quality of scalable features while managing day-to-day trade-offs and timelines. Additionally, you will safeguard delivery health by tracking key KPIs, monitoring system and product performance, participating in incident response, managing project budgets, mitigating team-level delivery risks, and identifying opportunities to leverage modern technologies like AI to drive operational efficiency.


Based in Dearborn, MI, this is a hybrid position with a required four-day onsite presence each week. Relocation assistance may be available for qualified candidates.

What you'll do...

  • Contribute to the product group vision and roadmap, helping define tactical plans and execution strategies in alignment with broader digital and industrial goals.
  • Translate high-level strategy into actionable user stories and technical requirements, partnering with engineering and platform teams to build scalable features while managing trade-offs and project timelines.
  • Coordinate the end-to-end agile delivery and launch of features, collaborating closely with engineering, design, and product to ensure quality and timely execution.
  • Identify and track dependencies and integrations across cross-functional teams, helping resolve blockers to ensure smooth, continuous end-to-end value delivery.
  • Gather and analyze internal customer feedback, telemetry, and discovery insights to make informed, data-driven decisions for product improvement.
  • Track key KPIs, monitor system and product health, support operational improvements, and participate in incident response efforts.
  • Build collaborative relationships with business stakeholders and engineering partners, serving as a reliable point of contact to align technical delivery with product requirements.
  • Guide day-to-day execution within a collaborative, customer-centric team environment, promoting agile best practices and peer mentoring.
  • Support resource and project budget tracking, help identify and mitigate team-level delivery risks, and assist in identifying opportunities to leverage modern technologies like AI to drive efficiency

You'll have...

  • Bachelor of Computer Science, Information Systems, Systems Programming or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience

  • 5+ years of experience with coordinating Agile teams, and having a solid understanding of Agile ceremonies, iterative delivery, and change management.
  • 5+ years of Technical Program Management experience with skills including the following:
    • Strong collaboration and peer-mentoring skills, with experience guiding project teams toward common delivery goals.
    • Clear and articulate communicator, comfortable facilitating team-level discussions, aligning cross-functional stakeholders, and translating technical progress into clear updates.
    • Ability to build relationships and influence peers in a matrixed environment, proactively resolving execution-level conflicts and bottlenecks.
    • Solid understanding of program management metrics, including resource tracking, scheduling, and project prioritization.
    • Familiarity with Human-Centered Design (HCD) principles and utilizing user feedback loops to prioritize features.
    • Self-motivated coordinator who manages immediate delivery timelines, anticipates project risks, and adapts quickly to changing priorities.


Even better, you may have...

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science or similar
  • Automotive Engineering experience
  • Good understanding of Dassault 3DX capabilities and its ecosystem
  • Strong results orientation, helping to drive accountability and structured progress metrics across immediate team deliverables

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

  • Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
  • Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up childcare and more
  • Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more

  • Established and active employee resource groups
  • Paid time off for individual and team community service
  • A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day
  • Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

title: Sähköasentaja, Helsinki
location: Espoo, Hanko, Helsinki, Hyvinkää, Ingå, Järvenpää, Karkkila, Kauniainen, Kerava, Kirkkonummi, Lohja, Mäntsälä, Nurmijärvi, Pornainen, Raasepori, Siuntio, Tuusula, Vantaa, Vihti, Finland
description:
Etsimme sähköasentajaa Helsinkiin

Onko työskentely sähköalalla sun visiosi? Osaatko tehdä perusasennukset itsenäisesti kuvien mukaan ja kenties myös kytkeä keskukset? Onko työmoraalisi hyvä, ja tulet helposti juttuun ihmisten kanssa?

Kuvaus työstä

Etsimme kokenutta sähköasentajaa Helsinkiin. Töitä tehdään monissa eri kohteissa ja ajokortti on työn kannalta välttämätön. Kyseessä on vuokratyösuhde ja työt voi aloittaa heti.

Työ on itsenäistä ja siinä pärjätäksesi sinulla on oltava kokemusta sähkötöistä, kuten perusasennuksien tekemisestä itsenäisesti kuvien mukaan ja keskuksien kytkemisestä. Visio Sähkö toki tukee sinua työssäsi, mutta työkohteessa olet päivän aikana itse vastuussa työn etenemisestä aikataulussa, eikä vieressä ole aina kokeneempaa kaveria, jolta voi kysyä neuvoa.

Jos seuraavat asiat ovat hallussa, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö

Hakeaksesi tätä työpaikkaa, sinulla tulee olla:

* Sähköalan koulutus - työ on vastuullista ja peruskoulutuksen pitää olla kunnossa.
* Usean vuoden kokemus sähkötyöstä - etsimme ammattilaista, jolta asiat sujuvat eikä tarvitse olla vahtimassa
* Voimassa olevat ammattikortit (työturvallisuuskortti ja sähkötyöturvallisuuskortti)- jos ei ole, niin asia on hoidettava kuntoon ennen töiden aloitusta.
* Hyvä suomen kielen taito - työnjohtokieli on suomi.
* Korkea työmoraali – työ on itsenäistä ja vastaat itse työnjäljestäsi.
* Sosiaaliset taidot kunnossa – tulet toimeen ihmisten kanssa tiukoissakin paikoissa.

Onko meillä yhteinen visio? – Näin teet työpaikkahakemuksen

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakjoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme työntekijä, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus. Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta!

Hakemuksia tulee paljon, ja jotta hakuprosessi on kaikille reilu, voimme ottaa huomioon vain järjestelmässä tehdyt hakemukset. Voit parantaa omia mahdollisuuksiasi tulla valituksi, kun:

* liität hakemukseesi ansioluettelon (CV) tai kirjaat aikaisemmat työpaikkasi kuluneelta viideltä vuodelta,
* kerrot, miten aiemmissa työpaikoissa opitut asiat tukevat sinua pärjäämään hakemassasi uudessa tehtävässä.

Näin saat lisätietoa tehtävästä

Jos haluat lisätietoja tehtävästä, voit lähettää rekrytoinnista vastaaville henkilöille sähköpostia otsikolla "Sähköasentaja, Helsinki" osoitteisiin JP Huttunen / jp.huttunen(at)visiohr.fi tai Sasu Nieminen / sasu.nieminen@visiohr.fi. Olemme tavoitettavissa ma-pe klo 09.00-15.00. Arvostamme, että sähköpostissa kysyt vain työtehtävään liittyviä asioita. Jätä esimerkiksi itsesi esittely ja myyntipuheet varsinaiseen hakemukseen.

Tsemppiä hakemuksen tekoon!

Visio Sähkö - ainoa sähköalaan erikoistunut henkilöstövuokrausyritys

Visio Sähkö on ainoa sähkötoimialaan täysin erikoistunut henkilöstövuokrausyritys, ja olemme osa Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut -konsernia. Toimimme koko Suomen alueella. Verkostomme alalla ovat laajat: osaamme ja pystymme ohjaamaan työnhakijan juuri oikeaan työhön, olet sitten kymmeniä vuosia sähköalalla työskennellyt tai juuri koulusta valmistunut. Työllistämme sähköalan osaajia niin lyhyisiin kuin pysyvämpiin työsuhteisiin niin henkilöstövuokrausella kuin suorarekrytoinnilla.

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilöstöpalvelualan yritys, joka pelaa reilua peliä. Tarjoamme töitä niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Työntekijöitä autamme löytämään oman visionsa mukaisen työpaikan. Työnantajia taas palvelemme etsimällä oikeat ihmiset avoimiin tehtäviin.

Yhteistyö perustuu jokaisen kolmen tahon kesken vallitsevaan luottamukseen. Mikäli haluat työnantajan, jolle jokainen työntekijä on merkityksellinen ja arvokas, niin se on Visio!

title: Hankinta- ja sopimusjuristi
description:
Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen työ maailmanluokan yliopistossa sopimusten ja julkisten hankintojen parissa?

Etsimme nyt perhevapaan sijaiseksi hankinta- ja sopimusjuristia täydentämään Aalto-yliopiston asiantuntevaa lakipalvelutiimiä! Kyseessä on vuoden mittainen sijaisuus, ja aloitus on ihanteellisesti syys–lokakuussa 2026.

Aalto-yliopisto haluaa joukkoonsa ratkaisuhakuisen ja itseohjautuvan tekijän, joka on kerryttänyt jo kokemusta hankintasopimusten ja julkisten hankintojen parissa työskentelystä. Sovit Aalto-yliopiston joukkoon, jos olet tarkka ja tinkimätön työsi laadusta ja sinussa sykkii tiimipelaajan sydän. Jos tämä kuvaus herätti mielenkiintosi, niin haluamme kuulla sinusta lisää!

Aalto-yliopiston hankinta- ja sopimusjuristina päätehtäväsi on vastata yliopiston julkisten hankintojen ja hankintasopimusten tekemisen juridisesta tuesta ja kehittämisestä. Työskentelet tiiviisti yhdessä yliopiston hankintatiimin asiantuntijoiden sekä muiden aaltolaisten kanssa ja raportoit lakiasiainjohtajalle ja matriisissa hankintapäällikölle sekä Aalto-yliopistokiinteistöjen toimitusjohtajalle. Olet avainasemassa mielenkiintoisten hankintojen tekemisessä yliopiston palveluihin, infrastruktuureihin ja kampukseen liittyen. Nautit vaihtelevasta työarjesta ja pyrit löytämään käytännölliset ratkaisut kollegoidesi kiperiinkin kysymyksiin asiakaslähtöisellä ja tunnollisella asenteellasi.

Tehtävänkuvasi keskiössä ovat:

  • julkisen hankintamenettelyn valmisteluun, läpivientiin ja päätöksentekoon liittyvä juridinen neuvonta sekä oikeudellinen ohjaus ja hankintoihin liittyvät sopimusasiat;

  • hankintapäätöksiä koskevien hankintaoikaisuvaatimusten käsittely sekä muut hankintaan liittyvät riita-asiat; ja

  • hankintaan ja sopimuksiin liittyvien toimintamallien kehittämiseen osallistuminen ja henkilöstön oikeudellinen kouluttaminen.

Tuet myös kiinteistöyhtiöitä kiinteistökehittämiseen ja vuokrasopimuksiin liittyvissä juridisissa kysymyksissä.

Saatat olla etsimämme henkilö, jos:

  • olet koulutukseltasi oikeustieteen maisteri ja sinulla on ainakin pari vuotta käytännön kokemusta julkisten hankintojen ja sopimusten parissa työskentelystä (myös valtiontuki-, kilpailu- ja julkissektorin sääntelyn sekä muu tekoäly- ja/tai digitaalisten palveluiden tai rakentamisen juridiikan tuntemus on eduksi);

  • sinulla on itseohjautuva ja toimeen tarttuva työote ja innostut uuden oppimisesta ja yliopiston toimintojen kehittämisestä;

  • sinulla on ammatillista varmuutta, olet ratkaisukeskeinen ja hallitset liiketoimintalähtöisen ajattelutavan – haluat aidosti löytää toimivia ja kestäviä ratkaisuja; ja

  • sinulla on hyvät ihmissuhdetaidot ja työskentelet saumattomasti sekä suomen että englannin kielellä (myös ruotsin kielen taito katsotaan eduksi).

Aalto-yliopisto tarjoaa sinulle:

  • monipuolisen työnkuvan mielenkiintoisten hankintojen parissa;

  • mahdollisuuden olla mukana yliopiston palveluiden kehittämisessä ja kestävän tulevaisuuden rakentamiseen tähtäävän strategian toteuttamisessa;

  • position asiantuntevassa ja mukavassa tiimissä, jossa vaihdetaan tietoa ja tuetaan toisia;

  • matalahierarkkisen ja jatkuvaa kehittymistä arvostavan työyhteisön; sekä

  • rennon ja joustavan työkulttuurin sekä hyvän työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainon.

Aalto-yliopistossa tieteen, taiteen, tekniikan ja liiketoiminnan vahva yhdistelmä tuo lahjakkuudet yhteen. Aalto-yliopisto on kansainvälinen rohkeiden ajattelijoiden yhteisö, joka työskentelee huippututkimuksen ja koulutuksen parissa, luoden kestävää tulevaisuutta. Aalto-yliopistolla osaaminen ja ideat ovat olennaisessa roolissa muutoksen johtamisessa ja kansainvälisten haasteiden kääntämisessä mahdollisuuksiksi. Aalto-yliopistolla on lähes 13 000 opiskelijaa ja yli 4 700 työntekijää – ja heidän koko innovaatioekosysteemi on vielä tätäkin suurempi. Kaikki Aallossa työskentelevät ovat osa avointa yhteisöä, jossa tasa-arvo ja inklusiivisuus luovat uteliaisuutta, innovaatiota, yhteistyötä ja hyvinvointia.

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä meille CV:si tai linkkaa meille LinkedIn-profiilisi hakujärjestelmämme kautta viimeistään 9.8.2026. Liitäthän mukaan myös hakukirjeesi. Haethan mahdollisimman pian, sillä alamme tutustua hakijoihin jo ennen haun päättymispäivää. Jos haluat jutella positiosta tarkemmin, voit olla yhteydessä Minjonin rekrytoijaan Wilma Tuomiseen (+358 40 515 3834 tai wilma.tuominen@minjon.fi).

title: System Engineer
description:
OUR STORY:
🇪🇺 Join Scaleway and shape the sovereign cloud of tomorrow !
Since 1999, we have been designing secure, sustainable infrastructures aimed at supporting the most ambitious companies.
Historically known for our dedicated servers (Dedibox), we made a strategic shift to cloud computing in 2015. Staying true to our principles of simplicity, flexibility, and technical excellence, we have become one of the leading players in Europe in the sector.
With the rise of artificial intelligence, we have strengthened our commitment, supported by the Iliad Group, which is investing €3 billion to develop a serious, sovereign AI alternative to American and Asian giants.
Every day, thanks to our fast-growing portfolio of cloud and AI products (bare metal, containerization, serverless, AI, etc.), Scaleway proudly serves thousands of customer across the private and public sector, from corporations like France Télévisions or Hachette Livre, to fast-growing startups like Photoroom and Biolevate, to institutions like the City of Copenhagen.
📍 Our offices are located in Paris, Lille, Toulouse, Rennes, Rouen, Bordeaux and Lyon.

WHY WE NEED YOU ?

Our growth is driving us to strengthen our Storage team to enhance, maintain, and scale our homegrown object storage platform.

Your mission will be to collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, automate, and scale distributed storage systems in order to ensure the delivery of robust, high-performing solutions that meet operational and product requirements while supporting Scaleway’s massive customer data needs.

YOUR FUTURE TEAM

We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a spirit of sharing, helps bring new projects to life every day, advancing our ambitions together.

You will be part of a team of up to 5 engineers. The team owns Scaleway's Object Storage product and is responsible for expanding its capabilities, improving its reliability and performance, and enabling the deployment of new regions and service classes. You will work closely with the Beekeeper engineering team, which develops our in-house Software Defined Storage solution, and with the Storage SRE team responsible for production operations.

YOUR DAILY ROUTINE

  • Design, deploy and operate new features for Scaleway's in-house Object Storage platform.
  • Contribute to the opening of new Availability Zones and Regions.
  • Improve the performance, scalability and reliability of a storage infrastructure.
  • Ensure the operational excellence of the platform through preventive and corrective maintenance.
  • Participate in the Level 2 on-call rotation and troubleshoot complex production incidents.
  • Collaborate with Data Center teams on hardware-related operations.
  • Automate infrastructure deployment and configuration using Infrastructure-as-Code practices.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and onboarding materials.

HARDSKILLS:

  • 5+ years of experience operating large-scale Linux infrastructures.
  • Strong understanding of high-load, distributed infrastructure (hardware, networking, low-level storage like SSDs/NVMe/RAID, or Ceph/S3 APIs)
  • Solid experience with Linux system administration, networking and infrastructure automation.
  • Hands-on experience with Ansible, GitLab CI/CD and scripting.
  • Good knowledge of monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.

SOFT SKILLS:

  • Curious and eager to continuously learn.
  • Autonomous, proactive and solution-oriented.
  • Rigorous, with strong attention to reliability and operational excellence.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving technical environment.

WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SCALEWAY ++++

Hybrid work: We offer up to 3 days of remote work per week.

Offices: Our offices are spacious, dynamic workspaces with bold design, conveniently located near public transport. Most of our offices feature outdoor spaces (terraces) and bike parking facilities.

Dining: Our chef provides a healthy meal service at the headquarters, and breakfast is available across all our sites year-round. Scalers working from regional sites enjoy a Swile card for lunches.

Well-being commitments: Whether it’s access to a gym, daycare places, or discounted services for caring services, Scaleway is committed to supporting Scalers in maintaining a balanced life.

International environment: With dozens of nationalities, Scaleway offers a stimulating environment where English is as widely spoken as French.

Career & Mobility: Our managers value internal mobility, and opportunities to transition to other entities within the Iliad Group are accessible to all Scalers.

🚀 Why join the Scaleway adventure?

✔ A rich and diverse product offering: Scaleway offers over 100 public cloud products in IaaS, PaaS, and AI.

✔ A cutting-edge technical environment: Scaleway provides modern infrastructures, including high-performance bare metal servers, to tackle exciting technical challenges.

✔ Commitment to responsible cloud: Scaleway is dedicated to a more responsible cloud, with data centers powered solely by renewable energy since 2017, minimizing our ecological footprint and holding top-level certification.

🔜 THE NEXT STEPS …

  • Discovery call with a recruiter
  • Interview with the manager to understand your technical skills and approach to the role
  • Interview with the Architects to validate your expertise, deepen discussions, and assess your fit with the team
  • Interview with the Head of Storage to tour our offices and meet your future colleagues

title: Software Engineer - Battery Controller & Infrastructure
description:
Role - Software Engineer - Battery Controller & Infrastructure

Company - iwell - Harmonizing Clean Energy

Location - Utrecht

About iwell

At iwell, we are all about reinforcing energy security. We help European businesses become more energy independent. With growing regulations, extreme price volatility and rising grid issues, they need to be resilient. It is time to take charge and think ahead.

We deliver energy management solutions that ensure that businesses are always in control of their energy. Our in-house developed EMS and modular battery storage drive profit through sustainability, making businesses future-proof.

We are a fast-growing international team of bold, talented individuals. From engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. No matter what your strong suit is, we always are looking for people who are determined to make a positive impact.

The Role

The Battery Controller team owns the software that is closest to the hardware: the C#.NET application that steers our battery systems and guards their safety. This is code that runs on real hardware, in the field, making real-time decisions that keep our customers' energy operations safe and reliable.

But this team owns more than the application. We also run a large share of the infrastructure that keeps the fleet operational such as Linux, Ansible orchestration, self-hosted DevOps stack, VPN gateways, networking and monitoring. We don't believe in developers who throw their code over a wall to "ops", so we're looking for someone who is two things at once: a solid C# engineer, and someone who gets a real kick out of the infrastructure side. You own things end to end, you document as you go, and you're the person your team can lean on when the plumbing needs care.

Success in this role means being able to:

  • Write and maintain safety-critical C#.NET code with the care it deserves.

  • Own infrastructure end to end

  • Support our Operations team whenever help is needed, move comfortably between application work and operational work, and see the two as one job rather than two.

What you will do

  • Develop and maintain the C# application that controls our battery systems and guards their safe operation. For example: designing a safety module for the Battery Controller, which helps in keeping our batteries safe and only alert the on-call operator when it is absolutely necessary, or integrating a new type of battery in our battery portfolio.

  • Take ownership of part of our infrastructure and operations. You won't do all of it, but you'll pick up an area (or a few) and run with it.

Depending on where your strengths and interest lie, the infra work could include:

  • Orchestrating our linux based fleet with Ansible and other automation tools.

  • Keeping self-hosted infrastructure healthy across Hetzner, Azure and StackHero (OS and Docker updates, DevOps pipelines, our GitLab instance, and the Mikrotik-based VPN gateway).

  • Designing, testing and documenting new on-site network setups for our Customer Operations team to install.

What are looking for

  • Solid experience as a C#.NET developer, writing clean, maintainable code.

  • Knowledge of hardware communication protocols such as Modbus and MQTT.

  • Hands-on experience with Linux, and a love of scripting and automating tasks away.

  • Comfort with infrastructure tooling such as Ansible, Docker, Azure and OpenVPN, and with cloud/hosting environments like Hetzner.

  • The know-how to set up a reliable and secure network, and the curiosity to keep up with the field.

  • A genuine affinity for the operational side of software — you see running the system as part of building it.

  • Strong communication skills and a habit of documenting your work. Fluency in English is required.

  • Weekly working hours of 32-40 hours

  • Coming into the office 3-4 days per week


What we offer

  • 30 holidays per year, plus an annual company trip of 3 days

  • The opportunity to do volunteer work, by offering 1 volunteer day per year

  • Learning & Development budget of EUR 1,500 per year

  • Attractive pension plan with Brand New Day

  • Working remotely for 2 weeks per year

  • We cover your travel costs, regardless of whether you come by bike, car, or public transport.

  • A mobile phone allowance of EUR 25 per month

  • Additional activities such as a bootcamp, volleyball tournament, company drinks etc.

Interested?

For more information about iwell, what we do, why we do it, and an overview of our partners, visit https://iwell.eu/.

Our application process

  1. Apply. Our People & Culture Team and the hiring manager will review your application and will respond within 2 weeks.

  2. Phone screening. Are you a true iweller-in-the-making? We will invite you for an introductory call.

  3. Are you the one? You will have two or more interviews. For some roles, you will also be asked to work on a case.

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
This role is for one of the Weekday's clients

Salary range: Rs 1000000 - Rs 2500000 (ie INR 10 - 25 LPA)

Min Experience: 5+ years

Location: Pune
JobType: full-time

We are looking for a highly skilled Cloud Security Engineer with 5–7 years of experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining secure cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Cloud Security and Identity & Access Management (IAM), with a strong understanding of cloud-native security controls, access governance, and compliance best practices.

In this role, you will work closely with engineering, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to strengthen the organization's cloud security posture, implement least-privilege access models, and ensure secure deployment practices across cloud platforms. You will play a critical role in protecting cloud infrastructure, applications, and sensitive data from evolving cyber threats while supporting business scalability and operational excellence.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and manage security controls across cloud environments to ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
  • Develop and maintain Identity & Access Management (IAM) policies, roles, permissions, and access controls based on the principle of least privilege.
  • Monitor cloud infrastructure for security vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and compliance deviations using cloud-native and third-party security tools.
  • Implement secure authentication mechanisms, including multi-factor authentication (MFA), single sign-on (SSO), and role-based access control (RBAC).
  • Collaborate with DevOps and engineering teams to integrate security best practices into CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployments.
  • Conduct security assessments, risk analyses, and cloud configuration reviews to identify and remediate potential security gaps.
  • Investigate security incidents, perform root cause analysis, and support incident response activities.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions to detect suspicious activities across cloud environments.
  • Support regulatory compliance initiatives by ensuring cloud environments adhere to industry security standards and organizational policies.
  • Document security architectures, IAM standards, operational procedures, and technical recommendations.

Required Skills

Must-Have Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience in Cloud Security across public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Extensive expertise in Identity & Access Management (IAM), including user lifecycle management, access governance, privilege management, and authentication protocols.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, security groups, firewalls, encryption, and key management services.
  • Experience implementing Zero Trust security principles and least-privilege access models.
  • Knowledge of identity federation technologies including SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and LDAP/Active Directory.
  • Experience with cloud security monitoring, vulnerability management, and security compliance frameworks.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security concepts and secure cloud provisioning.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) solutions.
  • Knowledge of container and Kubernetes security.
  • Familiarity with SIEM, SOAR, and endpoint security solutions.
  • Experience automating security operations using Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
  • Understanding of DevSecOps methodologies and secure software development practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5–7 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, or cloud security engineering.
  • Relevant cloud or security certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, CCSP, or equivalent are highly preferred.

description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Portugal. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Portugal.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Observability Architect
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Digital Solution Engineering Manager


What we believe in

ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.

We offer a broad range of automation, electrification, and digital solutions for process, hybrid, and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control systems, software, measurement, analytics, and lifecycle services. Our digital portfolio enables customers to improve operational excellence, reliability, cybersecurity, and sustainability across industrial operations.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will join ABB's Industrial Automation – Digital Industry Analytics / Research & Development organization as a Principal Architect – Observability Platform. You will provide technical leadership for defining the architecture, engineering standards, and strategic roadmap for ABB's enterprise observability platform supporting industrial cloud and edge environments. Working closely with Product Management, Platform Engineering, DevOps/SRE, Security, and Customer Operations teams, you will drive scalable, secure, and resilient platform capabilities that enable operational excellence across ABB's digital portfolio.

This role is contributing to the Industrial Automation – Digital Industry Analytics / Research & Development organization in Bangalore, India.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Define and drive the architectural vision, technology roadmap, and engineering standards for ABB's enterprise observability platform, enabling scalable, secure, and highly available cloud and edge solutions.
  • Lead architecture governance by establishing reusable reference architectures, best practices, and technical standards while guiding engineering teams through complex architectural decisions and technology adoption.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, Platform Engineering, DevOps/SRE, Security, and Customer Operations teams to deliver reliable, cloud-native observability capabilities that enhance platform resilience, operational excellence, and customer experience.
  • Champion innovation, reliability engineering, and technical excellence by mentoring engineering teams, driving architectural modernization, and promoting observability and operational best practices across the organization.

Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 12+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, and enterprise architecture, with proven expertise in designing large-scale cloud-native and distributed systems.
  • Strong experience architecting enterprise observability platforms using technologies such as Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, New Relic, Dynatrace, Datadog, Splunk, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights.
  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes (preferably Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)), microservices, distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and hybrid cloud-edge deployment models.
  • Strong understanding of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), operational excellence, reliability engineering, telemetry, centralized logging, distributed tracing, and monitoring best practices.
  • Proven ability to establish architecture governance, technical standards, platform roadmaps, and engineering best practices while leading cross-functional teams in enterprise environments.
  • Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and mentoring skills with the ability to influence technical strategy and drive innovation across global engineering organizations.

More about us

ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, helping industries become more productive, efficient, and sustainable. The Process Automation business automates, electrifies, and digitalizes some of the world's most complex industrial infrastructures, serving customers across energy, process, hybrid, marine, mining, chemicals, water, and manufacturing industries.

The Digital Industry Analytics organization plays a critical role in delivering scalable, secure, and intelligent software platforms that power ABB's next generation of industrial digital solutions. By combining deep domain expertise with cloud-native technologies, AI, analytics, and observability, ABB enables customers to improve operational reliability, optimize performance, and accelerate their digital transformation. At ABB, we foster an inclusive culture where collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning empower our people to create sustainable solutions for industries worldwide.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Head of Professional Services
description:
Job Title: Head of Professional Services

Location: Hybrid - Reading or Leeds Area

Salary: Competitive

Job Type: Permanent – Full Time

  • Are you the manager who makes sure the right people are on the right work at the right time – every time?

  • Have you led and developed technical teams in a matrix, owning the people and the plan while others set the technical direction?

  • Can you hold a shifting picture of capacity across multiple practices and keep it calm, clear and under control?

If yes, then let’s get to the important stuff!

The Role


As Head of Professional Services, you will own the delivery engine that sits behind every practice at TIEVA. This is the role that makes sure the right people are doing the right work at the right time – so our technical leaders can add value in their domains, and our engineers can build.

You will own line management, workload, planning and organisation for the consultants and engineers who deliver across the business. Work is scheduled sensibly, capacity is understood, conflicts get resolved, and every person you manage is supported, developed and clear on what they are doing. The output is a delivery engine that runs smoothly and people who are genuinely looked after.

You will operate in a matrix. You are the direct line manager for your people – their 1:1s, development, performance and wellbeing sit with you. Technical leadership sits with our Practice Technical Leads and Principal Cloud Architect, and Solution Scoping sits with the Head of Pre-Sales, your peer in delivery. You do not set technical direction or own solution quality; you make sure the people delivering across all of it are organised, available and not overloaded, partnering closely with those leaders so direction and delivery stay joined up.

The newest challenge you will take on is our Solution Architect population, who work as a hybrid between Pre-Sales and Professional Services. They flex across both worlds depending on demand, which makes their scheduling the hardest in the business. Holding that balance – keeping pre-sales responsive without starving delivery, and vice versa – is a core part of the role, and the clearest example of the matrix you will run.



The Candidate

Line Management

  • Act as the direct line manager for consultants and engineers across the practices – 1:1s, objectives, performance reviews, career development and wellbeing all sit with you.
  • Handle the people side end to end – absence, conduct, onboarding, induction and HR matters, partnering with HR where needed.
  • Be the consistent point of management your people go to – the person who knows what they are working on, how they are doing, and what they need next.
  • Hold development conversations focused on the person’s growth, drawing on the Technical Leads and Principal for the technical view of their progression.

Workload and Resource Management

  • Own workload management for the teams across all practices – who is on which engagement or piece of work, and when.
  • Run the resourcing process so engineers and consultants receive work through a managed plan, not ad hoc direct requests.
  • Collaborate with the Project Management Office to balance project and non-project work – they own the portfolio, governance and plans, you own the people and their capacity, and together you make the schedule work.
  • Resolve capacity conflicts – when two demands compete for the same person, you make the call and re-plan in partnership with the relevant technical or commercial lead.
  • Protect focus time and sensible booking discipline so technical teams are not fragmented across too many concurrent demands.
  • Manage the Solution Architects’ split between pre-sales and professional services – the trickiest scheduling balance in the business, keeping both motions served without either being starved.

Planning and Organisation

  • Maintain a clear, forward view of capacity, utilisation and upcoming demand across every practice.
  • Forecast resourcing needs against the project and pre-sales pipeline, flagging gaps and pinch points before they bite.
  • Track utilisation and bench time, balancing billable demand against available capacity.
  • Coordinate the operating rhythm – booking discipline, intake of new demand, and the cadence that keeps work flowing predictably.
  • Provide planning and utilisation reporting to the CTO and to the technical and commercial leaders who depend on your people’s availability.

Partnering Across the Matrix

  • Practice Technical Leads and the Principal Cloud Architect – they set technical direction and own quality; you make sure the people delivering it are organised, available and developing, and you surface where capacity puts delivery at risk.
  • Head of Pre-Sales – your peer. They own Solution Scoping; you coordinate the availability of consultants, engineers and Solution Architects to support it, and protect delivery capacity from being quietly eroded.
  • Project Management Office – a key collaborator. They own the project portfolio, governance and plans; together you agree what gets booked and resolve where project and non-project work compete for the same people.
  • Coordinators – you work hand in hand with the coordination function, enforcing the operating model and keeping scheduling clean.
  • CTO – your reporting line. You give a clear, honest picture of capacity, utilisation, team health and delivery risk across the practices.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven line management experience – a track record of managing, developing and retaining technical people such as consultants or engineers.
  • Strong resource, capacity or delivery management experience in a services, MSP, consultancy or professional services environment.
  • Comfortable operating in a matrix – managing people whose technical direction is set by someone else, without friction.
  • Excellent planning and organisation – able to hold a complex, shifting picture of who is doing what across multiple teams and keep it under control.
  • Confident resolving conflict – competing demands, over-allocation and difficult prioritisation calls, worked through with your peers to land amicable solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder management – credible with technical leaders, commercial leaders and senior leadership alike.
  • A clear, calm communicator – the kind of manager people trust and go to.

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Background in an IT services, MSP or cloud consultancy environment – familiarity with how technical delivery, PMO and pre-sales actually interact.
  • Experience managing or scheduling hybrid roles that flex across pre-sales and delivery, such as Solution Architects or overlay resource.
  • Exposure to a PSA or resource management platform such as ConnectWise, Autotask or similar.
  • Familiarity with utilisation, capacity and forecasting reporting.

Qualifications / Accreditations

  • People management or leadership qualification – ILM, CMI or equivalent (desirable).
  • Willingness to pursue further relevant professional development.

Who We’re Looking For

  • People-first – genuinely invested in the development and wellbeing of the people you manage.
  • Organised – calm under a shifting set of demands, and able to keep the plan clear when others cannot.
  • Decisive – makes the prioritisation call when two demands compete, and re-plans without drama.
  • Boundary-aware – comfortable owning the people and the plan while leaving technical direction to those who own it.
  • Collaborative – builds strong, trusting partnerships with technical and commercial leaders.



What you’ll get in return

As an Investors In People Platinum organisation, we pride ourselves on providing the highest quality experience for our people.

Financial

  • Life Insurance
  • Pension
  • Car allowance (subject to role)
  • £1,000 refer a friend bonus
  • Generous uncapped commission scheme (sales role)
  • Profit share bonus scheme (non-sales, subject to T&C’s)
  • Will writing contribution
  • Long Service Awards (financial and time rewards)
  • Electric Car Scheme (salary sacrifice)
  • Cycle to Work Scheme (salary sacrifice)
  • Buying holidays (salary sacrifice)
  • IT Equipment Purchase / Loan Scheme
  • Financial Wellbeing Tool
  • Pension Surgery (consultation with a financial advisor)
  • Discount scheme (retail, experience days, gym membership, etc.)
  • Travel and accommodation reward scheme (Navan Platform)

Health and Wellbeing

  • Private Medical Insurance – includes optical and dental
  • Employee Assistance Programme -for you and your family (Counselling, legal advice, career coaching, financial support)
  • Digital GP
  • Wisdom Wellbeing Platform
  • AVIVA Wellbeing Platform
  • Gym membership contribution
  • Gym time
  • Free onsite yoga (TIEVA North office only)
  • Free eye tests
  • Flu vaccinations
  • Fruit basket
  • Mental Health First Aiders

Time off

  • Holidays – above statutory increasing with service, plus 8 bank holidays
  • Birthday benefit -Have your birthday off on us!
  • Enhanced Maternity Pay
  • Enhanced Paternity Pay
  • Enhanced Adoption Pay
  • Compassionate Leave
  • Jury Duty top up pay
  • Funeral Leave
  • Volunteering Days

Supporting your development

  • Comprehensive onboarding plan
  • Funded training and accreditations
  • Monthly 121’s
  • Annual performance reviews
  • Professional Development Plans
  • Various internal training opportunities
  • Access to our Learning and Development Specialist

Perks

  • Welcome goodie bag
  • Company apparel
  • Free staff parties
  • Incentives, competitions and prizes including trips
  • Staff awards
  • Opportunity to join various teams, e.g. Culture Team, EDI Team, ESG Team
  • Free parking at either office location
  • High quality well-equipped offices – Table football, pinball, pool table, shuffleboard, air hockey, games consoles, darts, multi-faith room, bar, outdoor eating area (subject to location).


Why choose TIEVA?

We’re not your average technology company, we put people at the very centre of all we do. A career at TIEVA means giving you the opportunity to shape your future. We will provide you with all the tools you need to succeed, this isn’t just the basics, we are talking about the latest automation technology, weekly campaigns, holidays, prizes, and team incentives.

Further, faster - We know it’s important for you to keep moving forward, that’s why you’ll have the very best training opportunities. We invest heavily in our teams, culture, environment, and values which is reflected in us holding an Investors in People Platinum Standard accreditation and by us continuing to develop talent from within.

More than technology –TIEVA is a leading IT solutions and services provider operating within all industries. We have experienced phenomenal growth by adopting a people-first approach and providing exemplary service to our customers.

Real world, real career - Our focus is to deliver world class services and the best in technologies. You will work with the team to innovate yet always be looking to improve and deliver a portfolio of new products and services to our customers.

If you would be interested in joining a values-driven, highly reputable business with an inclusive, driven and highly committed team please apply ASAP!

Our promise to you….

If you have a disability or neurodiversity, we will provide support and adjustments that you may need throughout our recruitment process and beyond. Any information you share on your application will be treated in confidence.

TIEVA is an inclusive company where you can enjoy the career you want, without changing who you are. We welcome candidates from all walks of life and are passionate about promoting greater diversity in the tech sector.

OR

title: Keikkatyöntekijä, Hoivakoti Aavatar Lahti
description:
Etsimme nyt ikäihmisten kotiin Lahteen keikkatyöntekijää lämminhenkiseen, osaavaan työyhteisöömme. Aavatar sijaitsee luonnonkauniilla paikalla Lahden Jalkarannassa. Tänne on hyvät kulkuyhteydet ja matka Lahden keskustaan on noin 4 km.

– Olemme täällä sinua varten!

Me Attendolla olemme Matkalla kodiksi. Se merkitsee sitä, että haluamme olla ennen kaikkea koti ikäihmisille, vammaisille ja vammautuneille sekä mielenterveys- ja päihdekuntoutujille. Viimeisten vuosien aikana olemme onnistuneet johtamiseen, asiakaskokemukseen ja kohtaamisiin satsaamalla kasvattamaan niin läheis- ja asukastyytyväisyytemme kuin henkilöstötyytyväisyytemmekin historialliseen huippuun.

Jokainen asukkaamme ansaitsee tulla kohdatuksi omana itsenään ja elää täyttä elämää. Attendolaisena olet tärkeä osa tätä tehtävää.

Keikkatyöntekijänä voit tehdä työtä silloin, kun sinulle parhaiten sopii. Keikkatyö on joustavaa ja työkavereinasi on rautaisia hoiva-alan ammattilaisia. Voit valita itse kuinka paljon vuoroja teet – näin saat työn sovitettua esimerkiksi toisen työn, opiskelun tai perhevapaan rinnalle. Keikkatyön kautta sinulle voi halutessasi avautua mahdollisuuksia pidempiaikaisiin sijaisuuksiin tai vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Attendolla.

Työ on 2- tai 3-vuorotyötä ja työsuhteen aloituksen ajankohdasta voimme sopia kanssasi.

Tutustu meidän arkeemme Instagramissa: https://www.instagram.com/attendo.aavatar/ [https://www.instagram.com/attendo.aavatar/]

Mitä edellytämme sinulta?

* Sosiaali- ja terveysalan opintoja (esim. lähihoitajan tai hoiva-avustajan tutkinto tai opiskelija)

* Tartuntatautilain 48§:n tarkoittama rokotussuoja asiakkaiden ja potilaiden suojaamiseksi koko työsuhteen voimassaoloajan ajaksi

* Rikosrekisteriote yli kolmen kuukauden mittaisessa työsuhteessa (alaikäisten, iäkkäiden ja vammaisten kanssa toimiessa)

* Hygieniapassi tai valmius sen suorittamiseen kolmen kuukauden kuluessa työsuhteen aloittamisesta

* Sujuva suomen kielen taito

* Sote-ammattikortti eli varmennekortti

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Kuljemme rinnallasi
Attendolla esihenkilösi ei ole kaukana, vaan mukana arjessa – tukemassa ja kulkemassa rinnallasi. Meillä olet tärkeä osa moniammatillista tiimiä, joka tekee kodista kodin asukkaillemme.

Tuemme kehittymistäsi
Attendolla kehittymismahdollisuudet ovat täyttä totta, eivät pelkkää puhetta. Meillä on laaja koulutustarjonta, ja kannustamme kaikkia työntekijöitämme kouluttautumaan ja halutessaan myös etenemään urallaan.

Joustamme kanssasi
Tasapaino työelämän ja muun elämän välillä on meille tärkeää. Meillä voit työskennellä joustavasti keikkaillen.

Työsuhteen ehdoissa ja palkkauksessa noudatamme yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta.

Huomioithan, että olemme savuton työpaikka.

Kiinnostuitko? Hae meille työkaveriksi!

Hakuaikaa on 30.8.2026 asti, mutta älä jää odottamaan, vaan hyödynnä mahdollisuus päästä osaksi tiimiämme – täytämme paikan heti, kun sopiva hakija löytyy! Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Attendo-kodin johtaja. Lähetäthän työhakemuksesi vain rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta. Hakemuksen jättämisen yhteydessä pääset halutessasi vastaamaan myös lyhyeen videokysymykseen.

Täällä sinua varten

Attendo-kodin johtajan yhteystiedot:

Etunimi Sukunimi Mari Räsänen

Sähköposti mari.rasanen@attendo.fi [mari.rasanen@attendo.fi]

Puhelinnumero 044 494 3529

Rekrytointiprosessin päätyttyä tulemme lähettämään lyhyen kysymyksen, jolla kartoitamme hakijoiden tyytyväisyyttä rekrytointiprosessiimme.

----------------------------------------

Attendo – Tulevaisuuden hoivan suunnannäyttäjä



Attendo on Pohjoismaiden johtava hoivapalveluiden tarjoaja. Tehtävämme on vahvistaa ihmistä niin, että jokainen, joka meillä asuu, saa elää omannäköistään täyttä elämää.

Tarjoamme hoivaa ja asumispalveluita ikäihmisille, kehitysvammaisille, vammautuneille, päihde- ja mielenterveyskuntoutujille sekä terapian tarpeessa oleville.

Asukkaillemme olemme ennen kaikkea koti, sidosryhmillemme kumppani ja yhteiskunnassa vahva muutosvoima. Yli 18000 työntekijäämme palvelee yli 400 toimipisteessä ympäri Suomen.

Vahvistamme ihmistä. Katsomme eteenpäin. Ratkaisemme yhdessä. Me olemme Attendo.

title: Airbus Fleet Engineer - Avionic Systems
description:
The Fleet Engineer reports to the Airbus Technical Fleet Manager - Fleet Management and is responsible for the compliance of applicable CAR-AIR -OPS,CAR M and CAR 145 requirements in order to ensure the continuing airworthiness and to maintain the high aircraft safety standards.

Accountabilities

  • Review of all Airbus related Airworthiness Directives and mandatory Service Bulletins on the Etihad Airways Fleet to ensure that all mandatory modifications are properly assessed, decided, all the related assessments are performed and complied in a timely manner to maintain aircraft airworthiness and safety standards
  • Work with OEMs, MROs and internal departments to improve the fleet reliability, on-time performance and reduce cost
  • Create business cases for modifications and facilitate decision making in the Modification Review Committee
  • Compile Engineering Orders, Special Checks and Additional Engineering Requirements for the purpose of modification, aircraft status assessment for reliability and safety issues.
  • Support technical projects (e.g. EIS, end of aircraft lease, modification projects)
  • Ensures that all TFU/ FAIR are reviewed on regular basis and related advisories are issued
  • Ensures that all work is performed in accordance with internal processes and procedures

title: SPARC Safeguarding Implementation Lead
description:
Location: Any MSF office*

Contract: Permanent at 100%

Starting date: ASAP

Deadline to apply: 17th August 2026

Compensation and Benefits: MSF practice is to offer the compensation and benefits package in line with the MSF entity offering the contract.

*By default, the successful canddiate will be offered a contract in the MSF office of their country of residence at time of application.

I. CONTEXT

MSF is committed to creating a safe, respectful, and dignified environment for its patients, their caretakers, and the communities in which it works, and for all its volunteers and staff. To this end, all sections of MSF have adopted Behavioural Commitments designed to ensure all staff are aware of their obligations to create workspaces free from abuse and inappropriate behaviour. MSF is committed to safeguarding and ensuring zero tolerance of inaction on abuse.

MSF is continuously strengthening its safeguarding work, and safeguarding remains a top organizational priority. In line with this organization commitment, MSF has created an ambitious six-year plan to robustly, consistently, and cohesively implement safeguarding measures and actions and firmly embed a safeguarding culture across the MSF movement and within its country programmes through its Strategic Planning and Resource Cycle (SPARC).

SPARC is an ambitious plan, involving all MSF staff working in their respective roles to ensure safeguarding is institutionalized as a “way of working” and to ensure that MSF upholds the highest standards and implements best practices with respect to safeguarding in all of its offices and operations. To achieve its aims, MSF International will require additional safeguarding staff to ensure coordination and implementation of the work across MSF.

II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB

In addition to any other tasks assigned by the International Safeguarding Coordinator, the SPARC Safeguarding Implementation Lead drives the implementation, operationalisation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of MSF’s SPARC Safeguarding ambitions and strategic initiatives across the movement.

The role leads coordination and implementation efforts that translate safeguarding ambitions, commitments, policies, and standards into practical, measurable, and sustainable safeguarding practices across MSF.

The position advances safeguarding culture change by strengthening accountability, implementation oversight, monitoring, learning, and cross-functional collaboration aligned with MSF’s safeguarding ambitions to 2031 and in close collaboration with SPARC’s Accountability and Learning Officer

The role champions survivor-centred, trauma-informed, person-centred approaches and contributes to strengthening prevention, detection, reporting, response, accountability, and institutional learning on safeguarding across the Movement.

The SPARC Safeguarding Implementation Lead reports to and supports the International Safeguarding Coordinator (ISC) and works closely with: Operational Center Safeguarding/Behavioural Leads in all Operational Directorates, the International Platform On Behaviors (IPOB), the Ambassadors Network on Ethical Behaviour (ANEB), the SPARC’s Safeguarding Coordinating Mechanism, the SPARC’s Accountability and Learning Officer, the RIOD (International Platform for the Operational Directors), the IDRH (International platform for the HR Directors), the International Platform for the Medical Directors.

III. ACCOUNTABILITIES

1. Lead implementation of SPARC safeguarding ambitions and initiatives:

· Lead coordination and implementation follow-up of SPARC Safeguarding ambitions and strategic initiatives across the SPARC cycle.

· Translate common safeguarding ambitions into implementation plans, deliverables, milestones, accountability mechanisms, and measurable outcomes.

· Monitor movement-wide coordination of safeguarding initiatives across ODs, sections, and international platforms and report on implementation progress against safeguarding objectives and ambitions to 2031.

· Develop implementation guidance, tools, frameworks, templates, and operational resources.

Key Accountabilities:

  • Safeguarding ambitions are translated into practical implementation plans and operational deliverables.

  • Implementation progress is systematically tracked, monitored, and reported.

  • Common implementation approaches, tools, and guidance are developed and used across relevant stakeholders.

2. Drive safeguarding culture change and operationalisation:

. Drive integration of safeguarding as a core organizational practice across MSF offices, projects, and operational environments.

. Strengthen safeguarding accountability, leadership engagement, and operational ownership across functions and levels of the organization.

. Embed safeguarding responsibilities into organizational systems, operational planning, management practices, onboarding, and workforce processes.

. Support the ISC in cross-functional coordination with IDRH, MedOps, Dir Med, RIOD, ILD, DEI, and other key stakeholders.

Key Accountabilities:

  • Safeguarding is increasingly embedded into organisational systems, operational practices, and ways of working.

  • Safeguarding considerations are integrated into workforce and operational processes.

  • Cross-functional collaboration on safeguarding implementation is strengthened.

  • Organisational awareness and ownership of safeguarding responsibilities are increased across the movement.

3. Lead monitoring, accountability, learning, and continuous improvement:

. Monitor implementation progress, identify risks and gaps, and drive corrective and improvement actions where needed.

. Analyse safeguarding implementation trends, challenges, and lessons learned to inform strategic decision-making.

. Produce implementation reports, dashboards, briefing papers, presentations, and governance updates.

. Lead learning and knowledge-sharing initiatives related to safeguarding implementation and best practices.

. Coordinate safeguarding reviews, consultations, evaluations, and implementation follow-up processes

Key Accountabilities :

  • Monitor safeguarding implementation progress

  • Analyze implementation to support evidence-based strategic decision-making.

  • Produce high-quality reports, dashboards, briefing papers, presentations, and governance updates

  • Lead learning and knowledge-sharing initiatives to promote best practices and continuous improvement.

  • Coordinate safeguarding reviews, consultations, evaluations, and follow-up processes, ensuring recommendations are tracked and implemented.

IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY

The role advises IO, OD and Sections leadership on the implementation, operationalisation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of MSF’s safeguarding ambitions and strategic initiatives. The position needs to be able to organize and prioritize deliverables independently.

The role uses subject matter expertise, analysis, independent judgement and translates Safeguarding Ambitions and Strategic Initiatives and concepts into practical outputs and plans of action. This role works across internal stakeholders, influencing decisions, building consensus around safeguarding issues and strategies and autonomously champions survivor-centred, trauma-informed, person-centred approaches and contributes to strengthening prevention, detection, reporting, response, accountability, and institutional learning across the Movement.

V. SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE

The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others.

Education

A master's degree in relevant field such as international law, human rights OR a bachelor's degree combined with significant relevant experience in safeguarding.

Experience

A minimum of 3 years implementing safeguarding initiatives in operational/country programme contexts.

MSF experience is an asset.

Knowledge / Skills

· Strong understanding of safeguarding and safeguarding risks.

· Ability to translate strategic plans into pragmatic, implementable actions.

· Ability to coordinate and work with a range of stakeholders in a consultative mode to reach consensus on action.

· Strong writing skills and ability to communicate safeguarding concepts and present data clearly and simply to a range of audiences.

· A strong understanding of monitoring and evaluation.

Competencies

· Demonstrated ability to lead complex implementation and coordination initiatives across diverse stakeholders.

· Ability to influence organisational change in matrixed and multicultural environments.

· Strong strategic coordination and implementation management skills.

· Demonstrated ability to drive accountability and follow-through across multiple workstreams.

· Ability to navigate sensitive safeguarding issues with discretion, diplomacy, and sound judgement.

· Cross cultural awareness and commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion principles.

. Motivation to work in a humanitarian organisation and a fast paced, dynamic environment.

Languages

· English, French is an asset

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. MSF expects all staff to share this commitment and promote an environment where abuse and misconduct is not tolerated.

We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process.

Note: All offers of employment will be subject to reference checks, including Human Resources, and to appropriate screening checks. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms his/her/their understanding of these selection procedures.

title: Lead Decision Scientist, Revenue, Purchase & Order
description:
Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

The Revenue, Purchase & Order area spans three domains, which define the user experience through the entire escrow service funnel we offer at Vinted. From the value-driven pricing propositions, to smooth checkout and messaging experience, to the successful order fulfillment and addressing challenges when things go wrong. How do we optimise discounts for acceptable ROI and platform growth? How do we use pricing strategies for generating revenue without a cost on growth speed? How can we decrease cancellations through levers within and beyond your scope? And finally, how do we reduce friction for users’ order management? All these questions need guidance for measurement for us to be confident in steering the decision-making in the right direction.

We’re looking for a Lead Decision Scientist to join our Area DSA team to create impact by identifying and prioritising the most impactful problems to solve within this scope and ensuring they get resolved through influencing stakeholders, enabling your DSA peers to tackle them, or solving them on your own. We expect the Lead Decision Scientist to determine the right approach for each challenge.

You will report directly to the Area DSA lead, and will be part of the Area's DSA leads team. This setup will enable you to deliver impact across all three domains and will require close collaboration with all data roles and product directors for each domain.

In this position, you’ll

  • Identify, prioritise, and systematically resolve the most impactful Decision Science problems and opportunities across Pricing, Purchase & Order, ensuring solutions are effective, efficient, and viable long-term
  • Build alignment by engaging domain leadership, peers, fellow decision scientists, and cross-functional stakeholders to validate priorities, clarify, and measure trade-offs
  • Set and raise the standard for experimentation and decision-making across the scope by improving metrics, methods, interpretation, and how insights are translated into decisions
  • Be responsible for the measurability of success for key Marketplace Product programs within your scope
  • Partner with the domains' leadership to ensure measurability of OKRs and prioritise accordingly, where the input is needed the most
  • Be ready to own and deliver selected initiatives hands-on yourself

About you

  • Experience: You have proven experience in a Decision Science, Data Analytics, or Data Science role.
  • Analytical Mindset: You possess excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance the depth of your analysis with tangible business impact. You are highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes.
  • Statistical Foundation: You have strong knowledge of statistical methods, including experience running A/B tests, regression analysis, causal inference, and other inferential techniques. You can suggest alternative methods when standard approaches aren't the best fit.
  • Technical Expertise: You have strong skills in SQL and Python. You treat data code like software, valuing reproducibility, clarity, and performance. You are comfortable with giving and receiving code and methodology reviews, and Git is part of your daily workflow. You are also experienced with BI tools like Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Master Communicator: You are fluent in written and spoken English and can convincingly present complex results and statistical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. You are effective in influencing decision-making without authority through data, communication, and collaboration.

Work perks

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
