title: Learning Officer
description:
Learning Officer (Uganda Response Innovation Lab)

Country/Region: Uganda

Location: Kampala (SCI office) with 30% field travel

Organization: Save the Children International

Join us to lead sustainable change for children:

  • Be part of a GLOBAL and DIVERSE technical community
  • Get EXPOSURE in many different contexts
  • Test and scale up INNOVATIVE SOLUTIONS
  • Influence policies that affect MILLIONS OF CHILDREN

OVERVIEW

Ready to turn learning into impact? Join us in driving innovative solutions that improve the lives of children.

About the Response Innovation Lab (RIL) and U-RIL:The Response Innovation Lab (RIL) is a global network of field-based humanitarian platforms dedicated to strengthening innovation and learning ecosystems in crisis settings. It provides a collaborative platform for humanitarian, development, and private-sector actors to test, adapt, and scale solutions that improve outcomes for affected populations.In Uganda, the Uganda Response Innovation Lab (U-RIL)—hosted by Save the Children International—serves as the national platform within this global network. U-RIL brings together diverse actors including government agencies, UN organisations, NGOs, refugee-led and community-based organisations, the private sector, and academia. Its mandate is to foster collaboration, generate and share evidence, and promote innovation that strengthens Uganda’s refugee response. Through this role, U-RIL contributes to thought leadership, supports nexus programming, and ensures that policy and practice are informed by evidence and innovation.

About the Learning Hub:The Learning Hub (LH) is an innovative initiative of U-RIL that embeds cross-sectoral learning directly into Uganda’s refugee response. Conceived as a public good, the LH ensures that existing evidence—ranging from resources, data, and lived experiences—is systematically gathered, synthesised, and disseminated. Its purpose is to make evidence accessible and actionable for refugee response actors, helping them consolidate programming, improve decision-making, and drive systemic change in both policy and practice. The Learning Hub also plays a critical role in the Uganda Refugee Resilience Initiative (URRI), a multi-consortia effort, funded by the Royal Danish Embassy, led by Save the Children and the Danish Refugee Council. Within URRI, U-RIL leverages the Learning Hub to strengthen the evidence and learning agenda across consortia.

THE ROLE PURPOSE;

The candidate will be responsible for coordinating learning activities led by U-RIL.

He/she will work closely with the Learning Hub team to lead knowledge management efforts include support to collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation and management of data and resources, as well as coordination of learning activities across the two URRI consortia, thus contributing to the development of reports, mappings, digital solutions, events and publications. The ideal candidate is a team player who works well independently too. He/she will join our small but dynamic team under the Response Innovation Lab and be hosted at the Country Office of Save the Children International.

In the event of a major humanitarian emergency, the role holder will be expected to work outside the normal role profile and be able to vary working hours accordingly.

KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY:

  • Coordinate and contribute to the planning and implementation of evidence generation and learning activities, including studies, mappings, case studies, documentation exercises, learning reviews, and assessments.
    • Support the design of qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, data collection plans, and learning approaches in collaboration with the U-RIL team and consultants.
    • Support the development and quality assurance of data collection tools, including interview guides, questionnaires, surveys, observation tools, and online forms.
    • Ensure research and evidence generation activities adhere to ethical standards, safeguarding requirements, and quality assurance processes.
    • Support the design and implementation of a learning log in coordination with the URRI secretariat and Consortia MEAL teams
    • Support periodic reflection sessions, after-action reviews, pause-and-reflect meetings, and learning workshops to promote evidence-informed decision-making.
    • Coordinate the management, maintenance, and continuous updating of Learning Hub databases, including Settlement-Level Actor Mapping (SLAM), thematic actor mappings, partner directories, and evidence repositories.
    • Develop and maintain contact databases, stakeholder directories, and knowledge repositories to support evidence generation and dissemination.
    • Coordinate evidence collection and documentation activities across both URRI consortia, working closely with consortium partners, technical leads, consultants, and external stakeholders at district and national level
    • Serve as a focal point for coordinating learning activities with implementing partners, research institutions, government counterparts, UN agencies, private sector actors, and refugee-led organisations
    • Support the planning and delivery of learning events, workshops, webinars, dissemination meetings, and other knowledge-sharing platforms
    • Coordinate administrative and operational support required for the effective functioning of the Learning Hub, in collaboration with the U-RIL Programme Manager.
    • Prepare procurement requests and coordinate with Save the Children procurement and operations teams to ensure timely acquisition of goods and services.
    • Coordinate the collection, compilation, analysis, and reporting of Learning Hub output and outcome indicators in line with project workplans and donor reporting requirements.
    • Coordinate the collection and synthesis of partner feedback to inform adaptive management and continuous improvement of Learning Hub activities.
    • Ensure that activities are conducted in accordance with organisational quality standards, safeguarding policies, and ethical research principles.

To succeed in this role, you will need to have;

  • At least a bachelor’s degree in social sciences, Development studies, Economics, Statistics, Public policy, international development, Monitoring and Evaluation, Research methods, Information management, or another relevant field.
  • At least 3 years of progressively responsible experience in research, evidence generation, knowledge management, project coordination, monitoring and evaluation, or learning within humanitarian or development programmes
  • Experience planning and coordinating workshops, learning events, consultations, and dissemination activities.
  • Solid understanding of ethical requirements, including consent
  • Flexibility for regular travel to the refugee hosting districts
  • Curiosity for management concepts, innovative approaches and new technologies
  • Strong understanding of qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, data management and MEAL principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesise complex information into clear, actionable insights
  • Excellent project coordination, planning, and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including report writing and presentation skills.
  • Sector specific experience related to climate smart agriculture, market systems development, localization, resilience and self-reliance
  • Experience of photography/videography and content capture

Application Information:

Please apply using a cover letter and up-to-date CV as a single document. Please also include details of your current remuneration and salary expectations. A copy of the full role profile can be found at https://hcri.fa.em2.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/CX_1/

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions
  • Identify and resolve technical issues, ensuring the reliability and performance of applications

  • Proven track record of optimizing Spark performance within production-level projects
  • Strong proficiency in Python, specifically for complex data manipulation utilizing libraries like Polars or Pandas
  • Solid understanding of columnar data storage formats, particularly Parquet, with practical experience using Delta Tables
  • Proven expertise in data processing, analysis, and transformation workflows

Intermediate+

title: Lead Decision Scientist, Revenue, Purchase & Order
description:
Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

The Revenue, Purchase & Order area spans three domains, which define the user experience through the entire escrow service funnel we offer at Vinted. From the value-driven pricing propositions, to smooth checkout and messaging experience, to the successful order fulfillment and addressing challenges when things go wrong. How do we optimise discounts for acceptable ROI and platform growth? How do we use pricing strategies for generating revenue without a cost on growth speed? How can we decrease cancellations through levers within and beyond your scope? And finally, how do we reduce friction for users’ order management? All these questions need guidance for measurement for us to be confident in steering the decision-making in the right direction.

We’re looking for a Lead Decision Scientist to join our Area DSA team to create impact by identifying and prioritising the most impactful problems to solve within this scope and ensuring they get resolved through influencing stakeholders, enabling your DSA peers to tackle them, or solving them on your own. We expect the Lead Decision Scientist to determine the right approach for each challenge.

You will report directly to the Area DSA lead, and will be part of the Area's DSA leads team. This setup will enable you to deliver impact across all three domains and will require close collaboration with all data roles and product directors for each domain.

In this position, you’ll

  • Identify, prioritise, and systematically resolve the most impactful Decision Science problems and opportunities across Pricing, Purchase & Order, ensuring solutions are effective, efficient, and viable long-term
  • Build alignment by engaging domain leadership, peers, fellow decision scientists, and cross-functional stakeholders to validate priorities, clarify, and measure trade-offs
  • Set and raise the standard for experimentation and decision-making across the scope by improving metrics, methods, interpretation, and how insights are translated into decisions
  • Be responsible for the measurability of success for key Marketplace Product programs within your scope
  • Partner with the domains' leadership to ensure measurability of OKRs and prioritise accordingly, where the input is needed the most
  • Be ready to own and deliver selected initiatives hands-on yourself

About you

  • Experience: You have proven experience in a Decision Science, Data Analytics, or Data Science role.
  • Analytical Mindset: You possess excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance the depth of your analysis with tangible business impact. You are highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes.
  • Statistical Foundation: You have strong knowledge of statistical methods, including experience running A/B tests, regression analysis, causal inference, and other inferential techniques. You can suggest alternative methods when standard approaches aren't the best fit.
  • Technical Expertise: You have strong skills in SQL and Python. You treat data code like software, valuing reproducibility, clarity, and performance. You are comfortable with giving and receiving code and methodology reviews, and Git is part of your daily workflow. You are also experienced with BI tools like Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Master Communicator: You are fluent in written and spoken English and can convincingly present complex results and statistical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. You are effective in influencing decision-making without authority through data, communication, and collaboration.

Work perks

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • Access to a discounted gym membership plan
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted

Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

Hybrid Work

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.

Equal Opportunity

The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

description:
The Data Science team helps us fulfill our mission by informing strategy, defining success metrics, and identifying new ways to deliver user value. We understand our company’s goals and proactively inform their direction with data so that our product can help more teams do great things.

As a Data Scientist at Asana, you’ll help us ask the right questions and answer them rigorously. You’ll work closely with our Product and Business teams to understand their goals and proactively inform their direction with data. You’ll keep taking on new responsibilities as you grow—from defining core metrics to building machine learning models and keeping the data flowing in our pipelines

Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do, and your recruiter can share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of new product features.

  • Investigate high-level questions like “What are the collaborative patterns of the most successful teams using Asana?”

  • Add new metrics and aggregations to our data warehouse to make new classes of questions answerable.

  • Build models to predict the growth trajectory of different customer segments.

  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders across engineering, product management, and business teams to drive data-informed decision-making.

About you

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, Engineering, a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years of experience in applying data science techniques to drive technical product development and decision-making.

  • Strong technical background in statistics, mathematics, information science, or another heavily quantitative field.

  • Fluency in at least one modern language useful for data processing (such as Python or Scala).

  • Proficiency with relational data modeling and SQL.

  • Expertise in statistical methods and experimental design and analysis.

  • Experience with measurement techniques for search ranking, relevance, or quality assessments.

  • Experience with distributed data processing systems (such as Spark or Redshift).

  • Background in advanced statistical modeling (e.g., GLM, mixed effects) and/or machine learning techniques

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

title: Junior Consultant- Obstetrics and Gynecology
description:
Save the Children invites applications for the above-mentioned position. We are committed to equal employment opportunities, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, colour, ethnic origin, nationality, disability, age, or beliefs and religion. We are committed to diversifying our staff to better represent the communities we serve and actively welcome underrepresented groups to apply.

The Opportunity

Junior Consultant of Obstetrics and Gynae will be part of the technical leadership of the Hospital Program, with special focus on Sexual Reproductive Health in close collaboration with local health authorities, SRH working group and community members. Furthermore, the role is expected to engage with internal and external technical working groups and communities of practice. Junior consultants will work closely with the Pediatrician, Anesthesiologist, operation theatre staff and midwives, and will have direct communication with the other members of the clinical team. Capable of managing high-risk pregnancies and obstetric emergencies, including life-saving surgical and medical interventions. The role emphasizes mentorship, supervision, and continuous professional development of junior doctors, midwives, nurses, and allied health staff to build resilient teams and improve service delivery.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience practicing independently as an obstetric /Gynae (i.e., does not require supervision). Up to date evidence of current license and registration to practice.
  • Minimum of three months’ work/volunteering experience in Field hospital in low resource settings.
  • Ability and willingness to travel to remote and insecure locations and unstable areas.
  • Previous experience of managing obstetric complications often associated with humanitarian emergencies e.g. management of infectious diseases in pregnancy, clinical management of rape etc.
  • Familiar with the Minimum Initial Service Package (MISP) for reproductive health in humanitarian settings
  • Advanced life support, pediatric life support and neonatal life support trained or their equivalents
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a multicultural environment and establish harmonious and effective working relationships both inside and outside the organization.
  • MBBS with MCPS / DIPLOMA/ FCPS/ MS and equivalent degree in Gynae and obstetric recognized by the BMDC having at least 2 years job experience in gynae and obstetric field preferably in Low resource settings like Rohingya camps.

The Organisation

We employ approximately 25,000 people across the globe and work on the ground in over 100 countries to help children affected by crises, or those that need better healthcare, education and child protection. We also campaign and advocate at the highest levels to realise the rights of children and to ensure their voices are heard.

We are working towards three breakthroughs in how the world treats children by 2030:

• No child dies from preventable causes before their 5th birthday

• All children learn from a quality basic education, and that,

• Violence against children is no longer tolerated.

We know that great people make a great organisation, and that our employees play a crucial role in helping us achieve our ambitions for children. We value our people and offer a meaningful and rewarding career, along with a collaborative and inclusive workplace where ambition, creativity, and integrity are highly valued.

Application Information

Please apply using a cover letter and an up-to-date CV as a single document. Please also include details of your current remuneration and salary expectations

Only short-listed candidates will be invited for an interview

‘Save the Children promotes diversity in its workforce.’

We need to keep children safe, so our selection process reflects our commitment to the protection of children from abuse.

All employees are expected to carry out their duties in accordance with our global anti-harassment policy.

title: Digital Lead - Rare Portfolio

description:

About

"새로운 라이프스타일을 제시하는 오디오 콘텐츠 플랫폼, 코코지”

코코지는 세상에 없던 오디오 콘텐츠 경험을 만들어 다음 세대의 순수한 성장을 돕는 제품을
온/오프라인 양방향으로 제공하는 스타트업 입니다.

우리는 ‘듣는 경험’을 새롭게 정의합니다.
오디오북, 창작동화부터 동요, 클래식 음악과 영어, 역사, 과학 이야기, 백색소음까지,
우리의 일상을 풍요롭게 만들어 주는 모든 소리 콘텐츠가 코코지 모바일 앱 안에 있습니다.
그리고 그 오디오 경험을 더욱 특별하게 완성해주는 것은 코코지만의 인터랙티브 오디오
플레이어, 코코지 하우스와 아띠입니다.
우리는 ‘듣는 즐거움’을 통해 세상을 더 따뜻하게 바꾸고 있습니다.

"왜 세상에 없던 오디오 콘텐츠 플랫폼인가!"

세상에는 오디오 콘텐츠 회사도 있고, 디바이스 제조사도 있고, 모바일 앱 개발사도 있습니다.

코코지는 ‘듣는 경험’을 둘러싼 모든 것을 연구•개발하고 서비스합니다.
국내외 유명 IP와 출판사, 창작자들의 거대한 콘텐츠 플랫폼인 코코지 앱,

그리고 콘텐츠 제작자, 유통 파트너,
사용자와 커머스 시스템이 함께 성장하는 오디오 콘텐츠 생태계까지.

D1 is an athletic-based group training, and personal 1 on 1 training facility for adults as well as youth athletes as young as 7 with a mission of providing the best fitness philosophy and facility to its athletes, empowering them to improve themselves by efficiently and consistently reaching their fitness goals.
At D1, our promise to our athletes is: “You pick the goal, we help you get there” and D1 Coaches are the catalysts for our fulfillment of that promise. title: Senior Manager - Application Security Engineering EMEA
description:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.

About the Role

As Senior Manager, Professional Services – EMEA, you will lead Black Duck's regional Professional Services team, responsible for helping customers successfully adopt and operationalize application security solutions. You will manage a team of Implementation Consultants who transform customer investments in Black Duck technology into measurable business and security outcomes.

This role combines people leadership, customer engagement, operational management, and business partnership. You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Technical Account Managers, Product, Support, and Services leadership to ensure exceptional customer experiences while building a high-performing and scalable services organisation.

While this is a leadership position, it is not a purely managerial role. The successful candidate will remain actively engaged with customers, supporting strategic initiatives, executive relationships, complex delivery programmes, and critical business outcomes across the EMEA region.

As Senior Manager, Professional Services – EMEA, you will play a critical role in helping customers realise the full value of Black Duck solutions while shaping the future of our services organisation across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

Why This Opportunity

This is an opportunity to:

  • Lead a geographically distributed team of highly skilled services professionals.
  • Influence customer success at some of the world's most recognised software-driven organisations.
  • Shape the onboarding and adoption experience for customers across the EMEA region.
  • Partner with stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Technical Account Managers, Product, Support, and Engineering.
  • Help execute the regional services strategy.
  • Build scalable delivery models that drive both customer outcomes and business performance.

What You Will Do

Lead and Develop the EMEA Services Team

  • Build, inspire, and develop a high-performing team of Implementation Consultants.
  • Coach and develop team members to achieve their full potential.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
  • Support career development and skills growth initiatives.
  • Build regional capabilities aligned with evolving market and customer needs.
  • Recruit, retain, and develop top consulting talent across the region.

Deliver Exceptional Customer Outcomes

  • Ensure customers achieve measurable value from their Black Duck investments.
  • Oversee successful delivery of implementation, onboarding, advisory, and adoption services.
  • Drive consistency in delivery methodology, quality standards, and customer experience.
  • Engage directly with strategic customers and executive stakeholders to support complex programmes and critical initiatives.
  • Act as an escalation point for significant delivery challenges and customer concerns.
  • Champion customer success and long-term business outcomes.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Lead the operational management of the Professional Services organisation across EMEA.
  • Manage resource planning, utilisation, capacity forecasting, backlog management, and delivery performance.
  • Establish scalable processes, methodologies, and delivery standards.
  • Monitor key business metrics including service delivery performance, customer satisfaction, project health, and forecasting accuracy.
  • Continuously improve efficiency, predictability, and service quality.
  • Drive operational improvements that enable the business to scale effectively.

Partner Across the Business

  • Work closely with cross-functional leaders to drive customer success and business growth.
  • Collaborate with Sales teams to support strategic opportunities and services positioning.
  • Partner with Customer Success teams to accelerate customer adoption and time-to-value.
  • Work closely with Technical Account Managers to ensure seamless transitions from implementation to ongoing adoption.
  • Help define customer engagement strategies for key accounts.
  • Provide field insights to Product Management, Engineering, and Support teams.
  • Support the development of new services offerings and go-to-market initiatives.

Act as a Trusted Customer Advisor

  • Build executive-level relationships with strategic customers and help ensure successful outcomes throughout their journey with Black Duck.
  • Serve as a leadership sponsor for key customer engagements when needed.
  • Participate directly in customer meetings, business reviews, workshops, and strategic planning sessions.
  • Support critical customer situations and escalations while maintaining a focus on long-term partnerships.
  • Represent the Professional Services organisation both internally and externally.
  • Be visible and accessible to customers whenever leadership engagement is required.

Contribute to Business Growth

  • Help grow Black Duck's services business and strengthen customer relationships.
  • Support regional services bookings and revenue objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to expand customer engagement through onboarding, implementation, training, optimisation, and advisory services.
  • Contribute to regional planning and organisational strategy.
  • Drive initiatives that improve scalability and customer outcomes.

What You Will Bring

We are looking for a leader who combines technical credibility, business acumen, and a passion for helping teams and customers succeed.

Required Experience

  • Proven leadership experience managing Professional Services, Consulting, Customer Success, Technical Delivery, or Solutions organisations.
  • Experience leading distributed teams across multiple countries and cultures.
  • Strong customer-facing experience, including executive stakeholder engagement.
  • Experience managing services delivery operations, resource planning, forecasting, and capacity management.
  • Demonstrated success building and developing high-performing teams.
  • Strong business acumen and operational management skills.
  • Excellent communication, influencing, and leadership skills.

Technical and Industry Knowledge

  • Experience working within cybersecurity, application security, DevSecOps, SaaS, or enterprise software organisations.
  • Understanding of software development, secure development practices, DevOps, or related technology domains.
  • Ability to engage credibly with both technical teams and senior business leaders.
  • Experience supporting complex enterprise customer environments.

Helpful Experience, But Not Mandatory

  • Application security, SAST, SCA, DAST, IAST, software supply chain security, or related cybersecurity experience.
  • Experience leading Professional Services organisations through growth and organisational change.
  • Security certifications or relevant industry credentials.

What Success Looks Like

You will be successful when:

  • Your team consistently delivers high-quality projects and onboarding outcomes.
  • Team members are engaged, growing, and recognised as trusted advisors.
  • Resource utilisation, backlog management, and delivery performance are healthy and predictable.
  • You have built strong partnerships with Sales, Customer Success, and Technical Account Management teams.
  • Cross-functional teams view Professional Services as a strategic partner.
  • The EMEA services organisation scales effectively while maintaining quality and customer satisfaction.

Customers will see value when:

  • They achieve measurable value from their Black Duck investment.
  • They receive expert guidance throughout their implementation journey.
  • Projects are delivered efficiently and aligned to business objectives.
  • Their experience feels seamless across implementation, adoption, and ongoing success.
  • They experience a coordinated and customer-centric approach across Black Duck.
  • They receive a consistent experience regardless of geography or complexity.

Practical Details

Location: Flexible within EMEA

Travel: Occasional travel within EMEA for customer visits, team engagement, leadership meetings, and company events.

Reports To: Director of Professional Services

Team Scope: Responsible for leading the EMEA Professional Services organisation, including Implementation Consultants, while partnering closely with Customer Success and Technical Account Management teams to drive customer onboarding, adoption, and long-term success.

If This Sounds Like You

You are passionate about developing people, building trusted customer relationships, and helping customers achieve business outcomes from technology investments. You enjoy balancing leadership, operational excellence, and customer engagement, and you are comfortable working across teams to drive customer success.

If you are excited by the opportunity to help some of the world's leading organisations improve how they build secure software while leading a talented regional team, we would love to hear from you.

Join Black Duck and help shape the future of application security services across EMEA.

Black Duck is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran or military service status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Black Duck complies with all applicable laws prohibiting employment discrimination in every jurisdiction where it operates and provides reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.

We are proud to offer a range of development opportunities, including mentorship, training, and career progression pathways, to help our colleagues grow and succeed. We also celebrate diversity through various initiatives and events, fostering a culture of inclusion and respect. title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
Why Join HYCU?

HYCU is the fastest-growing leader in the multi-cloud and SaaS data protection as a service industry. By bringing true SaaS-based data backup and recovery to on-premises, cloud-native, and SaaS IT environments, the company provides unrivaled data protection, migration, disaster recovery, and ransomware protection to thousands of companies worldwide. The company's award-winning R-Cloud platform eliminates complexity, risk, and the high cost of legacy-based solutions, providing data protection simplicity to make it the #1 SaaS Data Protection platform. With an industry leading NPS score of 91, HYCU has raised $140M in VC funding to date and is based in Boston, Mass. Learn more at www.hycu.com.


Overview


We are building next-generation Generative AI products that deliver actionable data insights at enterprise scale. Quality, reliability, and trust are critical for AI-driven systems. Our QA and Automation team ensures that AI workflows, data pipelines, and platforms are robust, observable, and production-ready.


Job Summary (Essential Functions)


  • Design and implement automated test frameworks for AI, data, and application workflows.
  • Validate end-to-end AI pipelines including data ingestion, model inference, and outputs.
  • Test AI model behavior for accuracy, consistency, and regressions.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to improve testability and quality.
  • Monitor system health and proactively identify quality risks.


Technical Skills & Job Requirements


  • Strong experience in test automation and quality engineering.
  • Hands-on experience with API testing and backend validation.
  • Experience testing data pipelines or data-driven systems.
  • Proficiency in scripting or programming languages such as Python.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing integration.


Responsibilities


  • Build and maintain automated test suites for AI and data platforms.
  • Validate AI outputs and detect regressions or anomalies.
  • Work closely with developers to resolve defects and improve quality.
  • Define quality metrics, dashboards, and monitoring signals.
  • Contribute to best practices for testing AI-driven systems.


Education & Experience


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in QA, automation, or software testing roles.
  • Experience testing enterprise-scale or data-intensive applications.
  • Exposure to AI, ML, or analytics systems is a strong plus.



Attributes of a Successful HYCUer in this role:

  • Self-starter and strategic thinker who thinks outside the box
  • Takes responsibility and ownership for driving successful outcomes. You’re results-driven with a winning attitude
  • Team player! You have excellent people and management skills to interact with staff, colleagues, cross-functional teams and third parties
  • Hands-on and builders' mentality with an entrepreneurial mindset and intrinsic motivation
  • Obsessed with being customer-focused - We know our customers and are advocates for their voice and point of view across HYCU
  • Intellectual curiosity, always open for continuous learning/growth mindset


Who We Are:

Our Core Values: Authenticity, Grit and Empathy are at the heart of everything we do at HYCU. All of us at HYCU take ownership in shaping and contributing to our culture. We pride ourselves in developing an inclusive and diverse company that supports our employees and customers to do extraordinary things.

The following is how we approach each Core Value:

  • Authenticity – To be authentic means to be who we are and do it well. Focus your energy on being who YOU are. Be true to yourself. Authenticity also extends to our products. Understanding where we are truly the best fit for our customers and when we are not. And finally, authenticity in relationships: ensuring that we are honest and do what we say we’re going to do.
  • Grit – To win we need to want it. Every team member needs to be able to jump in and help at every turn. Whether it’s staying late to help a colleague or customer or finding a better process and making sure it’s communicated cross-functionally. You just have to do it and love it…and never stop trying.
  • Empathy – We need to care about each other, about our clients, about our business, and about the world around us. That might seem like a tall order, but if we don’t live in a constant state of empathy, if we don’t strive to truly put ourselves in another person’s shoes, we cannot truly serve the market.

"We are at our best when we stay true to our Core Values."~ Simon Taylor, CEO

What We Offer:

Come work for one of CRN’s “Cloud 100 Companies for 2026”. At HYCU you’ll have the opportunity to build your career with a “Visionary” B2B SaaS company from Gartner’s Magic Quadrant for BackUp and Data Protection Platforms. HYCU provides an excellent benefits package including Medical Insurance, generous time off, and more. We offer career development programs and an inclusive global culture. All our employees participate in our equity program.

Equal Opportunity Employer

HYCU is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

title: Arbetsterapeut till Karlslundsgården
description:
Vill du bli vår nya kollega? Om du är en arbetsterapeut med ett starkt engagemang för människor, intresse för välfärdsteknik och nyfikenhet på framtiden, då är det här tjänsten för dig!

Om tjänsten

Karlslundsgården är Örebro kommuns enda särskilda boende med inriktning välfärdsteknik. Vi hittar lösningar genom att tillsammans tänka utanför boxen och använder digitala möjligheter för att bidra till ökad trygghet, säkerhet och självständighet för våra hyresgäster.

Som arbetsterapeut hos oss samarbetar du med hyresgäster i det dagliga livet med fokus på att ta tillvara individens egna förmågor och resurser. Du kommer att dela ansvar med en arbetsterapeutkollega och jobba i team tillsammans med våra hyresgäster, sjuksköterskor, omvårdnadspersonal och enhetschef. Vi jobbar med ett rehabiliterande förhållningssätt i grunden, där vi utgår från hyresgästens målsättning och där alla är viktiga för en helhet. Du kommer tillsammans med våra aktivitetsombud vara drivande i arbetet med aktiviteter och delta i dem för att möjliggöra en glädjefylld och stimulerande vardag för våra hyresgäster. Med hjälp av nyfikenhet, lyhördhet och nyttjande av nya tekniska lösningar kan vi ge våra hyresgäster ett så självständigt liv som möjligt. Vi vågar tänka nytt och kreativt, och vi hoppas att du vill vara en del av det arbetet!

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:

  • utföra arbetsterapeutiska bedömningar med standardiserade instrument samt prova ut hjälpmedel
  • planera, genomföra och följa upp rehabiliteringsåtgärder
  • utbilda, informera och handleda övriga professioner samt studenter
  • ha en ledande roll på teamträffar
  • ha kontakt med och ge stöd till anhöriga och närstående

Om arbetsplatsen

Du hittar Karlslundsgården på Gäddestavägen 2 i Karlslund. Här lever våra upp till 72 hyresgäster livet på sina egna villkor och vi har äran att få stötta dem i vardagen. Genom att ta tillvara på innovativa tekniklösningar som sensorgolv, nyckeltaggar och mycket mer skapar vi förutsättningar för våra hyresgäster att leva ett både tryggare och självständigare liv. Vi har 8 avdelningar med inriktning somatik och kognitiv svikt, varav en avdelning har teckenspråksinriktning. Här finns gemensamma ytor, personalutrymmen, parboendemöjligheter och flera gemensamma balkonger. I den mysiga trädgården i söderläge finns växthus, odlingar, lusthus, konstverk, en liten damm, boulebana och promenadstråk med sittplatser.

För att sätta guldkant på våra hyresgästers vardag anordnar vi mycket aktiviteter i huset. I vårt närområde finns också många unika förutsättningar såsom hästar, grillplats, kyrkans trädgård och lokaler, skogen, herrgården m.m. Vill du få ett smakprov på vad vi har för oss just nu? Kolla in våra sociala medier "https://www.facebook.com/karlslundsgarden/" på Facebook eller "https://www.instagram.com/karlslundsgardenvobo/" på Instagram med vår hashtag #pådinavilkor.

https://www.orebro.se/omsorg--stod/boenden/sarskilt-boende-for-aldre/lista/2017-10-25-karlslundsgarden.html

Som arbetsterapeut på Karlslundsgården kommer du ingå i Hälso- och sjukvårdsorganisationen (HS) där vi samlar alla sjuksköterskor och arbetsterapeuter inom kommunens särskilda boenden under en och samma organisation. På så vis kan vi skapa bättre förutsättningar, jämlik vård och värna om Örebro kommuns hälso- och sjukvårdsresurser. För dig som arbetsterapeut innebär det även att du får en chef som i grunden är legitimerad och därmed är väl insatt i de frågor du står inför i arbetet.

Läs mer om hur det är att jobba inom Örebro kommun och vård och omsorg på https://www.orebro.se/jobb/socialtarbete

Kvalifikationer

Som arbetsterapeut är du trygg i dig själv och har god självinsikt. Du trivs med att ha egna ansvarsområden och tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter på ett självständigt och strukturerat sätt. Att vara lyhörd och tillmötesgående i ditt bemötande, både mot kollegor och patienter, ser du som en självklarhet. Du är tydlig i din kommunikation och har förmåga att säkerställa att information når fram. Dessutom har du lätt att anpassa dig efter ändrade omständigheter och ser möjligheter i förändringar, vilket blir särskilt viktigt för att vi ska kunna ta tillvara på ny teknik!

Vidare behärskar du det svenska språket på ett sätt så att du kan kommunicera med hyresgäster och övrig personal, samt dokumentera det som verksamheten kräver. Då arbetet innefattar digital dokumentation i verksamhetssystem krävs god datorvana.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Krav:

  • legitimerad arbetsterapeut
  • B-körkort

Meriterande:

  • erfarenhet av arbete som arbetsterapeut
  • erfarenhet av arbete med personer med kognitiv svikt
  • erfarenhet av arbete med välfärdsteknik

Omfattning och tillträde

Anställningsform: tillsvidareanställning

Sysselsättningsgrad: 100%

Tillträde: enligt överenskommelse

Antal tjänster: 1

Övrig information

Intervjuer kan komma att ske digitalt. På http://www.orebro.se/jobb/digitalaintervjuer kan du läsa mer om våra digitala intervjuer och hur du kan förbereda dig.

Under rekryteringsprocessen kommer det ske en legitimationskontroll via Socialstyrelsen samt kontroll hos Inspektionen för vård och omsorg.

Innan du erbjuds en anställning inom vård- och omsorgsarbete behöver du visa upp registerutdrag ur misstanke- och belastningsregistret.

Ansökan

Sista ansökningsdag är 13 augusti men vi tillämpar löpande urval så varmt välkommen med din ansökan redan idag!

Skyddade personuppgifter? Läs mer om hur du ansöker på https://www.orebro.se/jobb/skyddadepersonuppgifter

title: Senior Engineer, Occupational Safety
description:
In this position...
﻿The Senior Engineer, Occupational Safety, working without supervision, is the site health and safety subject matter expert responsible for developing innovative solutions to occupational safety and security concerns such as hazard control and prevention, safety systems and equipment, compliance, risk, etc. with consistency in a timely manner. The role may work with other team members in the implementation of the Company’s Safety Operating System (SOS) and plant-wide safety processes such as emergency response planning, safety training, and with the application of technical standards, principles, theories, and concepts. The role would also take on project leadership to guide other team members to continuously improve occupational safety programs.

What you'll do...

  • Guides other team members for the implementation of plant-wide safety processes including safety operating system, emergency response planning, and safety training orientations, by providing expertise on the application of occupational safety programs.
  • Participates in the implementation of regular inspections and audits to identify and assess workplace hazards, unsafe conditions, risks, and related issues such as safety equipment and systems, hazard identification, risk evaluation, preventive maintenance completion, etc. to ensure compliance with all federal, state, local laws, regulations and Corporate Safety and Health policies. Communicates effectively and acts as a liaison with statutory authorities, regulatory bodies, and corporate representatives.
  • Supports and participates in launch activities of new projects, safety/ergonomic risks for new equipment/ processes, off-standard understanding, approvals, etc., and guides engineers for their consistent implementation across responsible locations.
  • Consults with multiple cross-functional leaders for accident investigations and near misses, applies risk management expertise to properly identify underlying causes and guides the development and implementation of corrective actions without compromising functional integrity, intended purpose, or efficiency of the equipment, process, or procedure that posed the initial safety hazard. Facilitates and conducts presentations at health and safety meetings and participates as required in the facility operating system.
  • Conducts needs assessment and identifies requirements for new training programs to prevent employee injuries and illnesses and the elimination of hazards in the work environment. Assists in the oversight of employee training programs and can present safety training materials as needed.
  • Leads the delivery of Occupational Safety and Security projects partnering with external auditors/consultants and with other functional leaders. Leverages expertise across occupational safety and related disciplines to design creative solutions to critical safety and security issues ensuring alignment with the organization’s objectives and policies. Represents the organization as the prime contact in interactions with senior external personnel involving significant technical complexities as a part of these projects.
  • Designs Occupational Safety specific communications and standards in response to new and emerging occupational safety concerns to encourage the adoption of safety practices, focused on incident avoidance and regulatory compliance. Liaises with the plant and network medical, security functions, and UAW Health & Safety Representatives.
  • Supports and leads continuous improvement initiatives in partnership with senior leaders across Health and Safety initiatives and provides recommend updates to existing Occupational Safety function-specific policies, guidelines, programs, and procedures related to safety in the workplace, hazardous materials management, industrial hygiene monitoring, equipment safety systems, etc.
  • Demonstrates expertise in technical occupational safety subjects such as risk assessment and hazard identification, incident investigation, injury statistics reporting, safety program development, industrial hygiene and exposure monitoring, safety equipment and systems, etc. along with a strong understanding of related concepts and principles. Counsels and advises leaders across responsible locations with respect to safety objectives to emphasize a proactive approach to providing a safe working environment.

You'll have...
Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Master’s Degree (preferred) in Occupational Health & Safety, Safety/Health Sciences, or any other related discipline.

Experience:

  • Minimum 1 year of occupational safety work experience with a Master’s degree or 2 years of work experience with a Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Health and Safety, Occupational Safety, or a related field.

Licenses and Certifications:

  • Certified Safety Professional (Preferred)
  • Certified Industrial Hygienist (Preferred)

Work Requirements:

  • Involves frequent (defined as one to two-thirds of the time) lifting of more than 10 to 25 pounds. Work performed requires a good deal of walking or standing and may include some sedentary work and working conditions that include moderate noise levels related to the use of office equipment or machinery. May involve exposure to varying outside temperatures.

This description outlines the general nature and scope of work typically performed in this job. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, knowledge, skills, work requirements, etc. It may vary slightly based on business or geographic needs and is subject to being reviewed and updated periodically.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

  • Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
  • Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
  • Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more
  • Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
  • Tuition assistance
  • Established and active employee resource groups
  • Paid time off for individual and team community service
  • A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day
  • Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

This position is a salary grade 8 and ranges from $99,100-$166,200.
Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Software Engineer specializing in .NET MAUI to join our cross-platform mobile development team. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain high-performance applications that run seamlessly on Android, iOS, from a single shared codebase. You will work closely with product managers, UX designers, and backend engineers to deliver polished, production-grade experiences to our users.

As a senior member of the team, you will also mentor junior developers, contribute to architectural decisions, and champion engineering best practices across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain cross-platform applications using .NET MAUI targeting Android, iOS.
  • Architect scalable, maintainable solutions following MVVM, Clean Architecture, and SOLID principles.
  • Implement native platform integrations and custom renderers/handlers where platform-specific behaviour is required.
  • Proficiency with platform-specific APIs on Android (Java/Kotlin interop) and iOS (Swift/Obj-C interop).
  • Collaborate with UX/UI designers to translate wireframes and mockups into responsive, accessible user interfaces.
  • Integrate RESTful APIs and backend services with robust error handling.
  • Write comprehensive unit tests, integration tests, and UI tests using xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest along with Appium or similar frameworks.
  • Optimize application performance including startup time, memory usage, rendering, and battery consumption.
  • Conduct code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and mentor junior and mid-level engineers.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Stay current with .NET MAUI releases, Xamarin migration paths, and the broader .NET ecosystem.
  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated building, testing, and deployment of mobile applications.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 8+ years of professional software development experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with .NET MAUI or Xamarin.Forms (with demonstrated MAUI migration expertise).
  • Proficiency with platform-specific APIs on Android (Java/Kotlin interop) and iOS (Swift/Obj-C interop).
  • Experience consuming and integrating RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs.
  • Solid knowledge of dependency injection, asynchronous programming (async/await), and reactive patterns.
  • Familiarity with Git-based workflows, pull request culture, and branch strategies (GitFlow, trunk-based).
  • Strong debugging, profiling, and performance-tuning skills across multiple target platforms.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Good to Have

  • Knowledge of platform-specific design systems (Material Design, Apple Human Interface Guidelines, Fluent Design).
  • Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or App Center for CI/CD.
  • Familiarity with SQLite, Realm, or other embedded databases for local data persistence.
  • Experience with accessibility standards (WCAG) and building inclusive applications.
  • Contributions to open-source .NET or MAUI community projects.

title: Product Manager - AI Neobank App
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in India. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in India.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Arbetskonsulent till Vetlanda, Clustera Sverige
description:
Arbetskonsulent till Steg till Arbete i Vetlanda

Om oss

Clustera Sverige AB är en del av APM Group som startades 1994 i Australien. Koncernen har närmare 18 000 medarbetare med verksamhet i 11 länder runt om i världen. APM hjälper över två miljoner människor varje år att leva ett bättre liv och tillhandahåller tjänster med fokus på att få deltagare närmare en anställning eller utbildning.

Verksamheten i Sverige omfattar cirka 140 medarbetare. Clustera levererar arbetsmarknadstjänster och program i hela landet. Vi har ett genuint intresse av att hjälpa människor att komma vidare i både livet och karriären, och under åren har vi gjort det med mycket goda resultat och hög kvalitet.

Vi är ISO-certifierade inom ISO 14001 och ISO 9001.

Vad innebär det att vara en del av Clusteras team?

Clustera är ett etablerat bolag där det är högt i tak och kreativitet och nytänkande välkomnas. Vi ingår i en global koncern med lång erfarenhet från internationella matchningstjänster. Med stabil värdegrund vägleder vi i alla lägen.

På Clustera tror vi på människors förmågor och brinner för att stödja och lyfta dem. Vårt mål i mötet med andra är att motivera och inspirera till nya möjligheter. Det gäller både våra deltagare och samarbetspartners, men även våra medarbetare och samhället i övrigt.

Tjänsten

Det är en spännande tjänst där du kommer att möta en bred målgrupp. Tjänsten, Steg Till Arbete (STA), är ett samarbete med Arbetsförmedlingen, där målet är att deltagarna ska få en arbetsträning och/eller anställning med hjälp av insatsen.

Tjänsten som arbetskonsulent är på heltid. Du ingår i ett team tillsammans med en till arbetskonsulent och en arbetsterapeut. I tjänsten ingår även dokumentation, planering och att utvärdering av resultat. För att trivas i rollen behöver du vara flexibel, ha förmåga att arbeta självständigt såväl som i team och vara van att arbeta med en bred målgrupp. Vi ser gärna att du har intresse av att nätverka.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Behörighetskrav

Som arbetskonsulenten behöver du ha minst två års högskole- eller yrkeshögskoleutbildning på heltid inom sociologi, beteendevetenskap, pedagogik eller medicin samt minst ett års erfarenhet på minst halvtid av individuell eller grupphandledning/coaching av personer med psykisk eller fysisk ohälsa alternativt funktionsvariation under de senaste tre åren. Vi behöver uppvisa utbildningsintyg samt tjänstgöringsintyg som styrker kraven för Arbetsförmedlingen.

Behärskar svenska språket i tal och skrift.

Vad vi kan erbjuda dig

Clusteras medarbetare är vår viktigaste tillgång, och därför vill vi erbjuda en roll som både inspirerar och ger dig stort handlingsutrymme. Vi drivs av att se människor utvecklas, och vi ger dig möjligheten att använda din kompetens och kreativitet i arbetet. Tillsammans med din coachande chef får du stöd i att forma din karriär, fortsätta växa och nå dina mål.

title: Associate Vice President
description:
This role is for one of the Weekday's clients

Salary range: Rs 2500000 - Rs 5000000 (ie INR 25- 50 LPA)

Min Experience: 8+ years

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
JobType: full-time

We are seeking an experienced Associate Vice President – Identity & Access Management (IAM) to lead the strategy, implementation, and governance of enterprise identity and access management initiatives. The ideal candidate will have 8–11 years of experience in designing and managing IAM programs, with deep expertise in SailPoint and modern Identity & Access Management practices. This leadership role requires a strong technical background, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to build and mentor high-performing teams while driving enterprise security initiatives.

As an AVP, you will work closely with cybersecurity, infrastructure, application development, compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure secure, compliant, and scalable identity lifecycle management across the organization.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the enterprise Identity & Access Management (IAM) program, ensuring alignment with organizational security and compliance objectives.
  • Design, implement, and optimize IAM solutions using SailPoint IdentityIQ or SailPoint Identity Security Cloud.
  • Oversee identity lifecycle management, including user provisioning, de-provisioning, access requests, role management, and certification processes.
  • Develop and enforce IAM governance frameworks, policies, standards, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with security, infrastructure, HR, and application teams to integrate IAM solutions across enterprise applications and cloud platforms.
  • Drive automation of identity governance processes to improve operational efficiency and reduce security risks.
  • Manage privileged access, segregation of duties (SoD), role-based access control (RBAC), and least-privilege principles.
  • Support internal and external audits by ensuring compliance with security standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor IAM operations, identify improvement opportunities, and implement scalable security controls.
  • Lead incident resolution related to identity and access issues while ensuring minimal business disruption.
  • Mentor, guide, and develop IAM engineers and technical leads, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous learning.
  • Partner with senior leadership to define IAM roadmaps and strategic initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
  • 8–11 years of experience in Identity & Access Management, cybersecurity, or enterprise security engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ, SailPoint Identity Security Cloud, or equivalent SailPoint solutions.
  • Deep understanding of Identity & Access Management (IAM) concepts, including identity governance, authentication, authorization, federation, and access lifecycle management.
  • Experience implementing RBAC, access certifications, identity provisioning, password management, and access governance.
  • Knowledge of enterprise authentication protocols such as SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and LDAP/Active Directory.
  • Familiarity with cloud IAM services and enterprise security architecture.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

Must-Have Skills

  • Identity & Access Management (IAM)
  • SailPoint
  • Identity Access Management
  • Identity Governance
  • Access Lifecycle Management
  • Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
  • Access Certification
  • User Provisioning & De-provisioning
  • Authentication & Authorization
  • Enterprise Security

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Team Leadership
  • People Management
  • Project Management
  • Cybersecurity Governance
  • Risk & Compliance
  • Cloud Security (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Privileged Access Management (PAM)
  • ITIL or Agile methodologies
  • Security Automation

Preferred Attributes

  • Proven experience leading technical teams and delivering enterprise-scale IAM transformations.
  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong decision-making and strategic planning capabilities.
  • Relevant certifications such as SailPoint Certified IdentityIQ Engineer, CISSP, CISM, or similar security certifications are highly desirable.
  • Passion for building secure, scalable, and compliant identity ecosystems while mentoring teams and driving operational excellence.

title: Persoonlijk Begeleider dagbesteding
description:
Krijg jij energie van de geur van verf en papier en het begeleiden van mensen? Bij werk- en dagbesteding 'De Sam' op het groene Landpark Assisië zoeken we een aanpakker. Een baan waar zorg, ambacht en creativiteit prachtig samenkomen!

Wat ga je doen?

De Sam is een bruisende plek met een eigen winkel en werkplaats. Hier is altijd reuring en draait alles om wat mensen wél kunnen. Jij neemt de afdeling schilderswerkplaats en de papierschepperij onder je hoede.

  • Kijken naar de mens: Je werkt met cliënten met een lichte tot (zeer) ernstige verstandelijke beperking. Jij ziet precies wat iemand nodig heeft en past het werk daarop aan, zodat iedereen op zijn eigen niveau meedoet.

  • Jouw Passie: Met je handen in de verf werk je met de cliënten aan mooie producten voor in onze winkel. Van het opzetten van een schilderij tot de verkoop ervan: jullie doen het samen.

  • Samenwerken: Je viert de kleine en grote successen niet alleen, maar met een hecht en gezellig team van collega's, vrijwilligers en lokale kunstenaars.

Wat bieden wij?

Onze medewerkers zijn het hart van onze organisatie. En daar zijn wij enorm trots op! Daarom bieden wij:

  • Een contract voor de duur van 1 jaar met intentie tot verlenging voor onbepaalde tijd.

  • Een contract voor 24 tot 28 uur met een optie tot meer uren in combinatie met wonen.

  • Een eerlijk salaris van €2.893 - €3.902 bruto per maand op fulltime basis [FWG 40 voor persoonlijk begeleider CAO gehandicaptenzorg].

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: Een netto vergoeding voor je woon-werkverkeer.

  • Aandacht voor jou als persoon. Daarom krijg je van ons naast vakantie-uren ook balansverlof- uren die flexibel zijn in te zetten.

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%, korting op je sportabonnement en nog vele extra’s.

  • Ruimte voor scholing en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

  • Kom je in dienst bij Prisma en ken jij iemand die goed bij ons past? Draag een nieuwe collega aan en ontvang een aanbrengbonus van €500,- na het succesvol doorlopen van de proeftijd.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die nuchter is, stevig in de (werk)schoenen staat en makkelijk schakelt. Jouw basis bestaat uit:

  • De juiste papieren (of de drive om ze te halen): Je hebt een afgerond zorg- of welzijnsdiploma op zak (denk aan MBO 4 Zorg & Welzijn, Social Work of Pedagogiek). Heb je deze nog niet, maar ben je wel supergemotiveerd om je papieren alsnog te behalen? Ook dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek!

  • Gevoel voor creatieve activiteiten: Je hoeft echt geen kunstenaar te zijn, maar je hebt overduidelijk affiniteit met kunst en vindt het leuk om creatief bezig te zijn.

  • Een flexibele mindset: Je bent een kameleon in de zorg. Je thuisbasis is de schilderwerkplaats of de papierschepperij, maar je vindt het geen probleem om even in te springen bij andere disciplines binnen De Sam als de dag daarom vraagt. (Verder werk je doordeweeks en overdag, en vind je een sporadisch weekend-evenement prima).

Enthousiast geworden?

Zie jij jezelf al werken bij Prisma als begeleider? Wacht dan niet langer en solliciteer vandaag nog. Heb je vragen?

Neem gerust contact op met Betty Verhagen (teamleider de Sam) +31649345132.

Wij kunnen niet wachten om jouw sollicitatie te ontvangen en je te verwelkomen in ons team!
