title: Senior Project Manager-DRR, Emergency & Humanitarian Response
description:
The Organization:

Lutheran World Relief, which is part of Corus International, has been present in Nepal since 2011. Corus International is the parent of a family of world-class organizations working to deliver the holistic, lasting solutions needed to end extreme poverty once and for all. We are a global leader in international development, with 150 years of combined experience across our brands. Our nonprofit and for-profit subsidiaries include IMA World Health and its fundraising brand Corus World Health, Lutheran World Relief, CGA Technologies, Ground Up Investing, and Farmers Market Brands. In Nepal, Corus operates under Lutheran World Relief. Our more than 400 employees around the globe are experts in their fields and dedicated to helping the world's most vulnerable people break the cycle of poverty and lead healthy lives.

At Corus we believe that good only grows stronger and we reflect that belief in our workplace culture. We value every employee's specialized area of expertise and nurture professional growth. We promote an engaging and supportive work environment, where employees feel enabled and driven to innovate, learn and collaborate. And because our subsidiaries often function as partners, our employees have the opportunity to work across our enterprise family.

Job Brief:

Position Summary: This position will be an employee of Lutheran World Relief. The RISE Fund project strengthens disaster preparedness, governance, and resilience in Nepal's most vulnerable provinces, Karnali and Sudurpaschim. The program runs across multiple sectors to reduce humanitarian risks and build inclusive disaster risk management systems.

The program has four interlinked components:

  • Emergency Preparedness & Coordination - establishing rapid response teams, provincial search and rescue units, and activating emergency operations centers.
  • Shelter & Relief Support - pre-positioning emergency supplies, constructing temporary shelters, and ensuring rapid deployment within 24-72 hours after disasters.
  • Health & WASH Services - training health workers, deploying mobile medical camps, distributing dignity kits, and restoring safe water and sanitation systems.
  • Protection & Logistics - providing mental health and psychosocial support, safeguarding vulnerable groups, and creating an emergency transportation fund for rapid deployment.

The project aims to work with the provincial government to enable them to target 13 priority districts and 116 municipalities, directly benefiting over 30,000 individuals and indirectly reaching more than 500,000 people.

The Senior Project Manager- DRR, Emergency and Humanitarian Response Manager (DEHRM)'s core functions are to manage anticipated DRR, Emergency and Humanitarian Response including identifying and supporting local partners, implementing projects, representing LWR in the government and non-government sector in federal and provincial level. The DEHRM will oversee and monitor the implementation of anticipated DRR, Humanitarian and Emergency Response project activities in close coordination with federal and provincial governments stakeholder along with peer agencies, manage local implementing partners, and ensure the program quality; and meet the highest international as well as Donor's standards of implementation.

Responsibilities:

Program Management: 20%

  • Support in design and implement DRR, emergency and humanitarian response related projects and programs in coordination with federal and provincial Government, local partners and other stakeholder as necessary.
  • Leads design and implementation of DRR, emergency and humanitarian response program in Nepal.
  • Ensure current and potential LWR's DRR partners have capacity and skill to implement assigned projects.
  • Ensure all reports meet LWR internal deadlines, Cooperation Agreement deadlines, and/or AAA award agreement deadlines.
  • Ensure partner narrative and financial reports are completed and submitted to the LWR-Nepal office and HQ on a timely basis.
  • Works as a team member of partner selection committee and provides inputs on technical capability of potential partner organization for future opportunities.
  • Manage partner organizations for successfully implementing the project and ensure high-quality outcomes in or field.
  • Monitors the assigned DRR, emergency and humanitarian response project periodically including financial, collects learning and provide feedback and mentoring to partner organizations and LWR for improvement in program. Support in project evaluation, assessment and surveys including developing terms of reference (ToR) and agreement with consultant and firms.

DRR, Emergency and Humanitarian Response: 30%

  • Support in design and implementation of DRR, early preparedness and emergency response and resilience program in Nepal.
  • Ensure that the reporting requirements of donors and LWR are timely submitted with high-quality standards.
  • Coordinate in establishment and strengthening of Rapid Response Teams, Provincial Search and Rescue Teams, Emergency Medical Teams, and other emergency response mechanisms.
  • Work closely with partners and ensure stock pilings are maintained at strategic locations and ensure minimum standard of the emergency materials and develop Standard Operating Procedure (SoP) for handling stockpiling.
  • Support in activation or strengthening of Provincial Emergency Operations Centers (PEOCs) and coordination mechanisms.
  • With Country Office and HQ, provide input on decisions regarding responding to sudden onset and complex emergency situations.
  • Lead LWR needs assessments or participate in joint assessments and draft high-quality needs assessment report within 72 hours from sudden onset emergency.
  • Participate in initial coordination meetings of response agencies and document outcomes.
  • Represent LWR at selected UN and peer agencies (AIN) cluster meetings related to DRR, emergency, and humanitarian response.
  • With PD, coordinate with CHO and HQ on response decisions.
  • Lead the Country Office emergency team following protocols as outlines in the Emergency Preparedness Plan.

Coordination and Collaboration: 20%

  • Maintain and liaise cordial coordination, communication and collaboration with government stakeholders, donors, peer agencies and local partners.
  • Maintain strong relationships with federal, provincial, and local governments, humanitarian coordination mechanisms, donors, UN agencies, and NGO partners.
  • Represent LWR in relevant coordination forums, including NDRRMA, Ministry of Home Affairs, Provincial Ministries, AIN working groups, UN Clusters, DDRCs, LEOCs, and other humanitarian platforms.
  • Obtain necessary permission, authentication from the ministry or province and municipality as required.
  • Lead for approval of related project Agreement (PA) and project evaluation by the SWC and other government stakeholders.
  • Represents LWR in AINTGDM working group of AIN and others.

Technical Support: 10%

  • Provide technical DRR, Emergency and Humanitarian response supports to local partners, and their staffs along with provincial LWR's co-workers.
  • Provides technical support in DRR, emergency health preparedness, humanitarian response, resilience, shelter, WASH, health in emergency, and protection programming to provincial and provincial and local government officials as well as partner NGOs on program implementation.
  • Support in establishing and strengthening of rapid response team, search and rescue team, emergency medical team, and community-based disaster preparedness mechanisms.
  • Ensure high-quality implementation of emergency shelter, dignity kits, WASH, health, and psychosocial support interventions.
  • Strengthen emergency health preparedness and response by training health workers, DDRC members, and Emergency Medical Teams (EMTs); supporting disease early warning and risk communication through mass media; and coordinating the deployment of mobile medical camps to provide first aid, essential medicines, maternal and child health services, disease surveillance, and referral services during emergencies.
  • Facilitate Technical training to Government officials (Provincial, district and local government stakeholders), NGO and LWR staff on CHS, SPHERE and other relevant HA tools.
  • Organize technical meeting and workshop in consultation with government stakeholders at provincial, district and local along with peer agencies related to DRR, HA and emergency response.
  • Act as a key resource person in conducting above training, project design and business development in the DRR, HA and emergency response programming area, gap-filling and taking on growth responsibilities, as needed.
  • Coordinate the identification of staff capacity and technical assistance needs of partner organizations and capacity strengthening and required interventions to support program quality.
  • Work closely with MEAL team to monitor project performance, generate evidence, document lesson learned, success stories and improve program quality.
  • Lead in developing the ToR for the consultant as needed for the project and hire them ensuring the LWR's standard procedure and requirement.

New Business Development 10%

  • Supports and facilitates exploring new DRR, preparedness, HA and emergency response program opportunities in the country.
  • Serves as a member of country focal person for institutional donor as well as other donor opportunities on DRR, emergency and humanitarian response and be the member of capture and proposal team.
  • Lead in drafting concept note related to DRR, emergency and humanitarian response opportunities in the country.
  • Contributes to develop LWR/Corus DRR, emergency and humanitarian response portfolio in Nepal.
  • Position LWR to engage into any consortium related to DRR, emergency and humanitarian response program as suggested by the supervisor.
  • Provides technical content for concept note and proposal development in the sector of DRR, emergency and humanitarian response and as suggested by the supervisor.

title: Kunnossapitoasentaja
description:
Etsitkö työtä, jossa näkyy kädenjälkesi? Haemme sinua

Kunnossapitoasentaja

Lappeenrannan leipomolle vakituiseen työsuhteeseen

Kunnossapitoasentajana työskentelet Lappeenrannan leipomon tuotantolaitteiden parissa monipuolisissa mekaanisissa asennus- ja kunnossapitotehtävissä. Olet osa tehtaan omaa seitsemän henkilön kunnossapitotiimiä. Tehtävät pitävät sisällään teollisen leipomon tuotantolinjojen teknistä ylläpitoa ja vianselvitystä, ennakkohuoltoja sekä muutos- ja perusparannustöitä. Työssä on vastuuta ja vapautta sopivassa suhteessa.

Työtä tehdään kolmessa vuorossa: aamuvuorossa klo 06–14, iltavuorossa klo 14–22 sekä yövuorossa klo 22–06. Tehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen (40 h/vko).

Miksi Fazer Leipomot?

Meillä kaikki alkaa ihmisistä. Olet osa kannustavaa ja lämminhenkistä työyhteisöä, jossa työkaverit jakavat osaamistaan ja oppivat toisiltaan. Vuosittain tekemämme henkilöstökyselyn mukaan kunnossapito-osasto koetaan reiluksi työyhteisöksi, jossa viihdytään hyvin. Kunnossapitoasentajana sinulle tarjoutuu mahdollisuus kasvattaa omaa osaamistasi mukavassa ja kannustavassa tiimissä. Työ on itsenäistä ja vaihtelevaa, eikä yksikään päivä ole samanlainen.

Me Fazerilla haluamme luoda monimuotoisuuden ja osallisuuden kulttuurin sekä tarjota tasavertaisen työyhteisön, jossa kaikkia työntekijöitä kunnioitetaan ja jossa työympäristö koetaan motivoivaksi ja turvalliseksi.

Palkkaus

Tehtävä kuuluu leipomoiden työntekijöitä koskeva työehtosopimuksen piiriin. Aloituspalkka tehtävässä on 2150 € – 3050 € / kk riippuen valitun henkilön koulutuksesta ja aiemmasta alan työkokemuksesta. Peruspalkan lisäksi maksamme erilaisia lisiä, esimerkiksi iltavuorolisää 1,91 € – 2,46 € / h ja yövuorolisää 13,99 € – 20,58 € / h.

Tehtävässä on mahdollisuus liiketoimintakohtaiseen tuotannon tulospalkkioon, jonka tavoitetaso on 74senttiä / h (rakenne ja ehdot määritellään vuosittain).

Tarjoamme lisäksi monipuolisia etuja, kuten esimerkiksialennuksia Fazerin tuotteista sekä etuja hyvinvointiin, kuten Epassin.

Mitä toivomme sinun tuovan tiimiin?

Sinulla on aikaisempaa kokemusta kunnossapidon työtehtävistä sekä tekniikan alan koulutus. Eduksi tehtävässä katsomme leipomokoneiden tuntemuksen, sähkö-/automaatio-osaamisen sekä mekaanisen kunnossapidon osaamisen. Lisäksi edellytämme valmiutta työskennellä vuorotyössä.

Kokemusta tärkeämpää meille on kuitenkin aktiivinen ja oma-aloitteinen työote sekä motivaatio uuden oppimiseen. Sinut tunnetaan mukavana työkaverina, ja nautit onnistumisista. Positiivinen asenteesi säilyy myös tiukoissa tilanteissa. Toimit johdonmukaisesti työturvallisuus edellä niin arjessa kuin kiire- ja painetilanteissakin.

Hae nyt ja tule mukaan tiimiin, joka luo merkityksellisiä hetkiä

Haku on auki 16.8. saakka. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa leipomon tekninen päällikkö Antti Juha numerosta 040 8443 522 arkisin klo 12–14.

Ruokaelämyksiin keskittyvänä yrityksenä Fazer mahdollistaa jokaiselle päivän parhaista hetkistä nauttimisen. Missiomme, Ruokaa, jolla on merkitys, rakentuu vankalle, yli130-vuotiaalle perinnöllemme, kuluttajalähtöisyydelle ja innovaatioille kehittäessämme tulevaisuuden ruokaelämyksiä. Lähes 6 000 omistautuneen ammattilaisen voimin keskitymme kuluttajatuotteisiin ja suoraan kuluttajaliiketoimintaamme Pohjois-Euroopassa, minkä lisäksi tuotteitamme viedään yli 40 maahan. Fazer noudattaa liiketoiminnassaan eettisiä ohjeita, jotka pohjautuvat konsernin arvoihin ja YK:n Global Compact -aloitteen periaatteisiin. Fazer-konsernin liikevaihto vuonna 2025 oli 1,2 miljardia euroa.

title: PU & GI Jacketing Work Supervisor
description:

To supervise and coordinate all polyurethane (PU) insulation and galvanized iron (GI) jacketing works, ensuring all installations are completed safely, according to project specifications, quality standards, and project schedules while complying with Singapore MOM, BCA, and Workplace Safety and Health (WSH) requirements.

Supervise daily PU insulation and GI jacketing installation works.

Assign work to workers and subcontractors.

Ensure manpower is deployed efficiently.

Monitor productivity and work progress.

Conduct daily toolbox meetings before work starts.

6 days work a week

Coordinate with Main Contractor, Project Engineer, Site Engineer, QA/QC Inspector, and Safety Officer.

Schedule work according to project milestones.

Coordinate with other trades to prevent work clashes.

Correct material thickness

Proper overlap and joint sealing

Secure banding and fixing

Weatherproof finishing

Verify completed work before requesting inspections.

Rectify defects and punch list items.

Enforce the use of PPE.

Monitor safe work practices for:

Working at height

Scaffolding

Cutting and fabrication of GI sheets

Manual handling

Power tools

Stop unsafe work when necessary.

Monitor stock levels.

Prevent material wastage.

Report shortages to Project Engineer or Procurement.

6. Progress Monitoring

Prepare daily work progress reports.

Record manpower attendance.

Track completed quantities.

Report delays and recommend corrective actions.

7. Inspection & Documentation

Assist QA/QC during inspections.

Ensure work complies with approved method statements.

Maintain:

Daily site diary

Inspection records

Material records

Handover documentation

Supervise insulation technicians and jacketing workers.

Train new workers on installation methods and safety requirements.

Monitor workmanship.

Resolve site issues promptly.

Equipment insulation

GI sheet fabrication and installation

Aluminum/GI jacketing

Vapour barrier systems

Sealants and weatherproofing

Reading construction and insulation drawings

Leadership and supervision

Planning and scheduling

Problem-solving

Quality inspection

Communication with clients and contractors

Knowledge of construction safety regulations

Report writing

Attend morning coordination meeting.

Conduct toolbox briefing.

Assign work to installation teams.

Inspect ongoing PU insulation and GI jacketing works.

Coordinate inspections with QA/QC.

Update progress reports.

Ensure site housekeeping.

Resolve technical and safety issues.

Plan the next day's activities.

3–5 years (or more) experience supervising insulation and GI jacketing works.

Experience in commercial, industrial, M&E, or HVAC construction projects.

Familiarity with Singapore construction practices and WSH requirements.

Cleanroom facilities

title: Logistic Coordinator
description:
Position Summary:
As a Logistics Coordinator, Quick Ship, you will coordinate daily logistics and shipping activities to ensure the timely, accurate, and cost-effective movement of materials and finished goods. You will support export and import operations by preparing shipment documentation, collaborating with internal teams and logistics partners, and ensuring compliance with applicable trade regulations and customer requirements.
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
  • Coordinate outbound shipments and support logistics operations to ensure smooth and timely delivery.
  • Prepare and process shipping documentation for export and domestic shipments.
  • Collaborate with freight forwarders and logistics service providers to coordinate collections and deliveries.
  • Review customer orders and shipping requirements to ensure accurate shipment execution.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders to obtain complete and accurate shipping instructions.
  • Generate shipping documentation through internal systems and maintain accurate shipment records.
  • Prepare customs documentation and support clearance processes in compliance with applicable regulations.
  • Partner with Warehouse, Quality, and Logistics teams to ensure on-time shipment readiness and dispatch.
  • Monitor shipment status and provide timely updates to stakeholders and customers.
  • Ensure adherence to company policies, export control regulations, and international trade requirements.
  • Process freight invoices and assist in resolving discrepancies with suppliers.
  • Support investigation and resolution of shipment-related issues and delivery exceptions.
  • Maintain logistics data and documentation within company systems.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement to enhance logistics efficiency and customer service.
  • Adhere to Health, Safety & Environment policies as laid by the organization.
Who You Are:
You build partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. You consistently achieve results, even under challenging circumstances, and take on new opportunities and challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm. You readily act on ideas and adapt quickly to changing logistics priorities while ensuring operational excellence.
For This Role, You Will Need:
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple tasks and manage logistics operations effectively.
  • Understanding of shipping documentation and logistics processes.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with internal teams and external partners.
  • Basic knowledge of international trade or export/import processes.
Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:
  • Experience supporting logistics, supply chain, or shipping operations.
  • Familiarity with logistics systems or platforms (such as shipment tracking or documentation tools).
  • Knowledge of customs documentation and compliance requirements.
  • Ability to identify process improvements and drive efficiency initiatives.

Our Culture & Commitment to You!

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our dedication to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing flexible, competitive benefits plans to meet you and your family’s physical, mental, financial, and social needs. We provide, medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture prioritizes work-life balance and offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.

Our training programs and initiatives focus on end-to end development, from onboarding through senior leadership. We provide a wide range of development opportunities, including face-to-face and virtual training, mentorship, and coaching, project management, and on-the-job training.

title: HubSpot CRM Specialist
description:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect high-performing professionals with global companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries like SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. We match top talent to full-time remote roles where they’re hired directly into client teams and provided ongoing support by Huzzle.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

About the Company

Our client is an FDA-registered, ISO-accredited independent contract microbiology laboratory providing critical testing and research services across a diverse range of industries. Based in the US, the team specializes in product efficacy, safety screening, and regulatory compliance for sectors including pharmaceuticals, medical devices, cosmetics, and food science. They serve as essential partners to global manufacturers, helping them verify marketing claims and ensure product safety through rigorous analytical methods and microbial identification.

The team consists of highly experienced professionals dedicated to accuracy and rapid turnaround times in a high-stakes, science-driven environment. As an established leader in the microbiology space, the company fosters a culture of technical excellence and professional integrity. Candidates have the opportunity to work at the forefront of microbial research and quality control, supporting the development of safe, innovative products that impact public health and consumer safety..

Job Summary

We are looking for a hands-on RevOps professional to take full ownership of our HubSpot ecosystem and commercial workflows. This is not a basic data-entry role; it is a mission-critical position designed for a HubSpot power user who can bridge the gap between technical CRM administration and high-stakes commercial operations. You will be responsible for ensuring our HubSpot Pro environment is optimized, our reporting is airtight, and our quoting process is flawless. If you thrive on building efficient systems, managing complex pricing logic, and maintaining total data integrity, you will be a vital pillar of our commercial team’s success.

Key Responsibilities

  • HubSpot Administration: Manage and optimize the HubSpot Professional environment, including deal stages, lifecycle stages, custom properties, and user permissions.
  • Workflow Automation: Build and maintain sophisticated automated workflows to streamline lead routing, sales notifications, and data management.
  • Quoting & Pricing Logic: Coordinate the quoting process, ensuring all calculations, margins, and pricing logic are accurate before delivery to clients.
  • Reporting & Analytics: Develop and manage custom reports and dashboards to provide the leadership team with real-time visibility into sales performance and pipeline health.
  • Process Documentation: Create and maintain clear, technical documentation for all CRM processes and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Data Integrity: Conduct regular audits to ensure data completeness, accuracy, and hygiene across the entire CRM database.
  • System Integration: Assist in managing integrations between HubSpot and third-party tools (e.g., Zapier, Make) to enhance commercial efficiency.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in Revenue Operations (RevOps), Sales Operations, or CRM Administration.
  • Hands-on experience managing HubSpot at the Professional tier or higher, including building complex workflows and custom reports.
  • Advanced spreadsheet skills (Excel/Google Sheets) with the ability to manage complex quote calculations and financial logic.
  • Strong understanding of sales margins, pricing structures, and pipeline management.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a "zero-error" mindset regarding data and documentation.
  • Professional proficiency in written English, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly.
  • Ability to work full-time with a minimum of 5 hours overlap with US Central Time.
  • A process-driven personality with the ability to work independently and solve technical problems proactively.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Active HubSpot Certifications (Reporting, Sales Software, or Admin).
  • Previous experience in Laboratory services, CRO/CDMO, or highly regulated technical industries.
  • Experience with attribution reporting and full-funnel marketing analytics.
  • Familiarity with Zapier, Make, or basic scripting for automation.
  • Knowledge of vendor qualification processes and audit documentation.

Benefits

💻 Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams

🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network

🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement

💰 Tailored Compensation: Salaries vary by client and candidate preference — we’ll match you with options that fit your goals

title: Manual Tester
description:

Obszary naszej działalności obejmują m.in.:

• doradztwo technologiczne,

• tworzenie oprogramowania,

• systemy wbudowane,

• rozwiązania chmurowe,

• zarządzanie danymi,

• dedykowane zespoły projektowe.

Cześć! Poznaj możliwości współpracy ze Scalo!

Zakres współpracy obejmuje:

  • wykonywanie testów manualnych aplikacji mobilnej,

  • realizację testów funkcjonalnych, regresyjnych oraz testów warstwy wizualnej i graficznej,

  • przygotowywanie scenariuszy oraz przypadków testowych na podstawie dokumentacji projektowej,

  • rejestrowanie wyników testów oraz raportowanie błędów z wykorzystaniem Jira i Confluence,

  • udział w pracach zespołu realizowanych zgodnie z metodyką Agile/Scrum,

  • wsparcie procesu zapewnienia jakości w kolejnych iteracjach rozwoju aplikacji.

  • lokalizacja projektu: Warszawa lub Lublin,

  • świadczenie usług w trybie hybrydowym, obejmującym obecność w biurze 2 razy w tygodniu w Warszawie lub Lublinie,

  • budżet projektu: do 104 PLN/h + VAT, w zależności od doświadczenia oraz zakresu świadczonych usług.

Kompetencje wymagane do realizacji usług:

  • minimum 2 lata doświadczenia w testach manualnych aplikacji mobilnych, obejmujących testy funkcjonalne, regresyjne oraz testy warstwy wizualnej,

  • doświadczenie w projektach realizowanych zgodnie z metodykami zwinnymi (Agile/Scrum),

  • doświadczenie w projektach z obszaru bankowości,

  • znajomość produktów i usług bankowych, takich jak konta, karty, kredyty czy płatności,

  • bardzo dobra znajomość Jira oraz Confluence,

  • umiejętność przygotowywania scenariuszy testowych, dokumentacji testowej oraz raportowania wyników i błędów.

Mile widziane:

  • znajomość standardów dostępności WCAG oraz narzędzi NVDA i WAVE,

  • znajomość narzędzi VoiceOver (iOS), TalkBack (Android) oraz przeglądarkowych narzędzi deweloperskich,

  • umiejętność pracy z pakietem Adobe oraz aplikacją Figma,

  • znajomość technologii i nowoczesnych rozwiązań wykorzystywanych w bankowości mobilnej i internetowej.

Co oferujemy w ramach współpracy?

  • możliwość świadczenia usług w różnorodnych projektach z obszaru Software, Embedded, Data i Cloud Services,

  • zaangażowanie w dodatkowe inicjatywy presealsowe oraz eksperckie,

  • dostęp do opieki medycznej, karty sportowej oraz platformy kafeteryjnej zgodnie z obowiązującymi zasadami współpracy.

title: Senior Interior Designer

title: Observability Product Developer (Full Stack + Grafana)
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Digital Solution Engineering Manager


What we believe in

ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.

We offer a broad range of automation, electrification, and digital solutions for process, hybrid, and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control systems, software, measurement, analytics, and lifecycle services. Our digital portfolio enables customers to improve operational excellence, reliability, cybersecurity, and sustainability across industrial operations.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will join ABB's Digital Industry – Genix Platform Engineering organization as a Software Engineer – Observability Platform. You will contribute to building and enhancing enterprise-grade observability capabilities that provide end-to-end operational visibility across industrial edge-to-cloud environments. Working closely with Platform Engineering, SRE/DevOps, and Product Engineering teams, you will develop scalable cloud-native solutions that improve platform reliability, telemetry insights, and operational efficiency.

This role is contributing to the Digital Industry – Genix Platform Engineering function in Bangalore, India.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Design, develop, and enhance scalable observability platform capabilities, including telemetry pipelines, backend services, APIs, microservices, and user interfaces that provide end-to-end operational visibility across industrial edge-to-cloud environments.
  • Build and maintain reusable Grafana dashboards, plugins, and operational analytics capabilities while integrating modern observability technologies such as Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Collaborate with Platform Engineering, SRE/DevOps, and Product Engineering teams to improve platform reliability, onboard services, troubleshoot distributed systems, and deliver secure, scalable cloud-native solutions.
  • Contribute across the complete software development lifecycle by delivering high-quality, maintainable code, participating in design, testing, release, support, documentation, and continuous platform improvements.

Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 4–8 years of experience in software development, preferably in platform engineering, observability platforms, or cloud-native enterprise applications.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo/Jaeger, and OpenTelemetry for building enterprise observability solutions.
  • Proficiency in React, TypeScript, and backend technologies such as Node.js, Python, or Go, with experience developing APIs and microservices.
  • Experience with Kubernetes (preferably Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)), cloud-native architectures, distributed systems, and CI/CD practices.
  • Good understanding of telemetry ingestion, monitoring, logging, operational analytics, and troubleshooting complex distributed applications.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Platform Engineering, SRE/DevOps, Product Engineering, and Customer Delivery teams.

More about us

ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, helping industries become more productive, efficient, and sustainable. The Process Automation business automates, electrifies, and digitalizes some of the world's most complex industrial infrastructures, serving customers across energy, process, hybrid, marine, mining, chemicals, water, and manufacturing industries.

The Genix Platform is a strategic digital foundation that enables industrial organizations to harness cloud-native technologies, observability, AI, and advanced analytics to improve operational reliability, accelerate digital transformation, and deliver secure, scalable industrial software solutions. At ABB, we foster an inclusive culture where innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning empower our people to create sustainable solutions for industries worldwide.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

title: HR Project Management and Governance
description:
About Horse Powertrain

Horse Powertrain Ltd is an independent new powertrain solutions business, with over 125 years of heritage from Renault and Geely. We develop and produce world-class hybrid and combustion engines and transmissions to move our industry forward, offering many different paths to net zero.

Horse Powertrain has 19,000 dedicated and determined employees, working in 17 manufacturing plants, and 5 R&D centers on three continents. This role is employed by Horse Powertrain Ltd and is based at our office in Madrid, with occasional travel possible to Horse Powertrain’s other sites.


Why join us?

At Horse Powertrain, you’ll have opportunities to grow your career while making a difference. This is a dynamic, international environment, staffed by caring and collaborative people. If you’re ready to create excellence with us, you’ll be appreciated and rewarded.

HR Project Management and Governance (HR PMO)

Help drive the successful delivery of our global HR agenda. As our HR Project Management and Governance professional, you will act as the governance, execution and transformation backbone of the HR function, bringing structure, visibility and discipline to key HR initiatives, leadership routines and strategic priorities. Working closely with HR leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, you will help ensure decisions translate into action, risks and dependencies are actively managed, and strategic initiatives deliver measurable business outcomes.

What you will be doing

  • Coordinate HR governance activities, including HR leadership meetings, governance forums, workshops, HR seminars and the annual governance calendar.

  • Maintain oversight of the HR project and transformation portfolio, tracking milestones, deliverables, ownership, risks, dependencies and escalation points.

  • Support CHRO on executive presentations, governance packs, reports and committee materials to support effective decision-making by HR leadership, the Executive Management Team and other relevant forums.

  • Monitor HR performance metrics, dashboards and project progress, highlighting achievements, risks, trends and areas requiring intervention.

  • Track actions, decisions, issues and commitments across the HR function, ensuring accountability and timely follow-up.

  • Support the implementation of HR initiatives by coordinating change and adoption activities, monitoring organisational readiness and helping ensure changes are embedded and sustained.

  • Partner with teams across HR, including HR Business, Centres of Expertise, HR Operations and Social Relations, to align priorities, timelines, resources and interdependencies.

  • Support governance assurance activities, including audit, compliance or review follow-up requiring HR coordination and documentation.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of governance processes, project management practices and ways of working across the HR function.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience coordinating projects, programmes or business initiatives within a complex or international environment.

  • Strong organisational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining excellent attention to detail.

  • Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where priorities may evolve.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence working across different functions and levels of the organisation.

  • Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret information, identify risks and provide practical recommendations.

  • Experience preparing presentations, reports or dashboards for leadership teams or senior stakeholders.

  • A collaborative, proactive and solution-oriented approach, with a focus on delivering results and driving continuous improvement.

  • A degree in Business, Human Resources, Project Management or a related discipline is an advantage. Experience in HR, transformation, consulting or project management environments is beneficial but not essential.

Equal opportunities employer

As a company, we are committed to equal opportunities, and recruit people based on their competencies and qualifications. We encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply for our job vacancies. If you believe you have the skills and passion to excel in this role, we would like to hear from you. Let’s explore the possibilities together.

Horse Powertrain Limited is a global leader in powertrain solutions. Learn more at www.horse-powertrain.com

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are establishing a brand-new, high-impact AI & Algorithm Domain within our core Business Unit. As a founding Senior Algorithm Engineer, you will drive our next-generation Generative AI capabilities (such as customer service chatbots and translation agents) and architect/optimize core algorithmic engines, including Search, Recommendation, Advertising, and Dynamic Pricing.

This is a rare, high-ownership role where your algorithms will directly impact millions of travelers—optimizing user experience, conversion rates, and revenue management from day one.

Key Responsibilities

  • Dynamic Pricing & Revenue Management: Design and implement reinforcement learning (RL) and contextual bandit algorithms to optimize real-time pricing, personalized discounts, and hotel/flight bundling.
  • Search, Ranking & Personalization: Develop advanced deep learning architectures (e.g., Two-Tower models, Graph Neural Networks, and Transformers) to rank properties, flights, and experiences based on real-time user intent, historical behavior, and high-dimensional destination context.
  • Generative AI & Conversational Commerce: Build and fine-tune Large Language Models (LLMs) to power next-generation AI travel assistants, automating complex itinerary planning and multi-modal customer support.
  • Supply-Demand Forecasting: Construct high-precision spatio-temporal forecasting algorithms to predict travel demand surges, hotel cancellation probabilities, and market competitiveness.
  • Low-Latency Inference: Optimize complex deep learning models to execute within milliseconds, ensuring real-time search results are served seamlessly during peak traffic periods.
  • Distributed Infrastructure: Architect and scale distributed training pipelines using frameworks like PyTorch, Ray, or DeepSpeed over massive datasets consisting of billions of real-time clickstream events.
  • Algorithmic Guardrails: Implement rigorous evaluation frameworks, multi-variant A/B testing systems, and counterfactual reasoning methods to measure the true causal impact of algorithmic changes on conversion rates and Gross Bookings Value (GBV).

Required Qualifications

Experience & Education:

  • Professional Experience: 8+ years of professional experience building, deploying, and scaling advanced machine learning algorithms in a high-throughput, customer-facing digital economy.
  • Education: Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, or a highly quantitative field.

Technical Skills:

  • Programming Mastery: Expert proficiency in Python or SQL with a focus on writing production-grade, highly optimized code.
  • ML / AI Ecosystem: Deep expertise in PyTorch, TensorFlow/JAX, and classical ML stacks (Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, LightGBM).
  • Big Data & Cloud Infrastructure: Strong hands-on experience working with Spark and Kafka.

Domain Expertise:

Proven track record in at least two of the following mathematical/algorithmic domains:

  1. Learning-to-Rank (LTR): Frameworks and collaborative filtering.
  2. Reinforcement Learning: Multi-armed bandits and RL (Q-learning, policy gradients) applied to pricing or allocation.
  3. Time-Series Forecasting: Forecasting at scale using DeepAR, Prophet, or custom neural forecasting architectures.
  4. Anomaly Detection: Large-scale anomaly detection/classification for payment and account fraud.

title: Product Director, Higher Education & School Boards
description:
The Role

Unit4 is a market leader for ERP and finance solutions across universities, colleges, and the Canadian K-12 school board market. Higher education faces structural funding pressure, growing research complexity, and the demands of an increasingly digital student experience. School boards navigate provincial funding compliance, trustee governance, and the operational weight of collective agreements across large, geographically distributed organizations. As Product Director for Higher Education and K-12, you own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap that makes Unit4 the platform of choice across these institutions.

This is not an account management or advisory role. You will have dedicated engineering capacity to build vertical depth that distinguishes Unit4 in this market - capabilities that matter to a university CFO managing a research portfolio, a registrar navigating financial aid complexity, or a Superintendent of Business in a school board managing provincial budget allocations. You will work closely with horizontal product teams to ensure the platform delivers end-to-end, but the vertical product strategy is yours.

The right person has built enterprise software for higher education institutions or K-12 school boards. You understand the funding models, the compliance obligations, and where current systems fall short. You have shipped features that research finance officers, HR directors, and school board finance teams actually use.

AI is reshaping higher education from multiple directions simultaneously. Research institutions are navigating AI-assisted grant workflows, evolving indirect cost models, and new data governance obligations from research funders. Administratively, AI offers real efficiency gains across finance, procurement, and HR. Capturing those gains while maintaining the rigorous data governance, academic integrity, and accreditation standards these institutions operate within is the defining challenge. This role requires someone who understands both sides and can build a product roadmap that helps institutions move forward with confidence.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Higher Education and K-12 product vision, strategy, and multi-horizon roadmap; align it with Unit4's platform strategy and commercial growth targets.

  • Lead a prioritized product backlog with dedicated engineering capacity - defining outcomes, success metrics, release plans, and quality criteria.

  • Translate deep sector knowledge into specific, investment-backed product requirements: problem statements, opportunity sizing, and build-vs-partner decisions.

  • Define industry-specific solution blueprints, reference configurations, and pre-built templates for HE and K-12 institutions.

  • Work closely with horizontal product teams to ensure HE and K-12 requirements are reflected in platform investment across finance, HR, procurement, and research management.

  • Partner with the Industry Growth Director on launch readiness, pricing, packaging, and field enablement for new capabilities.

  • Engage directly with strategic customers and the HE Industry Board to validate roadmap direction, co-innovate, and capture outcome evidence.

  • Ensure regulatory, accessibility, research-compliance, and provincial requirements across our supported geographies are systematically reflected in the roadmap.

  • Monitor the competitive landscape - know what Ellucian, Workday, Microsoft, Tribal Group, and others are shipping and what it means for Unit4's positioning.

  • Work with partners to extend the value proposition for HE and K-12 customers.

  • Own feature outcomes, not just delivery - define clear adoption, usage, and customer impact goals for every capability you champion, and track performance against them after launch.

  • Serve as the internal authority on the Higher Education and K-12 verticals, providing product, marketing, analyst relations, and pre-sales teams with the industry grounding they need to position, demonstrate, and sell effectively.

What You'll Bring

  • Proven product management experience building enterprise software - ERP, finance systems, or enterprise SaaS - for higher education institutions or K-12 school boards. You have shipped products used by HE finance teams, research administrators, or school board operations staff, not just studied the sector.

  • Deep working knowledge of higher education finance: research grant accounting, fund and restricted-fund accounting, full economic costing, endowments, and tuition revenue models.

  • For the K-12 dimension: working knowledge of provincial ministry funding formulas, trustee governance and board reporting, school-level budget delegation, and collective agreement administration.

  • Understanding of the student lifecycle interfaces - financial aid, tuition management, integration with student information systems - and what they demand from the ERP layer.

  • A clear point of view on how AI is reshaping the research enterprise and administrative operations of HE institutions, and what responsible, governance-compliant product decisions look like in this context.

  • Commercial orientation: you understand how product decisions drive ARR, win rate, and customer retention.

title: Safeguarding and Wellbeing Mentor - Term Time Only + 4 Weeks (Maternity Cover)
description:
Are you passionate about supporting young people facing significant challenges to education, wellbeing and safety?

We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Safeguarding and Wellbeing Mentor to join our Safeguarding and Wellbeing team on a maternity cover basis. This is a rewarding opportunity to make a real difference to the lives of learners who require targeted support to overcome barriers and achieve positive outcomes.

In this specialist role, you will work with a designated cohort of learners who have identified vulnerabilities or barriers to learning, attendance and progression. This may include learners experiencing safeguarding concerns, mental health difficulties, family challenges, social care involvement, attendance issues, behavioural concerns, housing instability, exploitation risks, or other circumstances impacting their ability to engage successfully in education.

As a key member of the Safeguarding and Wellbeing team, you will deliver targeted interventions, coordinate support plans and act as a trusted professional for learners, families and curriculum staff. You will also respond to safeguarding and wellbeing referrals from across the wider college, working closely with Deputy Designated Safeguarding Leads, curriculum teams and external agencies to ensure concerns are identified, assessed and addressed appropriately.

The role combines frontline safeguarding practice, early help and pastoral support. You will be responsible for managing a caseload of vulnerable learners, contributing to multi-agency planning, supporting attendance and engagement, undertaking risk assessments where required, and ensuring that accurate, timely records are maintained.

A trauma-informed approach sits at the heart of our work. We recognise that many young people have experienced adversity and require consistent, relational support to feel safe, valued and able to succeed. You will use strength-based practice to build positive relationships, reduce barriers to participation and help learners develop resilience, confidence and independence.

We are looking for an individual with experience of working with young people who face complex challenges, alongside a strong understanding of safeguarding, child protection and early help. You will be confident working in partnership with families, curriculum staff, local authorities and external professionals, whilst maintaining a clear focus on safeguarding and learner welfare.

If you are committed to improving outcomes for vulnerable young people and want to be part of an experienced, supportive and highly regarded safeguarding team, we would love to hear from you.
To provide Statutory, pastoral and welfare responsibilities for a designated cohort of learners in a specific curriculum area. This includes monitoring attendance and intervening in cases of persistent absence, children missing education. As a key member of the Safeguarding and Welfare team, you will provide front line and early help support for learners facing a wide range of barriers to education. These barriers may include absences, home issues, mental health challenges, crises, or the need for critical support.

Responsibilities also involve identifying and monitoring vulnerable and 'at risk' learners within your remit. You will work closely with cross-college teams to ensure that these learners are retained by the college, maintaining detailed records of your interventions and support provided. Additionally, you will serve as the single point of contact for learners within your identified cohort and their parents/carers and staff, ensuring effective communication and coordinated support for all parties involved.

  • To provide Early Help support for both the college and Local Authority as soon as issues arise. This includes assistance with safeguarding, pastoral care, social and welfare needs, wellbeing, and health care, all aimed at identifying and removing barriers to accessing education.
  • To lead on Personal Education Plans (PEP) for Looked After Children (LAC), Children with a Social Worker, children working with Youth Justice in collaboration with Social Services, ensuring that external assessment criteria are met.
  • Provide comprehensive support for Care Experienced students, including effective participation in LAC Reviews, Care Planning, Placement Planning Meetings, and Care Leavings, ensuring attendance at all relevant LAC reviews.
  • Manage cases at Child in Need and Early Help Assessment level, ensuring compliance with statutory and legal requirements. Contribute to work under the new Family First Partnership framework, working collaboratively with partner agencies to support the development and delivery of the right plan for the family.
  • Responsible for the attendance management of an identified cohort, implementing and coordinating targeted interventions to improve attendance, working with families and external agencies through a relational practice approach. Lead responsibility for supporting learners at Tier 3 within the Attendance Policy (persistent absence) and for responding to attendance concerns where vulnerabilities or risk are identified at any stage of a learner’s journey.
  • Implement the positive behaviour policy by managing the incident process and outcomes, including supporting at Formal panels and reports. Handle a caseload of learners with behavioural issues, identifying actions that can lead to an improvement in behaviour, ensuring effective strategies for behaviour management are recorded and tracked.
  • Students within the cohort will routinely receive targeted interventions due to identified need; however, all students, including those progressing well, will participate in a minimum of one termly 1:1 review.
  • SWMs with a specialist area are responsible for undertaking termly 1:1 reviews, in line with expectations, for learners within the wider cohort who are not identified for targeted or specialist support.
  • Be the designated point of contact for parents and carers, within your identified cohort fostering and maintaining positive, supportive relationships to help learners and families overcome barriers to education. Ensure that all contact details for parents and carers are kept up to date in the college systems.
  • Support the implementation of the college’s Mental Health Strategy by serving as the first point of contact for learners experiencing poor mental health. Promote the vision of becoming a mentally healthy college by referring learners to appropriate internal and external services.
  • To promote and safeguard the welfare of young people and vulnerable adults at the college and refer/signpost to external agencies where appropriate.
  • Developing a positive and supportive connection with learners, create an atmosphere of trust and support, prioritising the safeguarding and wellbeing of all students.
  • Facilitate the successful transition of learners by coordinating with secondary schools, arranging transition visits, and providing support during college interviews. Liaise with social workers when necessary and ensure that all pre-enrolment support, such as bursaries and required kits, is provided so that learners feel confident when they start college.
  • Assist in the Enrolment process by capturing learner wellbeing and welfare information, ensuring that accurate parent contact details are recorded. Identify any concerns, issues, or barriers that students might face to ensure they receive the appropriate support once they start college. Refer any risk concerns to managers as needed.
  • Support in College induction program to ensure learners are informed of where to seek help and what support is available and know how to keep themselves safe.
  • Maintain accurate records of interventions, ensuring learners vulnerabilities and support needs are recorded and highlighted.
  • To conduct home visits where there is an attendance/welfare/safety concern.
  • To undertake training and CPD as required for the role, including a minimum of one Safeguarding Board Training session per year, to keep up to date with local procedures and emerging themes.
  • Any other duties, of a similar level of responsibility, as may be required

Qualifications
Essential Criteria
  • Level 2 or GCSE 4 or above in English and Maths
  • Educated to Level 3/A Level or above (evidence of ongoing industry CPD considered)
  • Full UK driving Licence, business insurance, and access to a vehicle
  • Mental Health First Aid qualification or willingness to undertake training
How Identified: Application/interview

Desirable Criteria
  • Teaching qualification e.g. Level 3 Cert of Education and Training (PTLLS) First Aid qualification or willingness to obtain.
How Identified: Application/interview

Experience
Essential Criteria
  • Experience of working with 16-18-year old’s in an education setting
  • Experience of supporting learners and families with safeguarding issues inc. CIN, LAC, EHA
  • Experience of dealing with behaviour management / challenging learner behaviour
  • Experience and understanding of attendance management
  • Experience of working with cross college teams in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience of working with young people in a pastoral and wellbeing setting
  • Experience of dealing with safeguarding and mental health concerns
  • To have empathy with young people, approachable but with the confidence to assert authority when required
  • Experience of effective team working and promoting relationships between staff, students and the community
  • Experience of working under pressure, including handling difficult situations on your own and de-escalating them
  • Experience of working with outside agencies such as safeguarding professional, schools, social workers, Youth Justice Team, Positive Steps, Parents and Key Workers
How Identified: Application/interview

Desirable Criteria
  • Experience of the Education Inspection framework
  • Experience of the Prevent Strategy
How Identified: Application/interview

Specialist Knowledge
Essential Criteria
  • Good working knowledge of safeguarding and child protection, Child in need and Early help Processes
  • Specific knowledge and understanding of the issues faced by young people that impact on their wellbeing, safety and mental health
  • Understanding a Trauma-informed approach
  • Good understanding of mental health issues and how they impact on learners
  • Committed to the safeguarding of children and vulnerable adults
  • Able to interact positively with young people and adults
  • Committed to the principles of equality and diversity
  • Ability to communicate, negotiate and work effectively with internal and external partners
  • Ability to work unsupervised and manager own time and priorities; be well organized and self-motivated
  • To have flexibility and willing to try out new ideas
  • Ability to keep and evaluate records and statistical data.
How Identified: Application/interview

IT Skills
Essential Criteria
  • Good working knowledge of IT and digital safeguarding systems
  • Basic know of Microsoft Office Programs
  • Understanding of college systems
How Identified: Application/interview



This role is offered on a fixed-term basis until March 2027, with the potential for a further extension.

title: Senior Internal Control Specialist
description:
Customs Support Group (CSG) is Europe’s leading independent customs services provider. Founded in 1964, we operate in 14 European countries with 120+ offices and a team of 1,700+ customs professionals.

We help companies move goods across borders smoothly and compliantly, taking the pressure out of customs.

What we do: We support more than 60,000 clients and process over 20 million declaration lines each year.
From day‑to‑day customs declarations to compliance, duty optimization and trade advice, we make cross‑border trade easier and more predictable.

How we work: We combine local customs expertise with modern digital tools to handle large volumes accurately and at speed.
Our technology helps teams work smarter, reduces manual effort, and improves turnaround times. In markets like the UK, this already led to clear productivity gains.

Why it matter: Customs rules are becoming more complex and mistakes are costly. Delays, compliance risks and unclear regulations can slow businesses down.
CSG helps clients stay compliant, reduce risk and keep their supply chains moving.

Why Join Us

At CSG, you will be part of a growing international organization that is improving how customs work gets done.

You will:

  • Work with experienced customs professionals and technology teams

  • Gain exposure to international trade and complex supply chains

  • Contribute to services that have a real impact on global commerce

This is a chance to build a career in a stable but evolving industry, where expertise and good judgement still matter.

Purpose of the position We are looking for a Senior Internal Control Specialist to ensure the continuous monitoring, testing, and improvement of the internal control framework currently being implemented across the group. This is a key role in safeguarding the integrity of our financial reporting and operational processes, as well as ensuring compliance and risk mitigation throughout the organization.

As a Senior Internal Control Specialist you will report to the Manager Group Control and you will support and work closely together with the local Managing Directors, Finance Directors and Department heads in various countries.

Key Responsibilities

· Performing regular testing and monitoring of the internal control framework to ensure design and operational effectiveness

· Assessing and reporting on the effectiveness of controls related to financial reporting, business operations, and compliance

· Identifying control deficiencies and working with local and group-level stakeholders to ensure timely and effective remediation

· Supporting and coordinating the periodic internal control assessment and risk-based audit planning

· Collaborating with external auditors and managing requests related to internal controls

· Preparing clear and concise reports and dashboards for senior management and the audit committee

· Recommending improvements to strengthen internal controls and optimize risk management processes

· Staying up to date with best practices, internal audit methodologies, and regulatory requirements

· Conducting training sessions and providing guidance to business and process owners to raise awareness and understanding of risk and control objectives

What we offer

· A dynamic and international work environment

· A permanent position with growth potential

· Competitive annual salary and yearly bonus arrangement

· Attractive fringe benefits, including a pension plan

· Hybrid working model and flexible working hours

· Company laptop and mobile phone allowance

· Learning & development opportunities

Requirements

· At least 5 years of relevant experience in internal audit, internal control, or risk management within a multinational company or Big 4 audit firm

· Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field

· Strong understanding of internal control and risk management frameworks (e.g., COSO)

· Experience using technology to support audit and control processes (e.g., automation, data analytics)

· Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex control topics clearly and effectively

· Self-motivated, hands-on, and able to work independently across multiple levels of the organization

· Fluent in English, both written and spoken

· Willingness to travel occasionally within Europe

Role: Automation Tester — AI (Banking Domain)

This role is with our client who is leading financial institution modernizing our digital platforms. Our client combine rigorous risk and compliance standards with data-driven product innovation. We’re hiring an Automation Tester with AI experience to strengthen QA capability for critical banking applications and to help embed intelligent testing, test automation,and ML-driven validation into our delivery lifecycle.

Role overview

As an Automation Tester — AI, you will design, build and maintain automated test solutions for banking applications, and apply AI/ML techniques to improve test coverage, defect detection, and test efficiency. You will work closely with engineering, product, security, and operations teams to ensure high-quality releases that meet functional, regulatory, and performance requirements for retail and corporate banking products.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain automated test suites for functional, integration, regression, API, UI, and performance testing across web, mobile, and backend banking systems.
  • Integrate AI/ML techniques to enhance testing — e.g., intelligent test-case prioritization, flaky-test detection, anomaly detection in logs/metrics, visual UI validation, test-data generation, and predictive defect analytics.
  • Create and maintain test frameworks, reusable libraries, and test automation pipelines integrated into CI/CD (e.g., GitLab/GitHub Actions/Jenkins).
  • Collaborate with business analysts, product owners, developers and architects to define test strategies that cover regulatory, security, anti-fraud, and data privacy requirements.
  • Develop robust test data management approaches for sensitive banking data, including anonymization, synthetic data generation, and secure test environments (including air-gapped or restricted setups).
  • Implement and maintain API-first testing (REST/gRPC) and contract testing where applicable.
  • Execute performance and scalability testing for critical payment, transaction, and settlement flows; analyze results and recommend remediation.
  • Build dashboards and reports for test health, coverage, defect trends, and AI-driven quality insights.
  • Participate in root-cause analysis for defects, coach teams on quality practices, and promote shift-left testing in Agile/Scrum/SAFe environments.
  • Ensure test artifacts meet auditability and compliance standards required in the banking domain.

Required qualifications

  • 3–7+ years of software testing/quality assurance experience with strong hands-on automation experience.
  • Proven experience with automation tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium) and test frameworks in Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Practical experience applying AI/ML methods to testing problems — e.g., model-based testing, anomaly detection, NLP for test-case generation/maintenance, or supervised learning for defect prediction.
  • Hands-on with API testing and tools such as Postman, RestAssured, Pact, or similar.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and using test orchestration tools.
  • Familiarity with performance testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, k6) and interpreting performance metrics.
  • Strong knowledge of banking domain concepts: payments, accounts, loans, KYC/AML, transaction flows, and relevant regulations (e.g., PSD2, PCI-DSS, GDPR as applicable).
  • Understanding of secure software development and testing practices, including data protection and secure test environments.
  • Experience working with databases and writing SQL for verification and test data setup.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with MLOps/ModelOps tools or platforms and familiarity with ML lifecycle (training, validation, inference monitoring).
  • Knowledge of observability and log analytics tools (ELK/Elastic Stack, Splunk, Prometheus/Grafana) to enable AI-driven test insights.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and IaC (Azure, AWS, Terraform, ARM/Bicep) for test environment provisioning.
  • Experience in regulated banking environments or with enterprise-scale critical systems.
  • Certifications in testing (e.g., ISTQB) or cloud/AI certifications are advantages.
  • Experience building or contributing to synthetic data generators, test-data factories, or privacy-preserving data techniques.

When you apply, you voluntarily consent to the disclosure,collection and use of your personal data for employment/recruitment and related purposes in accordance with the Tech Aalto Privacy Policy, a copy of which is published at Tech Aalto’s website (https://www.techaalto.com/privacy/)

Confidentiality is assured, and only shortlisted candidates will be notified for interviews.

title: Creator Outreach Associate Contractor
description:
Headquarters: Remote (United States)

About Us:

Twitch is the world's biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We're about community, inside and out. You'll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We're on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we're up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we're solving on our Blog.

About the Role:

Twitch is searching for a Creator Outreach Associate to identify, persuade, and successfully onboard emerging talent to the Twitch livestreaming community. As the ideal candidate, you are fascinated by creator communities and stay on the cutting edge of creator and influencer trends and cultural moments. You are fluent in the ever-evolving language of creators and influencers. You know where the next generation of live streamers will be found, how to get them to Twitch, and how to get them set up and streaming successfully. You'll be determined, organized, methodical, and have a deep personal drive to see new creators succeed on Twitch. You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy, be quick to learn, and always look for new ways to improve your work. This is a high-volume, metrics-driven role: you'll be responsible for reaching out to a weekly target of new creators and guiding them through to their first stream. Targets may adjust over time with business needs. This is a fixed-term contract position based in the United States, ending mid-December 2026.

You Will:

  • Search widely across platforms and communities to spot emerging talent, understand what's resonating culturally, and proactively reach out to creators who could thrive on Twitch.
  • Initiate confident cold outreach and persuade creators to see Twitch as an exciting, meaningful next step in their careers.
  • Stay deeply plugged into creator trends, rising influencers, new platforms, and cultural moments that shape where audiences gather.
  • Guide creators through their earliest steps on Twitch—making onboarding clear, supportive, and geared toward getting them confidently to their first stream.
  • Own each creator relationship from first outreach through their first stream, then hand off to a Strategic Partner Manager with clear context (creator background, onboarding notes, first-stream feedback) for ongoing development.
  • Manage your outreach pipeline in a CRM—logging touchpoints, updating lead status, and keeping records clean.
  • Validate leads before outreach (confirm follower counts, check a creator isn't already assigned) to keep the pipeline accurate and avoid duplicate outreach.

You Have:

  • Must be based in the United States and legally authorized to work and be paid in the US for the duration of the contract.
  • Prior experience in a quota-carrying outreach, sales, or talent-scouting role.
  • Proven interest and knowledge in one of: creator support, lead generation, influencer marketing, or community management.
  • A genuine passion for livestreaming and internet culture, and a strong understanding of the creator economy—including where creators are rising across platforms (Twitch, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, etc.) and what's driving content trends.
  • Determination to find and bring new creators to Twitch, and to support and grow them, with a deep desire to help shape the future of the platform.
  • Comfort with CRM and creator-analytics tools, or the ability to learn them quickly, to manage a pipeline and source creators efficiently.

Bonus Points

  • Personal experience as a live streamer or content creator, familiarity with live streaming tools and software.
  • Existing relationships with a wide variety of content creators across platforms

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The base pay for this position ranges from $31/hour in our lowest geographic market and up to $39/hour in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

#LI-Remote

Twitch is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Twitch values your privacy. Please consult our Candidate Privacy Notice, for information about how we collect, use, and disclose personal information of our candidates.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twitch-creator-outreach-associate-contractor

title: Senior Software Quality Engineer
description:
About the opportunity

N26 is building the first mobile bank the world loves to use. We have over 8 million customers in 24 markets and a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide. We’re here to transform banking for the better—and that starts with building a world-class engineering culture where quality is not just a checkbox, but a foundation.

We are looking for a Senior Quality Engineer to join our Quality Platform team. In this role, you won’t just be "testing" software; you will be building the infrastructure and tools that enable hundreds of developers to ship high-quality code at speed. As part of the Quality Platform team, your mission is to design, maintain, and evolve the ecosystem used to test our complex microservices architecture. You will be a force multiplier, creating the tools and processes that make quality a seamless part of the developer experience.

This is a hybrid role based in our Barcelona office.

In This Role You Will

  • Build Tools: Design and maintain internal tools, frameworks, and platforms that streamline testing across our microservice landscape.
  • Champion GitOps: Work closely with DevOps and SRE teams to integrate quality gates into our CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and ArgoCD.
  • Evolve Architecture: Consult on the testability of our microservices and ensure our platform scales with our growth.
  • Set Standards: Define company-wide quality processes, moving beyond manual checks to automated, resilient systems.
  • Mentor: Act as a technical leader within the Quality community at N26, mentoring other engineers and advocating for a "Quality First" mindset.

What You Will Bring Along

  • An Ownership Mindset: You are a self-starter and a "go-getter." You don’t wait for instructions; you identify bottlenecks and solve them.
  • Strong Coding Fundamentals: You have a deep understanding of programming principles. Whether it’s Java, Kotlin, TypeScript, or Python, you write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  • Microservices Expertise: You have experience working in complex, distributed environments and understand how to test communication between services.
  • Containerization Knowledge: You are comfortable working with Docker to containerize test environments and tools.
  • The "Plus" Factor: You have a strong affinity for GitOps/DevOps cultures. Hands-on experience with ArgoCD or GitHub Actions is a major plus.
  • Communication Skills: You have a strong command of the English language and can effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What's in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe's most talked about disruptors.
  • Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
  • As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
  • Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.
  • A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today's digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it's how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Sounds good? Apply now for this position.

Equal Opportunities:

We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential.

We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We're committed to creating an inclusive workspace where everyone feels valued and respected, free from harassment and discrimination. If there's anything you need to make the application process work for you, please let us know by reaching out to candidate.exp@n26.com.

Visit our website to learn more about Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion at N26.
