title: Technical Delivery Manager
description:
Job Description: Tech Delivery Team Lead

Company Overview:

Bar Code India is a place where extraordinary people gravitate in order to do their best work. Together we craft customized solutions and experiences people once couldn’t have imagined — and now can’t imagine living without! If you’re excited by the idea of making a real impact, and joining a team where we pride ourselves in being one of the most diverse and inclusive companies in the Country, a career with BCI might be your dream job!

Role Overview

Delivery Team Lead to own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle of our projects. You will be the primary bridge between our external clients and our internal engineering teams.

Your job is to translate customer needs into actionable sprints, ensuring that we ship high-quality software on time and within budget. You will wear multiple hats: part Project Manager, part Scrum Master, and part Client Account Manager. Your ultimate goal is to remove roadblocks for the team and provide transparency and confidence to the client.

Key Responsibilities

1. Project Lifecycle Management

● Requirement Gathering & Analysis: Lead deep-dive sessions with clients to understand their business goals. Convert these discussions into detailed functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

● Scheduling & Planning: Create realistic project roadmaps, milestones, and resource schedules. Identify critical paths and dependencies early to prevent bottlenecks.

● Revenue & Targets: Monitor project budgets and burn rates. Ensure billing milestones are met to achieve quarterly revenue targets.

2. Sprint Execution & Agility

● Scrum Master Role: Facilitate all agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives). Ensure the team is unblocked and focused on the sprint goal.

● Backlog Grooming: Work with the product owner/client to keep the backlog healthy, prioritized, and ready for development.

3. Client & Stakeholder Management

● Kick-off Meetings: Lead high-energy "Customer Kick-off" meetings to set expectations, scope, and communication protocols. Conduct "Internal Kick-offs" to align the engineering team on the vision.

● Communication Hub: Serve as the single point of contact for project status. Provide weekly status reports (RAG status—Red/Amber/Green) to stakeholders, highlighting risks and mitigation plans.

● UAT Management: Guide the client through the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) phase, managing feedback and ensuring timely sign-off for go-live.

4. Resource & Risk Management

● Resource Allocation: Optimize team utilization. Ensure the right skills are assigned to the right tasks and forecast hiring needs based on upcoming project pipelines.

● Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify project risks (scope creep, resource unavailability, technical blockers) and implement contingency plans.


Required Qualifications

● Experience: 4-7+ years in IT Project Management or Delivery, with at least 2+ years leading teams.

● Methodology: Strong practical knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies (CSM or PMP certification is a strong plus).

● Communication: Exceptional stakeholder management skills—capable of saying "no" to scope creep while maintaining a positive client relationship.

● Tools: Proficiency in JIRA, Confluence, Microsoft Project, or similar project management tools.


Roles & Responsibilities

On-Time Delivery (OTD)

● Goal: Ship features and projects according to the committed schedule.

● Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

○ Schedule Variance: Projects completed within +/- 10% of the original timeline.

○ Sprint Completion Rate: Consistently achieving >90% of sprint commitments (Say/Do ratio).

○ Milestone Hit Rate: Percentage of billing/critical milestones delivered on the exact date promised.

Customer Satisfaction & Quality

● Goal: Ensure the client is happy with the process and the product.

● Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

○ UAT Sign-off Speed: Time taken from "Ready for UAT" to "Signed Off" (minimizing feedback loops).

○ CSAT Score: Achieve a minimum Customer Satisfaction score of 4/5 on post-delivery surveys.

○ Escalation Rate: Zero valid escalations to senior management regarding lack of communication or missed deadlines.

Resource Efficiency & Revenue

● Goal: Maximize team output and ensure the company gets paid.

● Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

○ Utilization Rate: Maintain team utilization between 80-90% (avoiding bench time and burnout).

○ Scope Management: Zero "unbilled" scope creep (all additional requests must be change-ordered).

○ Billing Timeliness: All technical deliverables required for invoicing are ready by the cutoff date.

Process Adherence

● Goal: Maintain delivery discipline and hygiene.

● Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

○ Zoho Sprints Hygiene: 100% of tickets have clear descriptions, estimates, and updated statuses before sprint start.

○ Meeting Efficiency: Stand-ups and planning meetings finish within time boxes (e.g., stand-up < 15 mins).


Role Focus: Customer Interface, Project Management, Sprint Execution & Revenue Realization

● Reports To: VP Software Practices

● Location: Gurgaon


Join our team and be part of an organization that values your talent, rewards your hard work, and offers endless opportunities for growth and success. Apply now and take the first step towards an exciting and fulfilling career!

About Bar Code India

Welcome to the extraordinary world of Bar Code India (BCI), where we have proudly led the charge in revolutionizing supply chain technologies across India for over two decades. Our mission is simple yet powerful: empowering businesses and their ecosystems to unlock unparalleled quality and efficiency through enhanced visibility and intelligence.

With an impressive portfolio of leading manufacturing and retail customers under our wing, including Flip-kart, Cipla, FedEx, Unilever, Colgate, Ikea, Sony, and Hero, BCI stands at the forefront of the industry. Innovation is the heartbeat of our organization, driving us to excel in barcoding, enterprise mobility, and RFID. We have recently taken our prowess to new heights by developing an awe-inspiring IoT stack of solutions, empowering our customers with transformative digital advancements.

Our team, comprising over 250 talented individuals across 7 offices in India, is united in reimagining the Indian supply chain solution industry. Within our vibrant and dynamic workplace, we firmly uphold our values of diversity, equity, and inclusion, fostering a culture of boundless growth, seamless collaboration, and constant learning.

Now, the time has come for you to join us in shaping the next frontier of our industry. Together, we will disrupt the status quo, leaving an indelible mark and making a genuine difference. This is not just a job – it's an invitation to be part of something extraordinary.

An Oracle Master Data Management (MDM) / Customer Data Management (CDM) & Oracle Product Data Hub Consultant builds and manages single, clean versions of company data. The Master Data Management Consultant will play a critical role in overseeing technology projects that focus on mastering and governing customers, products, pricing, and chart of accounts. This position will be responsible for developing, designing, and developing the Oracle Customer Data Management platform, inclusive of integrations with Oracle CPQ, Oracle Subscription CX, Oracle Fusion ERP, and other Realpage applications. This role will report to the BEST Data Services Senior Manager in our Business Enterprise Systems Technology department. The successful candidate will take a hands-on approach to managing our Master Data Management (MDM) platform and processes. This will include Oracle Customer Data Management, Oracle Subscription Management CX, Oracle CX CPQ, and Oracle Fusion. This role will also work with key stakeholders across the organization to drive enhancements to a successful implementation.

Responsibilities

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Develop inbound and outbound integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
  • Develop REST APIs, SOAP Web Services, and FBDI-based integrations.
  • Build and support BI Publisher reports, OTBI reports, and SQL-based reports.

  • Collaborate with business users to gather requirements and provide technical solutions.
  • Support Oracle quarterly releases and regression testing.
  • Prepare technical design documents and support documentation.
  • Work with Oracle Support to resolve product-related issues.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 6-8 years as a technical hands-on consultant for Master Data Management implementations and technical integrations.

    • Hands-on knowledge of Oracle Customer Data Management, APEX, Oracle Integration Cloud
    • Minimum of 5 years in development and designing MDM solutions

    • Experience with leading custom application development projects using Oracle Customer Data Management.

Askel on rakennettu niillä raameilla, mitä olemme rakentaneet aikaisempien yksiköidemme Iittalan Kotikulman, Harmonia Nuutajärven sekä juuret ovat saaneet alkunsa vuonna 2005 perustetusta lastensuojelulaitos Viialan Kotikolosta, joka on myös osa Iittalan Kotikulmaa.

Yksikkömme ammatillisten ja kokemuksellisten valmiuksien pohjalta pystymme tarjoamaan palveluja noin 5–17-vuotiaille sijaishuoltoa tarvitseville. Työkokemusta lastensuojelusta vaaditaan. Tehtävään valitun tulee esittää rikosrekisterilain (770/1993) 6 §:n 2 mukainen lasten kanssa työskenteleviltä vaadittava rekisteriote.

Askeleella työskennellään huomioiden jokaisen lapsen yksilöllisyys. Meille on tärkeää luoda luottamuksellinen suhde lapseen. Myös vastaavana ohjaajana pääset työskentelemään omaohjaajana. Askeleella ohjaajilla on mahdollisuus hyödyntää monipuolisesti omia vahvuuksiaan niin itsenäisessä työskentelyssä kuin osana tiimiä.

Toimintamme ydintä ovat perusturvallisen arjen luominen, elämän raamittaminen sekä aiempiin kiintymyssuhteisiin liittyvien häiriöiden ja tunnekokemusten tunnistaminen. Arkemme rakentuu kootuista rutiineista, joita opettelemme yhdessä lasten kanssa. Lapsen osallisuus arjen rutiineihin suhteutetaan hänen osaamistasoonsa, enemmän kuin numeraaliseen ikään. Toimintamme pohjautuu lasten aktiiviseen kuntouttamiseen sekä vahvaan tunnetyöskentelyyn. Käytämme työvälineinä erilaisia taide- ja kulttuurilähtöisiä menetelmiä sekä ympäristö- ja luontokasvatus kulkee arkemme perusteemoina. Askel Juupajoen tiloissa on oma uima-allas sekä lähiympäristö mahdollistaa monenlaiset liikunnalliset harrasteet.

Korostamme työyhteisön vuorovaikutustaitojen merkitystä. Yhteisökasvatus on meille työmmeperuselementti, jota pyrimme hiomaan niin, että se vastaisi kunkin yksilön henkilökohtaisia tarpeitamahdollisimman tarkasti huomioiden kaikki ne elementitmitä tarvitaan ymmärryksen saamiseksi.Kuntouttavalla työotteella tarkoitamme omaa osallisuutta arjen jakamiseen ja tiiviiseen yhdessä tekemiseen. Tavoitteena on, että palautteen antaminen ja saaminen voi tapahtua turvallisesti molempiin suuntiin ja yhdessä oppien. Myös vaikeiden asioiden puheeksi ottaminen on osa tavoitteellista työskentelyä, jossa turvallisuus saavutetaan riittävällä läsnäololla ja osaamisella. Usein avoin keskusteluyhteys ontoimivin kanava kunnioittavaan lähestymistapaan. Vaikka kasvatusotteemme on aikuislähtöistä, tarkoittaa se samalla sitä, että aikuiset suostuvat kasvamaan yhdessä asiakkaiden kanssa ja näkemään omat kehityshaasteensa ja korjaamaan toimintaansa tarvittaessa.Pyrimme luomaan yhteisön, jossa erehtyminen on sallittua ja jossa yhteisön rakenteet ovat niin vahvat,että se antaa uskoa siihen, että kaikilla on turvallista olla yhteisön jäsen omista mahdollisista haasteista huolimatta.

Perusyksikössä vastaavan ohjaajan työnkuva on pääasiassa kasvatusjohtajan työparina toiminen, vastuualueet sovitaan tapauskohtaisesti myös vahvuuksia hyödyntäen. Kasvatusjohtajan sijaistaminen tarvittaessa ja lomien ajan on osa työnkuvaa, Lastensuojelun kokemusta ja osaamista tulee löytyä koulutuksen lisäksi.

Sairaanhoitajalle on lisäksi mahdollista vastata lääkehoidosta, tästä oma lisäkorvaus.

Työ on ilta ja yö painotteista, lapset ovat koulussa arkisin, vastaavan ohjaajan painopiste vuoroissa on lasten paikalla olo aikana, poislukien kasvatusjohtajan sijaistaminen aamuvuoroissa.

title: AI Engineer

Projektit voivat sisältää esimerkiksi AI-roadmapin suunnittelua, käyttötapausten määrittelyä sekä generatiiviseen tekoälyyn ja koneoppimiseen liittyvien ratkaisujen toteuttamista.

Etsimme AI-ratkaisuista innostunutta osaajaa, joka haluaa yhdistää työssään teknisen osaamisen, asiakkaiden liiketoiminnan ymmärtämisen ja käytännön toteutuksen asiakasprojekteissa. Voit olla jo kokeneempi tekijä tai urasi hieman aiemmassa vaiheessa oleva asiantuntija, kunhan pystyt työskentelemään itsenäisesti asiakasympäristössä ja viemään asioita eteenpäin oma-aloitteisesti.

title: Purchasing Clerk
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Calculate figures for food inventories, orders, and costs. Maintain clear and organized records to ensure all reports and invoices are filed and stored properly. Post invoices using computer programs. Conduct inventory audits to determine inventory levels and needs. Complete requisition forms for inventory and supplies. Notify manager/supervisor of low stock levels. Verify and track received inventory and complete inventory reports and logs. Reconcile shipping invoices and receiving reports to ensure count accuracy. Receive, unload, and process deliveries. Refuse acceptance of damaged, unacceptable, or incorrect items. Troubleshoot vendor delivery issues and oversee return process. Adhere to food safety and handling policies and procedures across all food-related areas. Monitor PAR levels for all food items to ensure proper levels.

Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

title: Copy Editor (Israel)
description:
Position: Copy Editor

Location: Israel



Role Overview:

Jerusalem News Syndicate (JNS), the fastest-growing news agency covering Israel and the Jewish world, is seeking a full-time Copy Editor to join our editorial team. This is a fully remote role open to anyone in Israel.



The ideal candidate will have experience in copy editing for a news publication, a strong understanding of the US/Israel political landscape, and a commitment to our mission. This role requires sharp attention to detail, excellent writing and editing skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced news environment. Responsibilities include proofreading, copyediting, and publishing content via WordPress, covering opinion pieces, news articles, and press releases. The Copy Editor will also participate in editorial meetings and collaborate with supervisors to ensure the highest editorial standards.



What You’ll Do:

  • Fully proofread and copyedit a continuous stream of opinion pieces, briefs, news and feature articles, press releases, and aggregated content about Israel and the Jewish world in a timely manner.
  • Flag and correct factual errors and inconsistencies, including verifying names, dates, statistics, quotes, and links, including following up with writers when information is unclear or unverifiable
  • Check for plagiarism as needed for each story
  • Edit headlines, subheads, and photo captions to improve clarity and accuracy
  • Ensure that all texts conform to JNS editorial standards and abide by the highest quality
  • Publishing finished articles to the CMS
  • Update the website as needed (i.e. uploading breaking news items)



What You Bring:

  • 2+ years of copyediting experience at news/media publications, with expertise in US/Israel political issues, Jewish topics, and online publishing
  • Native English speaker
  • Solid understanding of the Israel/US political landscape and Global/American Jewish communities
  • Proficiency in WordPress and related content-management tools
  • Strong editorial background with excellent proofreading, communication, and adherence to style guides.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and work both independently and collaboratively.
  • Experience in fact-checking and plagiarism detection is a plus.
  • Must reside and be eligible to legally work in Israel



Why JNS

  • Be part of a mission-driven organization dedicated to journalistic integrity.
  • Work in an innovative and collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth.
  • Join a passionate team committed to delivering high-quality news coverage.



About Us:

Jerusalem News Syndicate (JNS) is the fastest-growing news agency covering Israel and the Jewish world. We provide news, briefs, features, opinions, and analysis to 100 print newspapers and digital publications on a daily basis.

We are dedicated to upholding the highest standards of journalism, ensuring accuracy and honesty in all our communications regarding Jewish concerns. Our team is committed to uncovering and refuting false narratives while delivering fully reported and credible material.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
Mission

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager with experience helping build and successfully grow a new Consumer APP; a person with strong Product thinking.

The right person in this role will play a pivotal role in planning, building, and most importantly, enabling inline’s consumer apps to become popular with millions of users through product-led growth. For the right person, you’ll influence and shape priorities through market insights, user research, data analysis, and technical feasibility. The key to this role is ensuring the product team focuses on product development that enables growth experiments that iterate to high-impact user experiences, that build month-over-month wins in conversion, retention, and viral loop-driven growth.

Responsibilities

Strategy & Prioritization

  • Partner closely with the co-CEO and UX design manager to translate product vision into executable roadmaps.
  • Conduct market research, competitive analysis, user research, and data analysis to provide product recommendations.
  • Evaluate product opportunities by balancing customer value, business impact, engineering effort, and operational complexity.
  • Continuously monitor product performance and provide insights to help refine priorities and roadmap execution.

Program Management

  • Lead cross-functional programs from planning through execution, ensuring successful product delivery.
  • Coordinate closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Operations, and other stakeholders to align priorities and execution.
  • Manage Product Backlog, Release Planning, Sprint Planning, and Scrum execution.
  • Identify project risks, resolve blockers proactively, and drive teams toward successful delivery.

Consumer Product Insights

  • Develop a deep understanding of consumer behavior and user journeys.
  • Analyze product metrics and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Partner with Marketing to evaluate growth initiatives, including SEO, CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, Referral, and user engagement.
  • Help define Growth Metrics and establish data-driven decision-making processes.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of Technical Program Manager or related experience.
  • Experience building or launching consumer-facing digital products or mobile applications.
  • Strong understanding of 0→1 product development, MVP validation, and iterative product delivery.
  • Ability to work closely with Engineering to evaluate technical feasibility, development effort, and resource planning.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
  • Familiarity with consumer product growth concepts, including Acquisition, Activation, Retention, SEO, CRM, or Lifecycle Marketing.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication, stakeholder management, and program management skills.

Preferred

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly preferred:

  • Partner integrations, including third-party platform integrations, APIs, Webhooks, or ecosystem partnerships.
  • Authentication and identity systems, such as Single Sign-On (SSO), OAuth, OpenID Connect, social login (Google, Apple, LINE), or account linking.
  • Online payment systems, including payment gateways, digital wallets, subscription billing, payment flows, or fintech-related integrations.
  • Marketplace, FoodTech, TravelTech, or other consumer internet platforms.
  • Experience working with Growth, Experimentation (A/B Testing), or Product Analytics.

title: Junior Valuer / Valuation Consultant
description:
Build a career valuing some of the world’s most substantial industrial and infrastructure assets.

John Foord is a specialist international valuation consultancy with a history dating back to 1828. We work with clients in more than 40 countries, helping insurers, financial institutions, asset owners and major industrial businesses understand the replacement value of complex physical assets. Our reputation is built on technical excellence, independence and long-term client relationships.

We are looking for a motivated Junior Valuer / Valuation Consultant to join our Singapore-based valuation team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a background in quantity surveying, building surveying, engineering, construction management, cost estimating or asset valuation who wants to build a specialist international career.

Why join John Foord?

· Work on international projects across mining, manufacturing, power, renewables, infrastructure, data centres and other major asset classes.

· Learn from experienced valuers, engineers, surveyors and industry specialists.

· Gain early responsibility through client contact, site surveys, cost research and report preparation.

· Develop specialist expertise in insurance replacement cost valuation and tangible asset advisory.

· Build a long-term career in a growing, independent, owner-managed business with real progression opportunities.

The role

You will support valuation assignments from site survey through to final report, working alongside senior valuers and technical specialists. The role combines site inspections, client communication, research, analysis and report writing.

Key responsibilities

· Assist with site inspections, virtual surveys and desktop assessments throughout Singapore and internationally.

· Collect and review information on property, plant and equipment for insurance replacement cost assessments.

· Prepare valuation reports, appendices and supporting cost analysis for client review.

· Research plant, equipment and construction costs and share relevant findings with the valuation team.

· Work directly with clients to obtain technical information and respond to queries professionally.

· Coordinate with Operations on job status, schedules and project milestones.

· Support senior valuers with complex assignments, proposal inputs, report proofreading and quality checks.

· Maintain valuation databases and contribute to continuous improvement of templates, systems and internal processes.

About you

· A degree or diploma in quantity surveying, building surveying, engineering, construction management or a related field.

· Approximately two to five years’ relevant experience in cost estimating, cost engineering, quantity surveying, asset valuation or a similar technical role.

· Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

· Clear, professional communication and report-writing ability.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Office.

· A positive attitude, self-motivation and the confidence to work in a small but growing team.

· Willingness to travel internationally as required.

· Interest in working towards RICS, API, ASA or another relevant professional accreditation.

Location and eligibility

Singapore. Applicants must be Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents.

title: Parttime Meeting & Event Medewerker
description:
Als Meeting & Event Medewerker (16 uur per week) ben jij hét eerste aanspreekpunt voor gasten die bij ons een evenement, meeting of borrel willen organiseren. Na het inplannen hiervan blijf je betrokken bij de voorbereiding en uitvoering van het event. Heeft een gast wensen die we niet kunnen bieden, dan heb jij een alternatief voorhanden die eigenlijk nog beter is! Jij snapt als geen ander wat de wens achter de vraag is en hoort aan de ontspannen zucht aan de andere kant van de telefoon dat de gast tevreden is.

"ALS MEETING & EVENT MEDEWERKER DRAAG JIJ BIJ AAN EEN ONVERGETELIJKE BELEVING VOOR ONZE GASTEN."

WAT GA JE DAN PRECIES DOEN?

Je gaat de Meeting & Events Supervisor ondersteunen bij de offerte aanvragen en het verwerken hiervan.
Daarbij zorg je voor een goede overdracht van alle afspraken naar het team van het Restaurant, de Keuken en eventuele andere betrokken afdelingen – en tref je alle voorbereidingen voor een geslaagde meeting of event. Naast dat jij de gast ontzorgt, verwelkom jij de gast ook op hun event en kunnen onze gasten bij jou terecht voor vragen en speciale wensen. Ook na het event neem je nog even contact op met de gast om te vragen of alles naar wens is geweest.

En verder:

  • Zorg je voor het aannemen van zaal- en groepsreserveringen en zorg je voor de juistheid van alle gegevens;

  • Draag je zorg voor het opnemen en opvolgen van offertes voor zowel de Business- als Leisure markt;

title: Simulation Optimisation Consultant (AnyLogic & Java)
description:
Are you passionate about AI? 🤖

At Satori Analytics, we aim to change the world one algorithm at a time by bringing clarity to global brands through Data & AI. From cloud-based ecosystems for fintech to predictive models for airlines, our cutting-edge solutions cover the entire data lifecycle—from ingestion to AI applications.

As a fast-growing scale-up, our team of 100+ tech specialists—including Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and more—delivers innovative analytics solutions across industries like FMCG, retail, manufacturing and FSI. Join us as we lead the data revolution in South-Eastern Europe and beyond!

Ready to move plant simulation from manual scenario analysis to automated, simulation-based optimisation for a global leader in aluminium manufacturing? We're looking for a hands-on specialist who can bridge AnyLogic simulation, Java-based software engineering, optimisation methods, and real operational decision-making — taking a modular optimisation framework from live connection and validation all the way to expansion and managed operational support.

What Your Day Might Look Like:

  • Connect the framework: Integrate a modular simulation optimisation framework with production AnyLogic models, databases, APIs, and plant-data environments.
  • Turn questions into use cases: Translate operational questions — scheduling, resource allocation, operating parameters, energy, logistics, throughput — into simulation and optimisation use cases.
  • Build in Java: Develop and maintain Java-based components that execute scenarios, marshal inputs, parse outputs, and enable reliable optimisation runs.
  • Make results credible: Define and validate simulation input/output data contracts and business KPIs, ensuring recommendations are reproducible and usable by operational stakeholders.
  • Optimise smartly: Apply the right optimisation approaches for real-valued, scheduling, selection, and multi-objective problems — and design efficient experiments for long-running simulations.
  • Prove the value: Validate recommendations against live models, quantify operational benefit, and support the transition from prototype to a repeatable operational process.
  • Operationalise it: Contribute to dashboards, recurring study scheduling, workflow integration, technical documentation, and knowledge transfer.
  • Collaborate closely: Work with client stakeholders and the wider delivery team to prioritise delivery, resolve issues, and maintain technical quality.

Requirements

Your Superpowers🚀:

  • Demonstrable hands-on commercial experience with AnyLogic — able to develop, adapt, integrate, and troubleshoot simulation models.
  • Strong Java development experience, including integration-oriented or production-quality software engineering.
  • Experience in discrete-event simulation; exposure to agent-based modelling is highly valuable.
  • Experience in manufacturing, process, plant, logistics, supply-chain, or other operational simulation environments.
  • Practical understanding of optimisation, operations research, simulation-based decision support, digital twins, or related analytical methods.
  • Experience integrating software with databases, APIs, structured data inputs/outputs, and production data environments.
  • Ability to communicate technical results clearly in terms of operational decisions, constraints, and measurable outcomes.

Benefits

Perks on Perks:

  • Competitive salary and hybrid work model – come hang out in our Athens office or work remotely from anywhere in European economic Area (EU, Switzerland etc.) or UK (up to 6 weeks per year).
  • Training budget to level up your skills from the top tech partners in the market (Microsoft, AWS, Salesforce, Databricks etc.) – whether it’s certifications or courses, we’ve got you covered.
  • Private insurance, top-tier tech gear, and the chance to work with a stellar crew.

Ready to create some data magic with us? Hit that apply button and let’s get started.

Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making

title: Mainframe Systems Specialist (Backup & Storage)
description:
Mainframe Systems Specialist (Backup & Storage)

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Mainframe Systems Specialist (Backup & Storage) to administer, maintain, and optimise enterprise mainframe backup infrastructure supporting mission-criticalsystems. The successful candidate will be responsible for the administration of IBM z/OS, CA-1 Tape Management, enterprise backup platforms, tape libraries, and storage infrastructure to ensure secure, reliable, and recoverable business operations.

The role includes installation, configuration, patch management, performance monitoring, capacity planning, troubleshooting, and vendor coordination for enterprise backup and storage environments. You will work closely with infrastructure, operations, storage, disaster recovery, and application teams to ensure backup integrity, system resilience, and compliance with enterprise standards.

This position is ideal for professionals with strong experience in IBM mainframe environments, enterprise backup technologies, and storage management.

Key Responsibilities

Mainframe Backup Administration

  • Administer and maintain enterprise backup solutions supporting IBM z/OS environments.
  • Manage CA-1 Tape Management System, ensuring the integrity and availability of backup media and retention policies.
  • Configure and maintain backup schedules, policies, and recovery procedures.
  • Perform backup validation, restoration testing, and operational health checks.

z/OS Systems Administration

  • Administer and support IBM z/OS operating systems and related system utilities.
  • Support Job Control Language (JCL) execution and troubleshooting for backup and operational jobs.
  • Maintain system configurations and ensure compliance with enterprise operational standards.
  • Support routine system maintenance and platform upgrades.

Storage & Tape Management

  • Administer enterprise tape management systems and automated tape libraries.
  • Manage storage resources including:
  • Direct Access Storage Devices (DASD)
  • Tape media
  • Virtual tape systems
  • Enterprise backup storage platforms
  • Monitor storage utilisation and optimise backup capacity planning.

Backup Infrastructure Management

  • Install, configure, and maintain enterprise backup hardware and software, including:
  • CA-1
  • Dell EMC Data Domain
  • Dell EMC ECS (Elastic Cloud Storage)
  • Hitachi Content Gateway (CGX)
  • Enterprise Tape Libraries
  • Perform software upgrades, security patching, and system hardening.
  • Ensure backup infrastructure complies with organisational security and operational policies.

Performance Monitoring & Capacity Planning

  • Monitor backup jobs, storage performance, and system availability.
  • Analyse backup trends and forecast storage capacity requirements.
  • Optimise backup windows and system performance.
  • Review system logs and proactively identify operational issues.

Incident & Problem Management

  • Investigate and resolve backup failures, storage issues, and infrastructure incidents.
  • Perform root cause analysis for backup-related problems.
  • Coordinate recovery activities during production incidents.
  • Support business continuity and disaster recovery operations.

Vendor & Technical Support

  • Liaise with hardware and software vendors to resolve complex technical issues.
  • Coordinate software upgrades, firmware updates, and hardware maintenance activities.
  • Participate in vendor-supported troubleshooting and problem resolution.

Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

  • Support Disaster Recovery (DR) planning, testing, and simulation exercises.
  • Validate backup and restoration procedures.
  • Ensure backup environments meet recovery objectives (RPO/RTO).
  • Participate in business continuity planning initiatives.

Documentation & Governance

  • Prepare and maintain:
  • Backup architecture documentation
  • Configuration standards
  • Recovery procedures
  • Operational runbooks
  • Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
  • Capacity planning reports
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise governance, security, and audit requirements.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve backup automation, operational efficiency, and storage utilisation.
  • Evaluate emerging backup and storage technologies.
  • Participate in infrastructure modernisation initiatives.

Required Technical Skills

Mainframe Platforms

  • IBM z/OS
  • Job Control Language (JCL)
  • Mainframe Operations
  • Mainframe System Administration

Backup & Recovery

  • CA-1 Tape Management
  • Enterprise Backup Administration
  • Backup Scheduling
  • Backup Validation
  • Restore & Recovery Procedures
  • Disaster Recovery

Storage Technologies

  • DASD
  • Tape Storage
  • Virtual Tape Systems
  • Storage Capacity Planning
  • Storage Performance Management

Backup Hardware

  • Dell EMC Data Domain
  • Dell EMC ECS
  • Hitachi Content Gateway (CGX)
  • Enterprise Tape Libraries

System Administration

  • Software Installation
  • Patch Management
  • System Hardening
  • Configuration Management
  • Performance Monitoring

Preferred Skills

  • IBM DFSMS
  • IBM Tivoli Storage Manager (TSM) / IBM Storage Protect
  • Enterprise Storage Management
  • Mainframe Security Administration
  • Automation using REXX or JCL
  • ITIL-based Service Management
  • Incident and Change Management

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline in Science, Engineering or Technology.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in IBM mainframe infrastructure administration.
  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience administering CA-1 Tape Management.
  • Experience with enterprise backup hardware and storage platforms.
  • Experience supporting high-availability or mission-critical environments is highly desirable.

Preferred Certifications

While not mandatory, the following certifications are advantageous:

  • IBM Certified System Administrator – z/OS
  • IBM Storage Protect (Spectrum Protect) Certification
  • Dell EMC Proven Professional (Backup & Recovery)
  • Hitachi Vantara Storage Certifications
  • ITIL® 4 Foundation Certification

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving and root cause analysis capabilities.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with infrastructure teams, vendors, and stakeholders.
  • Strong documentation and organisational skills.
  • Willingness to support after-hours maintenance, weekend activities, and critical production incidents.

title: Senior Data Engineers til dataplatform i Forsvaret
description:
NATO og dansk forsvar står foran en omfattende digital og operativ transformation for at kunne imødegå fremtidens udfordringer. Den sikkerhedspolitiske situation og særligt Ruslands ageren i Ukraine gør denne transformation endnu mere nødvendig. Transformation er tidskritisk, og indebærer en cybersikker, teknologisk, digital og datacentrisk modernisering og organisering af hele Forsvarsministeriets koncern.

Derfor er vi nu ved at opbygge en koncernfælles programorganisation ved Forsvarsministeriet Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse, som er overordnet ansvarlig for at bygge fremtidens digitale og datacentriske forsvar og forestå den digitale og operative transformation. Programmet skal i løbet af de kommende år være ca. 200 medarbejdere.

Programmet er organiseret i tre hovedspor:

  • Eksekvering som har ansvar for opbygning af en ny digital backbone samt gennemføre applikationsmigrering til den nye digitale backbone
  • Digitalt fundament som har ansvar for arkitektur, datamodel og -governance, sourcing og industrisamarbejde samt cybersikkerhed
  • Forretning som har ansvar for koordination og samarbejde med det operative niveau, efterlevelse af NATOs styrkemål og ikke mindst digital transformation af koncernen
Om stillingen
Du bliver en del af Forsvarsministeriets program for Digital og Operativ Transformation, hvor vi opbygger en ny dataplatform, der skal skabe sammenhæng mellem systemer, data og operative behov.

Vi søger udviklere, der kan tage ansvar for opsætning af data pipelines fra forskelligartede kildesystemer, transformation af data, samt operationalisering i DevSecOps.

Du kommer ikke til at arbejde med isolerede komponenter, men med at få helheden til at fungere. Det betyder, at du både designer datamodeller, bygger pipelines og sikrer, at data bevæger sig korrekt og stabilt gennem platformen.

Opgaverne inkluderer:

  • Udvikling af dataflows, transformationer og pipelines
  • Datamodellering og strukturering af data, herunder metadata
  • Integration mellem systemer, services og datakilder
  • Sikring af datakvalitet og sammenhæng på tværs af platformen
Du vil ofte arbejde ud fra en overordnet retning eller et ønsket end-state, hvor du selv er med til at definere løsningen og vejen dertil.

Om dig

Du har erfaring med at arbejde med data i praksis og trives i en rolle, hvor du både udvikler og skaber sammenhæng mellem systemer.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring med data engineering, datamodellering, data- og løsningsarkitektur
  • Har erfaring med API’er, streaming, event-baserede integrationer eller distribuerede systemer
  • Har erfaring med SQL, Spark, Parquet eller Delta
  • Har erfaring med brug af DevOps eller DevSecOps
  • Har erfaring med integrationer og dataflows på tværs af systemer
  • Kan tage ansvar for løsninger end-to-end
Det er vigtigt, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt. Du kan arbejde ud fra en hensigt og selv omsætte den til en konkret løsning. Du har et mindset fokuseret på systemtænkning og datakvalitet.

Som person er du pragmatisk, løsningsorienteret og motiveret af at få komplekse systemer til at hænge sammen.

Vi tilbyder

  • En central rolle i et strategisk IT-projekt med stor organisatorisk synlighed
  • Et tværfagligt miljø med arkitekter, udviklere, domæneeksperter og standardiseringsfolk
  • Mulighed for at præge fundamentet for DOT’s IT-arkitektur
  • Du er med til at sikre, at data bliver et strategisk aktiv for Danmarks sikkerhed
Ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademikeroverenskomsten).

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Arbejdsstedet er i København.

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.

Kontakt og ansøgning

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte chef for sektionen Forretningstransformation Philip Engelholm på telefon +45 7221 7242.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Mia Nordbeck Carlsson på telefon +45 3266 5716 (fraværende i uge 31-33. I uge 31 kan HR-konsulent Madeleine kontaktes på 4031 1094. I uge 32-33 kan HR-konsulent Julie kontaktes på 3266 5848).

Ansøgningsfristen er den 23. august 2026 og samtaler forventes afholdt i forlængelse heraf. Stillingen er til besættelse efter aftale.

Du søger stillingen via linket og vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og kopi af uddannelsesbevis. Vær opmærksom på at bilag skal tilføjes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse

Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) er en styrelse under Forsvarsministeriet.

FMI har ansvaret for det samlede forsvars og beredskabs materiel, IT og cybersikkerhed. Det er os, der anskaffer, driver og bortskaffer materiel og IT for såvel Hæren, Søværnet, Flyvevåbnet, Arktisk Kommando, Specialoperationskommandoen, Hjemmeværnet, Beredskabsstyrelsen og resten af Forsvarsministeriets koncern. Desuden bistår vores IT-medarbejdere dagligt i at modstå de cyberangreb, Forsvarsministeriets koncern udsættes for. Vi er ca. 2500 medarbejdere (3/4 civile - 1/4 militære) fordelt ud over hele Kongeriget, med hovedkontorer i henholdsvis Ballerup, Brabrand og Hvidovre.

title: Mfg Process Engineer (Round Parts)
description:

title: [Rooms] Director of Rooms
description:
POSTION SUMMARY

Functions as the strategic business leader of the property's Rooms department. Responsible for planning, developing, implementing and evaluating the quality of property’s rooms. Position works with direct reports to develop and implement departmental strategies and ensures implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives. The position ensures Rooms operations meet the brand’s standards, targets customer needs, ensures employee satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues and maximizes the financial performance of the department. Develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and employees and provides a return on investment to the owner and company.

KEY RESPONSIBIRITES

Leading Rooms Team
• Champions the brand’s service vision for product and service delivery.
• Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding departmental goals to produce desired results.
• Makes and executes the necessary decisions to keep property moving forward toward achievement of goals.
• Monitors and promotes room rates, specials, and promotions at the residence.

Managing Profitability
• Analyzes service issues and identifies trends.
• Works with Rooms team to develop an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand’s business strategy and leads its execution.
• Reviews and audits expenses.

Managing Revenue Goals
• Monitors Rooms operations sales performance against budget.
• Reviews reports and financial statements to determine Rooms operations performance against budget.
• Coaches and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy and rate, wages and controllable expenses.
• Compares budgeted wages to actual wages, coaching direct reports to address problem areas and holding team accountable for results.

Ensuring and Providing Exceptional Customer Service
• Demonstrates and communicates key drivers of guest satisfaction for the brand’s target customer.
• Delivers excellent customer service throughout the customer experience and encourages the same from other employees.
• Reviews guest feedback with leadership team and ensures appropriate corrective action is taken.
• Coordinates and communicates event details both verbally and in writing to the customer and property operations.
• Creates an atmosphere in all Rooms areas that meets or exceeds guest expectations.
• Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
• Uses personal judgment and expertise to enhance the customer experience.
• Stays available to solve problems and/or suggest alternatives to previous arrangements.
• Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
• Stays visible and interfaces with customers on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
• Works to continually improve customer service by integrating obtained feedback and personal judgment into action plans.
• Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
• Ensures that employees understand expectations and parameters for Room duties.
• Facilitates the development of creative solutions to overcome obstacles and ensures implementation to continually improve guest satisfaction results.

Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities
• Interviews and hires employees.
• Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
• Ensures that regular, ongoing communication is happening in Rooms (e.g., pre-shift briefings, staff meetings).
• Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participates in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.
• Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of staff/operations meetings with an emphasis on generating innovative ways to continually improve results.
• Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the performance review process and holds staff accountable for successful performance.
• Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an “open door policy” and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
• Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.
• Conducts annual performance appraisal with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.
• Champions change, ensures brand and regional business initiatives are implemented and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary.
• Identifies talents of direct reports and their teams, and assists with their growth and development plans.

title: Regional Operations Account Specialist - Freight Fowarding
description:
DP World is transforming global trade through integrated logistics solutions that connect economies, businesses, and communities. As we continue to expand our Freight Forwarding and Logistics capabilities across Europe, we are looking for an experienced Senior Manager Operations Account Management – Freight Europe to join our Operations Excellence (OpsX) team.

This role is critical in ensuring operational excellence for our most strategic freight customers across Europe. As the operational counterpart to Key Account Managers, you will play a pivotal role in translating customer commitments into world-class service delivery, driving performance, governance, and continuous improvement across our Air, Ocean, and Road freight operations.

At DP World, we are creating smarter, more efficient supply chains through innovation, collaboration, and customer-centricity. If you thrive in a fast-paced international environment and are passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences, we would love to hear from you.

About the Role

Location: Sweden

Contract: 5 months fixed term

The Senior Manager Operations Account Management – Freight Europe is responsible for owning operational delivery and service performance for assigned strategic freight customers across Europe.

Acting as the primary operational contact for key customers, you will ensure consistent execution across branches, Customer Service teams, Shared Service Centres, and Operations Excellence functions. You will lead performance governance, manage escalations, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and ensure compliance with agreed service levels, SOPs, and contractual KPIs.

This role requires strong leadership, stakeholder management, and freight forwarding expertise to drive operational excellence across a complex and diverse European logistics network.

How You Will Contribute

Operational Ownership & Service Delivery

  • Take full operational ownership of assigned strategic freight customers across Europe.
  • Ensure consistent and reliable service delivery across Air, Ocean, and Road freight operations.
  • Drive compliance with customer SOPs, SLAs, contractual agreements, and operational KPIs.
  • Identify service risks and implement proactive corrective actions to protect customer satisfaction and business continuity.
  • Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with customers, Key Account Managers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Ensure transparent communication regarding operational performance, service quality, and improvement initiatives.

Performance Management & Governance

  • Monitor, analyse, and interpret operational performance data across multiple countries and functions.
  • Identify trends, risks, and root causes impacting service delivery.
  • Drive accountability for operational KPI achievement across branch and Shared Service Centre teams.
  • Maintain customer performance dashboards, escalation logs, and continuous improvement trackers.
  • Facilitate governance forums and performance reviews to ensure operational issues are addressed and improvements implemented.
  • Promote best-practice sharing and performance consistency across the European freight network.

Customer Relationship & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary operational point of contact for strategic freight customers.
  • Represent DP World in service reviews, escalation meetings, and operational discussions.
  • Partner closely with Key Account Managers to align commercial commitments with operational capabilities.
  • Coordinate activities between customers, branch operations, Customer Service teams, OPSX functions, and Shared Service Centres.
  • Foster strong stakeholder relationships through transparency, accountability, and a customer-first mindset.
  • Act as an operational ambassador for DP World across strategic customer accounts.

Continuous Improvement & Standardisation

  • Identify and implement operational efficiency and process improvement initiatives.
  • Support Lean, standardisation, and operational excellence programmes across customer accounts.
  • Drive adoption of best practices across countries, branches, and operational functions.
  • Support implementation of automation, digital tools, and data-driven operational processes.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of SOPs, playbooks, and customer governance frameworks.
  • Work closely with Process Excellence and Business Intelligence teams to improve operational visibility and performance.

Escalation & Issue Management

  • Lead customer escalation management, ensuring timely resolution and effective communication.
  • Develop and execute corrective and preventive action plans.
  • Track escalation progress and ensure sustainable resolution before closure.
  • Maintain comprehensive escalation records and service recovery documentation.
  • Ensure high standards of customer responsiveness and issue resolution.

Leadership & Capability Development

  • Support onboarding, training, and development of operational teams supporting strategic customer accounts.
  • Mentor junior Operations Account Managers and operational stakeholders.
  • Promote a culture of operational discipline, collaboration, and customer focus.
  • Drive engagement and accountability across both direct and indirect teams.
  • Champion DP World's values and commitment to operational excellence.

What You Will Bring

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Master's degree or postgraduate qualification in Operations, Logistics, or Process Management is advantageous.
  • Lean Six Sigma, Project Management, or Continuous Improvement certification is preferred.
  • Minimum 8-10 years of experience within Freight Forwarding, Logistics, or Supply Chain Operations.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in a customer-facing operational account management role.
  • Proven experience managing complex multinational freight customers across Air, Ocean, and Road freight.
  • Strong background in operational governance, performance management, and service delivery excellence.
  • Experience working within international matrix organisations.
  • Experience collaborating with Shared Service Centres and offshore operational teams.
  • Strong understanding of freight forwarding systems, TMS, ERP, CRM platforms, and KPI frameworks.
  • Experience driving process standardisation, continuous improvement, and operational transformation initiatives.
  • Exposure to reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, and advanced Excel is advantageous.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong customer relationship, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent understanding of end-to-end freight forwarding operations across multiple transport modes.
  • Proven operational leadership and account governance capabilities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset.
  • Ability to identify root causes and implement sustainable operational improvements.
  • Excellent project management and organisational skills.
  • Strong influencing and negotiation skills across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Ability to work effectively across countries, functions, and cultures.
  • Resilient, adaptable, and capable of operating in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality.
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
  • Additional European languages such as German, French, or Dutch are advantageous.
  • Willingness to travel across Europe (approximately 20-30%).

Compensation

DP World offers exciting and challenging career opportunities within a rapidly growing global organisation. We are committed to attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional talent by fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performance culture where employees can grow and thrive.

A market-competitive compensation and benefits package is offered.

About DP World

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving quality of life around the world. DP World exists to make the world's trade flow better, changing what is possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With more than 111,000 employees from 159 nationalities across 77 countries, DP World is transforming and integrating its businesses across Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics, and Technology to deliver seamless, end-to-end supply chain solutions.

We are committed to fostering a culture of inclusion, respect, integrity, and empowerment, where diverse perspectives drive innovation and business success.

WE MAKE TRADE FLOW

TO CHANGE WHAT'S POSSIBLE FOR EVERYONE

title: Passenger Assistant (Zero-hours)
description:
· Are you looking for a rewarding role focussed on helping others?
· Do you want to make a real difference?

If so, we have the role for you!

London Hire Community Services provide accessible home-to-school transport services where our service users are unable to access public transport. Our services are run under a full passenger vehicle operator’s licence regulations.

We have built our service around principals and process that are recognised as industry standards. We take the safety of our passengers as well as our staff very seriously and have also put in place OHSAS 18001 that governs the way we manage Health and Safety in the workplace.

  • Assist the driver wherever possible in a manner that ensures the safety and comfort of passengers.
  • Assist passengers when embarking and disembarking the vehicle, including assisting service users who have disabilities, to alight the vehicle in accordance with Health and Safety requirements.
  • Monitor and supervise passengers whilst in transit and being responsible for their welfare whilst on board.
  • When necessary, assist in the operation of the passenger lift or other equipment that is used to assist passengers boarding and alighting the vehicle as required.
  • Ensure any wheelchairs are correctly located and secured using suitable equipment.
  • Ensure passengers in wheelchairs are secured with a full lap and diagonal safety belt or other securing equipment.
  • Communicate with passengers and clients in a patient, informative, non-patronising manner.
  • Report late running and incidents in line with depot processes.
  • Ensure the vehicle allocated is always secure whilst in use.
  • Ensure all communication equipment is correctly utilised ensuring the safe, smooth and efficient running of the service.
  • You should demonstrate a sound understanding of disabilities.
  • Able to deliver the service with a patient and level-headed attitude.
  • Ability to work in a team environment as well as confidence to work with minimum supervision and using own initiative.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication.
  • Great attention to detail and able to complete records clearly and accurately.



  • Zero hours – no fixed contractual hours, working on a split-shift basis covering AM and PM transport.
  • Rolled up holiday pay entitlement is 12.07% of gross pay relating to work completed. This will be paid to you each month, and there is no entitlement to other additional paid annual leave to be taken during school term weeks.
  • There is no requirement to work during school holidays, although overtime may be available that will be paid in addition to your contractual earnings.
  • Salaries are pro-rata - you will receive payment every month of the year (even in non-working periods!)
  • Access to our Employee Assurance Programme.
  • Automatic enrolment in our pension scheme after three months service.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:

• rozwiązania chmurowe,

• zarządzanie danymi,

    świadczonych usług.

Kompetencje wymagane do realizacji usług:

    danych),

Co oferujemy w ramach współpracy?

title: Storeman
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Receive and stage merchandise by department, mark appropriately for placement in facility, and deliver merchandise to appropriate department. Stack received merchandise on pallets or carts. Complete requisition forms for inventory and supplies. Notify manager/supervisor of low stock levels in a timely manner. Receive deliveries, store perishables properly, and rotate stock. Inspect deliveries and date times to verify freshness, cleanliness, consistency, and quality throughout case lots. Refuse acceptance of damaged, unacceptable, or incorrect items. Adhere to food safety and handling policies and procedures across all food-related areas. Organize, clean, and sanitize all refrigerators and freezers, floors, food equipment, and drains. Remove empty pallets, cardboard, and trash and place in proper storage areas.

Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak to guests and co-workers using clear, appropriate and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print).

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

  • Previous experience in stock control or stores or a similar position
  • Data capturing and stock taking experience
  • Ability to work accurately and without supervision
  • Proficiency in Microsoft packages essential (Word, Excel, email) essential
  • Attention to detail pertaining to area of responsibility
  • Strong planning and organizing skills to meet deadlines with regards to operational requirements essential
  • Ability to work within a pressurized environment

CRITICAL WORK ACTIVITIES

  • Complete all daily duties as set out in departmental duties and requirements.
  • To take full responsibility for Inventory Control in Stores
  • Assist cost controller in determining par stock levels for stores as per consumption
  • Ensure all requested store requisitions are captured daily.
  • Uphold HACCP procedures and ensure good housekeeping
  • To communicate between cost control, receiving and stores operations, and ensure strict adherence of stores and inventory procedures

Safety and Security

  • Follow company and department safety and security policies and procedures to ensure a clean, safe, and secure environment.
  • Use proper equipment, wear appropriate personal protective clothing (PPE), and employ correct lifting procedures, as necessary, to avoid injury.
  • Report work related accidents, or other injuries immediately upon occurrence to manager/supervisor.
  • Identify and correct unsafe work procedures or conditions and/or report them to management and security/safety personnel.
  • Follow policies and procedures for the safe operation and storage of tools, equipment, and machines.
  • Complete appropriate safety training and certifications to perform work tasks.
  • Follow Hazardous Material Management Program procedures for handling and disposing of chemicals, fertilizer, pesticides, blood borne pathogens, etc., including using Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS).

Policies and Procedures

  • Follow company and department policies and procedures.
  • Protect company tools, equipment, machines, or other assets in accordance with company policies and procedures.
  • Ensure uniform, nametags, and personal appearance are clean, hygienic, professional and in compliance with company policies and procedures.
  • Maintain confidentiality of proprietary materials and information.
  • Protect the privacy and security of guests and coworkers.
  • Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Communication

  • Speak to guests and co-workers using clear, appropriate and professional language.

Working with Others

  • Support all co-workers and treat them with dignity and respect.
  • Develop and maintain positive and productive working relationships with other employees and departments.
  • Partner with and assist others to promote an environment of teamwork and achieve common goals.

Quality Assurance/Quality Improvement

  • Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards.

Physical Tasks

  • Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print).
  • Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift.
  • Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance.
  • Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination.
  • Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces.
  • Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces.
  • Move up and down stairs and/or service ramps.

General Procurement

  • Notify manager/supervisor of low stock levels in a timely manner.
  • Receive and stage merchandise by department, mark appropriately for placement in facility, and deliver merchandise to appropriate department.
  • Complete requisition forms for inventory and supplies.
  • Stack received merchandise on pallets or carts.

General Food - Stocking/Receiving

  • Date, label, and rotate all items according to company standards.
  • Adhere to food safety and handling policies and procedures, such as First In-First Out (FIFO) and Cold Chain compliance, across all food-related departments or areas.
  • Maintain the sanitation standards of the food storeroom and walk-ins.
  • Identify and remove merchandise that is outdated, distressed, or unacceptable in appearance to ensure quality and freshness.

title: Teamlead Verzuim & Inzetbaarheid | Amstelveen
description:
Wat jij gaat doen

Als Teamlead Verzuim & Inzetbaarheid
Als Teamlead Verzuim & Inzetbaarheid ben je één van de sleutelfiguren in de verdere inrichting van regio West. Binnen Acture Arbo maken we de beweging naar een regionale organisatie waarin professionals vanuit verschillende disciplines steeds intensiever samenwerken rondom onze klanten. In deze transitie speel jij een belangrijke rol.

Je bouwt en ontwikkelt een team van casemanagers en zorgt voor een uniforme, kwalitatieve en toekomstbestendige werkwijze. Tegelijkertijd werk je nauw samen met de regiomanager, bedrijfsartsen, arbeidsdeskundigen, verpleegkundigen en andere professionals binnen de regio.

Je bent zichtbaar, benaderbaar en weet mensen mee te nemen in verandering. Je coacht medewerkers in hun ontwikkeling, stimuleert eigenaarschap en zorgt voor verbinding tussen verschillende disciplines. Daarmee draag je direct bij aan een dienstverlening die niet alleen kwalitatief sterk is, maar ook klantgericht, efficiënt en toekomstbestendig.

In deze rol:

  • Bouw en ontwikkel je het casemanagementteam binnen regio West;
  • Geef je dagelijks leiding aan medewerkers en begeleid je hun groei en ontwikkeling;
  • Borg je kwaliteit, uniformiteit en continue verbetering van processen;
  • Werk je samen met collega-teamleads aan één herkenbare werkwijze binnen alle regio's;
  • Stimuleer je multidisciplinaire samenwerking rondom klanten;
  • Lever je een actieve bijdrage aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de regionale organisatie;
  • Ben je een belangrijke sparringpartner voor de regiomanager op het gebied van capaciteit, teamontwikkeling en dienstverlening.

Deze functie heeft een duidelijk pionierskarakter. Je stapt in op een moment waarop de regionale structuur wordt opgebouwd en krijgt volop ruimte om mee te denken, te verbeteren en impact te maken.

Wat jij krijgt

Voor wat hoort wat.

  • Een uitstekend salaris. Wij bieden jou een salaris tot maximaal €5.616 bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband (40 uur per week). Dit is afhankelijk van jouw werkervaring. Binnen Acture zijn er diverse doorgroeimogelijkheden, zowel verticaal als horizontaal.
  • Bonusregeling. Goede prestaties gaan niet onopgemerkt voorbij. Acture beloont goede financiële bedrijfsresultaten en persoonlijke resultaten met een jaarlijkse bonus. Deze bedraagt maximaal 8% van het basis bruto jaarsalaris en wordt afhankelijk van jouw persoonlijke resultaten en de resultaten op groepsniveau, geheel of gedeeltelijk uitgekeerd aan het eind van het jaar.
  • 30 vakantiedagen. Omdat wij tijd voor jezelf net zo belangrijk vinden.
  • Vakopleidingen, trainingen en coaching. Ons continu leren en verbeteren programma biedt training on-the-job en een breed aanbod van opleidingen waar collega’s via onze online trainingsbibliotheek – de Acture Academy – onbeperkt toegang tot hebben. Als jij bij ons aan de slag gaat als casemanager bieden we jou de hbo geaccrediteerde opleiding Regie op verzuim en Ziektewet aan in combinatie met individuele coaching.
  • Een goede pensioenregeling. Geregeld via MijnDoenpensioen van a.s.r. Zo zit je er niet alleen nu, maar ook later nog warmpjes bij!
  • Een collectieve zorgverzekering. Bij Zilveren Kruis krijg jij een collectiviteitskorting van 5% op de premie van de aanvullende verzekering. Bovendien kom je in aanmerking voor extra vergoedingen.
  • We investeren in jouw (mentale) gezondheid. Naast een gezonde lunch en sportmogelijkheden bieden we via ons vitaliteitsplatform extra ondersteuning voor medewerkers. Dit platform is speciaal ontwikkeld om je te helpen lekker in je vel te zitten en te blijven. Je kunt hier gebruikmaken van persoonlijke begeleiding door een coach, maar ook inspirerende artikelen, video’s en events vinden over uiteenlopende onderwerpen die bijdragen aan jouw welzijn.

Wat wij vragen

Naast die persoonlijke match.


Je bent een leider die mensen weet te verbinden én resultaat weet te realiseren. Je brengt rust en structuur in een omgeving die volop in ontwikkeling is en krijgt energie van bouwen aan teams en samenwerking.

Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in het volgende:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau;
  • Ervaring met het aansturen en ontwikkelen van teams;
  • Ervaring binnen arbodienstverlening, verzuimmanagement of een vergelijkbare dienstverlenende omgeving;
  • Je beschikt over de opleiding Regie op Verzuim of bent bereid deze te behalen.

Wat jou onderscheidt:

  • Je ontwikkelt mensen en teams naar een hoger niveau;
  • Je brengt structuur, eigenaarschap en focus;
  • Je bent veranderingsgericht en voelt je prettig in een pioniersomgeving;
  • Je stimuleert samenwerking over disciplines heen;
  • Je beschikt over organisatiesensitiviteit en weet verschillende belangen te verbinden;
  • Je combineert resultaatgerichtheid met oprechte aandacht voor mensen.

Enthousiast?

Vanwege de vakantieperiode ontvang je vóór 10 augustus geen inhoudelijke terugkoppeling op je sollicitatie.

Vanaf 10 augustus vinden de eerste online kennismakingsgesprekken plaats met geselecteerde kandidaten. Daarna volgt een assessment, een gesprek met de Manager en Directeur en tot slot een klikgesprek met enkele teamleden.
