title: Externe vacature bij Byzonder: Projectleider Intensieve Zorg
description:
Byzonder is op zoek naar een nieuwe collega! Via deze weg delen wij graag onderstaande vacature. Solliciteren via: ajkingma1@outlook.com

Vacature Projectleider Intensieve Zorg (12 uur per week)

Bouw mee aan de toekomst van intensieve zorg in Friesland

Werk jij in de gehandicaptenzorg en krijg je energie van samenwerken, verbinden en vernieuwen? Wil jij naast je huidige functie een regionale rol vervullen waarmee je echt verschil kunt maken? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.

Byzondr, het samenwerkingsverband van de Friese gehandicaptenzorg, zoekt een:

Projectleider Intensieve Zorg 12 uur per week | voor de duur van één jaar (met mogelijkheid tot verlenging)

De uitdaging

Intensieve zorg is één van de drie strategische thema's van Byzondr. Samen werken we aan één ambitie:

"Voor iedere cliënt met een complexe zorgvraag een passend antwoord, door goede regionale samenwerking."

Als projectleider geef je samen met de thema-ambassadeur en deelnemende organisaties verdere invulling aan dit thema. Je brengt mensen en organisaties bij elkaar, ondersteunt de bestaande werkgroepen, organiseert kennisdeling en helpt ideeën om te zetten in concrete resultaten.

Wat ga je doen?

Je:

• ondersteunt de thema-ambassadeur Intensieve Zorg;

• coördineert en faciliteert de regionale werkgroepen;

• stelt een projectplan op;

• ondersteunt, waar nodig, bij het opstellen van implementatieplannen van de deelnemende zorgorganisaties;

• organiseert themabijeenkomsten;

• stimuleert kennisuitwisseling en samenwerking tussen de zorgorganisaties;

• ontwikkelt samen met de deelnemende organisaties nieuwe initiatieven;

• bewaakt de voortgang en rapporteert aan de programmamanager en stuurgroep;

• werkt samen met de vertegenwoordigers van het programma ‘intensieve zorg/VG 7+’ van het samenwerkingsverband van 5 grote zorgaanbieders in Noord Nederland;

• werkt samen op dit thema met andere WLZ sectoren (GGZ en VVT) en met andere domeinen (WMO, Jeugdwet)

• verbindt regionale ontwikkelingen met landelijke initiatieven en kansen.

Wie zoeken wij?

Je bent een enthousiaste verbinder die gemakkelijk samenwerkt over organisatiegrenzen heen. Daarnaast beschik je bij voorkeur over:

• HBO+ werk- en denkniveau;

• ervaring met project- of programmamanagement;

• kennis van de gehandicaptenzorg;

• affiniteit of ervaring met intensieve of complexe zorg door achtergrond (gedragswetenschapper of begeleider met ervaring) of ervaring

• verbindende kracht: je kunt partijen bij elkaar brengen; brengt dilemma’s in kaart en brengt ze, waar nodig, onder de aandacht bij de thema-ambassadeur en evt stuurgroep van Byzondr. We zoeken bij voorkeur een collega die al werkzaam is bij één van de Friese organisaties die deelnemen aan Byzondr.

Zie de site Byzondr : byzondr.nl

Wat bieden wij?

• een uitdagende regionale opdracht met maatschappelijke impact;

• de mogelijkheid om de samenwerking rond intensieve zorg in Friesland verder vorm te geven;

• samenwerking met betrokken professionals uit de gehele Friese gehandicaptenzorg;

• veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, innovatie en netwerkontwikkeling;

• een inzet van gemiddeld 12 uur per week gedurende één jaar (met mogelijkheid tot verlenging);

• vergoeding van de (loon)kosten van de uitlenende organisatie.

Interesse?

Wil je meer weten of je belangstelling kenbaar maken? Neem dan contact op met: Auke Jelle Kingma – programmamanager Byzondr, 06 53825722, ajkingma1@outlook.com

title: Distrikt Bjerringbro søger medarbejdere
description:
Er du social- og sundhedsassistent? Så se lige med her:

Er du social – og sundhedsassistenten, som gerne vil arbejde både rehabiliterende og omsorgsfuldt i et stærkt tværfagligt borgernært team, så er chancen der nu hos os.

Hjemmeplejen distrikt Bjerringbro søger 2 nye dygtig og fagligt velfunderet kollega i en fast stilling i fortrinsvis dagvagt med afløsning i aftenvagt.

Distrikt Bjerringbro er placeret i skønne landområder, hvor vi har ruter i både by og på landet. Du bliver en del af en personalegruppe med fantastiske kollegaer fordelt på forskellige aldersgrupper og faggrupper. Vi lægger vægt på et godt arbejdsmiljø hvor din mening tæller, hvor der er højt til loftet og du har din nærmeste leder tæt på.
I de borgernære teams har vi alle indflydelse på vores daglige arbejde, og er med til at finde fælles løsninger på de udfordringer der kan opstå.
Vi har en fast ergoterapeut tilknyttet teamenes, en visitator som er her 2 gange om ugen og en fysioterapeut som deltager på ugentlige tværfaglige møder.

Vi har derfor brug for netop dig, som har lyst til:
  • at have en afvekslende hverdag, hvor ingen dage er ens
  • at vi lægger vægt på dine faglige input og at alles mening er værdifuld
  • at vi i samarbejde med dig sætter dine kompetencer i spil og hvor du vil opleve, at der er mulighed for at du kan udvikle dig personligt og også som en del af et team
  • at der er fokus på arbejdsmiljøet
  • at der uddelegeres opgaver under ansvar
  • at du altid er en vigtig medspiller.

Vi forventer selvfølgelig også lidt af dig, blandt andet at du:
  • er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent
  • har et godt overblik og gode samarbejdsevner
  • deltager aktivt og bidrager til det gode arbejdsmiljø
  • kender dine kompetencer og ved, hvornår du skal sige til/fra
  • har lyst til at arbejde tværfagligt og rehabiliterende i borgernes hjem med respekt for borger og pårørende
  • er loyal overfor Viborg Kommunes rammer og værdier
  • er en god holdspiller med et positivt sind.
  • du er indstillet på at afløse i aftenvagt ved behov
Vi tilbyder dig:
  • En fast stilling fortrinsvis dagvagt med afløsning i aftenvagt
  • En til tider hektisk dagligdag, men hvor vi kan se hinanden i øjnene, inden vi går hjem
  • En hverdag, hvor vi som noget helt naturligt arbejder med digitale værktøjer heriblandt skærmopkald til borgere, Nexus, Digirehab, vagtplan via Loop samt TEAMS til tværfaglige møder på skærm
  • En god introduktion til dine opgaver
  • En mulighed for selvfølgelig selv at vælge dit timetal mellem 32 og 37 t/uge

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Din vagtplan tilrettelægges så vidt muligt efter dine ønsker, med vagt hver 2. weekend eller 5 weekender fordelt over 12 uger.
Stillingen er på 37 timer/ugentlig eller efter aftale.

Har vi vækket din interesse, så send os din ansøgning, så du har mulighed for at blive en del af vores fantastiske arbejdsplads. Du er også meget velkommen til at kontakte os for en uforpligtende snak og/eller en kop kaffe.

Løn - og ansættelsesvilkår
I henhold til gældende overenskomst.

19. August 2026

title: Er din pædagogfaglighed det perfekte match til mennesker med multiple funktionsnedsættelser? Så har vi jobbet til dig
description:
Bliv del af en hverdag, hvor din faglighed gør en forskel for mennesker med fysiske og psykiske funktionsnedsættelser.

Hos os handler pædagogik om langt mere end dagens opgaver. Du bruger din pædagogfaglighed til at skabe tillid, relationer og muligheder.

Nogle gange gør du det ved at støtte en borger i at passe sit arbejde eller deltage i fritidsaktiviteter. Andre gange ved at skabe struktur og forudsigelighed i hverdagen. Og nogle gange opstår de vigtigste pædagogiske øjeblikke midt i den personlige pleje, hvor nærvær, kreativitet og tillid gør forskellen.

"Min vigtigste opgave er at støtte mennesker, der er afhængige af vores hjælp, i at have det mest aktive, indholdsrige og værdige liv, som de selv har mest mulig indflydelse på og selvbestemmelse omkring," fortæller en af dine kommende kolleger.

Du bliver en del af
En arbejdsplads, hvor vi er nysgerrige på hinandens idéer og erfaringer. Vi deler viden, sparrer om dilemmaer og udvikler vores praksis sammen, fordi vi ved, at den bedste støtte til borgerne skabes i fællesskab.

Som socialpædagog på botilbuddene for mennesker med multiple funktionsnedsættelser i Center for Længerevarende Boformer bliver du en del af et fagligt stærkt fællesskab, hvor du hver dag er med til at skabe et trygt, meningsfuldt og værdigt hverdagsliv for voksne (18+) med udviklingshæmning, ofte i kombination med fysiske og/eller psykiske funktionsnedsættelser.

Vi søger socialpædagoger til flere botilbud
Vi har lige nu ledige stillinger på flere botilbud. Når du søger, kan du angive, hvor du helst ønsker ansættelse. Vi sidder også klar til at hjælpe med at finde det helt rigtige match, der passer til dine kompetencer og ønsker.

Er der interesse fra begge sider, vil du blive inviteret til en samtale. Du kan besøge botilbuddet, inden du beslutter dig, og vi står klar til at svare på spørgsmål undervejs.

Læs om de forskellige botilbud, der aktuelt har ledige stillinger:

  • Fredskovvej
  • Grøndalsvænge
  • Jacobshøj
  • Løvstikkevej
  • Provstevej
  • Robertshøj
Et område, mange muligheder
Botilbuddene på det multiple område er forskellige både i målgrupper, pædagogiske fokusområder og opgavernes kompleksitet.

Du kan fx arbejde et sted, hvor

  • borgerne er aktive medspillere i eget liv, har arbejde og netværk uden for botilbuddet
  • borgerne har behov for støtte til at skabe struktur, overskuelighed og forudsigelighed
  • borgerne har fysiske og/eller kognitive funktionsnedsættelser
  • de fleste borgere kommunikerer med sprog, mens andre kommunikerer nonverbalt og kræver opmærksomhed på små signaler
  • etik, selvbestemmelse og udvikling er omdrejningspunktet, og hvor også de små fremskridt har stor betydning
Uanset hvor du bliver en del af fællesskabet, er relationen til borgeren og den faglige refleksion grundlaget for arbejdet.

”Du kan ikke tale om én målgruppe; det er virkelig bare mennesker. Det opmuntrer til, at man bare ser personen. Det gør målgruppen umulig at forklare, men det er med til at gøre mit arbejde spændende,” siger en af dine kommende kolleger.

Hos os får du mulighed for at

  • arbejde med Low Arousal og neuropædagogiske tilgange
  • udvikle dine kompetencer gennem kurser, temadage, supervision og faglige netværk
  • sparre med engagerede kolleger på tværs af centrets mange tilbud
  • arbejde tæt sammen med andre socialpædagoger, social- og sundhedsassistenter og sygeplejersker
  • indgå i alle opgaver omkring borgeren, hvor personlig pleje kan være en naturlig del af arbejdet
  • arbejde systematisk med dokumentation, observationer og faglig refleksion
Hvem er du?
Du er uddannet socialpædagog og motiveres af at skabe udvikling, trivsel og livskvalitet sammen med mennesker, der har brug for din faglighed.

Måske har du erfaring fra handicapområdet. Måske kommer du fra psykiatrien, børneområdet eller et helt tredje sted. Flere af dine kommende kolleger havde ikke forestillet sig, at de skulle arbejde med voksne med multiple funktionsnedsættelser, og i dag kan de ikke forestille sig at arbejde andre steder.

Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, fagligt reflekteret og optaget af at møde mennesker med respekt, nærvær og ordentlighed.

Du får en grundig introduktion, en mentor og løbende sparring, så du bliver godt klædt på til opgaven.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst for pædagogisk personale.

Stillingerne er som udgangspunkt på fuld tid med dag-, aften- og weekendvagter. Enten hver anden eller tredje weekend. Vagterne varierer fra botilbud til botilbud. Vi lægger vægt på fleksibilitet, så arbejdsliv og privatliv kan hænge sammen.

Vi indhenter reference og straffeattest i forbindelse med ansættelse.

Har du spørgsmål?
Du er velkommen til at sende en SMS til rekrutteringsafdelingen på 24 67 50 81, så kontakter vi dig.

Send dit CV og uddannelsesbevis. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Søg via linket senest fredag den 28. august 2026
Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

title: Product Manager, Adapt
description:
The Product Management team drives Asana’s product strategy and execution, translating customer needs and opportunities into a compelling roadmap and working cross-functionally to deliver impactful solutions for team productivity and collaboration. We’re helping to define the Work Management category and inventing new ways for teams to work more efficiently together and see the larger purpose behind their work. Our team works directly with Engineering, Design, Experience Research, and Data Science, as well as with Sales, Support, and Marketing to ship great products. You’ll take part in every type of product work here — from strategy to product to process improvements — conceptualizing, launching, and iterating on Asana itself for millions of teams around the world.

We are looking for an experienced product manager to join the team responsible for key elements of Asana’s work platform strategy. Over the next 2 years, a critical piece of Asana’s strategy is to continue building out a platform that can support many different types of workflows. You’ll be responsible for understanding how customers’ need to structure work to enable their workflows and build out the features to meet those needs directly, and enable other Asana R&D teams to incorporate structure into their features. You’ll work with a large set of cross-functional partners across both our GTM and internal teams to learn about how internal and external customers of all sizes need to customize their core Asana experience to support their workflows, and how your work fits within the entire customer lifecycle so that we customers feel confident in structuring their work in the right way at the right time to power.

This role is perfect for a product manager with deep customer empathy for the complexity of mapping messy work to a structured tool, has an end-to-end ownership mindset, and drives for results. We are looking for someone who has experience building software in partnership with enterprise customers, strong product intuition, and can marry qualitative insights with quantitative data to deeply understand the customer experience. You thrive on learning from customers, and are excited to partner with engineering, design, user research, sales, and the rest of our amazing PM team.

This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

Define and deliver a compelling roadmap to ensure customers have the structure they need to power their end to end workflows.Synthesize input from customers, user research, data science, and business partners, ensuring we are continuously investing in the right ways to structure work, and shifting quickly when an area is no longer leveraged.Take new initiatives from 0 to 1, and then scale them up, as we validate product market fitPartner closely with design, engineering, marketing, and customer success to co-create a cohesive end to end journey and execute on the roadmap with velocity.Collaborate across the R&D organization to support other R&D teams in achieving their goals.

About you

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with at least 1-2 years experience on B2B SaaS.

  • Customer-centric: You spend time directly with customers to understand their nuanced challenges and synthesizing research to identify and solve problems..

  • Communication and collaboration: Demonstrate strong communication and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams, clarifying complex concepts and writing precise product specifications. You pair effectively with design, engineering, and our business teams.

  • Systems thinker: Think systemically, creating solutions that simplify complex use cases for customers.

  • Strategic: Provide strategic insights and create intuitive connections within the custom field & types features and platform to address critical customer issues.

  • Get Stuff Done: Execute projects with high velocity, breaking them down into MVPs and iterative stages for impactful delivery.

  • Grow Team Asana: Foster team morale and share best practices in product management.

  • Growth Mindset: Embrace a growth mindset, welcoming feedback and maintaining curiosity in learning.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between 29,000 - 31,935PLN. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

  • Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits

  • Career coaching & support

  • Inclusive family building benefits

  • Long-term savings or retirement plans

  • In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences

These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

#LI-Hybrid

About us

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.

Join Asana’s Talent Network to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.

title: Associate III, Pricing Operation [L3] (CE Pricing)
description:
본 공고는 재직 임직원을 대상으로 하는 사내 공모 전용입니다. (임직원 추천은 Link로 진행)

This posting is exclusively for internal employees. (Employee referrals are submitted via the Link)

지원 시에는 반드시 첨부된 ‘사내 공모 지원서 양식’을 작성한 후, 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 접수해 주시기 바랍니다.

To apply, please complete the attached ‘Internal Transfer Request Form’ and submit it via your Coupang email address.

  • 사내 공모 정책: [Link]
  • Internal Transfer Policy: [Link]

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

쿠팡 Pricing Operations 조직은 고객에게 정확한 가격 경험을 제공하고, 가격 오류로 인한 재무적 리스크를 최소화하기 위한 모니터링 및 운영 업무를 수행합니다.
심야 Pricing Operations 담당자는 24/7 운영 체계의 핵심 구성원으로서 가격 이상 탐지 알람에 대해 실시간으로 모니터링하고 대응합니다. 가격 이상 징후를 신속하게 분석하고 조치하여 고객 경험을 보호하며, 가격 사고 예방을 통해 회사의 비즈니스 안정성과 수익성을 확보하는 역할을 담당합니다.

업무 내용

  • 가격 이상감지 Pricing Alert 실시간 모니터링 및 대응 수행
  • 오퍼레이터 근태 관리, 업무 품질 검수 및 에스컬레이션 이슈 대응
  • 가격 이상 징후 분석 및 가격 정상화 조치 수행
  • 상품 및 경쟁사 가격 검수 및 검증 업무 수행
  • SOP 기반 Alert 처리 및 운영 품질 관리
  • 가격 오류 발생 시 영향도 분석 및 유관부서 이슈 공유 (에스컬레이션)
  • Alert 처리 SLA 준수 및 운영 효율 개선 활동 수행
  • 운영 프로세스 개선 및 가격 손실 방지를 위한 인사이트 도출
  • 운영 데이터 분석 및 품질 지표 모니터링 수행

자격 요건

  • 운영 (Operation), 모니터링, 품질관리, 고객지원 또는 이커머스 관련 업무 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 데이터 및 사실 기반으로 문제를 분석하고 원인을 파악할 수 있는 분
  • 반복적이고 세밀한 업무 수행 능력 및 높은 정확도를 보유하신 분
  • 다양한 상황에서 우선순위를 판단하고 신속하게 의사결정할 수 있는 분
  • 원활한 커뮤니케이션 역량을 바탕으로 다양한 이해관계자와 협업이 가능한 분
  • 야간 및 교대 근무 수행이 가능한 분 (00~09시)
  • MS Excel 및 업무 시스템 활용 역량을 보유하신 분

우대 사항

  • 이커머스, Pricing, Marketplace, Catalog, Operations 관련 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 가격 모니터링, Risk Management, QC/QA 업무 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 데이터 분석 및 리포트 작성 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 대용량 데이터를 기반으로 이상 징후를 탐지하거나 운영 개선을 수행한 경험을 보유하신 분
  • SLA 기반 운영 조직 또는 24/7 운영 환경에서 근무한 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 긴급 상황 대응 및 에스컬레이션 프로세스 운영 경험을 보유하신 분

근무 형태

  • 근무시간 주 5일, 00:00 ~ 09:00
  • 전일 재택근무

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

전형절차

  • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
  • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
  • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

참고사항

  • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
  • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
  • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
  • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
  • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
  • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Senior Product Order Engineer
description:
Job Summary:

If you are looking for an opportunity in the Bill of Materials team called Order Engineering, Emerson has this exciting role for you! The Senior Product Order Engineer II is based in FCEC Chennai, India, and will provide technical and order engineering support for all the Emerson Flow Control products to meet customer requirements. We value autonomy, self-reliance, fast movers, a passion for robust and maintainable tests, and the ability to ship a quality product.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

1) Review incoming orders (commercial and technical) according to established guidelines/requirements

2) Check requirements in specification sheets against the technical information in OEDI/II and Bulletins. i.e. product versus service compatibility.

3) Verify required options are compatible with the selected options

4) Create/update product structures to meet the required construction.

5) Submit requests for engineering and/or part number setup.

6) Raise Internal Order Requisitions (IOR) to factories.

7) Provide timely response to factory enquiries.

title: (Gespecialiseerd) verzorgende
description:
Ben jij (gespecialiseerd) verzorgende en wil je graag een waardevolle bijdrage leveren binnen de ouderenzorg? Dan ben je van harte welkom op onze kleinschalige, warme locatie de Hessegracht in Doesburg.

Dit ga je doen

Als verzorgende ondersteun je bewoners bij de dagelijkse verzorging en voer je verpleegtechnische handelingen uit. Je luistert naar wat bewoners belangrijk vinden en stemt de zorg daarop af. Ook onderhoud je contact met 1e contactpersonen, familie, mantelzorgers en diverse behandelaren.

Ben je al gespecialiseerd verzorgende? Dan heb je daarnaast een coördinerende rol en houd je overzicht over de totale zorg rondom bewoners en hun dossier. Je bent een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor naasten en collega's en zorgt ervoor dat de zorg goed op elkaar aansluit.

Dit bieden wij

Ben je verzorgende en heb je de wens om in de toekomst door te groeien naar gespecialiseerd verzorgende? Dan kan dat! We hebben een uitgebreide online leeromgeving en je krijgt tijd voor scholing. Als organisatie vinden wij leren en ontwikkelen belangrijk.

Daarnaast kan je rekenen op deze arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • een contract bespreekbaar voor minimaal 16 uur en maximaal 28 uur per week;

  • een contract voor de duur van een jaar met de intentie dat dit wordt omgezet in een contract voor onbepaalde tijd;

  • een brutosalaris volgens de cao VVT van minimaal €2.736,- (FWG 35) en maximaal €3.864,- (FWG 40) bij een fulltime 36-urige werkweek;

  • aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals 8% vakantietoeslag, 8,3% eindejaarsuitkering en belastingvoordeel bij de aanschaf van een fiets, laptop of sport-, meditatie-of mindfulnessabonnement.

Hier ga je werken

Als nieuwe collega op locatie De Hessegracht in Doesburg word je onderdeel van een team van 50 medewerkers, onder leiding van een manager zorg. Op deze kleinschalige locatie wonen bewoners met dementie. De locatie bestaat uit 24 appartementen en 4 huiskamers. Hierdoor is er veel ruimte voor persoonlijke aandacht en een vertrouwde leefomgeving. Dat maakt de locatie, naast de bijzondere ligging in het park en gelegen aan de IJssel, zo uniek. Ook het historische centrum van Doesburg ligt op loopafstand.

Je komt terecht in een gezellig en betrokken team. Een vast team waarbij iedereen ertoe doet en verantwoordelijkheid neemt. Natuurlijk is plezier hebben met elkaar en in het werk hierbij erg belangrijk.

De Hessegracht is onderdeel van ouderenzorgorganisatie Attent Zorg en Behandeling. Wil je meer weten over onze organisatie? Lees dan hier verder.

Dit ben jij

Werk je naast dagdiensten ook graag in de nacht? Fijn! Met jouw flexibele inzet zorg je ook in de nacht voor rust en continuïteit voor onze bewoners. Je bent een open en betrokken persoon waar collega’s op kunnen rekenen. Daarnaast ben je iemand die weet van aanpakken en goed kan communiceren. Je deelt namelijk graag jouw kennis en ervaring.

En verder:

  • heb je kennis van zorg en welzijn op mbo-niveau 3;

  • heb je ervaringskennis in de omgang met cliënten;

  • ben je bekwaam in de handelingen die horen bij de functie;

  • heb je kennis van de ziektebeelden in de ouderenzorg.

Enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer nu!

Herken jij jezelf in deze functie en ben je enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan via de sollicitatiebutton! Je hoort zo snel mogelijk of we je uitnodigen voor een sollicitatiegesprek.

Let op: Een referentiecheck is onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure en bij je indiensttreding vragen wij je om een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) aan te vragen.

Lees hier meer over de sollicitatieprocedure.

Heb je vragen? Stel ze gerust!

Tanja Wanningen, manager zorg, vertelt je graag meer. Je bereikt haar op 06 - 57 97 48 27.

Heb je vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure? Neem dan contact op met de afdeling recruitment via 06 - 82 73 09 99.

잘 짜인 판에서 일하는 것을 넘어, 그 판을 직접 키우며 시장의 기준을 바꿀 분을 찾습니다.

[우리가 만드는 것]
콘스탄트는 탈모를 머리카락만의 문제가 아니라 '삶의 질의 문제'로 봅니다. 스킨케어가 매일의 루틴이 된 것처럼, 두피·헤어 케어도 일상의 습관으로 만들고 싶었습니다. 그렇게 만든 브랜드 '리필드'는 출시 이후 빠르게 성장해 지난해 매출 111억 원을 달성했고, 국내 두피 케어 시장에서 독자적인 자리를 잡았습니다.
우리는 빠른 실행력과 브랜드의 긴 호흡을 함께 가져가는 '브랜드 커머스' 회사입니다. 브랜드의 본질(why)은 지키되 표현(message)은 시장 반응에 맞춰 끊임없이 바꿔가며, 하나의 브랜드 자산을 길게 쌓아 올립니다. 국내에서 다진 힘을 일본·미국으로 넓혀가는 지금이, 글로벌 브랜드로 도약하는 변곡점입니다.

[콘스탄트가 잘하는 것]
• 눈으로 확인하는 효과 — 자사 앱과 두피 스캐너로 고객이 자신의 변화를 직접 확인합니다. 100만 건 넘게 쌓인 두피 데이터 위에서 제품을 만들고, 데이터로 검증합니다.
• 타협하지 않는 R&D — 탈모 전문의가 독자 개발한 특허 성분 'cADPR'. 그 효능을 입증한 논문이 국제 학술지 'Applied Sciences'에 등재됐습니다. 임산부도 안심하고 쓸 수 있는 성분으로 제품을 만들고 있습니다.
- 리필드,독자개발 ‘cADPR’ 성분 모발 성장 촉진 논문 국제학술지 게재 https://www.yakup.com/news/index.html?mode=view&cat=12&nid=325138
• 멀티채널 운영력 — 올리브영 헤어케어 1위 달성. 자사몰·쿠팡·마켓공구·큐텐까지 채널별 데이터를 정교하게 운영하며 성장을 넓혀갑니다.
• 이미 글로벌로 — 아마존 Overall Pick과 Amazon's Choice 선정. 미국·일본·중국에서 현지 사업을 운영합니다. 동남아·남미·유럽까지 글로벌 확장을 본격화하고 있습니다.

[콘스탄트의 일하는 방식]
콘스탄트는 사람이 손으로 메우던 일을 시스템으로 바꿉니다. 자체 개발 조직을 중심으로 AI 자동화를 빠르게 도입하고, 모든 의사결정을 데이터 위에서 내립니다. 스케일업의 속도를 시스템으로 떠받칩니다.
근무 시간이 아니라 임팩트로 일하고, 어느 회사 출신인지보다, 직접 무엇을 만들고 끝까지 밀어붙였는지를 봅니다. 콘스탄트에서의 일은 '맡겨진 업무'로 끝나지 않습니다. 직접 세운 가설이 제품이 되고, 그 제품이 누군가의 두피와 일상에 남습니다. 치열하게 고민할 환경과 과감하게 실행할 무대를 동시에 제공합니다.
확실한 배움을 남기는 실패는 언제든 환영합니다. 시장을 직접 키우며 나의 커리어까지 함께 키우는 즐거움을, IPO를 향해 달리는 지금의 콘스탄트에서 경험해 보세요.

'글로벌 본부 — 다음 시장을 0에서 직접 여는 사람들'
국내에서 검증한 제품을 세계 시장에 안착시키는 최전선입니다. 일본·북미를 중심으로 현지 채널을 세팅하고, 인플루언서·콘텐츠로 브랜드를 알리며 시장에 뿌리를 내려가는 단계입니다. 글로벌 본부는 일본·북미 현지 사업과, 동남아·남미까지 거래선을 넓히는 글로벌 B2B·B2C를 맡습니다. 정답이 정해져 있지 않기 때문에 직접 가설을 세우고, 채널 운영·MD·콘텐츠가 한 팀으로 움직입니다. 늘어나는 나라 수만큼 성취가 또렷하게 쌓이는, 큰 시장의 초기를 내 손으로 여는 무대입니다.

Responsibilities

•TikTok·Instagram 북미 인플루언서를 직접 서치·아웃리치하고 실행의 처음부터 끝까지 실행합니다.
•인플루언서 마케팅 캠페인 운영을 서포트합니다.
•유가·무가 시딩 데이터를 하나의 트래킹 체계로 정리하고 주 단위로 업데이트합니다.
•정리한 데이터에서 "어떤 크리에이터, 어떤 콘텐츠가 먹혔는지"를 뽑아내 다음 시딩 대상과 콘텐츠 방향을 제안합니다.
•북미 숏폼 트렌드와 경쟁 브랜드 시딩 콘텐츠를 리서치해 신규 전략을 제안하고 확장합니다.

Requirements

• 영어로 인플루언서에게 직접 아웃리치·DM 커뮤니케이션이 가능한 분
• 최소 6개월 이상 풀타임 근무가 가능한 분

Preferred

• 북미 인플루언서 시딩 또는 어필리에이트 마케팅 실무 경험
• TikTok Shop·Amazon 등 북미 이커머스 채널을 접해본 경험
• 본인이 직접 크리에이터로 숏폼 콘텐츠를 만들어본 경험
• K-beauty 또는 D2C 뷰티 브랜드·콘텐츠에 관심이 많은 분

Benefits

•근무형태: 인턴 3개월 (평가 결과에 따라 정규직 또는 계약직 전환), 급여 100% 지급

title: Senior Commissioning Engineer - Hoogspanning
description:
In bedrijf stellen en testen met impact? Speel een sleutelrol in ons commissioning team en word Senior Commissioning Engineer bij Hanab Energy Solutions!

Als Senior Commissioning Engineer ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het testen en inbedrijfstellen van secundaire systemen en installaties binnen hoogspanningsomgevingen. Jij speelt een cruciale rol in in de oplevering van veilige en betrouwbare installaties.

Je begeleidt het volledige commissioning proces van lopende projecten, zorgt ervoor dat de benodigde documentatie beschikbaar is en je bent constant in contact met onze klanten.

WAT GA JE DOEN?

  • Testen en in bedrijf stellen van hulpvoedingsvoorzieningen voor gelijk- en wisselspanning.
  • Controleren en testen van alle secundaire voedings- en stuurstroomkabels en verbindingen en besturings- en voedingspanelen.
  • Uitvoeren van functionele en veiligheidstesten op PAC-systemen en beveiligingsrelais (IED’s).
  • Ondersteunen van FAT-, SAT- en SIT-testen en uitvoeren van kwaliteitscontroles.
  • Opstellen van testplannen, vastleggen van restpunten-lijsten en vastleggen van gegevens voor as-built documentatie.
  • Spelen van een sleutelrol in de overdracht van installaties aan de klant.

Je werkt samen met de collega’s van het engineering team, het projectteam en zorgt voor een goede afstemming met de klant.

WAAROM HANAB?

Werken voor Hanab Energy Solutions betekent werken voor een toonaangevende speler op het gebied van energie infrastructuren. Hanab Energy Solutions is dé expert in ontwerp, aanleg en beheer van (complexe) hoogspanningsinstallaties. Wij helpen klanten als netbeheerders, energie-opwekkers en zakelijke klanten met uitdagingen die de energietransitie met zich meebrengt. Kortom, wij staan voor technisch vooruitstrevende oplossingen.

WAT BRENG JE MEE?

  • Een afgeronde mbo-4 of hbo-opleiding, richting elektrotechniek, energietechniek, industriële automatisering of een vergelijkbare richting.
  • Minimaal 8 jaar werkervaring met secundaire systemen en PAC-installaties.
  • Kennis van hoogspanningscomponenten zoals transformatoren en schakelaars.
  • Bij voorkeur certificeringen zoals VCA-VOL, BEI-BLS Transport-AVP, BEI-BHS Transport-AVP.
  • Kennis van de Engelse en van de Nederlandse taal (mondeling en schriftelijk).

Wij investeren graag in jouw ontwikkeling. Je kunt allerlei trainingen en opleidingen volgen.

Daarnaast beschik je over de volgende competenties:

  • Communicatiekracht: je kunt goed luisteren en anderen meenemen in jouw ideeën.
  • Prioriteiten stellen: je kunt overzicht houden, hoofd en bijzaken scheiden en de juiste keuzes maken in jouw werk.
  • Analytisch vermogen: je bent in staat om een probleem of vraagstuk vanuit verschillende invalshoeken te benaderen en kunt tot een oplossing komen.
  • Proactieve houding: je neemt initiatief om potentiële problemen te identificeren, komt met ideeën en oplossingen.
  • Veiligheidsbewustzijn: je bent je bewust van de mogelijke risico’s van een bepaalde actie of situatie. Je kunt deze signalen vervolgens doeltreffend omzetten om een actie op een veilige manier uit te voeren.

WAT HEBBEN WE JE TE BIEDEN?

  • Een mooi salaris passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring: tussen € 4.900,- en € 6.900,- bruto per maand.
  • Deelname aan de CAO Netwerkbedrijven. Boven op het salaris een flex-budget van 18% per maand. Je kunt dit uit laten betalen of (deels) gebruiken voor het kopen van verlof. Onderdeel hiervan is 8% vakantiegeld en 5,2% ADV en 4,8% overig flex-budget.
  • Eindejaarsuitkering: 3,7%.
  • Vakantiedagen: 24,5 bij een fulltime dienstverband.
  • Bijdrage ABP-pensioen: 27% waarvan H-ES 18,9% bijdraagt.
  • Functiegerichte opleiding bespreekbaar met een opleidingsbudget van € 1500,-.
  • Een leaseauto met tankpas, je moet natuurlijk wel op onze projecten
  • komen.
  • Duurzaam inzetbaarheidsbudget: € 700,- bruto per jaar, voor bijvoorbeeld een sport abonnement.
  • Een goede werksfeer, waar je gewoon jezelf kunt zijn.
  • Fijne collega’s en de leukste bedrijfsfeesten en teamactiviteiten.

Daarnaast zijn er volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. De dynamiek van onze projecten zorgt ervoor dat geen dag hetzelfde is.

LATEN WE KENNISMAKEN!

Klik op de ‘ik ben geïnteresseerd’ button en upload jouw cv met eventueel een motivatiebrief. Wij kijken uit naar jouw reactie!

Wil je eerst meer weten, voordat je gaat solliciteren?

Kom dan in gesprek met ons! Thijs Minderhoud kan je meer kan vertellen over het werk en onze projecten. Wil je eens langskomen op een projectlocatie? Dat kan! Wil je wel eerst bellen met Thijs Minderhoud op telefoonnummer +316 33010429? Dan kunnen we een afspraak met je maken!

Lees meer over de projecten bij Hanab Energy Solutions.

Voor vragen of meer informatie over het recruitment proces kun je contact opnemen met Carolien Molenaar, Corporate Recruiter, via recruitment-es@hanab.nl of via +31 624837885.

title: Lead Backend Engineer, Marketplace Payments (Limited-time Relocation Bonus)
description:
Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

We're searching for a Lead Backend Engineer to join one of our engineering teams in the Marketplace Payments domain. Our goal is to build secure & reliable payments solutions for all Vinted buyers and sellers. You’ll collaborate with experienced colleagues to own the critical lifecycle of a user’s financial journey. This means architecting the systems that power a user’s first sale and balance activation, ensuring seamless payment account creation across multiple PSPs. You will lead the charge in navigating the complexities of KYC/KYB and identity verification within an environment of ever-changing regulatory requirements. You and the team will drive the high-stakes execution of user migrations between different PSPs and payment licenses, all while maintaining the scalable, resilient core platform that ensures smooth payment account lifecycle for the entire Vinted Marketplace.

This is a fast-paced environment at the beginning of our journey, so we embrace uncertainty. We're constantly building new services and evolving existing ones, with experimentation being a key. We balance the "fail fast" principle to avoid analysis-paralysis, but we also take the time to understand the benefits of different alternatives before diving in. We're not afraid to make mistakes. We learn from them.

In this position, you’ll

  • Work in a team of 5-8 engineers, engineering manager, product manager and decision scientist.
  • Apply Agile and Lean principles in your work. We don't rigidly adhere to a single framework. We view Scrum, Kanban, and other methodologies as tools, selecting the most beneficial one for the team to achieve its goals.
  • Collaborate with other developers through GitHub pull requests and code reviews. Our pull requests move fast: time to first review is up to 5 min, average pull request cycle time (from open to merge) is up to 2 hours.
  • Use AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and others to improve your code.
  • See your code to affect millions of users almost instantly. Our main branch gets rolled out straight to production on each merge. With deployments many times per day.
  • Work with diverse tech stack, including: languages: Ruby; infrastructure: AWS and on-premise; databases/storage: MySQL, Elasticsearch, Redis; workflow orchestration: Temporal; monitoring/observability: Prometheus, Grafana. We don't expect you to be familiar with all of them beforehand, but we expect you will be excited to learn them fast.
  • Write unit tests for all of the code you write and contribute to integration and e2e test writing and its usage.
  • Take ownership of critical alerts and business metrics for your team to ensure our services achieve 99.99% availability.
  • You will participate in on-call rotations to ensure our product performs well.

About you

  • Continuous and Passionate Learner: You're eager to master new technologies and concepts, driven by a strong passion for technology and a "can-do" attitude, always ready to embrace new challenges and grow as a specialist.
  • Pragmatic Problem Solver: You think practically, choosing the best solutions while avoiding over-engineering. Your love for fixing things is driven by a deep desire to understand how they work.
  • Backend Expert with Strategic Decision-Making: You have solid backend engineering skills, familiarity with Ruby is beneficial but not required, and you balance immediate needs with long-term stability in your strategic decisions.
  • Collaborative and Communicative Team Player: You prioritize collective success, actively deepening your expertise, sharing knowledge, and upholding best engineering practices. Strong communication skills enable you to collaborate effectively with cross-domain teams and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Holistic and Systematic Thinker: You have a deep understanding and experience of building the complex systems and can strategically navigate how different components interact, guiding architectural decisions.
  • Mentor and Knowledge Sharer: Your mentorship leaves a lasting impact, empowering others to excel and grow by sharing deep technical insights and fostering a culture of knowledge exchange.
  • Cross-Functional Bridge Builder: You excel at aligning teams from different functional areas, ensuring cohesive collaboration to drive impactful outcomes.
  • Proactive Innovator: You identify opportunities for innovation and efficiency, leveraging new technologies to enhance capabilities.
  • Technical Leader: You effectively lead significant technical transformations within the organization, advocating for necessary changes while ensuring alignment with broader business strategies.

Work perks

  • This position is based in Vilnius/Kaunas. If you're currently living outside of Lithuania, we offer extensive Relocation Support. Do you require relocation to Lithuania if successful?
  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 working days of holiday
  • Access to all the tools & tech needed for work
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Private health insurance
  • Mental and emotional health support through the Mindletic app
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation
  • A dog-friendly office
  • In Vilnius office: Gym & in-house meals at friendly prices
  • In Kaunas office: a monthly lunch allowance, and a once-a-week provided in-house lunch and breakfast

Working at Vinted

Limited-time Relocation Package

This position is based in Lithuania, and if you're not (yet), don't worry! We're here to help you settle in with premium relocation assistance and a generous €30,000 gross bonus. If you feel that Vinted is your perfect cultural fit—apply! For more info, refer to our Relocation page.

Individual Learning Budget

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

Hybrid Work

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.

Equal Opportunity

The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

The gross monthly salary range for this position is:
€6.542—€8.842 EUR

title: Hyperscale Security Engineer
description:
As our Hyperscale Security Engineer, you will lead physical and electronic security engineering design and delivery across our development and expansion projects. Working closely with customer security teams, you’ll integrate security requirements from concept and design through construction and into live operations, ensuring our data centres meet the exacting standards of government, enterprise and hyperscale clients.

This role combines technical design leadership with commercial discipline, performing Capex and Total Cost of Ownership analysis, managing tender and contract specifications, and helping shape NEXTDC’s Security Roadmap as the sector evolves. You’ll work across domestic and international sites and partner with stakeholders at every level of the business.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Lead physical and electronic security engineering design and delivery across development and expansion projects, integrating customer security requirements into the design and development process
  • Establish and maintain robust Construction Security Plans to manage risk during construction adjacent to live operational data centres and oversee the structured transition of construction areas to operational customer security teams
  • Conduct Capex and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) options analysis, including comprehensive risk assessments, and present structured recommendations to support business case and investment decisions
  • Prepare, manage and evaluate tender and contract specifications, and conduct peer reviews and workflow assessments via Aconex and Procore across all security documentation
  • Perform construction-phase site inspections, on-site commissioning and delivery troubleshooting across domestic and international sites and provide ongoing Facilities Management support post handover
  • Engage proactively with internal and external stakeholders, review emerging security technology best practice, and contribute to NEXTDC’s Security Roadmap

This opportunity will see you working with world leaders in our space. Join our journey now and be an integral part of our success. We are happy for this position to be based in Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane, Canberra or Perth

  • Demonstrated expertise in physical and electronic security engineering design and delivery for government, enterprise and hyperscale customer environments
  • Proven project management experience, with the ability to lead and coordinate multi-disciplinary teams across global time zones in a complex, fast-paced environment
  • Sound knowledge of relevant industry, government and hyperscale security standards, including the Protective Security Policy Framework (PSPF) and Security Construction and Equipment Committee (SCEC) requirements
  • Current AGSVA Negative Vetting Level 1 (NV1) security clearance, or the demonstrated ability to obtain clearance within the first six months of appointment
  • Desirable: Diploma of Security Risk Management and ASIS Physical Security Professional (PSP) certification.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, or equivalent Diploma or Trade qualification.

  • Seize this exciting opportunity to join one of Australia’s fastest growing companies and play a key contributing role in the future of AI and the digital economy
  • Join an inclusive, diverse and values-driven working culture supporting hybrid work practices
  • Enjoy awesome employee benefits (gifted share options, NEXTDC days, volunteer days, professional development, holistic wellbeing and mental health programs and more)
  • Great opportunities to progress within our company (grow as we grow)

Our mission is to continue building a diverse and inclusive workforce which represents the communities in which we operate.

Make NEXTDC your next move.

title: HANDYMAN/LAGERMEDARBEJDER
description:
Vi mangler en frisk handyman til at varetage opbygning af messer, pop-up butikker og andre håndværksmæssige opgaver. Har du hænderne godt skruet på, er omhyggelig og har sans for detaljer? Sætter en ære i at gennemføre dit arbejde med stolthed og omhu, så er du måske vores nye kollega.

Arbejdsopgaver:

  • Være en del af planlægning og styring af messe- og butiksopbygning/nedtagning i samarbejde med butiksansvarlig og dekoratører

  • Vedligeholde og opbygning af showroom, 1-2 gange årligt

  • Vedligeholde inventar og materialer til brug i butikker og på messer

  • Forefalden lagerarbejde

Forventninger:

  • Har en håndværksmæssig baggrund, eller erfaring med træ-, maler- og murerarbejde m.m.

  • Kan bevare overblikket, også i travle perioder

  • Kørekort, samt truckcertifikat

  • Fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider

Det Gamle Apotek A/S tilbyder:

  • God og uformel omgangstone

  • Et spændende og alsidigt job

  • Gode kollegaer

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

Som person er du dynamisk, løsnings- og handlingsorienteret. Du trives med forskelligartede opgaver og en arbejdsdag, som sjældent er, som dagen før. Der må påregnes 50-80 rejsedage i forbindelse med messer og pop-up butikker.

Ansøgningsfrist snarest. Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.

Er du personen, vi leder efter, så send en skriftlig ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til lagerchef Preben Lau på pla@dga-engros.dk. Mærk ansøgningen ”Handyman”.

title: 재무회계 담당자(3~5년)
description:
About

"세상이 일하는 방식을 더 행복하게 변화시키자."
"우리는 IT 아웃소싱 시장의 거래 방식을 혁신하고 있습니다."


IT 기술의 발달로 일하는 방식이 변화하고 있습니다.
우리가 맞이할 미래의 일하는 방식은 과거와 같지 않을 것입니다.
더 빠르고, 더 편리하고, 더 정확한 방법으로 소프트웨어를 거래할 수 있는 플랫폼을 만들고 있습니다.

위시켓은 플랫폼의 성장을 인정받아 누적 102억원 투자를 유치하였고, 스타트업 유니콘부터 대형기업, 중소기업, 공공기관, 예비창업자까지 다양한 규모의 기업이 위시켓을 통해 IT 프로젝트를 진행하고 있습니다. 위시켓은 계속해서 변화하는 사회와 시장의 문제를 앞장서서 해결하며 세상이 일하는 방식을 더 행복하게 변화 시키고자 합니다.



■ 위시켓은 이렇게 일해요.

• 위시켓은 [유저중심]으로 일을 하고 있습니다.
어떤 포지션의 일을 하든 상관없이, 모든 팀원들은 유저들과의 직/간접적 접점을 가지고 있습니다. 유저들이 정말 원하는 것, 필요로 하는 것들을 만들기 위해 유저들의 생각이나 상황을 섣불리 추측하지 않습니다. 경쟁사보다는 유저들의 실망을 두려워합니다.

• 위시켓은 [T자형 인재]를 지향합니다.
협업을 어려워하거나, 깊이가 부족한 주변 사람이 되는 것을 경계합니다. 능력 있는 개인이 해결할 수 있는 문제보다 능력 있는 팀으로서 해결할 수 있는 문제가 더 크다고 생각합니다. 개인이 가지고 있는 버티컬한 능력만큼 협업을 중요하게 생각합니다.

• 위시켓은 [효과와 효율]을 중요하게 생각합니다.
효과가 있어야 효율이 의미가 있다고 믿습니다. 그래서 효과가 검증되기 전까지 수작업을 하기도 합니다.

• 위시켓은 [성장]을 위해 다양한 방면으로 끊임없이 노력합니다.
팀원 개개인의 현재 속도보다는 성장의 가속도를 중요하게 생각합니다.

• 위시켓은 [Why]를 중요하게 생각합니다.
본질에 집중하기 위해 항상 "왜?"를 질문하고 답을 찾습니다.


■ 채용 분야
• 채용분야 : 재무팀 (3 ~5년)

■ 위시켓 재무팀 소개
• 건전한 재무 상태의 유지를 통해 조직이 안정적으로 성장하고 목표를 달성할 수 있도록 중추적인 역할을 수행합니다.
• 회계 및 세무 관련 이슈에 대한 꼼꼼한 리스크 관리를 통해 재무 정보의 정확성과 투명성을 보장합니다.
• 전사적인 신뢰 구축에 기여하며, 경영진과 직원들이 의사 결정을 내릴 때 정확하고 유용한 정보를 제공합니다.
• 다양한 부서와의 긴밀한 소통과 협력을 통해 회사의 전략적 목표 달성을 지원하는 중요한 역할을 맡게 됩니다.
• 회계, 재무, 세무 등의 분야에서 폭넓은 전문 지식과 실무 경험을 바탕으로 업무를 수행하고 있습니다.

Responsibilities

1. 결산·회계
• ERP 전표 입력 및 검토, 계정별 명세 관리
• 월 결산 및 마감 업무
• 매출 세금계산서 발행, 매입계산서 수취 및 적격증빙 검증
• 법인카드 사용내역 정산 및 전표 매칭 검증

2. 자금
• 플랫폼 파트너 정산 대금 일별 지급 및 지급 내역 관리
• 일별 입출금 내역 관리 및 자금수지 작성
• 미입금(결제지연) 채권 모니터링 및 회수 관리
• 회수 일정 관련 유관 부서 커뮤니케이션

3. 세무·감사
• 부가가치세·법인세 신고 자료 준비
• 외부감사 요청자료 준비 및 계정별 소명자료 작성
• 세무조정 관련 자료 정리 및 대응 보조

Requirements

• 재무·회계 실무 경력 3~5년
• 회계 ERP 사용 경험 보유자 (전표 입력부터 월 마감까지 직접 처리해보신 분)
• 월 결산 사이클을 주도적으로 진행해본 경험
• 외부감사 대응 경험 보유자
• 대량 데이터를 다룰 수 있는 엑셀 활용 능력 보유자
• 마감 기한과 숫자 정확성에 책임감을 갖고 업무 하는 분
• 타 부서와 자료를 주고받으며 필요한 내용을 명확히 요청하고 조율할 수 있는 분
• 반복되는 업무에서 비효율을 발견하고 개선을 제안하시는 분

Preferred

• AI·자동화 도구로 반복 업무를 줄여본 경험이 있으신 분 (엑셀 매크로, 파이썬, 생성형 AI 등 방식은 무관)
• 업무를 위해 직접 무언가를 만들어보신 분 (관리 시트, 자동화 스크립트, 업무 매뉴얼 등)
• 재경관리사, 전산회계 1급, 세무회계 등 회계·세무 관련 자격증 보유자
• 회계·세무 관련 전공자
• 더존 위하고(WEHAGO) 사용 경험자
• IT·플랫폼 업종(아웃소싱·중개 플랫폼 등) 재무 업무 경험자

Benefits

■ 업무 환경
• 역세권에 위치해 있어서 편하게 이동할 수 있습니다. (역삼역에서 도보 5분 거리)
• ‘빠삐‘라는 발랄한 고양이가 사무실에서 함께 생활하고 있습니다.
• 사무실에 항상 음악이 켜져 있어 캐주얼한 분위기로 업무를 할 수 있습니다.
• 사무 공간 외 별도의 휴식 공간이 있어서 편하게 휴식을 취할 수 있습니다.
• LG그램/맥북, 모니터 등 업무에 필요한 장비는 모두 지원합니다.
• 효율적으로 업무하기 위해 슬랙, flex,Trello, 그리팅,컨플루언스, 구글 이메일/캘린더/드라이브 등 다양한 툴을 사용하고 있습니다.


■ 혜택 및 복지
위시켓은 세상이 일하는 방식 뿐만 아니라 팀원들이 행복하게 일할 수 있는 조직문화와 업무 환경을 만드는 데에도 노력을 기울이고 있습니다.
- 6.5 hour : 하루에 6.5시간 근무 합니다. (10시부터 18시까지 근무)
- Lunch time : 점심시간은 1시간 30분입니다. 여유롭게 식사하고, 개인시간을 가질 수 있습니다.
- Meal : 팀원들의 밥값 부담을 해소하기 위해 점심/저녁 식사를 제공합니다.
- Present : 생일을 맞이하는 팀원에게는 생일선물을, 설과 추석에는 명절 선물을 드립니다.
- health care : 팀원들의 건강을 위해 종합 건강 검진을 지원해 드립니다.
- Landing Program : 새로 합류한 팀원을 위한 랜딩제도와 버디제도를 운영하고 있습니다.
- 무제한 간식 제공 : 다양한 간식과 카페보다 맛있는 커피를 무제한으로 드실 수 있습니다.
- 성장을 위한 지원 : 개인 성장을 위한 도서, 교육, 세미나를 지원해 드립니다.
- 생일 조기 퇴근 : 행복한 시간을 보낼 수 있도록 2시간 조기퇴근제도를 운영하고 있습니다.
- 동호회 지원 : 팀원들과 더욱 친해지길 바라는 마음으로 사내 동호회 운영비를 지원해 드립니다.
- 친목활동비 : 한 달에 한 번 유닛끼리 문화생활 등을 할 수 있도록 운영비를 지원해 드립니다.
- 독서모임 : 같은 책을 읽고 자유롭게 생각을 공유하는 모임이 있습니다. (참여 시 상품권 지급)
- Cheerup : 사소한 일이라도 서로 칭찬하고 응원하는 문화가 있습니다. (칭찬상품권 지급)


■ 채용 형태
• 정규직 채용(수습 3개월)
• 입사 지원 서류에 허위사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.
• 수습기간에도 근무 조건 및 복지는 다른 직원과 동일하며, 제대로 업무를 수행할 수 있도록 충분한 교육을 진행합니다.

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Our client is a European insurtech company providing digital insurance solutions and embedded protection products, enabling seamless integration of insurance offerings into e-commerce and financial platforms across multiple markets.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build high-performance services: Design, develop, and maintain scalable APIs (gRPC and REST) powering core insurance services, taking ownership of complex services and their evolution.
  • Own delivery at system level: Lead microservices and larger system components end-to-end — from requirements and architecture through implementation, deployment, and operational ownership in production.
  • Contribute to technical direction: Provide input on technology choices, design patterns, and service boundaries; participate in architecture discussions led by Tech Leads and Architects.
  • Mentor and elevate the team: Coach mid-level and junior engineers through design reviews, pairing, and constructive code reviews; raise the engineering bar across the team.
  • Champion engineering excellence: Establish and enforce best practices in automated testing, observability (tracing, logging, metrics), CI/CD, and operational readiness.
  • Lead in production: Act as a senior escalation point for complex incidents; drive root-cause analysis, reliability improvements, and cost/performance optimization.
  • Ensure compliance and security: Embed security policies, coding standards, and regulatory requirements of the financial and insurance sector into design decisions from the start.

Must Have

  • 8+ years of backend development experience, with 5+ years working with Golang in production
  • Proven track record designing and evolving gRPC and REST-based APIs at scale, including ownership of complex service-level design decisions
  • Expert-level understanding of distributed systems, microservices architectures, event-driven design, and cloud-native patterns
  • Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and modern DevOps workflows, including production troubleshooting at scale
  • Strong experience with PostgreSQL (data modeling, performance tuning) and message queues (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ)
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and driving adoption of engineering best practices across a team
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for building clean, efficient, and maintainable systems
  • Regular use of AI tools to improve productivity, automate or reduce repetitive work, support decision-making, and deliver higher-quality outcomes
  • Ability to use AI tools responsibly by structuring effective prompts, critically validating outputs, understanding limitations, and taking ownership of the final result — and to guide others in doing the same
  • Excellent English communication skills, including the ability to communicate design decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience in the insurance, fintech, or broader financial services domain
  • Deep familiarity with observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure), ideally including cost optimization
  • Knowledge of infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, Helm)
  • Experience leading technical initiatives across multiple teams or contributing to platform-level decisions
  • German language skills are a plus

As a people-first organisation, we believe diversity strengthens our teams and drives innovation. All employment decisions are based on merit, skills, and performance, without discriminating based on any personal characteristic. This reinforces our commitment to providing an inclusive and respectful workplace.

At Accesa you can

Enjoy our holistic benefits program that covers the four pillars that we believe come together to support our wellbeing, covering social, physical, emotional wellbeing, as well as work-life fusion.

  • Physical Wellbeing: Our wellbeing program includes medical benefits, gym support, and personalised fitness options for an active lifestyle, complemented by team events and the Healthy Habits Club.
  • Work-Life Fusion: In very dynamic industries such as IT, the line between our professional and personal lives can quickly become blurred. Having a one-size-fits-one approach gives us the flexibility to define the work-life dynamic that works for us.
  • Emotional Wellbeing: We believe that to maintain our overall health, we need to invest in our mental wellbeing just as much as we do in our physical health, social connections or in achieving work-life balance.
  • Social Wellbeing: As a growing community in a hybrid environment, we want to ensure we remain connected not just by the great work we do every day but through our passions and interests.

title: Software Development Engineer - II | Backend (AI POD)
description:
About SpotDraft

SpotDraft is on a mission to help legal and business teams move faster, together. Our AI-powered contracting platform is redefining how companies manage contracts, and our story deserves to be told in creative, human, and memorable ways.


Job Summary

SpotDraft is revolutionizing legal operations with AI-powered tools that help legal teams work faster and smarter. Our flagship products leverage cutting-edge LLM technology to automate routine legal work and accelerate contract review.
Sidebar is an AI-powered team of legal assistants that handles routine legal work—from contract analysis and legal research to compliance tracking and drafting SpotDraft. It tackles everything beyond contracts, including policy questions, regulatory compliance, and strategic advice SpotDraft, learning from your organization's knowledge to become a specialized legal co-pilot.
VerifAI is an AI contract review tool that works as a Microsoft Word add-in, helping legal teams review contracts up to 70% faster with SpotDraft. It uses generative AI to check contracts against personal or organizational guidelines and answer open-ended questions SpotDraft, automatically flagging deviations and suggesting improvements.

About the role

We're looking for a Backend Engineer to join the AAI Pod — the team building SpotDraft's AI-powered product capabilities, including data/text extraction, contract intelligence, and LLM-driven features layered on our core contracting platform. You'll help architect, build, and scale backend systems that power these AI features end-to-end, working closely with Product, Engineering, and AI teams to ship high-impact capabilities that our customers directly experience.

This role sits at the intersection of strong backend fundamentals and applied AI — you won't just be calling an API, you'll be designing the systems (extraction pipelines, RAG architectures, orchestration layers) that make AI features reliable and scalable in production.

What you'll do

System Design & Architecture

  • Design and build scalable backend systems for AI-powered features, with a strong focus on reliability and performance

  • Own end-to-end system design (HLDs & LLDs) for extraction pipelines and AI feature integration

  • Make thoughtful trade-offs balancing speed, scalability, and maintainability in systems that call LLMs or process high volumes of documents/text

AI & Extraction Systems

  • Build and operate data/text extraction pipelines that power downstream AI features

  • Design and implement RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, or agentic workflows as part of product features

  • Own the reliability and cost-efficiency of AI-integrated systems — caching, fallback handling, and failure recovery for LLM-dependent services

Product & Engineering Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product, Design, and AI teams to ship impactful features

  • Translate ambiguous product requirements into clear technical solutions

  • Participate in cross-functional discussions and influence product direction

Execution & Ownership

  • Own features and systems end-to-end — from ideation to production and beyond

  • Build systems from scratch and evolve them as they scale

  • Take accountability for reliability, performance, and uptime of owned systems

Team & Culture Contribution

  • Contribute to hiring by participating in interviews and candidate evaluation

  • Mentor junior engineers and raise the overall engineering bar

  • Bring a strong "builder's mindset" with a bias for action and problem-solving

What We're Looking For

Must haves

  • 4–7 years of experience in backend/software engineering (minimum 4–5 years)

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — proven experience architecting and building scalable products/features end-to-end (not just feature-level execution)

  • Hands-on experience with system design (HLD & LLD)

  • AI/ML exposure — either has built/implemented a RAG pipeline, or has integrated/used LLMs in a production application

  • Experience with data or text extraction pipelines — this is core to the pod's work, not a peripheral skill

Should haves

  • Distributed systems experience — queues, async processing, caching

  • Familiarity with vector databases / embeddings (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, etc.)

  • Experience working in cross-functional teams (Product, Design, AI)

  • Track record of ownership — building, scaling, and maintaining systems independently

Nice to haves

  • Python or Go

  • Apache Beam or similar large-scale data processing frameworks

  • Prior experience in document-heavy or NLP-adjacent products (legal tech, fintech, OCR, search)

  • Prior experience in startup environments or fast-paced teams

Why SpotDraft?

  • Brilliant teammates—Work with some of the sharpest minds in legal tech.

  • Expand your network—Interact with top founders, investors, and industry leaders.

  • Real impact—Take ownership of projects and see your work in action.

  • Big goals, bold moves—We trust you to deliver, innovate, and push boundaries.

Our Core Values

  • Our business is to delight Customers

  • Be Transparent. Be Direct

  • Be Audacious

  • Outcomes over everything else

  • Elevate each other

  • Be Passionate. Take Ownership.

  • Be 1% better every day


All candidates’ personal data shared during the recruitment process will be handled with utmost confidentiality and used solely for hiring purposes, in line with applicable data protection regulations.

*SpotDraft is an equal-opportunity employer. Candidates will not be discriminated against based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, caste, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran, or disability status

title: Corporate Secretary
description:
• Handle a portfolio of local and international clients and support the delivery of corporate secretarial services.
  • Prepare and file statutory returns and documents with ACRA, including annual returns, resolutions, share allotments and changes of directors.
  • Maintain and update statutory registers, records and minute books in accordance with the Companies Act.
  • Assist in company incorporations, striking-off applications and routine corporate actions.
  • Ensure compliance with the Companies Act and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Liaise with clients, auditors, tax agents and government authorities on corporate secretarial matters.
  • Provide advisory support on corporate governance and business structuring when required.

Requirements:

  • Diploma or Degree in Business Administration, Law, Accountancy, or related discipline.
  • Minimum 2 years of relevant corporate secretarial experience in a professional firm or corporate services provider.
  • Good working knowledge of the Singapore Companies Act and ACRA.
  • ACIS / CSIS / CPA or equivalent professional qualification is an advantage.
  • Experience in handling a portfolio of local and international clients will be preferred.
  • Meticulous, responsible, and able to manage multiple deadlines independently.
  • Proficient in written and spoken English; Mandarin is an advantage to liaise with Mandarin-speaking clients.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and client service mindset
